glossary.ἐλθοῦσ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἐλθοῦσ’ = ἐλθοῦσα)
glossary.ἐλθοῦσα: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having come, going’
glossary.ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
glossary.ἐξαύδα: ἐξαυδάω — speak out, utter; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἐπέπλεον: ἐπιπλέω — sail over, sail upon (+ acc.); impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; prep. + dat./acc./gen., accented before the enclitic τε; ἐπί τε … καί ’both to … and’ · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπί τ’ … ἠμύει ’bows down upon’)
glossary.ἐπαίτιοι: ἐπαίτιος — to blame, culpable; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπασσύτεροι: ἐπασσύτερος — one upon another, in close succession (traditional sense; formation unclear); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπαύρωνται: ἐπαυρίσκω — get the result of, enjoy or suffer (+ gen.); aor. subj. 3 pl. mid. (ἐπαύρωμαι), in a purpose clause
glossary.ἐπεπείθεθ: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., elided (ἐπεπείθεθ’ = ἐπεπείθετο; Attic ἐπείθετο)
glossary.ἐπηπείλησ: ἐπαπειλέω — threaten, make a threat against; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐπηπείλησ’ = ἐπηπείλησε)
glossary.ἐρέοντο: ἐρέομαι — ask, enquire; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἠρέοντο)
glossary.ἐστί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg.; with a perf. part., periphrastic perfect: ’has been, is done’
glossary.ἑκάτοιο: ἕκατος — far-darter (epithet of Apollo, probably a short form of ἑκατηβόλος; sense not certain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἑκατηβόλου: ἑκατηβόλος — far-shooting; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Apollo
glossary.ἑκατόμβας: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἑλίκωπες: ἑλίκωψ — quick-eyed (or with rolling eyes; meaning uncertain), epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἑλισσομένη: ἑλίσσω — turn, roll, curl; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’curling’
glossary.ἑλόντ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual, elided (ἑλόντ’ = ἑλόντε): ’the two taking’
glossary.ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
glossary.ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἑταίρῳ: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑῆος: ἑός — one’s own (possessive of any person); masc. gen. sg., epic ἑῆος; sometimes taken as gen. of ἐύς ’good’
glossary.ἔβαν: βαίνω — go; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔβαν (= Attic ἔβησαν)
glossary.ἔδησαν: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἔλσαι: εἴλω — shut in, pen, hem in; aor. inf. act. ἔλσαι (epic ἕλσαι)
glossary.ἔξαγε: ἐξάγω — lead out, bring out; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἔπει: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by word’
glossary.ἔργῳ: ἔργον — deed, action; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by deed’ · also after ἐπί: ’task, undertaking’
glossary.ἔρχεσθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 dual: ’go, you two’
glossary.ἔστων: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 dual: ’let the two be’
glossary.ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
glossary.ἔτεκές: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; aor. 2 sg., accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.ἔτισεν: τίω — honour, value; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἔτισε(ν))
glossary.ἔφ: ἐπί — on, along; prep. + acc., elided and aspirated (ἐφ’), written ἔφ’ after its noun (anastrophe)
glossary.ἔφησθα: φημί — say, speak; impf. 2 sg., epic -σθα ending (= Attic ἔφης): ’you said, boasted’
glossary.ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I took away’
glossary.ἕρδον: ἔρδω (ῥέζω) — do, perform; offer (a sacrifice); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ἠΰτ: ἠΰτε — like, as, as when; particle, elided (ἠΰτ’)
glossary.ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
glossary.ἠετίωνος: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe, father of Andromache; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἠτίμησεν: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἠτίμησε(ν))
glossary.ἡμένη: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’)
glossary.ἤθελον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl. (ἤθελον)
glossary.ἤκουσεν: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of the person heard); aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἤκουσε(ν))
glossary.ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἰδυίῃ: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. sg., epic ἰδυίῃ (= Attic εἰδυίᾳ): ’to you who know’
glossary.ἱκέσθην: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 3 dual (strong aor., ἱκέσθην), + acc. of goal: ’the two came to’
glossary.ἱλάσκεσθαι: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἴτ: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἴτ’ = ἴτε)
glossary.ἴτην: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 dual (ἴτην = Attic ᾔτην): ’the two went’
glossary.ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
glossary.ἷκεν: ἵκω — come to, reach; impf./aor. 3 sg. active ἷκεν, ν-movable, unaugmented
glossary.ὀλοιῇσι: ὀλοός — destructive, baneful; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ὀλύμπιοι: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, dwelling on Olympus; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὀμίχλη: ὀμίχλη — mist, fog; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
glossary.ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
glossary.ὀρεγνύς: ὀρέγνυμι — stretch out, reach out; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀτρηρὼ: ὀτρηρός — brisk, active, ready; masc. nom. dual
glossary.ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
glossary.ὁρόων: ὁράω — see, look; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶν)
glossary.ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄφελλεν: ὀφείλω (epic ὀφέλλω) — owe, ought; impf. 3 sg. (= ὤφελλεν), + inf., of what should have happened: ’ought to have’ · also ὀφέλλω — increase, enlarge; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤφελλεν): ’was increasing’
glossary.ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
glossary.ὑγρὰ: ὑγρός — wet, watery; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑπέδεισαν: ὑποδείδω — fear, be afraid of; aor. 3 pl. (ὑπέδεισαν), + acc.
glossary.ὑπελύσαο: ὑπολύω — loose from under, set free; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -αο (= Attic ὑπελύσω), + gen. of what one is freed from
glossary.ὑψιβρεμέτης: ὑψιβρεμέτης — thundering on high; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὤνησας: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; aor. 2 sg. act. (ὤνησας)
glossary.ὦχ: ὦκα — swiftly, quickly; adv., elided and aspirated (ὦχ’ before a rough breathing)
glossary.ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= Attic αἷς): ’in which’
glossary.ᾠχόμεθ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 1 pl. mid., elided (ᾠχόμεθ’ = ᾠχόμεθα)
glossary.ῥίγιον: ῥίγιον — worse, more grievous; comparative adj. (cf. ῥῖγος ’shudder’), neut. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.αἰθιοπῆας: Αἰθίοψ — Ethiopian, one of the Aethiopians; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -ας)
glossary.αἰνὰ: αἰνός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’in dread, grievously’
glossary.αἴθ: αἴθε — would that; epic wish particle, elided (αἴθ’ = αἴθε; = εἰ γάρ), with ὄφελες + inf. · also with an optative: ’would that he might fulfil’
glossary.αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fiery, flashing (of wine; αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’look’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴσῃ: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. dat. sg.: ’by an evil lot’ (κακῇ αἴσῃ)
glossary.αἶσα: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. nom. sg., subject: ’your lot’ (τοι αἶσα)
glossary.αὐέρυσαν: αὐερύω (= ἀνερύω) — draw back (a victim’s head before the throat is cut); aor. 3 pl. (= Attic ἀνείρυσαν)
glossary.αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
glossary.αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg., with the speaker: ’I myself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a third person: ’she herself’
glossary.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’of the men themselves’ (ποδῶν αὐτῶν τε καὶ ἵππων ’of the very men’s feet and of the horses’) · also gen. pl. standing alone for the men, as against their horses: ’of the men themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἠδ’ ἵππων ’of the men and of the horses’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with a pronoun: τῶν … αὐτῶν ’of those very men’ · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by ἀντίον: ’them’ (ἀντίον … αὐτῶν ’face to face with them’) · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by σχεδόν: ’them’ (σχεδὸν … αὐτῶν ’close to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with καί, dependent on a noun: ’their own’ (καὶ αὐτῶν θυμός ’their own heart, too’) · also plain pronoun, gen. pl. after ἀήθεσσον: ’them’ (ἀήθεσσον … αὐτῶν ’unused to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with σφῶν: ’of themselves’ (σφῶν τ’ αὐτῶν ’of themselves’)
glossary.αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv. (cf. αὖθις)
glossary.βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’ · also dat. sg. in a periphrasis: βίῃ Ἡρακληείῃ ’by the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles) · also dat. sg. of means: ’by (your) strength’ · dat. sg. of respect: ’in might’ (βίῃ δ’ ὅ γε πολλὸν ἀμείνων ’in might he is much better’)
glossary.βαῖνον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαινον)
glossary.βῆσαν: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, causative with an object: ’made go, led out’ (not the intransitive ἔβησαν ’went’)
glossary.γουνάσομαι: γουνάζομαι — entreat, beg (clasping the knees; γόνυ ’knee’); fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I will entreat’
glossary.γυναικὸς: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg., with ἐϋζώνοιο: ’of the well-girdled woman’, after χωόμενον · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀντί: ’in place of a woman’ · also fem. gen. sg., possessive: ’of the wife’ (γυναικὸς … παρειαί ’the wife’s cheeks’)
glossary.δέξατο: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδέξατο)
glossary.δήν: δήν — for a long time; adv., epic (cf. δηρόν)
glossary.δίπτυχα: δίπτυχος — twofold, double-folded; neut. acc. pl., predicative with ποιέω: ’making (it) double’
glossary.δαίνυντ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. feast, partake; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυντ’ = δαίνυντο)
glossary.δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. sg., after ἐδεύετο: ’lacked the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. depending on ἦδος: ’pleasure of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀκουάζεσθον: ’hear of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. after ἐπιδευεῖς: ’short of a feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. dependent on ἔργα: ’the business of a feast’
glossary.δαῖτα: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. sg.: ’for the feast’ (after κατά), ’a meal’ (object of τετύκοντο) · also fem. acc. sg., object of δαίνυ (’give a feast’) and of τίθει (’set a feast’)
glossary.δεξιτερῇ: δεξιτερός — right, on the right; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic δεξιᾷ), with χειρί understood: ’with the right hand’
glossary.δεπάεσσιν: δέπας — cup; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic δέπασι)
glossary.διαπρήσσουσα: διαπρήσσω (= διαπράσσω) — accomplish, make one’s way through; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ησσ-
glossary.διογενὴς: διογενής — sprung from Zeus, Zeus-born; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes
glossary.διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg. Διί
glossary.δυωδεκάτη: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἠώς: ’the twelfth dawn’
glossary.δωδεκάτῃ: δωδέκατος — twelfth; fem. dat. sg., dat. of time with ἡμέρᾳ understood: ’on the twelfth (day)’
glossary.δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), acc. sg., goal of motion after ποτί
glossary.εἶμ: εἶμι — go, shall go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense, elided (εἶμ’ = εἶμι)
glossary.εὐνὰς: εὐνή — bed; pl. εὐναί, anchor-stones (the ship’s ’bed’ on the seabed); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εὐξαμένοιο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic εὐξαμένου), after ἔκλυες: ’when I prayed’
glossary.εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — far-thundering, wide-sounding (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. acc. sg., epic short -α · also masc. nom. sg., epic short -α (εὐρύοπα Ζεύς ’far-thundering Zeus’)
glossary.εὔξαντο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’they prayed’
glossary.εὔχετο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg.: ’was praying’ (no augment written; εὐ- not lengthened to ηὐ-)
glossary.εὗρεν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 sg., epic εὗρεν (= Attic ηὗρεν), ν-movable
glossary.θέσαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσαν): ’they laid, stowed’
glossary.θέτις: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κάη: καίω — burn; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάη): ’was burned up’
glossary.κέλευθον: κέλευθος — way, path, course; fem. acc. sg. (pl. also neut. κέλευθα)
glossary.κήδε: κῆδος — care, sorrow, trouble; neut. acc. pl., elided (κήδε’ = κήδεα, uncontracted; Attic κήδη)
glossary.κακῇ: κακός — bad, evil; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person: ’a fine (one)’ (καλὸν … ἴδον ’a fine one … I saw’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζυγόν: ’a fair (yoke)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’fair (skin)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος: ’fair (plot)’
glossary.κατά: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc./gen. · also preverb in tmesis (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’); acute kept before an enclitic
glossary.κατέδυ: δύω — sink, enter, go down into; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augmented (κατά … ἔδυ): of the sun ’set, went down’ · also with acc. of armour: ’put on, clad himself in’ (κατέδυ … τεύχεα ’put on his armour’)
glossary.καῖε: καίω — burn; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαιε): ’burned’
glossary.κνέφας: κνέφας — dusk, darkness, nightfall; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’darkness’ · also neut. acc. sg., after ἐπί: ’to darkness, to nightfall’
glossary.κνίσῃ: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — fat that wraps the entrails, savour of burning fat; fem. dat. sg., of what covers: ’with fat’ · also fem. dat. sg., the savour of burnt offerings: ’with the savour’
glossary.κοιμήσαντο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. lie down to sleep; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they lay down to sleep’
glossary.κορυφῇ: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’youths!’ (κοῦροι Ἀχαιῶν ’youths of the Achaeans’)
glossary.κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. acc. sg. (object of τίθει) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’power, might’ (τοῦ κράτος ἐστὶ μέγιστον) · also neut. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive in indirect statement: ’that the strength is great’ (μέγα … κράτος εἶναι ’that the strength is great’)
glossary.κρητῆρας: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κρονίδην: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κρονίωνα: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κυδιάνειραν: κυδιάνειρα — bringing glory to men (κῦδος + ἀνήρ); fem. acc. sg., epithet of ἀγορή ’assembly’ · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of μάχη ’battle’
glossary.λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε); λαβεῖν + gen. ’take hold of’
glossary.λήθετ: λήθομαι — forget; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (λήθετ’ = λήθετο), + gen.: ’did forget’
glossary.λίπ: λείπω — leave; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λίπ’ = λίπε = ἔλιπε): ’left’ · also λίπα — richly, sleekly (adv.), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα), with ἀλείφομαι: ’richly (anointed)’
glossary.λευκὰ: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.λεῖβε: λείβω — pour, pour as a libation; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλειβε): ’poured’
glossary.λισσομένη: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’begging’
glossary.μέλποντες: μέλπω — celebrate with song and dance; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μένων: μένω — remain, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’staying’
glossary.μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστίον: ’the middle of the sail’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀγκῶνα: ’the middle (of the elbow)’ (ἀγκῶνα … μέσον ’full on the elbow’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’the middle, the space between’ (ἐς μέσον ἀμφοτέρων ’into the space between the two’) · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with the man struck, ’through the middle’ (δουρὶ μέσον περόνησεν ’pierced him through the middle with a spear’) · also neut. acc. sg. as an adverb + gen.: ’midway between’ (μέσον τάφρου καὶ τείχεος ’midway between the ditch and the wall’) · also neut. acc. sg. of respect, of wasps: ’in the middle, at the waist’ (μέσον αἰόλοι ’nimble at the waist’)
glossary.μήνι: μηνίω — be wrathful, nurse one’s wrath (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μήνι’ = μήνιε) · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (μήνι’ = μήνιε, Attic ἐμήνιε): ’kept up his wrath’
glossary.μήνιε: μηνίω — be wrathful, nurse one’s wrath; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμήνιε): ’sat in wrath’
glossary.μίνυνθά: μίνυνθα — for a little while, briefly; adv., epic, accented before the enclitic περ
glossary.μίστυλλόν: μιστύλλω — cut into small pieces; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμίστυλλον), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἕρματα · also agreeing with κύματα: ’tall (waves)’ · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βοάω: ’loudly’ (μακρὰ βοῶν) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βιβάντα: ’with long (strides)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔγχεα: ’long (spears)’
glossary.μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’
glossary.μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after; + acc.: ’to, among’ (motion) · also + dat.: ’among’ (μετ’ ἀθανάτοισιν) · also + acc., ’next after’ (μετ’ ἀμύμονα Πηλεΐωνα) · also + acc., ’after, in pursuit of’
glossary.μολπῇ: μολπή — song with dance, play; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with song and dance’
glossary.μῆρε: μηρός — thigh; μῆρα, thigh-pieces burned for the god; neut. nom. pl., spelled as if a dual (μῆρε, = μῆρ’)
glossary.νέας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νέας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl. as a noun: ’young men’ · also adj., masc. nom. pl., agreeing with μαχηταί: ’young’
glossary.νηός: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νώμησαν: νωμάω — deal out, distribute, wield; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐνώμησαν)
glossary.οὐλοχύτας: οὐλοχύται — barley scattered on a sacrificial victim (οὐλαί + χέω ’pour’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.οὔλυμπόν: Οὔλυμπος (Ὄλυμπος) — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg., accented before τε
glossary.οὖρον: οὖρος — fair wind, following wind; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ)
glossary.πάσαντο: πατέομαι — taste, partake of; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπάσαντο): ’they tasted’
glossary.πέλασαν: πελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπέλασαν)
glossary.πέτασσαν: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, doubled σσ (= Attic ἐπέτασαν)
glossary.πίθηται: πείθω — persuade; mid. be persuaded, obey; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (αἴ κε πίθηται ’if he may be persuaded’)
glossary.παιήονα: παιήων — paean, hymn of thanks or praise to Apollo; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πανημέριοι: πανημέριος — all day long; masc. nom. pl., used adjectivally where English has an adverb
glossary.παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’) · also with αὐτόφι: παρ’ αὐτόφι ’right beside’ (the suffix -φι marks place)
glossary.παρήμενος: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παύσαντο: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπαύσαντο)
glossary.παῖδά: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’daughter’ · also masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’boy, son’ (παῖδά τε νηπίαχον ’and the infant boy’)
glossary.πεμπώβολα: πεμπώβολον — five-pronged fork (Aeolic πέμπε ’five’ + ὀβελός ’spit’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.περιφραδέως: περιφραδέως — very thoughtfully, carefully (adv. of περιφραδής)
glossary.πηλῆος: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ποθέεσκε: ποθέω — long for, miss; impf. 3 sg., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’kept longing for’
glossary.ποιήσαντες: ποιέω — make, do; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having made’
glossary.πολέμου: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., after ἀποπαύεο: ’from war’ · also gen. sg. of separation after ἐκ: ’out of the war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἄτερ: ’without war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after εἶκε: ’from war’ (εἶκε … πολέμου ’withdraw from war’) · also masc. gen. sg. of separation after ἀφεξόμεθ’: ’from war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἔραται: ’for war’ (πολέμου ἔραται ’loves war’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of respect after ἀκορήτω: ’insatiate of war’
glossary.πολυβενθέος: πολυβενθής — very deep (πολύς + βένθος); masc. gen. sg., two-ending adj. with λιμένος
glossary.πολυδειράδος: πολυδειράς — many-ridged (πολύς + δειράς ’ridge’); masc. gen. sg., epithet of Olympus
glossary.πολύστονα: πολύστονος — causing many a groan, much-lamented; neut. acc. pl., with κήδεα
glossary.ποντοπόροιο: ποντοπόρος — sea-going, crossing the sea; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with νηός
glossary.πορφύρεον: πορφύρεος — dark-gleaming, surging (of water; not a colour term in this use); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῦμα · also neut. acc. sg., of a cloak: ’purple, dark-red’ (πορφύρεον φᾶρος ’a purple cloak’)
glossary.ποτοῖο: πότος — drink, drinking; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), of what fills: ’with drink’
glossary.προέρεσσαν: προερέσσω — row forward; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, doubled σσ (= Attic προήρεσαν)
glossary.προβάλοντο: προβάλλω — throw forward, cast before; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= προεβάλοντο)
glossary.προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
glossary.προτόνοισιν: πρότονος — forestay (rope bracing the mast forward); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.πρυμνήσι: πρυμνήσιον — stern-cable (mooring rope); neut. acc. pl., elided (πρυμνήσι’ = πρυμνήσια)
glossary.πρυμνήσια: πρυμνήσιον — stern-cable (mooring rope); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πρῆσεν: πίμπρημι — blow, swell, fill (a sail); aor. 3 sg. (πρῆσε, ν-movable): ’filled’
glossary.πτόλεμόν: πτόλεμος — war (epic by-form of πόλεμος); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.πωλέσκετο: πωλέομαι — go to and fro, frequent; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκ-, unaugmented: ’used to go’
glossary.πόνου: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. gen. sg., after παύσαντο: ’from toil’ · also gen. sg. after λήγω: ’(never cease) from toil’
glossary.πόσιος: πόσις — drinking, drink; fem. gen. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’husband’), after ἔρον: ’desire for drink’
glossary.σκαιῇ: σκαιός — left; fem. dat. sg., with χειρί understood: ’with the left (hand)’
glossary.σπλάγχνα: σπλάγχνον — pl. σπλάγχνα, the inner organs (heart, liver, etc.), entrails, tasted first at a sacrifice; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.στήσαντ: ἵστημι — set up; aor. 3 pl. mid., elided (στήσαντ’ = στήσαντο = ἐστήσαντο): ’they set up’
glossary.στείλαντο: στέλλω — make ready, furl (sails); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐστείλαντο)
glossary.στείρῃ: στεῖρα — the ship’s stem, cutwater; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.σχίζῃς: σχίζα — split wood, billet; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αις)
glossary.σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι: τίς δὲ σύ ἐσσι ’who are you?’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε (elided τ’): ’you’ (σύ τ’ ἐϋφρήνῃς ’that you may gladden’)
glossary.τάνυσσαν: τανύω — stretch, stretch out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, doubled σσ (= Attic ἐτάνυσαν)
glossary.τέκον: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτεκον): ’I bore’
glossary.τέρπετ: τέρπω — delight; mid. take delight, enjoy; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (τέρπετ’ = ἐτέρπετο)
glossary.τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put, give!’
glossary.τίμησας: τιμάω — honour; aor. 2 sg., σ-aorist: ’you honoured’
glossary.τίμησόν: τιμάω — honour; aor. imper. 2 sg., accented before the enclitic μοι: ’honour!’
glossary.τίσωσιν: τίω — honour, value; aor. subj. 3 pl.: ’may honour’, after ὄφρ’ ἄν
glossary.τεκοῦσα: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having borne’
glossary.τερπικεραύνῳ: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.τετύκοντό: τεύχω — make, prepare; epic reduplicated aor. 3 pl. mid. (accented before enclitic τε): ’they prepared’
glossary.τιμῇ: τιμή — honour; fem. dat. sg.: ’in honour’
glossary.τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., object of ἐρέουσα · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (τοῦτο … τέκμωρ ’this is the sign’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τοῦτο ἔπος ’this word’)
glossary.τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
glossary.τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τόδ’ αἰνὸν ἄχος ’this dread grief’)
glossary.τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
glossary.τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’until’
glossary.τἆλλα: ἄλλος — other; τἆλλα, crasis of τὰ ἄλλα: the rest, the other things; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τῖσον: τίω — honour, value; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’honour!’
glossary.φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
glossary.φθινύθεσκε: φθινύθω — waste away, perish; impf. 3 sg., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’kept wasting away’
glossary.φοίβῳ: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (’bright, radiant’); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.φωνήσασ: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (φωνήσασ’ = φωνήσασα)
glossary.χέουσα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’pouring, shedding’
glossary.χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’
glossary.χαλκοβατὲς: χαλκοβατής — with a bronze threshold or floor (sense somewhat uncertain); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶ
glossary.χερνίψαντο: χερνίπτομαι — wash one’s hands; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐχερνίψαντο)
glossary.χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable (cf. epic χερσί)
glossary.χθιζὸς: χθιζός — of yesterday; masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’yesterday’
glossary.χρυσηῒς: Χρυσηΐς — Chryseis, daughter of Chryses; fem. nom. sg. (the diaeresis marks -ηῒς)
glossary.χρύση: Χρύσης — Chryses, priest of Apollo; masc. voc. sg. Χρύση
glossary.χωόμενον: χώομαι — be angry, be incensed; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the unspoken ’him’
glossary.ψαμάθοις: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl. (Attic ψάμμος)
glossary.ἀγάννιφον: ἀγάννιφος — very snowy, snow-capped (ἄγαν + νίφω); masc. acc. sg., epithet of Olympus
glossary.ἀδάκρυτος: ἀδάκρυτος — without tears, tearless; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀείδοντες: ἀείδω — sing; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ᾄδοντες)
glossary.ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear, listen; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’listening’
glossary.ἀκροτάτῃ: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superlative ἀκρότατος, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with κορυφῇ · also fem. dat. sg., with a noun understood: ’on the topmost (part)’ (ἐπ’ ἀκροτάτῃ ’on the very top’)
glossary.ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
glossary.ἀμύμονας: ἀμύμων — blameless, noble; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνά: ἀνά — up, up along; prep. + acc., or adv. · also preverb in tmesis (ἀνά … πέτασσαν = ἀνεπέτασσαν ’spread out’); acute kept before an enclitic
glossary.ἀνάγοντο: ἀνάγω — lead up; mid. put out to sea; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἀνήγοντο): ’they put to sea’
glossary.ἀνέβη: ἀναβαίνω — go up, mount; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augmented: ’went up’
glossary.ἀνέλοντο: ἀναιρέω — take up, snatch up; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’took up’
glossary.ἀνασχών: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised’
glossary.ἀνεδύσετο: ἀναδύομαι — come up, emerge, rise up; aor. 3 sg. mid., sigmatic thematic (-σετο)
glossary.ἀνθερεῶνος: ἀνθερεών — chin, the part under the chin; masc. gen. sg., after ὑπό
glossary.ἀπήμων: ἀπήμων — unharmed, safe; adj., masc. nom. sg. · also of a thing, bringing no harm: ’harmless’ (μῦθος ἀπήμων ’harmless word’)
glossary.ἀπεβήσετο: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -ήσετο (= Attic ἀπέβη)
glossary.ἀπηύρων: ἀπαυράω — take away, deprive of; impf. 3 pl., epic (augmented ἀπ-ηύρων), + acc. of the thing taken: ’they took away’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I took away’
glossary.ἀποπαύεο: ἀποπαύομαι — cease from, keep away from (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic ἀποπαύου)
glossary.ἀτάρ: ἀτάρ — but, yet, and; conj., poetic (= αὐτάρ)
glossary.ἀϋτήν: ἀϋτή — battle-cry, shout; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄμυνον: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’ward off (from)!’ + acc. of the thing and dat. of those helped
glossary.ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄτερ: ἄτερ — apart from, without; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἐΐσης: ἐΐσος — equal, fair-shared (epic, = Attic ἴσος); fem. gen. sg., agreeing with δαιτός
glossary.ἐΰδμητον: ἐΰδμητος — well-built (ἐΰ + δέμω); masc. acc. sg., with βωμόν · also neut. acc. sg., with τεῖχος: ’well-built’
glossary.ἐδεύετο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was lacking’
glossary.ἐδητύος: ἐδητύς — eating, food; fem. gen. sg., after ἔρον: ’desire for food’
glossary.ἐκάλυψαν: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. 3 pl., augmented, in tmesis with κατά (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’)
glossary.ἐλεύσεται: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — come, go; fut. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
glossary.ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκνον · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’my (heart)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’my (might)’
glossary.ἐντὸς: ἐντός — within, inside; adv., or prep. + gen.
glossary.ἐξέταμον: ἐκτάμνω — cut out; aor. 3 pl., epic 2nd aor. (= Attic ἐξέτεμον): ’they cut out’
glossary.ἐπαρξάμενοι: ἐπάρχομαι — begin a rite, pour the first drops of a libation; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having made the first pouring’
glossary.ἐπεστέψαντο: ἐπιστέφω — crown, fill to the brim (from στέφω); aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἐπικρήηνον: ἐπικραιαίνω (= ἐπικραίνω) — fulfil, bring to pass; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic
glossary.ἐρέουσα: ἐρέω (fut. of εἶπον) — say, tell; fut. part. fem. nom. sg., epic open -έουσα (= Attic ἐροῦσα): ’to say’
glossary.ἐρετμοῖς: ἐρετμόν — oar; neut. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with oars’
glossary.ἐρύσαντό: ἐρύω — draw, drag; pull off a spit; aor. 3 pl. mid., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἐσκίδναντο: σκίδναμαι (σκεδάννυμι) — scatter, disperse; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented: ’scattered’
glossary.ἐφετμέων: ἐφετμή — command, injunction, behest; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν), after λήθετο · also fem. gen. pl., after μέμνημαι: ’of the commands’
glossary.ἐφῆκεν: ἐφίημι — send upon, let loose upon; aor. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable
glossary.ἐϋζώνοιο: ἐΰζωνος — well-girdled; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), two-ending adj. with γυναικός
glossary.ἑκάεργος: ἑκάεργος — far-working, far-shooter, epithet of Apollo (the second element is disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑκηβόλῳ: ἑκηβόλος — far-shooting (ἑκάς + βάλλω), epithet of Apollo; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑλοῦσα: αἱρέω — take, take hold of; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
glossary.ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
glossary.ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, epic enlarged ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ, agreeing with παιδός
glossary.ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they cast out’ · also ’hit, strike’: ’they struck’ · also σὺν … ἔβαλον in tmesis (= συνέβαλον): ’they joined, brought together’ (σὺν … ἔβαλον πόλεμον ’joined war’)
glossary.ἔδειραν: δέρω — flay; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they flayed’
glossary.ἔθεεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., epic open -εεν (= Attic ἔθει): ’was running, sped on’
glossary.ἔκλυες: κλύω — hear; aor. 2 sg., + gen.: ’you heard’
glossary.ἔπειραν: πείρω — pierce; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they pierced’
glossary.ἔπειτά: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv., accented ἔπειτά before an enclitic (τοι)
glossary.ἔπλεο: πέλομαι — be, come to be; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented: ’you have come to be’ (= ἔπλευ)
glossary.ἔπλετ: πέλομαι — be, come to be; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπλετ’ = ἔπλετο): ’has come to be’
glossary.ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); masc. acc. sg., object of ἕντο with ἐξ: ’put away desire’
glossary.ἔρυσσαν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. 3 pl., epic doubled σσ (= Attic εἴρυσαν): ’they hauled’
glossary.ἔστησαν: ἵστημι — set up, stand; aor. 3 pl. act., transitive: ’set, stationed’ (the intransitive aor. has the same form: ’stood’)
glossary.ἔσφαξαν: σφάζω — slaughter, cut the throat of; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they slaughtered’
glossary.ἔτρεφον: τρέφω — nurture, rear, feed; impf. 1 sg.: ’I reared’
glossary.ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’) · also pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter subject: ’holding’
glossary.ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ (ἐξ … ἕντο): ’they put away (desire)’
glossary.ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
glossary.ἕρματα: ἕρμα — support, prop (stones or props under a beached ship); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἠέλιος: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠερίη: ἠέριος — early in the morning (or, others say, in the mist); fem. nom. sg., agreeing with the subject: ’early’
glossary.ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
glossary.ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
glossary.ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
glossary.ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj. (epic)
glossary.ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
glossary.ἰούσης: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., genitive absolute: ’as the ship went’
glossary.ἱλάσκοντο: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they were appeasing’
glossary.ἱλασόμεσθα: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; aor. subj. 1 pl. mid., short vowel (= ἱλασώμεθα), after ὄφρα: ’that we may appease’
glossary.ἱστοδόκῃ: ἱστοδόκη — mast-holder, the crutch or rest that holds the lowered mast; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
glossary.ἴκμενον: ἴκμενος — favourable, following (of a wind); masc. acc. sg., in the formula ἴκμενον οὖρον
glossary.ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’
glossary.ἴψαο: ἴπτω — press hard, smite; aor. 2 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’you struck hard’
glossary.ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent’
glossary.ἵκανεν: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’came to’
glossary.ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
glossary.ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὀλύμπιε: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὀφέλλωσίν: ὀφέλλω — increase, exalt; pres. subj. 3 pl., accented before the enclitic ἑ: ’may increase’
glossary.ὀϊζυρὸς: ὀϊζυρός — wretched, miserable; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄνησα: ὀνίνημι — help, benefit; aor. 1 sg. act., + acc.: ’I helped’
glossary.ὄφελες: ὀφείλω — owe, ought; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (ὄφελες = ὤφελες) with an inf. in a wish: ’would that you had’
glossary.ὅρμον: ὅρμος — anchorage, roadstead (cf. ὁρμίζω ’bring to anchor’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’)
glossary.ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
glossary.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’)
glossary.ὑφέντες: ὑφίημι — let down, lower; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lowered’
glossary.ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
glossary.ὠκεανὸν: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκυμορώτατος: ὠκύμορος — swift to one’s doom, short-lived; superlative ὠκυμορώτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’the most short-lived’
glossary.ὠκυπόροισι: ὠκυπόρος — swift-going, swift-sailing; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις; a two-ending adjective), agreeing with νηυσί
glossary.ὠκύμορος: ὠκύμορος — swift to one’s doom, short-lived (ὠκύς + μόρος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὠμοθέτησαν: ὠμοθετέω — lay raw pieces (on the burning offering) (ὠμός ’raw’ + τίθημι ’place’); aor. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ὤπτησάν: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. 3 pl. act., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
glossary.ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
glossary.ῥέξαι: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. inf. act.: ’to offer’ · also ’do, act’; aor. inf. act. (ὧδε δὲ ῥέξαι ’to do thus’)
glossary.ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn
glossary.αἰγλήεντος: αἰγλήεις — gleaming, radiant; masc. gen. sg., epic -ήεις adjective (epithet of Olympus)
glossary.αἰνότατε: αἰνός — dread, terrible; superl. masc. voc. sg. αἰνότατε: ’most dread one’, in address
glossary.αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly; adv. from αἰνός, intensifying a verb of feeling: αἰνῶς δείδοικα ’I am terribly afraid’ · also intensifying a verb of likeness: ’terribly like’ (αἰνῶς … ἔοικεν ’is terribly like’) · also doubling αἰνόθεν, in an adverbial phrase: ’terribly’ (αἰνόθεν αἰνῶς ’dreadfully, terribly’)
glossary.αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’ · also fem. nom. pl. with a dual verb (a dual subject, two goddesses): ’the two’
glossary.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a dative: ’to her herself’ (αὐτῇ περ νοεούσῃ ’even though she herself understands’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἅμα: ’with her’ · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἐν, of a thing: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ ’in it’)
glossary.αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
glossary.βηλοῦ: βηλός — threshold; masc. gen. sg., gen. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the threshold’
glossary.βουλάς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βουλεύσαντε: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; aor. part. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having planned’
glossary.βουλὰς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βοῶπις: βοῶπις — ox-eyed, with the eyes of a cow; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Hera · also epithet of a mortal woman, Clymene: ’ox-eyed’ · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’ox-eyed (Hera)’
glossary.γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’)
glossary.γλυκὺ: γλυκύς — sweet; neut. acc. sg.: ’sweet’ (γλυκὺ νέκταρ)
glossary.γλυκὺς: γλυκύς — sweet; masc. nom. sg., with ὕπνος: ’sweet’
glossary.δέος: δέος — fear, dread; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δέπας: δέπας — cup, drinking-cup; neut. acc. sg. (nom. identical)
glossary.δαιμονίη: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, uncanny; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), reproachful address: ’strange one’
glossary.δείδοικα: δείδω — fear; perf. 1 sg. with present sense, epic δείδοικα: ’I fear’
glossary.δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’
glossary.διέτμαγεν: διατμήγω — cut apart; aor. 2 pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= -ησαν), ’parted’; can agree with a dual subject
glossary.διί: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. dat. sg. (Διί, from the stem Δι-)
glossary.διείρεο: διείρομαι — question closely, ask all about; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic διείρου)
glossary.δικαζέμεν: δικάζω — judge, give judgement, decide; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic δικάζειν)
glossary.δολομῆτα: δολομήτης — of crafty counsel, wily; masc. voc. sg., epic -α: ’wily one’, in address
glossary.δυνήσομαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall be able’
glossary.δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
glossary.δὴν: δήν — for a long time, long; adv.
glossary.δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰδέω: οἶδα — know; subj. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰδῶ), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I may know’
glossary.εἰδήσειν: οἶδα — know; fut. inf. εἰδήσειν (fut. εἰδήσω), after ἐπιέλπεο: ’to be going to know’
glossary.εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., completing τέτληκας: ’to speak out, to tell’ · also inf. after ἐπιστάμενος: ’(know how) to speak’ · also aor. inf. after ἀνώγῃ: ’to speak’ (θυμὸς ἀνώγῃ εἰπεῖν ’the heart bids (him) speak’)
glossary.εἰσ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἰσ’ = εἰσί): ’are’
glossary.εἴρετο: ἔρομαι (εἴρομαι) — ask, question; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἤρετο): ’asked’
glossary.εἴρομαι: ἔρομαι (εἴρομαι) — ask, question; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic: ’I ask’
glossary.εἴσεται: οἶδα — know; fut. 3 sg. mid. εἴσεται, epic: ’will know’
glossary.εὔκηλος: εὔκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεινομένην: θείνω — strike, beat; pres. part. pass. fem. acc. sg.: ’being struck’
glossary.θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
glossary.θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.θεσπεσίοιο: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, marvellous, divinely great; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= -ου)
glossary.θρόνου: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θυμοῦ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κάθησο: κάθημαι — sit; pres. imper. 2 sg. κάθησο: ’sit!’
glossary.κάππεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 1 sg. κάππεσον, with κατά assimilated to the next consonant (= κατέπεσον): ’I fell down’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, subject plural: ’they fell down’
glossary.καθάπτεσθαι: καθάπτομαι — accost, address (+ acc., with words); pres. inf. mid., standing for an imperative: ’address him’
glossary.καθέζετ: καθέζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (καθέζετ’ = καθέζετο)
glossary.καθεῦδ: καθεύδω — sleep, lie asleep; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (καθεῦδ’ = καθεῦδε; Attic ἐκάθευδε)
glossary.καθῆστο: κάθημαι — sit; plpf. form 3 sg. καθῆστο with impf. sense (= ἐκάθητο): ’was sitting’
glossary.κακκείοντες: κατακείω — wish to lie down (desiderative of κεῖμαι); pres. part. masc. nom. pl., κακκείοντες = κατακείοντες
glossary.καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κατάνευσον: κατανεύω — nod assent to, grant by a nod; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’grant it!’
glossary.καταδύντα: καταδύω — go down, set; aor. part. masc. acc. sg. (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’)
glossary.καταδύντι: καταδύω — sink, set (of the sun); intrans. aor. part., masc. dat. sg., temporal: ’as it sank’
glossary.κατανεύσομαι: κατανεύω — nod assent, grant; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall nod assent’
glossary.κατανεύσω: κατανεύω — nod assent, grant; aor. subj. 1 sg. (short vowel) or fut., after κεν: ’I nod assent to’
glossary.κατανεῦσαι: κατανεύω — nod assent, promise; aor. inf. act.
glossary.κερτομίοισι: κερτόμιος — taunting, mocking; adj. used as noun, dat. pl., epic -οισι: ’with taunts’
glossary.κεφαλῇ: κεφαλή — head; fem. dat. sg., of the means: ’with a (nod of the) head’ · also dative of measure: ’by a head’ (κεφαλῇ … μείζονες ’taller by a head’) · also fem. dat. sg., with ἀμφί: ’about the head’
glossary.κλυτοτέχνης: κλυτοτέχνης — famed for skill, renowned craftsman; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hephaestus
glossary.κοιμᾶθ: κοιμάομαι — sleep, lie down to rest; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (κοιμᾶθ’ = κοιμᾶτο, Attic ἐκοιμᾶτο): ’used to sleep’
glossary.κολῳὸν: κολῳός — brawl, din, wrangling; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐλαύνετον: ’a brawl’
glossary.κομίσαντο: κομίζω — take care of, tend; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκομίσαντο): ’took in and tended’
glossary.κρατὸς: κάρη — head; gen. sg. κρατός, from the by-form κράς, gen. of separation: ’from his head’
glossary.κρητῆρος: κρατήρ — mixing bowl; masc. gen. sg., epic κρητήρ (= Attic κρατήρ)
glossary.κρονίδη: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus, patronymic/epithet of Zeus; voc. sg.
glossary.κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
glossary.κρυπτάδια: κρυπτάδιος — secret, hidden; neut. acc. pl. used as a noun: ’secret things’
glossary.κυανέῃσιν: κυάνεος — dark, dark-blue; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.κύπελλον: κύπελλον — cup, goblet; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λήθω: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); pres. 1 sg., epic λήθω: ’I escape (your notice)’
glossary.λήμνῳ: Λῆμνος — Lemnos, an island of the northern Aegean; fem. dat. sg., place where, after ἐν
glossary.λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
glossary.λαμπρὸν: λαμπρός — bright, shining; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’brightly’
glossary.λευκωλένῳ: λευκώλενος — white-armed; two-ending adj., dat. sg. (fem. with a woman’s name), epithet of women
glossary.λοίγια: λοίγιος — ruinous, deadly; neut. nom./acc. pl. (λοίγια ἔργα ’ruinous deeds’)
glossary.μάχῃ: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg. μέ, accented because an enclitic follows: ’me’
glossary.μέγιστον: μέγας — great; superl. neut. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
glossary.μέλλει: μέλλω — be about to, be destined, be likely (+ inf.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.μαλακοῖσιν: μαλακός — soft, gentle; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.μειδήσασα: μειδάω — smile; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having smiled’
glossary.μελήσεται: μέλω — be a care to (+ dat.); fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will be a care, will concern’
glossary.μεμαῶτα: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. part. (pres. sense) masc. acc. sg. μεμαώς, μεμαῶτα: ’eager, straining’
glossary.μετάλλα: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask after; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted -αε → -α: ’ask!’
glossary.μεταλλῶ: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask after; pres. 1 sg., contracted: ’I inquire’
glossary.μεῖναι: μένω — stay, wait; aor. inf., complementing ἔτλη: ’to stand firm, to wait for’
glossary.μουσάων: Μοῦσα — Muse; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μύθους: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
glossary.νέκταρ: νέκταρ — nectar, the gods’ drink; neut. acc. sg. (nom. identical)
glossary.νεικείῃσι: νεικέω — quarrel with, rebuke; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic νεικῇ), after ὄφρα μή: ’lest he rebuke’
glossary.νεικεῖ: νεικέω — quarrel with, rebuke; pres. 3 sg., contracted (epic νεικέει): ’she quarrels with’
glossary.νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
glossary.νεῦσε: νεύω — nod; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνευσε)
glossary.νημερτὲς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unerringly, truly’ · also neut. acc. sg. adj., agreeing with ἔπος: ’unerring (word)’
glossary.νικᾷ: νικάω — conquer, prevail; pres. 3 sg., contracted (= νικᾷ from epic νικάει)
glossary.νοήσῃ: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest she notice’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’if he notices’ (εἴ πέρ τε νοήσῃ)
glossary.νοήσῃς: νοέω — perceive, think of; aor. subj. 2 sg., indefinite after ὅττι: ’whatever you have in mind’
glossary.νοεούσῃ: νοέω — perceive, be aware; pres. part. fem. dat. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοούσῃ): ’being aware’
glossary.νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’apart from, without’
glossary.οἰνοχόει: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine, serve wine; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ᾠνοχόει)
glossary.οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., with the suffix -δε: οἶκον δέ ’homeward, to his house’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, after κατά: ’in the house, at home’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, goal after εἰς: ’into the house’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, goal after πρός: ’to the house’
glossary.οὐρανίωνες: Οὐρανίων — child of Uranus (Heaven) or dweller in heaven, sense disputed; masc. nom. pl., epic: θεοὶ Οὐρανίωνες ’the gods, the children of Heaven’
glossary.οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
glossary.παλινάγρετον: παλινάγρετος — that can be taken back, revocable; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.παράφημι: παράφημι — advise, exhort (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.: ’I advise’
glossary.παρέζετο: παρέζομαι — sit beside; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’sat beside’
glossary.παρείπῃ: παρεῖπον — talk over, win over, persuade (+ acc.); aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest she win you over’
glossary.πεποίθῃς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα be convinced, trust; perf. subj. 2 sg., purpose: ’that you may be convinced’
glossary.περικαλλέος: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.περικλυτὸς: περικλυτός — very famous, far-famed; masc. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form), epithet of Hephaestus
glossary.πεσόντα: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having fallen’
glossary.ποίησεν: ποιέω — make, build; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐποίησεν)
glossary.ποδὸς: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the part seized: ’by the foot’ · also masc. gen. sg., of the part: ’of the foot’ (ταρσὸν ποδὸς ’the sole of the foot’) · also after ἐκ: ’out of the foot’ (ἐκ ποδὸς ἕλκε)
glossary.ποιπνύοντα: ποιπνύω — bustle about, hurry busily; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’bustling’
glossary.πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
glossary.ποῖον: ποῖος — of what kind, what sort of; masc. acc. sg., interrogative: ’what sort of (word)?’
glossary.πραπίδεσσι: πραπίδες — wits, mind, understanding; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.πρόπαν: πρόπας — all through, the whole; neut. acc. sg., of time (πρόπαν ἦμαρ ’all day long’)
glossary.πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’) · also attributive, ’former’ (πρότερος πόσις ’former husband’)
glossary.πρῆξαι: πρήσσω (Attic πράσσω) — accomplish, achieve, effect; aor. inf. act.
glossary.σίντιες: Σίντιες — the Sintians, a people of Lemnos; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.στυφελίξαι: στυφελίζω — shake, dislodge by force, hurl; aor. inf. act., after ἐθέλῃσιν: ’to dislodge’
glossary.συμφράσσατο: συμφράζομαι — plan together with, contrive jointly (+ dat. of person, + acc. of the plan); aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.σφοῦ: σφός — their own, his own (possessive adj. of the 3rd person); masc. gen. sg. σφοῦ, agreeing with πατρός
glossary.σφὼ: σύ — you; dual nom. σφώ: ’you two’
glossary.τάδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (τάδ’ = τάδε): ’these things’ · also with a noun: ’these’ (τάδ’ ἔργα)
glossary.τέκμωρ: τέκμωρ — a fixed mark, sign, pledge; neut. nom. sg. (indecl.) · also goal, end, issue (τέκμωρ Ἰλίου ’the end of Ilios’)
glossary.τέτλαθι: τλάω — endure, bear; perf. imper. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’endure!’
glossary.ταράξῃ: ταράσσω — stir up, throw into confusion; aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα μή, with σύν in tmesis: ’lest he upset’
glossary.τελέσσω: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic τελέσω), after ὄφρα: ’until I accomplish’
glossary.τεταγὼν: τεταγών — seizing; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, found only in this participle (+ gen.): ’having seized’
glossary.τιμήσῃς: τιμάω — honour; aor. subj. 2 sg., after ὡς: ’that you will honour’
glossary.τοῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom. sg., elided (τοῦτ’ = τοῦτο): ’this’
glossary.φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.φέρειν: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. inf.
glossary.φέρτατός: φέρτατος — best, mightiest; superl. of φέρτερος, masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.φερόμην: φέρω — carry; impf. pass. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφερόμην): ’I was carried, I drifted’
glossary.φράζεαι: φράζομαι — consider, plan, devise; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic φράζῃ)
glossary.φρονέοντα: φρονέω — think, plan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντα)
glossary.χαλεποί: χαλεπός — harsh, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαῖται: χαίτη — hair of the head, mane; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χερείονα: χερείων (Attic χείρων) — worse, inferior; neut. nom. pl., comparative of κακός, with τά: ’the worse things’ · also masc. acc. sg., with gen. of comparison: ’worse than’ (Κεβριόναο χερείονα ’worse than Cebriones’)
glossary.χραίσμωσιν: χραισμέω — avail, help (+ dat.); aor. subj. 3 pl., after μὴ οὐ (fear): ’lest they fail to help’
glossary.χρυσόθρονος: χρυσόθρονος — golden-throned; adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses (an old alternative derives the second element from θρόνα ’embroidered flowers’)
glossary.ἀάπτους: ἄαπτος — meaning unknown (traditionally ’untouchable’ or ’irresistible’); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας
glossary.ἀγορεύειν: ἀγορεύω — speak (esp. in assembly); pres. inf.
glossary.ἀθανάτοιο: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀκέουσα: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; fem. nom. sg. ἀκέουσα: ’silent, in silence’
glossary.ἀκουέμεν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀκούειν)
glossary.ἀλεξέμεναι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀλέξειν): ’to defend’
glossary.ἀμβρόσιαι: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine, ambrosial; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμειβόμεναι: ἀμείβομαι — answer in turn, take turns; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’answering one another’
glossary.ἀμφιγυήεις: ἀμφιγυήεις — epithet of Hephaestus, conventionally ’lame in both legs’ or ’strong in both arms’; sense disputed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφικύπελλον: ἀμφικύπελλος — meaning disputed: usually ’double’ (a cup with a bowl at each end), also ’two-handled’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέπας
glossary.ἀνάσχεο: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. endure, bear; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic ἀνάσχεο (= Attic ἀνάσχου): ’endure!’ · also of an object held out, aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’hold up’ (τὸ σκῆπτρον ἀνάσχεο ’hold up the sceptre’)
glossary.ἀνέσταν: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans. (= Attic ἀνέστησαν)
glossary.ἀναΐξας: ἀναΐσσω — start up suddenly, spring up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναβάς: ἀναβαίνω — go up, climb, mount; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνεκτά: ἀνεκτός — endurable, bearable; neut. nom. pl.: οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ἀνεκτά ’no longer bearable’
glossary.ἀντίοι: ἀντίος — facing, opposite, in front; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀντιφέρεσθαι: ἀντιφέρομαι — set oneself against, match oneself with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
glossary.ἀπατηλὸν: ἀπατηλός — deceitful, deceptive; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπόειπ: ἀπεῖπον — refuse, renounce, say no; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic ἀπόειπε (= Attic ἀπεῖπε), elided
glossary.ἀπόστιχε: ἀποστείχω — go away, depart; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go away!’
glossary.ἀρήγειν: ἀρήγω — help, aid (+ dat.); pres. inf.
glossary.ἀργαλέος: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, grievous; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἀργυρόπεζα: ἀργυρόπεζα — silver-footed, epithet of Thetis; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀστεροπητής: ἀστεροπητής — lightener, wielder of lightning; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ἀστεροπητὴς: ἀστεροπητής — lightener, wielder of lightning; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ἀτελεύτητον: ἀτελεύτητος — unfulfilled, not brought to an end; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτιμοτάτη: ἄτιμος — dishonoured, without honour; superl. ἀτιμότατος, fem. nom. sg.: ’most dishonoured’
glossary.ἀφύσσων: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid), ladle out; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’drawing’
glossary.ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
glossary.ἁλίοιο: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of γέρων ’the old man of the sea’
glossary.ἄειδον: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic ἄειδον (= Attic ᾖδον)
glossary.ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι, agreeing with κτεάτεσσιν: ’the other (possessions)’
glossary.ἄλλοτ: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at other times; adv., elided (ἄλλοτ’); καὶ ἄλλοτ’ ’at another time too’
glossary.ἄσβεστος: ἄσβεστος — unquenchable, unceasing; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἅσσ: ὅστις (neut. pl. ἅσσα, epic = Attic ἅττα) — whoever, whatever; elided ἅσσ’ = ἅσσα: ’whatever things’
glossary.ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
glossary.ἐθέλωμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 1 sg., epic -μι (= Attic ἐθέλω): ’I wish’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
glossary.ἐλέλιξεν: ἐλελίζω — shake, make quake; aor. 3 sg.: ’shook’
glossary.ἐλαύνετον: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive on, stir up; pres. 2 dual: ’you two drive’
glossary.ἐμέθεν: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμέθεν (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’of me’
glossary.ἐμή: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. voc. sg. (= nom. in form), agreeing with μῆτερ: ’my (mother)’
glossary.ἐμοὺς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐμπεφυυῖα: ἐμφύω — grow in, cling to; perf. part. fem. nom. sg., intrans., epic ἐμπεφυυῖα (= Attic ἐμπεφυκυῖα): ’clinging’
glossary.ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐναντίον: ἐναντίος — opposite; neut. acc. sg. as adv./prep. + gen.: ’in front of, before’
glossary.ἐνδέξια: ἐνδέξιος — to the right; neut. acc. pl. as adv.: ’rightwards, towards the right’
glossary.ἐνῆεν: ἔνειμι — be in, be present in; impf. 3 sg., epic ἐνῆεν (= Attic ἐνῆν): ’was in (him)’
glossary.ἐνῶρτο: ἐνόρνυμι — rouse in; mid. arise among; aor. 3 sg. mid., ἐνῶρτο (ἐν + ὦρτο): ’arose among’
glossary.ἐούσῃ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. dat. sg., epic ἐούσῃ (= Attic οὔσῃ)
glossary.ἐοῦσαν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οὖσαν)
glossary.ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
glossary.ἐπίηρα: ἐπίηρα — pleasing service, gratification; neut. pl. in ἐπίηρα φέρειν ’to bring what pleases, to oblige’ (+ dat.); origin disputed
glossary.ἐπερρώσαντο: ἐπιρρώομαι — stream on, rush upon; aor. 3 pl. mid., ἐπερρώσαντο: ’streamed forward’
glossary.ἐπερχόμενον: ἐπέρχομαι — come on, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιέλπεο: ἐπιέλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic ἐπιέλπου): μὴ … ἐπιέλπεο ’do not expect’
glossary.ἐπιγνάμψασα: ἐπιγνάμπτω — bend, curb, bend to; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having curbed’
glossary.ἐπιεικὲς: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., used impersonally with ἐστί
glossary.ἐπιπείθεο: ἐπιπείθομαι — obey (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic ἐπιπείθου)
glossary.ἐρέθῃσιν: ἐρέθω — provoke, irritate; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν, after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’whenever she provokes’
glossary.ἐριδαίνετον: ἐριδαίνω (ἐρίζω) — quarrel, contend; pres. 2 dual: ’you two quarrel’
glossary.ἐσθλῆς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, fine; fem. gen. sg., with δαιτός · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with an understood βουλῆς: ’of good (counsel)’
glossary.ἐτήτυμον: ἐτήτυμος — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
glossary.ἐφήσεις: ἐφίημι — send upon, set on; fut. 2 sg., + acc. + inf.: ’you will make (me) …’
glossary.ἐφείω: ἐφίημι — send upon, lay on; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic ἐφείω (= Attic ἐφῶ); χεῖρας ἐφιέναι ’lay hands on’
glossary.ἐχθοδοπῆσαι: ἐχθοδοπέω — be at odds with, quarrel with (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἑδέων: ἕδος — seat, chair; neut. gen. pl., uncontracted (= ἑδῶν)
glossary.ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’his own’ · also neut. nom. sg., with the article, of one’s belongings: ’his own’ (τὸ δ’ ἑὸν ’his own’)
glossary.ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
glossary.ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
glossary.ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
glossary.ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
glossary.ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
glossary.ἔσεαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg., epic ἔσεαι (= Attic ἔσῃ): ’you will be’
glossary.ἔσοντ: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 pl., epic ἔσονται, elided (ἔσοντ’): ’will be’
glossary.ἔσταν: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans., epic (= Attic ἔστησαν): ’stood’
glossary.ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
glossary.ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
glossary.ἔχετ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. cling, hold on; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἔχετ’ = ἔχετο): ’kept holding on’
glossary.ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’
glossary.ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἕνεκα: ἕνεκα — on account of, for the sake of; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
glossary.ἠγνοίησεν: ἀγνοιέω (Attic ἀγνοέω) — fail to recognize, not know; aor. 3 sg. act., negated by οὐδέ: ’did not fail to recognize’
glossary.ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
glossary.ἠελίῳ: ἥλιος — sun; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέλιος (= Attic ἥλιος)
glossary.ἤϊ: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ἤϊε, elided (ἤϊ’ = ἤϊε; Attic ᾔει): ’went’
glossary.ἥρῃ: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. dat. sg. Ἥρῃ (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
glossary.ἥφαιστον: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
glossary.ἥψατο: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἦδος: ἦδος — pleasure, delight; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’ · also elided ἦρχον, impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀσκάλαφος καὶ Ἰάλμενος) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., + gen.: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀγκαίοιο πάϊς) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’
glossary.ἧχι: ἧχι — where; epic relative adv. (= Attic οὗ)
glossary.ἰδοῦσ: ὁράω — see; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἰδοῦσ’ = ἰδοῦσα; aor. stem ἰδ-): ’having seen’
glossary.ἰδυίῃσι: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. pl., epic ἰδυίῃσι (= Attic εἰδυίαις): ’skilful’
glossary.ἰόνθ: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., ἰόντα elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἰόνθ’): ’coming’
glossary.ἱκάνοι: ἱκάνω — come, reach, come upon (= ἱκνέομαι); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’might come upon’
glossary.ἵλαος: ἵλαος — gracious, propitious; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἵλεως)
glossary.ὀΐεαι: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted ὀΐεαι (= Attic οἴει): ’you suppose’
glossary.ὀλέσῃς: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. subj. 2 sg. (ὀλέσσω, Attic ὀλέσω): ’you destroy’
glossary.ὀλίγος: ὀλίγος — little, small, puny; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλύμπου: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, the mountain home of the gods; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀλύμπῳ: Ὄλυμπος (epic Οὔλυμπος) — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὀνειδείοις: ὀνείδειος — abusive, reproachful; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
glossary.ὀπὶ: ὄψ — voice; fem. dat. sg. (ὀπὶ καλῇ ’with a beautiful voice’)
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
glossary.ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
glossary.ὄχθησαν: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. 3 pl.: ’were vexed’
glossary.ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
glossary.ὑπόσχεο: ὑπίσχομαι — promise, undertake; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., ὑπόσχεο (= Attic ὑπόσχου): ’promise!’
glossary.ῥῖψε: ῥίπτω — throw, hurl; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρριψε)
glossary.αἱρήσειν: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; fut. inf. act.: ’to take’ (a city)
glossary.αἱρείτω: αἱρέω — take, seize; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it seize’
glossary.βάλετο: βάλλω — throw, cast; mid. throw on oneself, sling; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβάλετο): ’slung (round himself)’
glossary.βάλλετο: βάλλω — throw, cast; mid. throw on oneself, sling; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβάλλετο): ’he slung on’ (περὶ … βάλλετο, περί in tmesis)
glossary.βάσκ: βάσκω — go (lengthened form of βαίνω); pres. imper. 2 sg. βάσκε, elided (βάσκ’): ’go!’
glossary.βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βουληφόρον: βουληφόρος — counsel-bearing, giving counsel; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γερόντων: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.δίῳ: δῖος — bright, noble, divine (epic epithet); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαΐφρονος: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’took up (for himself)’
glossary.εἶδός: εἶδος — form, appearance, beauty; neut. acc. sg.; accented before enclitic τε
glossary.εὐρυάγυιαν: εὐρυάγυιος — wide-streeted (of a city); fem. acc. sg. εὐρυάγυιαν, agreeing with πόλιν (εὐρύς + ἄγυια ’street’)
glossary.εὕδοντ: εὕδω — sleep; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εὕδοντ’ = εὕδοντα)
glossary.εὗδον: εὕδω — sleep; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (Attic ηὗδον, ἐκάθευδον): ’they slept’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form)
glossary.ζηνὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus; dat. sg., epic stem Ζην- (Ζηνί = Διί)
glossary.θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θήσειν: τίθημι — put, place, make; fut. inf. θήσειν: ’to put, lay’ (ἐπ’ … θήσειν, ἐπί in tmesis, ’to lay upon’)
glossary.θείη: θεῖος — divine, from the gods; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α) · also τίθημι — put, make; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., in a purpose clause with κε: ’he might make’
glossary.θεῖος: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεῖός: θεῖος — divine, from the gods; adj., masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.θωρήξομεν: θωρήσσω — arm (put on the corslet, θώρηξ); aor. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel, with αἴ κεν (or fut. indic.): ’we shall arm’
glossary.θωρῆξαί: θωρήσσω — arm (put on the corslet, θώρηξ); aor. inf. act.: ’to arm’; accent from the following enclitic
glossary.κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’head’ (ἐστήριξε κάρη ’planted her head’)
glossary.κέλευε: κελεύω — command, order; pres. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευε): ’he gave orders’
glossary.κέλευσε: κελεύω — order, command; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευσε)
glossary.κέχυθ: χέω — pour, shed; epic past 3 sg., elided κέχυθ’ (form disputed; sense of κέχυτο), intrans.: ’was poured round, lay spread’
glossary.κήδεται: κήδω — trouble; mid. care for, be concerned for; pres. 3 sg. mid., + gen.: ’cares for’
glossary.κίχανεν: κιχάνω — reach, come upon, find; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκίχανεν), ν-movable: ’came upon, found’
glossary.καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, with a negative: ’not well’ (οὐ … καλὰ ’not fairly’) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’fine (gear)’
glossary.κείνῳ: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’on that day’
glossary.κελεύσω: κελεύω — urge, command, bid; fut. 1 sg. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’I shall bid’
glossary.κηρύκεσσι: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κήρυξι)
glossary.κηρύσσειν: κηρύσσω — proclaim, summon by herald; pres. inf.
glossary.κλῦτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic: ’hear!’
glossary.κομόωντας: κομάω — wear one’s hair long; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic diectasis (= Attic κομῶντας)
glossary.κρατερὰς: κρατερός — strong, mighty, stubborn; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.λήθη: λήθη — forgetfulness, oblivion; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λιγυφθόγγοισι: λιγύφθογγος — clear-voiced; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λιπαροῖσιν: λιπαρός — sleek, glistening, glossy (as skin rubbed with oil); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.μέγεθός: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.μέδοντες: μέδων — ruler, lord (part. of μέδω ’rule over’, used as noun); masc. voc. pl., address · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ἡγήτορες ἠδὲ μέδοντες ’leaders and rulers’
glossary.μέμηλε: μέλω — be a care to (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with pres. force, epic (Attic μεμέληκε): ’is a care’
glossary.μήδετο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was devising, planned’
glossary.μεγαθύμων: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μελίφρων: μελίφρων — heart-sweetening, soothing (μέλι ’honey’ + φρήν); masc. nom. sg., epithet of sleep
glossary.μερμήριζε: μερμηρίζω — ponder anxiously, be in doubt; impf. 3 sg.: ’pondered’
glossary.μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., used with an imperative to forbid: ’and let not’
glossary.νήδυμος: νήδυμος — sweet, refreshing (stock epithet of sleep; formation disputed, sometimes linked by folk-etymology to ἡδύς); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεστορέῃ: Νεστόρειος — of Nestor, Nestor’s; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -έῃ (= Attic -έᾳ)
glossary.νηγάτεον: νηγάτεος — newly made, freshly woven (exact sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νηληΐῳ: Νηλήϊος — of Neleus, Neleian (Nestor’s father); masc. dat. sg.: ’Neleus’ son’ (with υἷι)
glossary.νοσφιζοίμεθα: νοσφίζω — turn away, keep apart; mid. turn away from, withdraw; pres. opt. 1 pl. mid.: ’we should turn away (from it)’
glossary.νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration, after διά: ’(through) the night’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of a verb of covering: ’night’ (νύκτα … ἐκάλυψε) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἕλκω: ’night’ (ἕλκον νύκτα ’drawing night’) · also fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration without a preposition, with a participle: ’through the night’ (νύκτα φυλασσομένοισι ’keeping watch through the night’) · also fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration with an infinitive: ’through the night’ (νύκτα φυλασσέμεναι ’to keep watch through the night’)
glossary.ξύνες: συνίημι — understand, take heed; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic ξύν- (= σύν-): ’take heed!’
glossary.οὖλε: οὖλος — destructive, baneful (cf. ὄλλυμι ’destroy’); masc. voc. sg.: ’baneful (one)’
glossary.οὖλον: οὖλος — destructive, baneful (cf. ὄλλυμι ’destroy’); masc. acc. sg. · also οὖλος, ’whole, entire’ (Attic ὅλος), a different word
glossary.πέμψαι: πέμπω — send, convey; aor. inf. act.: ’to send’
glossary.παννύχιοι: παννύχιος — all night long; masc. nom. pl., with adverbial force: ’all night’
glossary.παννύχιον: παννύχιος — all night long; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα (or neut. adverbial): ’all night’
glossary.πανσυδίῃ: πανσυδίη — in full force, with all one’s might (πᾶς + σεύω); fem. dat. sg. used adverbially
glossary.πατρώϊον: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, ancestral; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πειρήσομαι: πειράω — try, make trial (of); fut. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic πειράσομαι), or hortatory aor. subj.: ’I shall try’
glossary.πολυκλήϊσι: πολυκλήϊς — with many oar-benches or thole-pins (sense disputed); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι
glossary.ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.πριάμου: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.προσεβήσετο: προσβαίνω — go up to, step onto; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο (cf. Attic προσέβη): ’mounted, stepped onto’
glossary.προσεφώνεε: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., augmented (προσ- + ἐ-φώνεε): ’was speaking to, addressed’
glossary.πυκινὴν: πυκινός — close-packed, dense; of counsel, shrewd; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πυλοιγενέος: Πυλοιγενής — born at Pylos, Pylos-born; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Nestor
glossary.πύλοιο: Πύλος — Pylos; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
glossary.στοναχάς: στοναχή — groan, sigh; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.συγκαλέσας: συγκαλέω — call together, summon; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having called together’
glossary.σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
glossary.τιμήσῃ: τιμάω — honour; aor. subj. 3 sg., in an indirect deliberation after ὡς: ’he should honour’
glossary.τρωσί: Τρώς — a Trojan; masc. dat. pl. (Τρῶες, Τρωσί): ’Trojans’
glossary.τῖ: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (τῖ’ = τῖε = ἔτιε): ’honoured’
glossary.υἷι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἷι (= Attic υἱεῖ)
glossary.φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
glossary.φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
glossary.φαῖμεν: φημί — say, declare; pres. opt. 1 pl., potential with κεν: ’we would say’
glossary.φράζονται: φράζομαι — consider, devise, plot; pres. mid. 3 pl.
glossary.φρεσί: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρονέοντ: φρονέω — think, ponder; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (φρονέοντ’ = φρονέοντα), epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντα)
glossary.φόως: φῶς (φάος) — light; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶς)
glossary.φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.φῆ: φημί — say, declare, assert; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφη): ’said, declared’
glossary.ψεῦδός: ψεῦδος — lie, falsehood; neut. nom./acc. sg.; accent from the following enclitic
glossary.ἀγορευέμεν: ἀγορεύω — speak, tell; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic -εύειν), used as an imperative: ’tell!’ · also plain inf. after ἔοικε: ’to speak’
glossary.ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
glossary.ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (= Attic -αν), agreeing with νύκτα: ’immortal’ · also noun ἀμβροσίη, fem. acc. sg.: ’ambrosia’ (food of the gods)
glossary.ἀμβρόσιος: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφέχυτ: ἀμφιχέω — pour around, envelop; aor. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aor. ἀμφέχυτο, elided (ἀμφέχυτ’): ’poured around, enveloped’
glossary.ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
glossary.ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες) · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’men!’
glossary.ἀνήῃ: ἀνίημι — let go, release; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ήῃ (= Attic ἀνῇ), with ἄν after εὖτε: ’lets go, releases’
glossary.ἀνῆκεν: ἀνίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’let go, released’ · also ’urged on, impelled’, with acc. of the person and an infinitive: ’impelled (you) to’
glossary.ἀποπτάμενος: ἀποπέτομαι — fly away; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg. (2nd aor. ἀπεπτάμην): ’having flown away’
glossary.ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
