glossary.ἀρτύνετο: ἀρτύνω — arrange, prepare, set in order; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’arranged, framed’
glossary.ἀτρέος: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
glossary.ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group · also ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετο): ’brought for himself’ (of taking a bride)
glossary.ἄγχιστα: ἄγχι — near; superl. adv. ἄγχιστα: ’nearest, most closely’
glossary.ἄκουσε: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσε)
glossary.ἄλγεά: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄλγη); accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
glossary.ἄνευθεν: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv.
glossary.ἄφθιτον: ἄφθιτος — imperishable, undying; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐδήσατο: δέω — bind; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’bound on (for oneself)’
glossary.ἐεισάμενος: εἴδομαι — seem; make oneself like (+ dat.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐεισάμενος: ’having likened himself (to)’
glossary.ἐκήρυσσον: κηρύσσω — proclaim, make proclamation; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐλεαίρει: ἐλεαίρω — pity, feel compassion for (epic by-form of ἐλεέω); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐνύπνιον: ἐνύπνιος — in sleep; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in sleep, in a dream’
glossary.ἐπέγναμψεν: ἐπιγνάμπτω — bend, bend to one’s will (γνάμπτω = κάμπτω); aor. 3 sg.: ’bent, swayed’
glossary.ἐπιτέλλω: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give charge to; pres. 1 sg.: ’I give charge’
glossary.ἐπιτετράφαται: ἐπιτρέπω — entrust, turn over to; perf. pass. 3 pl., epic -αται (= Attic -ανται): ’are entrusted’
glossary.ἐρητύειν: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; pres. inf., used as an imperative: ’hold (them) back!’
glossary.ἐφῆπται: ἐφάπτω — fasten upon; perf. pass. 3 sg., + dat.: ’is fastened upon’
glossary.ἐῴκει: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. with impf. force, 3 sg.: ’resembled’
glossary.ἔγρετο: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; aor. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aorist, epic (sense of Attic ἠγέρθη): ’awoke’
glossary.ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
glossary.ἔμελλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (root μελλ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented μέλλε(ν)): ’was going to, was destined’
glossary.ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
glossary.ἔνδυνε: ἐνδύω (ἐνδύνω) — put on (clothing); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented ἔνδυνε (= ἐνέδυνε): ’put on’
glossary.ἔνισπε: ἐνέπω — tell, relate; aor. 3 sg. (2nd aor. ἔνισπον): ’told’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. ἔνισπε: ’tell!’
glossary.ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
glossary.ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause of hoped-for result: ’might catch’ (εἴ τινά … ἕλοι ’to see if he might catch someone’)
glossary.ἕλοις: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you could take’
glossary.ἠγείροντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’gathered themselves’
glossary.ἠμαθόεντος: ἠμαθόεις — sandy (epithet of Pylos); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also ἠώς — morning, dawn (the time of day, not the goddess); fem. nom. sg.: ’it was morning’ (ἠὼς ἦν)
glossary.ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’leaders!’ · also masc. nom. pl., subject of ἧντ’: ’leaders (were sitting)’
glossary.ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
glossary.ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
glossary.ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἱπποκορυσταὶ: ἱπποκορυστής — armed with horses, i.e. chariot-fighters (sense uncertain; ἵππος + κορύσσω ’arm’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
glossary.ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
glossary.ἷζε: ἵζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 sg.: ’sat down’
glossary.ὀλέσῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in an indirect deliberation after ὡς: ’he should destroy’
glossary.ὀμφή: ὀμφή — voice of a god, divine utterance; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρθωθείς: ὀρθόω — set upright, raise; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised himself, sitting up’
glossary.ὑσμίνας: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
glossary.αἰσχρὸν: αἰσχρός — shameful, disgraceful; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’a shame’
glossary.αἱρήσομεν: αἱρέω — take, capture; fut. 1 pl.: ’we shall take’
glossary.αἴης: αἶα — land, earth; fem. gen. sg., epic by-form of γαῖα (= Attic γῆς)
glossary.βαθείης: βαθύς — deep; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.βαθὺ: βαθύς — deep, thick; neut. acc. sg., of standing grain: ’deep-standing’
glossary.βαρείῃ: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
glossary.βασιλῆες: βασιλεύς — king; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.βεβάασι: βαίνω — go, step; perf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic βεβᾶσι): of years, ’have gone by’
glossary.βοτρυδὸν: βοτρυδόν — in clusters, like a bunch of grapes; adv.
glossary.βουλεύσατο: βουλεύω — plan, devise; mid. devise for oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβουλεύσατο)
glossary.βουλῆς: βουλή — counsel, plan; council; fem. gen. sg. · with ἐξάρχω, ’out of the council’ · with ἐπακούω, ’(heed) the counsel’
glossary.βοόωντες: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic βοῶντες)
glossary.γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
glossary.γλαφυρῆς: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.δεδήει: δαίω — burn, blaze; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. δέδηα, intrans.): ’was ablaze’
glossary.δεκάδας: δεκάς — group of ten, ten; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δεκάδες: δεκάς — group of ten, ten; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.δευοίατο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο): ’would lack’
glossary.δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
glossary.διακοσμηθεῖμεν: διακοσμέω — arrange in order, marshal; aor. opt. pass. 1 pl.: ’were marshalled’
glossary.διακτόρῳ: διάκτορος — guide, messenger, epithet of Hermes (sense uncertain); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δοῦρα: δόρυ — beam, timber; also spear; neut. nom./acc. pl. δοῦρα, of a ship’s timbers · also δόρυ — spear; neut. acc. pl.: ’spears’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα ’sharp spears’)
glossary.δυσκλέα: δυσκλεής — inglorious; masc. acc. sg., contracted (= Attic δυσκλεᾶ), agreeing with an unexpressed ’me’
glossary.δῶκ: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δῶκ’ = ἔδωκε)
glossary.δῶκεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκεν)
glossary.εἰαρινοῖσιν: εἰαρινός — of spring; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic ἐαρινοῖς)
glossary.εἰῶσ: ἐάω — allow, let; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἰῶσ’ = εἰῶσι), epic εἰ- (= Attic ἐῶσι): ’they allow’
glossary.εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I may say’
glossary.εἵατ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 pl., epic εἵαται (= Attic κάθηνται), elided (εἵατ’ = εἵαται): ’sit’ · also impf. 3 pl., elided (εἵατ’ = εἵατο, = Attic ἧντο): ’sat’
glossary.εἶσι: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg. (neut. pl. subject with a sing. verb): ’go forth’
glossary.εὐρέα: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -έα, agreeing with νῶτα: ’broad (backs)’ · also masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic εὐρύν), agreeing with πόντον: ’wide (sea)’
glossary.εὐχωλὴν: εὐχωλή — vaunt, boast; a thing to boast of, triumph; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὖρός: Εὖρος — the East Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg., accented εὖρός before the enclitic τε
glossary.ζέφυρος: Ζέφυρος — Zephyr, the west wind; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεράποντες: θεράπων — attendant, comrade-in-arms; masc. voc. pl., in address: ’servants (of Ares)’ · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ’attendants’
glossary.θνῄσκων: θνῄσκω — die; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dying’
glossary.θυέστ: Θυέστης — Thyestes, brother of Atreus; masc. nom. sg., epic Θυέστα, elided (Θυέστ’ = Θυέστα)
glossary.θυέστῃ: Θυέστης — Thyestes, brother of Atreus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κάμε: κάμνω — toil, labour, grow weary; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμε): ’toiled’ (κάμε τεύχων ’toiled at making’)
glossary.κάρηνα: κάρηνον — head, summit; pl. mountain peaks; of a city, its towers or battlements; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., ’heads’ (ἵππων … κάρηνα, a way of saying horses)
glossary.κέλευον: κελεύω — bid, urge on; impf. 3 pl.: ’were urging’
glossary.καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’) · also + acc., ’through, throughout’ (καθ’ ὕλην ’through the wood’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (καθ’ ἵππων) · also + acc., ’according to’ (καθ’ ἡμέτερον νόον ’according to our mind’)
glossary.κακὴν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. sg. (κακὴν ἀπάτην ’an evil deceit’)
glossary.κατέλυσε: καταλύω — loosen, break down, destroy; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.κατένευσεν: κατανεύω — nod assent, promise by a nod; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κινήθη: κινέω — set in motion, stir; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was stirred’
glossary.κινήσῃ: κινέω — set in motion, stir; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after ὡς δ’ ὅτε: ’when … stirs’
glossary.κλαγγῆς: κλαγγή — clamour, din; fem. gen. sg., with παυσάμενοι: ’(ceasing) from the din’
glossary.κλισιάων: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic κλισιῶν)
glossary.κονίη: κονία — dust; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α)
glossary.κρονίδης: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus (Zeus); masc. nom. sg., patronymic
glossary.κὰδ: κατά (κάδ before δ-) — down; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (κὰδ … λίποιεν = καταλίποιεν ’leave behind’)
glossary.λάβρος: λάβρος — furious, boisterous; masc. nom. sg., of a wind
glossary.λέλυνται: λύω — loose, undo; perf. 3 pl. pass.: ’have been loosened’
glossary.λέξασθαι: λέγω — pick out, count up; aor. inf. mid.: ’to pick out for oneself’ · also λέγω — lay to rest; mid. lay oneself down, take up quarters; aor. inf. mid.: ’to lay themselves down’
glossary.λήϊον: λήϊον — standing crop, grain-field; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λίποιεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. opt. 3 pl., potential with κεν: ’would leave’
glossary.λίποιτε: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. opt. 2 pl., potential with κεν: ’you would leave’
glossary.λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
glossary.λαόν: λαός — people, host, army; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λαός: λαός — people, host, army; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λεῖπε: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλειπε)
glossary.λύσει: λύω — loose, break up; fut. 3 sg.: ’will bring down’
glossary.μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ’in the halls’
glossary.μελαίνης: μέλας, μέλαινα — black, dark; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μελισσάων: μέλισσα — bee; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’) · also with a hortatory subj.: ’and let us not’ (μηδ’ … ἀμβαλλώμεθα ’and let us not put off’) · also μηδ’ εἰ ’not even if’, before a condition with the indicative · also with an infinitive after a verb of bidding: ’and not to’ (μηδ’ ἐξέμεν ’and not to let go’)
glossary.μὰψ: μάψ — idly, to no purpose, recklessly; adv.
glossary.μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, counsel; fem. acc. sg., of respect: ’in counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of ὑφαίνειν: ’a plan’ · also object of ἐνίψει: ’cunning’ (νόον καὶ μῆτιν ’mind and cunning’) · also object of τεκτήναιτο: ’(frame) cunning’ · also fem. acc. sg. with διά: ’through the counsel (of)’ (διὰ μῆτιν Ἀθήνης ’through Athena’s counsel’)
glossary.νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
glossary.νήεσσι: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσι (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νήπια: νήπιος — childish, infant; neut. nom. pl., attributive: νήπια τέκνα ’infant children’
glossary.νήσοισι: νῆσος — island; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.νεφελάων: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
glossary.νόστος: νόστος — homecoming, return; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νότος: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νῶτα: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. pl., poetic ’the broad back of the sea’ · also acc. pl. of respect, ’on the back’ (ἐπὶ νῶτα δαφοινός ’blood-red on the back’) · also neut. acc. pl., object of βάλλω with μετά: ’the back’ (μετὰ νῶτα βαλών ’having turned the back’)
glossary.οἰνοχοεύειν: οἰνοχοεύω — pour wine, act as cupbearer; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic οἰνοχοεῖν)
glossary.οἰνοχόοιο: οἰνοχόος — wine-pourer, cupbearer; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with δευοίατο
glossary.οἴκαδε: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv., οἶκος + directional suffix -δε
glossary.οὐρούς: οὖρος — trench, ditch in which a ship is drawn up (traditional sense); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πέλοπι: Πέλοψ — Pelops, son of Tantalus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πέλοψ: Πέλοψ — Pelops, son of Tantalus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πέτρης: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πέφανται: φαίνω — show; mid./pass. appear; perf. 3 sg. pass.: ’has appeared, is plain’ · also φένω — slay; perf. pass. 3 pl. (the Homeric πέφανται): ’have been slain’ (σόοι ἠὲ πέφανται ’safe or slain’)
glossary.παντὶ: πᾶς — all, whole; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with Ἄργεϊ: ’all Argos’
glossary.πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην … πατρίδα γαῖαν ’dear native land’)
glossary.πατρίδος: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.παυροτέροισι: παῦρος — few, small; compar. παυρότερος ’fewer’; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.παυσάμενοι: παύω — stop; mid. cease from (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having ceased’
glossary.πειθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us obey’
glossary.πεποτήαται: ποτάομαι — fly about, flit; perf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic πεποτῶνται): ’flit about’
glossary.πεσόντες: πίπτω — fall, throw oneself; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having thrown yourselves (into)’
glossary.πιστὰ: πιστός — trusty, faithful; neut. acc. pl., attributive: ὅρκια πιστά ’faithful oaths’
glossary.πλάζουσι: πλάζω — drive astray, baffle, hinder; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.πλέας: πλείων — more; masc. acc. pl., epic πλέας (= Attic πλείονας), with υἷας
glossary.πληθὺν: πληθύς — throng, crowd, multitude; fem. acc. sg.: μετὰ πληθύν ’through the throng’
glossary.πληξίππῳ: πληξίππος — horse-lashing, driver of horses; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Pelops
glossary.ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
glossary.πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
glossary.πολλάων: πολύς — much, many; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic πολλῶν)
glossary.πολλέων: πολύς — much, many; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic πολλῶν)
glossary.πολλαί: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πολλῇσιν: πολύς — much, many; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic πολλαῖς)
glossary.πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — of many devices, resourceful; masc. voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
glossary.πολύαρνι: πολύαρνος — rich in lambs, rich in sheep; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Thyestes
glossary.πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’a great host’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with χρόνον: ’a long (time)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅμιλον: ’a great (throng)’ (πολὺν καθ’ ὅμιλον ’through the great throng’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόνον: ’much (toil)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄμβρον: ’a great (rain)’
glossary.ποτιδέγμεναι: ποτιδέχομαι — await, wait for; pres. inf. mid., epic ποτι- and -μεναι (= Attic προσδέχεσθαι)
glossary.πριάμῳ: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
glossary.πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πυθέσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn, hear of; aor. inf. mid., epexegetic: αἰσχρὸν … πυθέσθαι ’a shame to hear of’ · also aor. inf. mid. + gen., after πρίν: ’(before I) learn of’ (πρίν … πυθέσθαι ’before I hear of’) · also aor. inf. mid. in tmesis with ἔκ (ἐκπυθέσθαι): ’to find out’ (ἔκ τε πυθέσθαι) · also aor. inf. mid. of purpose, after προέηκε: ’to find out’ (ὅ με προέηκε πυθέσθαι ’who sent me to find out’)
glossary.πόντου: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πᾶσ: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., elided (πᾶσ’ = πᾶσα), agreeing with ἀγορή
glossary.σέσηπε: σήπω — make rot; perf. 3 sg., intrans.: ’has rotted’ (neut. pl. subject with a sing. verb)
glossary.σκηπτοῦχοι: σκηπτοῦχος — sceptre-bearing, sceptred; masc. nom. pl., adj. with βασιλῆες
glossary.σπάρτα: σπάρτον — rope, cable; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.σπουδῇ: σπουδή — haste, effort; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in haste, with effort’
glossary.στεναχίζετο: στεναχίζω — groan, sigh, resound with groaning; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass.
glossary.σφεας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. pron. (= Attic σφᾶς): ’them’
glossary.σφισιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic σφίσιν): ’among them, to them’
glossary.σχέτλιος: σχέτλιος — cruel, ruthless, hard-hearted; masc. nom. sg., of a person or god
glossary.σχοίατ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. hold oneself back from (+ gen.); aor. opt. mid. 3 pl., elided, epic σχοίατο (= Attic σχοῖντο)
glossary.τέλος: τέλος — end, fulfilment, outcome; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., as object (τέλος πολέμοιο κιχείω ’I find the end of the war’) · also neut. acc. sg. with the -δε of direction (τέλος δέ ’to the end’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐς, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐς … τέλος ’to the company’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐπί, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐπὶ … τέλος)
glossary.ταμόντες: τάμνω (τέμνω) — cut; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic τάμνω (= Attic τεμόντες): ὅρκια ταμόντες ’cutting a sworn pact’
glossary.τετρήχει: ταράσσω — stir, trouble; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. τέτρηχα, intrans.): ’was in an uproar’
glossary.τεύχων: τεύχω — make, fashion; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’making’
glossary.τοιόνδε: τοιόσδε — such as this, of this kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν
glossary.τοσόνδε: τοσόσδε — so great, so large; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν
glossary.τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
glossary.τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τρῶές: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.φίλης: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φεύγωμεν: φεύγω — flee; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us flee’
glossary.φεύξεσθ: φεύγω — flee; fut. 2 pl. mid., elided (φεύξεσθ’ = φεύξεσθε): ’you will flee’
glossary.φεύξονται: φεύγω — flee; fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’they will flee’
glossary.φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φορῆναι: φορέω — carry, bear; pres. inf., epic -ῆναι (= Attic φορεῖν)
glossary.φὴ: φή — like, as; epic adv. of comparison (= ὡς), introducing a simile
glossary.φῶτα: φώς — man, mortal; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀΐξασα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγέροντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic (= ἠγέροντο): ’gathered’
glossary.ἀγανοῖς: ἀγανός — gentle, soothing; masc./neut. dat. pl., attributive: ἀγανοῖς ἐπέεσσιν ’with gentle words’
glossary.ἀγορή: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering-place; fem. nom. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγορήν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering-place; fem. acc. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγορὴ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. nom. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
glossary.ἀειρομένη: ἀείρω — lift, raise; mid. rise up; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic αἰρομένη): ’rising’
glossary.ἀκούσειαν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to (+ gen.); aor. opt. 3 pl.: ’might listen to’
glossary.ἀκράαντον: ἀκράαντος — unaccomplished, fruitless; neut. acc. sg., predicate: ’in vain’
glossary.ἀλαλητῷ: ἀλαλητός — war-cry, shout; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a shout’
glossary.ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἀμφιελίσσας: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved at both ends (standing epithet of ships); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀπάτην: ἀπάτη — deceit, trick; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπονέεσθαι: ἀπονέομαι — go back, return; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπονεῖσθαι)
glossary.ἀπόλοντο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. ἀπόλλυμαι, perish, die; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic ἀπόλοντο (= Attic ἀπώλοντο)
glossary.ἀργείην: Ἀργεῖος — Argive, of Argos; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -είην (= Attic Ἀργείαν)
glossary.ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀργεϊφόντῃ: ἀργεϊφόντης — Argeïphontes, epithet of Hermes, of unknown or disputed meaning; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
glossary.ἀριθμηθήμεναι: ἀριθμέω — count, number; aor. inf. pass., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic ἀριθμηθῆναι): ’to be counted’
glossary.ἀσταχύεσσιν: ἀστάχυς (= στάχυς) — ear of grain; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
glossary.ἀτάλαντον: ἀτάλαντος — equal in weight, matching (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρέϊ: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἀτρεῖ)
glossary.ἀτρεὺς: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτρυτώνη: Ἀτρυτώνη — Atrytone, cult-title of Athena, traditionally ’the Unwearied’, though the derivation is uncertain; fem. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀϋτὴ: ἀϋτή — shout, battle-cry; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀϋτῆς: ἀϋτή — shout, battle-cry; fem. gen. sg., with σχοίατο: ’(refrain) from shouting’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on a noun (’of the battle-cry’) and as object of ἀκούετο: ’heard the cry’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by μεμαυῖα: ’eager for (the battle-cry)’
glossary.ἁδινάων: ἁδινός — thronging, close-packed, clamorous (sense debated); fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἄγεθ: ἄγω — lead, bring; imper. 2 pl., elided (ἄγεθ’ = ἄγετε), as an interjection: ’come now!’
glossary.ἄνθεσιν: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)
glossary.ἄπρηκτον: ἄπρηκτος — fruitless, without result; two-ending adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόλεμον
glossary.ἄργος: Ἄργος — Argos, the Argive land (Greece); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also the Pelasgian Argos, a district of northern Greece; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως) · also by metonymy ’war’ (ἔριδα Ἄρηος ’the strife of war’)
glossary.ἄτῃ: ἄτη — blind folly, delusion, ruin; fem. dat. sg., of means
glossary.ἅλις: ἅλις — in crowds, in abundance, enough; adv.
glossary.ἅπτεσθαι: ἅπτομαι — take hold of, lay hold of (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἅπτετ: ἅπτομαι — take hold of, touch (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἅπτετ’ = ἅπτετο)
glossary.ἐγχέσπαλοι: ἐγχέσπαλος — spear-brandishing, spear-wielding; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐθέλοιμεν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 1 pl., in a condition after εἴ περ: ’if we were willing’
glossary.ἐθέλοντα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’(me) though I wish’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a relative: ’wishing (to hang back)’
glossary.ἐκπέρσαντ: ἐκπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐκπέρσαντ’ = ἐκπέρσαντα): ’having sacked’
glossary.ἐνέδησε: ἐνδέω — bind in, entangle; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐξεκάθαιρον: ἐκκαθαίρω — clear out, clean out; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐξῆρχε: ἐξάρχω — lead off, lead the way, begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπάκουσαν: ἐπακούω — listen to, give heed to (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl.: ’heeded’
glossary.ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’allies!’
glossary.ἐπαΐξας: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπαιγίζων: ἐπαιγίζω — swoop down on like a squall, of wind (sense traditional); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπανέστησαν: ἐπανίστημι — rise up; aor. 3 pl. act., intrans.: ’rose up’
glossary.ἐπεσσεύοντο: ἐπισεύομαι — hurry on, rush to; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐπεσεύοντο): ’hastened on’
glossary.ἐρήτυε: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold back!’
glossary.ἐρήτυθεν: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -θεν (= Attic ἠρητύθησαν): ’were held back’
glossary.ἐρήτυον: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; impf. 3 pl.: ’were holding back’
glossary.ἐρεισάμενος: ἐρείδω — prop, lean; mid. lean on; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’leaning (on)’
glossary.ἐρχομενάων: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic ἐρχομένων): ’coming’
glossary.ἐρώει: ἐρωέω — hold back, hang back; pres. imper. 2 sg., after μηδ’: ’do not hang back’
glossary.ἐσσεύοντο: σεύω — set moving; mid. rush, hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic augment with doubled σ (ἐσσ-): ’rushed’
glossary.ἐσσομένοισι: εἰμί — be; fut. part. masc. dat. pl., epic ἐσσομένοισι (= Attic ἐσομένοις): ’to those yet to be’
glossary.ἐστιχόωντο: στιχάομαι — march in rows, go in ranks; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐστιχῶντο)
glossary.ἐτύχθη: τεύχω — make, bring about; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’came to pass’
glossary.ἐφέστιοι: ἐφέστιος — at the hearth, resident; masc. nom. pl.: ’householders’
glossary.ἐϋσσέλμοιο: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (of ships; σέλματα are the rowing-benches); fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑλκέμεν: ἕλκω — drag, haul; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἕλκειν)
glossary.ἑλοίμεθα: αἱρέω — take; mid. choose; aor. opt. mid. 1 pl. (stem ἑλ-), potential: ’we would choose’
glossary.ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑσταότ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα, Attic ἑστηκότα): ’standing’
glossary.ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
glossary.ἔθνεα: ἔθνος — tribe, throng, swarm; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔθνη)
glossary.ἔλιπεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔπ: ἐπί — to, towards; prep. + acc., following its noun with accent thrown back (ἔπι) and elided (ἔπ’) · also = ἔπεστι, ’is upon’: ἔπι (ἔπ’) as predicate, no case (εἶδος ἔπ’ ’beauty is upon him’)
glossary.ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα), elided (ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
glossary.ἕκαστοι: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. pl.: ’each of us’ · also ’each’ of a body of men, in apposition to the whole army (’each company’)
glossary.ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
glossary.ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
glossary.ἠμύει: ἠμύω — bow, droop, sink down; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἠϊόνος: ἠϊών — shore, beach; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἡμέτεραί: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
glossary.ἥρωες: ἥρως — hero; masc. voc. pl. (same as nom.), in address: ’heroes!’ · also nom. pl., subject: ’the heroes’ (ἥρωες Δαναοί … διδοῦσιν)
glossary.ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., attracted into the case of its antecedent: ’which’ (τῆς … γενεῆς ἧς ’the breed which’)
glossary.ἰκαρίοιο: Ἰκάριος — Icarian, of the Icarian Sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰλαδὸν: ἰλαδόν — in troops, in companies; adv.
glossary.ἱεμένων: ἵεμαι — hasten, press on, be eager; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’hastening’
glossary.ἱζόντων: ἵζω — sit down, take a seat; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’as they sat down’
glossary.ἱκόμεσθα: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we came’
glossary.ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
glossary.ἵστατ: ἵστημι — set; mid. stand, rise; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵστατ’ = ἵστατο): ’rose, stood up’
glossary.ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
glossary.ὀτρύνουσ: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ὀτρύνουσ’ = ὀτρύνουσα): ’urging’
glossary.ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’stirred’
glossary.ὄσσα: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report; Ossa, Rumour personified as a messenger of Zeus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὅμαδος: ὅμαδος — din, uproar of a crowd; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
glossary.ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
glossary.ὑπένερθε: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, underneath, beneath; adv., also + gen.: ποδῶν ὑπένερθε ’beneath their feet’
glossary.ὑπέρμορα: ὑπέρμορα — beyond fate, contrary to destiny; adv. (neut. pl. of ὑπέρμορος)
glossary.ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
glossary.ὑπερμενέϊ: ὑπερμενής — overmastering, very mighty; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
glossary.ὤλεσα: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 1 sg.: ’I lost’
glossary.ὤρορ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. 3 sg. (reduplicated ὤρορε), elided (ὤρορ’ = ὤρορε)
glossary.ᾕρεον: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾕρουν); with ὑπό in tmesis, ’they took away from under’
glossary.αἰγιαλῷ: αἰγιαλός — beach, shore; masc. dat. sg., of place: ’on the beach’
glossary.αἰδῶ: αἰδώς — shame, sense of shame; fem. acc. sg.; of what is covered, ’the shame’, i.e. the private parts
glossary.αἱματόεσσα: αἱματόεις — bloody, blood-red; fem. nom. sg., epic -όεσσα (= Attic -όεισα)
glossary.αἴσχιστος: αἰσχρός — shameful, ugly; superl. αἴσχιστος, masc. nom. sg.: ’ugliest’
glossary.αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’)
glossary.βασιλεύσομεν: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; fut. 1 pl.: ’we shall be kings’
glossary.βασιλεῦσιν: βασιλεύς — king; masc. dat. pl.: ἐριζέμεναι βασιλεῦσιν ’to strive with kings’
glossary.βασιλῆας: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.βουλεύῃσι: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic -ῃ), in a purpose clause: ’that he may take counsel’
glossary.βουλῇ: βουλή — counsel, plan, council; fem. dat. sg. (ἐν βουλῇ ’in council’) · also fem. dat. sg. of respect, no preposition: ’in counsel’ (βουλῇ … ἄριστος ’best in counsel’) · also fem. dat. sg., object of πείθομαι: ’counsel’ (βουλῇ … πίθοντο ’obeyed the counsel’)
glossary.βοόωντά: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic βοῶντα)
glossary.βοῶν: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., contracted (= epic βοόων): ’shouting’ · also βοῦς — ox, cow; fem./masc. gen. pl.: ’of cattle’ (βοῶν δημὸν ’the fat of oxen’)
glossary.βρέμεται: βρέμω — roar, resound; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’roars’, of the sea
glossary.βροτὸν: βροτός — mortal; masc. acc. sg., as a noun: ’mortal man’ (βροτὸν ἄλλον ’another mortal’)
glossary.γέλασσαν: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -σσ- and unaugmented (= ἐγέλασαν)
glossary.γέρα: γέρας — prize of honour, due portion; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.γελοίϊον: γέλοιος — laughable, ridiculous; neut. sg., epic -οῖος with diaeresis, predicate of an infinitive: ’laughable’
glossary.γυναῖκα: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. pl.: ’women’
glossary.δέξατό: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδέξατο): ’received’ (+ dat. of the giver)
glossary.δήμου: δῆμος — people, common folk (also the land of a people); masc. gen. sg.: δήμου ἄνδρα ’a man of the people’
glossary.δήσας: δέω — bind, tie; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having bound’
glossary.δίεπε: διέπω — manage, set in order; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= διεῖπε): ’marshalled’
glossary.δαιμόνι: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, odd; voc. sg., elided (δαιμόνι’ = δαιμόνιε), as address: ’strange one’ (gentle or chiding, tone uncertain)
glossary.δαναοί: Δαναοί — the Danaans, i.e. the Greeks (= Achaeans, Argives); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δειδίσσεσθαι: δειδίσσομαι — be frightened, fear (epic; same stem as Attic δεδίττομαι ’frighten’); pres. inf. mid.: ’to be frightened’
glossary.διδοῦσιν: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic διδόασι)
glossary.δύσω: δύω — strip off, put off (trans.); fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall strip’, with ἀπό in tmesis
glossary.εἰσὶν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they are’
glossary.εἴην: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 1 sg.: ’I would be’ · also in a wish or self-curse: ’may I (not) be’
glossary.εἴπεσκεν: εἶπον — say, speak; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic εἶπε): ’would say, used to say’
glossary.εἴσαιτο: εἴδομαι — seem, appear (+ dat.); aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in an indefinite relative clause: ’whatever might seem’
glossary.εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’clothes’
glossary.εὐρυβάτης: Εὐρυβάτης — Eurybates, Odysseus’ herald (’wide-strider’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θέειν: θέω — run; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῖν)
glossary.θήν: θήν — surely, indeed; epic enclitic particle (= Attic δήπου)
glossary.θαλερὸν: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, swelling; adj., neut. nom. sg.: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’an abundant tear’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’blooming, in his prime’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δάκρυ: ’abundant’ (θαλερὸν κατὰ δάκρυ χέουσα ’shedding abundant tears’)
glossary.θερσίτης: Θερσίτης — Thersites, a common soldier of the Greek army; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θερσῖτ: Θερσίτης — Thersites; masc. voc. sg., elided (Θερσῖτ’ = Θερσῖτα): ’Thersites!’
glossary.κατίσχεαι: κατίσχω (= κατέχω) — hold, keep back for oneself; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ), in a relative clause: ’whom you keep back’
glossary.κεκλήγων: κλάζω — shriek, cry loudly; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -ων (= κεκληγώς), present sense: ’shrieking’
glossary.κεκλημένος: καλέω — call, name; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’called’
glossary.κερτομέων: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, jeer at; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κερτομῶν)
glossary.κεφαλήν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in the head’
glossary.κιχήσομαι: κιχάνω — come upon, find, reach; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic: ’I shall find’
glossary.κιχείη: κιχάνω — come upon, find, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg., athematic (ἔκιχον, κιχείην), in a general relative clause: ’whom he might come upon’ · also in a main clause with κε, potential: ’would reach, would come upon’
glossary.κλαίοντα: κλαίω — weep; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’weeping’
glossary.κλισίαι: κλισίη — hut, tent; fem. nom. pl., Ionic -ίη (= Attic κλισία)
glossary.κλισίῃς: κλισίη — hut, tent; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic κλισίαις)
glossary.κοίρανος: κοίρανος — ruler, commander, lord; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοιρανέων: κοιρανέω — rule, be lord, command; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κοιρανῶν)
glossary.κορύσσων: κορύσσω — arm, equip; of war, array, stir up; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοτέοντο: κοτέομαι — be angry, bear a grudge (+ dat.); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic uncontracted
glossary.κρόνου: Κρόνος — Cronus, father of Zeus; masc. gen. sg.: Κρόνου πάϊς ’son of Cronus’ is Zeus
glossary.κυρτὼ: κυρτός — bent, humped; masc. dual nom., agreeing with ὤμω: ’humped’
glossary.κόμισσε: κομίζω — take care of, tend, look after; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ (= ἐκόμισε), unaugmented
glossary.κόσμον: κόσμος — order, due order, propriety; masc. acc. sg. (οὐ κατὰ κόσμον ’not in due order’)
glossary.λάχνη: λάχνη — wool, downy hair; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λέγ: λέγω — say, tell; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (λέγ’ = ἔλεγε): ’kept saying’
glossary.λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’, ’having seized’
glossary.λαούς: λαός — people, men; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.λιγύς: λιγύς — clear-voiced, shrill; masc. nom. sg.: ’clear-voiced’
glossary.λωβητῆρα: λωβητήρ — reviler, one who outrages; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάλιστ: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, elided (μάλιστ’ = μάλιστα): ’most of all, especially’
glossary.μάψ: μάψ — rashly, idly, without due cause; adv.
glossary.μίσγεαι: μίσγω — mix; mid. have intercourse with; pres. mid. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ), subj. after ἵνα: ’that you may lie with’
glossary.μεθήμων: μεθήμων — slack, remiss, easy-going; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετάφρενον: μετάφρενον — the back (between the shoulders); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μεταφρένου: μετάφρενον — the back (between the shoulders); neut. gen. sg.
glossary.μηκέτ: μηκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (μηκέτ’ = μηκέτι)
glossary.μοῦνος: μόνος (epic/Ionic μοῦνος) — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νέην: νέος — young, new; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νείκεε: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐνείκει): ’he reviled’
glossary.νεικείειν: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεικεῖν)
glossary.νεικείεσκε: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’used to revile’
glossary.νεικείων: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεικῶν)
glossary.νεμέσσηθέν: νεμεσσάω — feel righteous anger, resent; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -θεν (= Attic ἐνεμεσήθησαν), unaugmented
glossary.νεώμεθα: νέομαι — go, go back, return; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
glossary.νοστήσομεν: νοστέω — return home; fut. 1 pl. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’we shall return’
glossary.νόος: νόος — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic νοῦς)
glossary.νόστόν: νόστος — homecoming, return; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οἴκαδέ: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv. (οἶκος + -δε)
glossary.οἴσει: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; fut. 3 sg. (fut. οἴσω): ’will bring’
glossary.οἶσθ: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense, elided (οἶσθ’ = οἶσθα): ’you know’
glossary.οἷος: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. nom. sg., rough breathing (not οἶος ’alone’); in an indirect question: ’what sort of’ · also in a simile, introducing the likeness: ’like, just as’ (οἷος … ἀστήρ ’like a star’)
glossary.οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
glossary.οὐκί: οὐ — not; emphatic form οὐκί: ’not’ (ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’)
glossary.πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
glossary.πέπονες: πέπων — ripe, soft; in address a familiar ’good (friend)’, exact sense uncertain; masc. voc. pl. (said to a crowd, scornfully)
glossary.παρίστατο: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, come up to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.: ’stood by’
glossary.παραστάς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing beside’
glossary.πειρᾶται: πειράομαι — try, test, make trial of; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’he is testing’
glossary.πεπλήγων: πλήσσω — strike; reduplicated aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (form disputed): ’striking, driving off with blows’
glossary.πεσσέμεν: πέσσω — cook, digest; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic πέσσειν): of prizes, ’to digest, devour at leisure’
glossary.πλεῖαί: πλεῖος — full; fem. nom. pl. (Ionic, = Attic πλέως), + gen.: ’full of’
glossary.πληγῇσιν: πληγή — blow, stroke; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.πλησίον: πλησίος — near, neighbouring; neut. acc. sg. as adv. πλησίον: ’near, beside’; ἐς πλησίον ἄλλον ’to another next to him’
glossary.πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πολλαὶ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.: ’many’
glossary.πολυκοιρανίη: πολυκοιρανίη — rule by many lords; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
glossary.προσαμύνομεν: προσαμύνω — come to help, aid (+ dat.); pres. 1 pl.: ’we help’
glossary.προφέροις: προφέρω — bring forward, cast at (+ dat.); pres. opt. 2 sg., potential: ’you would cast (reproaches) at’
glossary.πρωτίστῳ: πρῶτος — first; superl. πρώτιστος, masc. dat. sg.: ’(to you) first’
glossary.πόδα: πούς — foot; masc. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in the foot’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’foot’ of a mountain, after ὑπαί (πόδα νείατον Ἴδης)
glossary.πόλεμόν: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πόντος: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’ · also possessive gen.: ’your’ · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’because of you’ · also gen. sg. after ἄρξομαι: ’from you’ (σέο … ἄρξομαι ’I shall begin from you’) · also gen. sg. after ἕξεται: ’on you’ (σέο … ἕξεται ’will rest on you’)
glossary.σκήπτρου: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.σκῆπτρόν: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τ’)
glossary.σμαραγεῖ: σμαραγέω — roar, resound, crash; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.σμῶδιξ: σμῶδιξ — weal, welt (the mark of a blow); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.στόμ: στόμα — mouth; neut. acc. sg., elided (στόμ’ = στόμα)
glossary.στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
glossary.συνοχωκότε: συνέχω — hold together, draw together; perf. part. act. dual nom., epic συνοχωκότε: ’drawn together’
glossary.σφισι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
glossary.τάρβησέν: ταρβέω — be afraid, be alarmed; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’was afraid’
glossary.τέο: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., Homeric/Ionic gen. sg. (= Attic τίνος): ’of what?’
glossary.τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο: Τηλεμάχοιο πατήρ ’father of Telemachus’
glossary.τιμὴ: τιμή — honour, standing, esteem; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
glossary.υἷος: υἱός — son; masc. gen. sg., epic υἷος (= Attic υἱοῦ), objective gen. with ἄποινα: ’ransom for a son’
glossary.φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so she spoke’
glossary.φέρτεροί: φέρτερος — stronger, better, superior; comparative adj. (no positive in use), masc. nom. pl., + gen. of comparison: ’stronger than’
glossary.φημὶ: φημί — say, assert, declare; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φιλεῖ: φιλέω — love, hold dear; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’loves’
glossary.φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; also sexual love; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν φιλότητι ’in love’
glossary.φολκὸς: φολκός — bandy-legged (meaning uncertain); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φοξὸς: φοξός — pointed, peaked (of the head); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φυλάσσοις: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch for; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential: ’you would watch for’
glossary.φωνησάσης: φωνέω — raise the voice, speak aloud; aor. part. act. fem. gen. sg.: ’who had spoken’
glossary.χαλεπῷ: χαλεπός — harsh, hard, grievous; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.: πλεῖαι χαλκοῦ ’full of bronze’
glossary.χατίζεις: χατίζω — need, lack, want (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg.
glossary.χερειότερον: χερείων — worse, inferior; comparative χερειότερος, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.χλαῖνάν: χλαῖνα — a thick woollen cloak; fem. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τ’)
glossary.χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χολωσάμενος: χολόω — anger; mid. grow angry; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having grown angry’
glossary.χρυσέου: χρύσεος — golden; masc. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦ)
glossary.χἠμεῖς: ἐγώ — I; χἠμεῖς = καὶ ἡμεῖς by crasis (ἡμεῖς nom. pl. ’we’): ’and we too’
glossary.ψεδνὴ: ψεδνός — thin, sparse; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγάγω: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. subj. 1 sg. act., with κεν in a general relative clause: ’I may bring’
glossary.ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg. · also the proper name Ἀγήνωρ — Agenor, a Trojan leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαθὸν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(not) good’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a named man: ’good’ (πὺξ ἀγαθὸν Πολυδεύκεα ’Polydeuces, good with his fists’)
glossary.ἀγκυλομήτεω: ἀγκυλομήτης — of crooked cunning (exact sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), epithet of Cronus
glossary.ἀγοράων: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering, public speaking; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἀγορῶν)
glossary.ἀγορεύοις: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with ἄν: ’you would speak’
glossary.ἀγορῆθεν: ἀγορή — assembly, place of assembly; adv. ἀγορῆθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the assembly’
glossary.ἀεικέσσι: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful; fem. dat. pl., epic -έσσι (= Attic ἀεικέσι)
glossary.ἀκούσαμεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἠκούσαμεν): ’we heard’
glossary.ἀκριτόμυθε: ἀκριτόμυθος — of undiscriminating, confused or endless speech (exact sense uncertain); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀλγήσας: ἀλγέω — feel pain, suffer; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having felt pain’
glossary.ἀμείνονα: ἀμείνων — better; comparative of ἀγαθός; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμετροεπὴς: ἀμετροεπής — endless in talk, of unmeasured speech; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφικαλύπτει: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover around, envelop; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνήσει: ἀνίημι — send up, let go; urge on, impel (to do); fut. 3 sg.: ’will urge’
glossary.ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg. · also + dat., ’to meet, against’ (τῇ δ’ ἀντίος ’to meet her’)
glossary.ἀπομόρξατο: ἀπομόργνυμι — wipe off; mid. wipe from oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’wiped away’
glossary.ἀπτόλεμος: ἀπτόλεμος — unwarlike, no fighter; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρχὸν: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρέμας: ἀτρέμας — without moving, calmly, quietly; adv.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδεω: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀτρεΐδῃς: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. dat. pl., epic Ἀτρεΐδῃς (= Attic Ἀτρείδαις): ’the sons of Atreus’
glossary.ἀτρεΐωνος: Ἀτρεΐων — son of Atreus (= Ἀτρεΐδης); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀφήσω: ἀφίημι — let go, send away; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall send away’
glossary.ἀφραίνοντα: ἀφραίνω — be foolish, act senselessly; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’playing the fool’
glossary.ἀχαιΐδες: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean woman; fem. nom./voc. pl., of men as an insult: ’Achaean women!’ · also fem. nom. pl., literal: ’Achaean women’ (πολλαὶ Ἀχαιΐδες ’many Achaean women’)
glossary.ἀχνύμενοί: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀχρεῖον: ἀχρεῖος — useless, to no purpose; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’helplessly, blankly’
glossary.ἄκοσμά: ἄκοσμος — disorderly, unseemly; neut. acc. pl. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.ἄκουε: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’listen!’
glossary.ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg. · also ἄλλον … ἄλλον, correlative: ’one … another’
glossary.ἄναλκις: ἄναλκις — without courage, feeble; adj. (2-termination), masc. nom. sg. · also fem. nom. sg., of Aphrodite: ’without might’
glossary.ἅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’; not the possessive
glossary.ἐκολῴα: κολῳάω — squabble noisily, brawl (like jackdaws); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐλάσασκεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’would strike’
glossary.ἐλέγχε: ἔλεγχος — reproach, disgrace; neut. pl. ἐλέγχεα, elided (ἐλέγχε’), epic uncontracted; nom./voc. pl.: ’disgraces’
glossary.ἐναρίθμιος: ἐναρίθμιος — counted among, of account; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐξάρχων: ἐξάρχω — begin, lead off, take the lead (+ acc. or gen.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐξαίρετοι: ἐξαίρετος — picked out, choice, select; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐξυπανέστη: ἐξυπανίστημι — rise up from under; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist, intrans.): ’rose up’
glossary.ἐπείη: ἔπειμι — be on, be upon (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg., in a wish or curse: ’may it be on’
glossary.ἐπενήνοθε: ἐπενήνοθε — grows on, lies thick on; old perf. 3 sg. with present sense, root uncertain (ἐνήνοθε, ἐπενήνοθε)
glossary.ἐπεσβόλον: ἐπεσβόλος — babbling, loose-tongued (ἔπος + βάλλω); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιβασκέμεν: ἐπιβάσκω — cause to go upon, bring into (+ gen.); pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic -ειν)
glossary.ἐπιδεύεαι: ἐπιδεύομαι — lack, be in need of (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.ἐπιμέμφεαι: ἐπιμέμφομαι — blame, find fault with (+ dat. or gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic ἐπιμέμφῃ)
glossary.ἐρητύσασκε: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’would restrain’
glossary.ἐσθλὰ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, staunch; neut. acc. pl.: ’good things, good deeds’
glossary.ἐφεύροι: ἐφευρίσκω — find, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’whom he might find’ · also after εἴ που, of a hoped-for search: ’if she might find’
glossary.ἐῶμεν: ἐάω — allow, let be, leave alone; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us leave’
glossary.ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
glossary.ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἔκπεσε: ἐκπίπτω — fall out, fall from; aor. 3 sg.: of a tear, ’fell from’ (+ dat. of the person) · also ’fell out of’ + gen., of a broken blade (ἔκπεσε χειρός ’fell from the hand’) · also aor. 3 sg., of a man falling from a vehicle, + gen.: ’fell out of’ (ἔκπεσε δίφρου ’fell out of the chariot’)
glossary.ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — standing out, eminent; adj., masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος, + gen. of comparison: ’choice beyond (others)’ · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial, + gen. of comparison: ’above (others)’ (ἔξοχον ἄλλων)
glossary.ἔοικεν: ἔοικα — be like, seem, be fitting; perf. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like’ (+ dat.: θεῇς … ἔοικεν ’is like goddesses’)
glossary.ἔοργε: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; perf. 3 sg. act. ἔοργε (from ἔρδω): ’has done’
glossary.ἔρεξεν: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; aor. 3 sg.: ’did’
glossary.ἔσχ: ἔχω — have, hold, hold back; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔσχ’ = ἔσχε): ’held back, kept (from + gen.)’
glossary.ἕζοντο: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἕλωμεν: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. subj. 1 pl., in a temporal clause with ἄν: ’whenever we take’
glossary.ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg., gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than himself’ · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’from herself’ (ἀπὸ ἕο ’away from herself’)
glossary.ἕτερον: ἕτερος — the other (of two), one; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόδα · also masc. acc. sg., in apposition to a dual noun: ’(the) one’ (ἄρνε … ἕτερον ’of the two lambs, one’) · also neut. acc. sg., ’one thing’ (ἕτερον … ἄλλο ’one thing … another’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πῦρ: ’the one’ (ἕτερον μὲν … ἄλλο δέ ’the one … the other’)
glossary.ἠνίπαπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 2 3 sg., epic reduplicated (ἠνίπαπον, no Attic equivalent)
glossary.ἠχῇ: ἠχή — sound, outcry, din; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly, heartily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’pleasing’ (φίλον καὶ ἡδύ ’dear and pleasing’)
glossary.ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
glossary.ἧσαι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 2 sg. mid.: ’you sit’
glossary.ἰδνώθη: ἰδνόω — bend, double up; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was bent double’
glossary.ἰθακήσιος: Ἰθακήσιος — of Ithaca, Ithacan; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱπποδάμων: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’
glossary.ἴδοι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past general relative clause: ’whom he might see’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. after μή, in a negative purpose clause: ’lest he see’ (μή μιν ἴδοι ’lest he see her’) · also in a past general temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever he looked’
glossary.ἴψεται: ἴπτομαι — press hard, smite, afflict; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’he will smite’
glossary.ἵδρυε: ἱδρύω — make sit, seat, settle; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’seat!’
glossary.ἵνά: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. (accent from the following enclitic) · also relative adv., ’where’ + indic. (ἵνά σφ’ ἀγορή τε θέμις τε ἤην ’where their assembly and court of right were’)
glossary.ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
glossary.ὀνείδεά: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη)
glossary.ὀνειδίζων: ὀνειδίζω — reproach, revile, taunt; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’reviling’
glossary.ὀξέα: ὀξύς — sharp, keen, shrill; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’shrilly’ · also neut. acc. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’sharp’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα ’sharp spears’)
glossary.ὀπήδει: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, contracted -ει: ’kept company with’
glossary.ὁμοκλήσασκέ: ὁμοκλάω — call out sternly, rebuke; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’would rebuke’
glossary.ὄπα: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice; fem. acc. sg., epic ὄπα
glossary.ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
glossary.ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’
glossary.ὤμω: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual nom./acc.: ’two shoulders’
glossary.ῥέξῃ: ῥέζω — do, perform, accomplish; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest he do’
glossary.αἰσχρόν: αἰσχρός — shameful, disgraceful; neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: ’shameful (to stay)’
glossary.αὐλίδα: Αὐλίς — Aulis, the Boeotian harbour where the Greek fleet gathered; fem. acc. sg., place to which: ἐς Αὐλίδα ’to Aulis’ · also object acc. of a verb of dwelling: ’inhabited Aulis’ (Αὐλίδα πετρήεσσαν ἐνέμοντο)
glossary.αὐτήν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg., as a plain pronoun: ’her’ (καὶ αὐτήν ’and her too’) · also intensive, fem. acc. sg.: ’itself’ (κανόνας τε καὶ αὐτήν ’the rods and the shield itself’)
glossary.βήσεται: βαίνω — go, step; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will go’
glossary.βουλαί: βουλή — plan, counsel; fem. nom. pl.: ’plans’
glossary.βουλεύωσ: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; pres. subj. 3 pl., elided βουλεύωσ’ (= βουλεύωσι), with κεν in a relative clause: ’who may plan’
glossary.βροτοῖσιν: βροτός — mortal, mortal man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.βωμοὺς: βωμός — altar; masc. acc. pl.: ’altars’ (κατὰ βωμούς ’at the altars’)
glossary.βωμοῦ: βωμός — altar; masc. gen. sg., with ὑπαΐξας (ὑπό + ἀΐσσω): ’from beneath the altar’
glossary.γενοίατο: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. opt. 3 pl., epic -οίατο (= Attic γένοιντο), wish: ’may they be’
glossary.γερήνιος: Γερήνιος — Gerenian, standing epithet of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.; meaning uncertain — perhaps from a place Gerenia, or linked to γέρας ’honour’
glossary.γνώμεναι: γιγνώσκω — come to know, find out; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic γνῶναι): ’to know’
glossary.γνώσεαι: γιγνώσκω — come to know; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic γνώσῃ): ’you will know’
glossary.γνώσῃ: γιγνώσκω — come to know; fut. 2 sg. mid., contracted (epic γνώσεαι): ’you will know’
glossary.δαφοινὸς: δαφοινός — blood-red, tawny-red (δα- intensive + φοινός ’red’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δαῶμεν: δάω — teach; pass. learn, find out (aor. ἐδάην); aor. pass. subj. 1 pl., epic δαῶμεν, after ὄφρα: ’until we learn’
glossary.δεινὰ: δεινός — fearful, terrible, dread; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with πέλωρα · also neut. acc. pl. used as adverb: ’dreadfully’ (δεινὰ ὁμοκλήσας ’shouting dreadfully’)
glossary.δεκάτῳ: δέκατος — tenth; neut. dat. sg., with ἔτει understood: ’in the tenth (year)’
glossary.δεξιαί: δεξιά — right hand, hand clasped in pledge (δεξιός ’right’); fem. nom. pl.: ’right hands’
glossary.δηρόν: δηρός — long, lasting; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’for long’
glossary.δράκων: δράκων — serpent, snake; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δυνάμεσθα: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic δυνάμεθα): ’we are able’ (+ inf.)
glossary.εἰδομένη: εἴδομαι — seem, make oneself like (+ dat.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg. in -όμενος, which in Homer also serves as an aor.: ’having made herself like’
glossary.εἰλέωσιν: εἰλέω — hem in, shut in, press close; pres. subj. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰλῶσιν), in a general relative clause: ’may hem in’
glossary.εἰσῆλθ: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, come in upon (+ acc.); aor. 3 sg., elided εἰσῆλθ’ (= εἰσῆλθε): ’came in upon’
glossary.εἴνατός: ἔνατος — ninth; epic εἴνατος (= Attic ἔνατος), accented before an enclitic; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’ninth’
glossary.εὑρέμεναι: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic εὑρεῖν)
glossary.θέμεναι: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic θεῖναι), with two accusatives: ’to make (you) …’
glossary.θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θαυμάζομεν: θαυμάζω — wonder at, marvel; pres. 1 pl.: ’we marvel’
glossary.θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θεσπεσίῃ: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, divine, beyond mortal scale; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by a wondrous (power)’
glossary.θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., subject: ’the god’ (common gender; may also name a goddess) · also masc. nom. sg. in a comparison: ’(like) a god’ (θεὸς ὣς)
glossary.θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., with ν-movable (= θῆκε), with double acc.: ’made (him) conspicuous’ · also ’laid, set’, with acc. and ἐπί + dat.: ’laid it on the knees’
glossary.κακότητι: κακότης — badness, baseness, cowardice; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’through baseness’
glossary.κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’ · also neut. acc. pl., adj. with ἔργα: ’evil (deeds)’
glossary.κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’ · also masc. nom. sg., attributive: ’evil’ (πόλεμος κακός ’evil war’)
glossary.κατήσθιε: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; impf. 3 sg., without movable ν (= κατήσθιεν): ’was devouring’
glossary.κατακοιμηθῆναι: κατακοιμάομαι — lie down to sleep, sleep (with); aor. inf. pass.: ’to lie down’
glossary.κενεόν: κενεός — empty; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κενόν): ’empty’, ’empty-handed’
glossary.κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’fame’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a report’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’fame, a good name’ (κλέος … ἄροιτο ’win fame’) · also neut. acc. sg., governed by μετά: ’after the fame’ (μετὰ κλέος ’in quest of the fame’)
glossary.κομόωντες: κομάω — wear the hair long; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κομῶντες): κάρη κομόωντες ’long-haired’
glossary.κονάβησαν: κοναβέω — ring, clang, resound; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκονάβησαν): ’rang’
glossary.κρήνην: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κρῖν: κρίνω — separate, sort, choose; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided κρῖν’ (= κρῖνε): ’sort!’
glossary.κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κῆρες: κήρ — death-spirit, doom of death; fem. nom. pl.: ’the death-spirits’ (a different word from κῆρ ’heart’)
glossary.λᾶαν: λᾶας — stone, rock; masc. acc. sg. (Attic λίθος)
glossary.μέλει: μέλω — be a care, be of concern (impersonal; dat. of the person, nom. of the thing); pres. 3 sg.: ’is a care to’
glossary.μήδεά: μῆδος — plan, counsel; neut. nom. pl.: ’counsels’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.μήδεο: μήδομαι — plan, take thought; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic μήδου): ’take thought!’
glossary.μίμνετε: μίμνω — stay, remain (= Attic μένω); pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’stay!’ · also pres. indic. 2 pl., trans. + acc.: ’you wait for’
glossary.μαχέονται: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -έονται (= Attic μάχονται), or an Ionic fut. (= μαχοῦνται): ’fight’ or ’will fight’
glossary.μείνατ: μένω — stay, wait; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided μείνατ’ (= μείνατε): ’stay!’
glossary.μερόπεσσι: μέροψ — mortal, ’speech-dividing’ (conventional epithet of men; sense uncertain); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, with the vowel doubled (= Attic μετεῖπε)
glossary.μιμνόντεσσι: μίμνω — stay, remain; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic μένουσι): ’for those who stay’
glossary.μῆνα: μείς, μήν — month; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a month’
glossary.μῆχος: μῆχος — means, remedy, way out; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.νεαροὶ: νεαρός — young, youthful; masc. nom. pl.: ’young ones’
glossary.νεμεσίζομ: νεμεσίζομαι — be indignant at, feel resentment at (+ acc.); pres. 1 sg., elided νεμεσίζομ’ (= νεμεσίζομαι)
glossary.νεοσσοί: νεοσσός — young bird, nestling (Attic νεοττός); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νηπιάχοις: νηπίαχος — childish, infantile (= νήπιος); masc. dat. pl., as a noun: ’childish ones’
glossary.νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl. νῆες
glossary.οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’; masc. acc. pl. (οὓς παῖδας ’his own sons’)
glossary.οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this one’
glossary.πέλωρα: πέλωρον — monster, monstrous thing; neut. nom. pl.: ’monsters’
glossary.παισὶν: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. pl., with ἐοικότες: ’like children’ · also masc. dat. pl. of interest: ’for the children’
glossary.πείθεό: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic πείθου): ’be guided!’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.πείθωνται: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded (+ dat.); pres. subj. 3 pl., in a condition with κεν: ’they obey’
glossary.περιτροπέων: περιτροπέω — revolve, come round (rare; formed on περιτρέπω ’turn round’); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= -ῶν), of the year: ’coming round’
glossary.πετάλοις: πέταλον — leaf; neut. dat. pl., with ὑπο- in ὑποπεπτηῶτες: ’beneath the leaves’
glossary.πλατάνιστον: πλατάνιστος — plane-tree; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic πλάτανος)
glossary.πλατανίστῳ: πλατάνιστος — plane-tree; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic πλάτανος), with ὑπό: ’beneath a plane-tree’
glossary.πληθύς: πληθύς — multitude, crowd; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πολεμήϊα: πολεμήϊος — of war, warlike; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’works of war’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τεύχεα and ἔργα: ’of war’ (πολεμήϊα τεύχεα ’armour of war’)
glossary.πολυζύγῳ: πολύζυγος — many-yoked, with many rowing-benches (ζυγόν ’yoke, thwart’); fem. dat. sg., agreeing with νηΐ
glossary.πρωΐζ: πρωΐζα — on the day before yesterday; adv., elided πρωΐζ’; with χθιζά ’yesterday and the day before’
glossary.πρόσθ: πρόσθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided πρόσθ’ (= πρόσθε): ’before (the others)’ · also adv., elided: ’in front, before him’
glossary.πτέρυγος: πτέρυξ — wing; fem. gen. sg., partitive: ’by the wing’
glossary.πτολίπορθος: πτολίπορθος — city-sacking, sacker of cities (πτόλις = epic πόλις, πέρθω ’sack’); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus · also fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), epithet of Enyo: ’sacker of cities’
glossary.πτολεμίξομεν: πτολεμίζω — make war, fight (epic for πολεμίζω); fut. 1 pl.: ’we shall fight’
glossary.πόνος: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’)
glossary.σήματα: σῆμα — sign, mark, token; neut. acc. pl.: ’signs’
glossary.σιωπᾶν: σιωπάω — be silent; pres. inf., after ἀνώγει: ’to be silent’
glossary.σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
glossary.σμερδαλέος: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dread, fearsome; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σπονδαί: σπονδή — libation, drink-offering (pl. also a truce or pact sealed by libation); fem. nom. pl.: ’libations’
glossary.στείχοντες: στείχω — go, walk, march; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going’
glossary.στρουθοῖο: στρουθός — sparrow; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.συνθεσίαι: συνθεσίη — covenant, agreement; fem. nom. pl.: ’covenants’
glossary.σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., epic acc. pl. σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by κατά: κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves’ · also reflexive, acc. pl., with αὐτούς: ’themselves’ (σφέας αὐτούς ’themselves’)
glossary.σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’) · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a token’ (σῆμα ἰδέσθαι ’to see the token’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’tomb’ (ἀνδρὸς τόδε σῆμα ’the tomb of a man’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθείς: ’a sign, an omen’ · also neut. acc. sg., after παρά: ’tomb’ (παρ’ Ἴλου σῆμα ’past the tomb of Ilus’)
glossary.τέρας: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. acc. sg.: ’portent’ · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition to a noun: ’a portent’
glossary.τίσασθαι: τίνυμαι (τίνω) — exact vengeance for, punish; aor. inf. mid. τίσασθαι: ’to take vengeance for’
glossary.τελεῖται: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil, accomplish; pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is being fulfilled’
glossary.τετριγῶτας: τρίζω — squeak, cheep; perf. part. τετριγώς, masc. acc. pl. (pres. sense): ’cheeping’
glossary.τλῆτε: τλάω — endure, bear up; aor. imper. 2 pl. (aor. ἔτλην): ’endure!’
glossary.τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. τοί (= Attic οἱ), used as a relative: ’who’ · also τοί = τοι, encl. dat. of σύ: ’to you’ (κασίγνητος δέ τοί εἰμι ’I am your brother’) · also masc. nom. pl. demonstrative, with γε: ’they’
glossary.τοσσαῦτ: τοσοῦτος — so great, so many; epic τοσσαῦτος (= Attic τοσοῦτος); neut. acc. pl., elided τοσσαῦτ’, acc. of duration: ’so many’
glossary.τούσδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’these’
glossary.τὼς: τώς — thus, so; epic adv. (= Attic οὕτως)
glossary.φάγε: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. 3 sg. φάγε, unaugmented (= Attic ἔφαγε); with κατά in tmesis: κατὰ … φάγε ’ate up’
glossary.φάσαν: φημί — say; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
glossary.φέροντες: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’bringing’
glossary.φέρουσαι: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’bearing’, ’bearing off’
glossary.φαίνων: φαίνω — show, bring to light; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’showing’
glossary.φθινύθειν: φθινύθω — waste away, perish (epic by-form of φθίνω); pres. inf., after ἔα: ’to waste away’
glossary.φρήτρας: φρήτρη — clan, brotherhood (a subdivision of the tribe); fem. acc. pl., distributive with κατά: κατὰ φρήτρας ’by clans’
glossary.φρήτρη: φρήτρη — clan, brotherhood; fem. nom. sg.: ’clan’
glossary.φρήτρηφιν: φρήτρη — clan, brotherhood; fem. dat. sg. with the epic suffix -φιν (= Attic φρήτρᾳ): ’clan’
glossary.φόνον: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φύλοις: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. dat. pl.: ’tribes’
glossary.φῦλα: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’tribes’
glossary.χειμέριαι: χειμέριος — wintry, stormy; fem. nom. pl., agreeing with ἄελλαι
glossary.χθιζά: χθιζά — yesterday; adv. (neut. pl. of χθιζός ’of yesterday’)
glossary.χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a time’
glossary.χῆραί: χῆρος, χήρα — bereft, widowed; fem. nom. pl.: ’widowed’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.ψεῦδος: ψεῦδος — falsehood, lie; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’a falsehood’ · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial with οὔ τι: ’falsely’ (οὔ τι ψεῦδος … κατέλεξας ’you have not recounted falsely’)
glossary.ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, bright, radiant; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’splendid (son)’
glossary.ἀγοράασθε: ἀγοράομαι — speak in assembly, harangue; pres. 2 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγορᾶσθε)
glossary.ἀκροτάτῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; superl. ἀκρότατος, masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλαπάξεις: ἀλαπάζω — sack, lay waste; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will lay waste’
glossary.ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
glossary.ἀλόχοιο: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀμφεποτᾶτο: ἀμφιποτάομαι — flutter around; impf. 3 sg., epic contracted -ᾶτο: ’fluttered around’
glossary.ἀμφιαχυῖαν: ἀμφιάχω — cry out around, shriek about (rare; sense taken from the formation); perf. part. fem. acc. sg. ἀμφιαχυῖα: ’shrieking around’
glossary.ἀνιηθέντα: ἀνιάω — grieve, distress; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’distressed’
glossary.ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
glossary.ἀπόβλητον: ἀπόβλητος — to be thrown away, cast off; neut. nom. sg., predicate (ἀποβάλλω): ’to be thrown away’
glossary.ἀρήγῃ: ἀρήγω — help, aid (+ dat.); pres. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause: ’may help’
glossary.ἀρίζηλον: ἀρίζηλος — conspicuous, very clear; masc. acc. sg., predicate with θῆκεν: ’conspicuous’
glossary.ἀστεμφέα: ἀστεμφής — unshaken, firm; fem. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with βουλήν
glossary.ἀστράπτων: ἀστράπτω — flash lightning; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’flashing lightning’
glossary.ἀσχαλάαν: ἀσχαλάω — be distressed, chafe, be vexed; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀσχαλᾶν): ’to chafe’
glossary.ἀσχαλάᾳ: ἀσχαλάω — be distressed, chafe, be vexed; pres. 3 sg. act., epic diectasis (= Attic ἀσχαλᾷ): ’chafes’
glossary.ἀφραδίῃ: ἀφραδίη — folly, thoughtlessness; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’through folly’
glossary.ἀϋσάντων: ἀΰω — shout, cry out; aor. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’shouting’
glossary.ἁπτέσθω: ἅπτομαι — touch, lay hold of (+ gen.); pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him touch’
glossary.ἄελλαι: ἄελλα — storm, blast of wind; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄκρητοι: ἄκρητος — unmixed (of wine); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with σπονδαί
glossary.ἄνεῳ: ἄνεως — silent, speechless; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄνυσις: ἄνυσις — accomplishment, achievement; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄργεος: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.ἄρχευ: ἄρχω — lead, rule (+ dat.); imper. 2 sg., elided ἄρχευ’ (probably ἄρχευε, a by-form of ἄρχε; formation uncertain): ’lead!’
glossary.ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐγένεσθε: γίγνομαι — become; aor. 2 pl.: ’you became, have become’
glossary.ἐθέλουσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they wish’
glossary.ἐκτελέουσιν: ἐκτελέω — bring to completion, fulfil; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐκτελοῦσιν; could also be a fut., ’will fulfil’): ’they fulfil’
glossary.ἐλέγχιστον: ἐλεγχής — shameful, disgraceful; superl. ἐλέγχιστος, masc. acc. sg., predicate with σε: ’most shameful’
glossary.ἐλεεινὰ: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, piteous; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’pitiably’
glossary.ἐλελιξάμενος: ἐλελίζω — whirl, coil; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having coiled himself’
glossary.ἐνάτη: ἔνατος — ninth (epic also εἴνατος); fem. nom. sg., predicate: ’ninth’
glossary.ἐναίσιμα: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, auspicious (of signs); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
glossary.ἐπέεσσ: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic ἐπέεσσι, elided ἐπέεσσ’ (= Attic ἔπεσι): ’with words’
glossary.ἐπέπιθμεν: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα trust; plpf. 1 pl. ἐπέπιθμεν, epic (+ dat.): ’we trusted’
glossary.ἐπίσπῃ: ἐφέπω — come upon, meet with, pursue; aor. subj. 3 sg. ἐπίσπῃ (aor. ἔσπον), in a purpose clause: ’may meet with’
glossary.ἐπαινήσαντες: ἐπαινέω — approve, praise; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having approved’
glossary.ἐπειγέσθω: ἐπείγω — press, urge; mid. hurry, hasten; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let (him) hasten’
glossary.ἐπιδέξι: ἐπιδέξιος — on the right hand (the lucky side); neut. pl. ἐπιδέξια as adv., elided ἐπιδέξι’: ’on the right’
glossary.ἐπιφρασσαίατο: ἐπιφράζομαι — notice, take note of, consider; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -αίατο (= Attic ἐπιφράσαιντο): ’might take note of’
glossary.ἐριδαίνομεν: ἐριδαίνω — quarrel, strive, contend; pres. 1 pl.: ’we quarrel’
glossary.ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
glossary.ἐτεὸν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
glossary.ἐφάνη: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (beside unaugmented φάνη): ’appeared’
glossary.ἑσταότες: ἵστημι — set up; perf. stand; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ἑσταότες (= Attic ἑστῶτες): ’standing’
glossary.ἔβαινον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they went’ (ἐν … ἔβαινον ’they went aboard’)
glossary.ἔθ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided ἔθ’ before a rough breathing (ἔθ’ ὡς): ’still’
glossary.ἔτεα: ἔτος — year; neut. pl., epic uncontracted ἔτεα (= Attic ἔτη), acc. of duration: ’years’
glossary.ἔφηνε: φαίνω — show, make appear; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’showed, revealed’
glossary.ἔῃσι: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ἔῃσι (= Attic ᾖ): ’may be’
glossary.ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg.: ’a single’ (ἕνα μῆνα ’a single month’); ’one’ (ἕνα καὶ δύο ’one and two’)
glossary.ἕρδομεν: ἕρδω — do, perform; offer (a sacrifice) (= ῥέζω); impf. 1 pl.: ’we were offering’
glossary.ἕρξῃς: ἕρδω — do, perform (= ῥέζω); aor. subj. 2 sg., after εἰ … κεν: ’you do’
glossary.ἠγερέθοντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. mid. 3 pl., epic -εθ- formation (= Attic ἠγείροντο): ’were gathering’
glossary.ἡγεμόνων: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the leaders’
glossary.ἱεροὺς: ἱερός — holy, sacred; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἱπποβότοιο: ἱππόβοτος — horse-pasturing, breeding horses; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with a place-name: ’horse-pasturing (Argos)’
glossary.ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
glossary.ἴαχον: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they shouted’
glossary.ὀδυρομένη: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn for; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
glossary.ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic Ὀδυσσῆος (double σ, metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆος)
glossary.ὀδύρονται: ὀδύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. 3 pl.: ’they lament’
glossary.ὀλεῖται: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; fut. 3 sg. mid., contracted (from ὀλέεται): ’will perish’
glossary.ὀρινομένη: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; pass. be stirred; pres. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’stirred up’
glossary.ὀψιτέλεστον: ὀψιτέλεστος — fulfilled late, late to be accomplished; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέρας
glossary.ὁρμήματά: ὅρμημα — rush, effort, striving; neut. acc. pl.: ’strivings’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.ὄζῳ: ὄζος — branch, bough; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὄρουσεν: ὀρούω — rush, dart, spring; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable: ’rushed’
glossary.ὄψιμον: ὄψιμος — late; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέρας: ’late’
glossary.ὅθεν: ὅθεν — from where, whence; relative adv.
glossary.ὅου: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg., epic ὅου (= Attic οὗ): ’whose’
glossary.ὑπέσταν: ὑφίστημι — undertake, promise; aor. 3 pl. intrans., epic ὑπέσταν (= Attic ὑπέστησαν): ’they undertook’
glossary.ὑπαΐξας: ὑπαΐσσω — dart out from under; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’darting out from beneath’
glossary.ὑπερμενέα: ὑπερμενής — of surpassing strength; masc. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with Κρονίωνα
glossary.ὑποπεπτηῶτες: ὑποπτήσσω — crouch beneath, cower; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ὑποπεπτηῶτες (perf. πεπτηώς): ’crouching beneath’
glossary.ὠκυπόροισιν: ὠκύπορος — swift-faring (of ships); fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἰγίδ: αἰγίς — aegis, Athena’s goat-skin shield; fem. acc. sg., elided (αἰγίδ’ = αἰγίδα)
glossary.αἰγίοχος: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰειγενετάων: αἰειγενέτης — ever-born, everlasting; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), epithet of θεῶν ’gods’
glossary.αἰθέρι: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰθέρος: αἰθήρ — the bright upper air, sky; masc. gen. sg. (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the upper air’)
glossary.αἰθαλόεν: αἰθαλόεις — sooty, smoky, blackened with smoke; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μέλαθρον
glossary.αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
glossary.αἴαντε: Αἴας — Ajax; masc. dual nom./acc.: ’the two Ajaxes’ (the Telamonian and the Locrian)
glossary.αὐγή: αὐγή — beam, ray, gleam of light; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐτόματος: αὐτόματος — acting of one’s own accord, unbidden; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βάλλει: βάλλω — throw, cast, hurl; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’casts, throws’ · also pres. 3 sg., of sound: ’strikes’ (κτύπος οὔατα βάλλει ’the din strikes the ears’)
glossary.βαλέειν: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. inf., epic βαλέειν (= Attic βαλεῖν) · also ’strike, hit’ (ἐπευξάμενος βαλέειν ’vaunting that he had struck’)
glossary.βουλεύσομεν: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; aor. subj. 1 pl., short vowel (= Attic βουλεύσωμεν), after εἰ without κε; or fut. indic. 1 pl.
glossary.βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
glossary.βοῦν: βοῦς — ox, cow; acc. sg. (masc. ’ox’, fem. ’cow’)
glossary.γένωνται: γίγνομαι — come to be, arrive, be; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., with ὅτ’ ἂν: ’whenever they come to be’
glossary.γέροντας: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg.: ’comes into being, grows’
glossary.γεράνων: γέρανος — crane (the bird); fem. gen. pl.
glossary.γλαφυρῇσι: γλαφυρός — hollow; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.δέκτο: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, athematic form (= Attic ἐδέξατο): ’accepted’
glossary.δήθ: δηθά (elided δήθ’) — for long, long since; adv., intensified by δή: ’for so long now’
glossary.δαΐξαι: δαΐζω — cleave, rend, tear apart; aor. inf. act.: ’to rend’
glossary.δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, main meal; neut. acc. sg. of the goal: ’to the meal’ (ἐπὶ δεῖπνον) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’a meal’ (of horses, ’fodder’)
glossary.δηΐοιο: δήϊος — hostile, ravaging (of fire); neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with πυρός
glossary.δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
glossary.δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
glossary.διέσσυτο: διασεύομαι — rush through, dart through; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented, epic double σ: ’darted through’
glossary.διακρινέει: διακρίνω — part, separate, decide between; fut. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic διακρινεῖ): ’will part’
