glossary.διοτρεφέες: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured (of kings); masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic διοτρεφεῖς)
glossary.δουλιχοδείρων: δουλιχόδειρος — long-necked; masc. gen. pl., epithet of κύκνων ’swans’
glossary.δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk; spear (a shaft of wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. (gen. δουρός)
glossary.δότω: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him give’
glossary.δῦναι: δύω — go down, sink, set; aor. inf. act. (root aorist), of the sun: ’to set’ · also ’go down into, enter’ (δῦναι δόμον Ἄϊδος εἴσω ’to go down into the house of Hades’)
glossary.εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may (they) be’ (αἲ γὰρ … μοι … εἶεν ’would that I had …’) · in a remote condition: ’if there were’
glossary.θέσθω: τίθημι — put, place; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him set (in order)’
glossary.θηξάσθω: θήγω — whet, sharpen; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him sharpen (his own)’
glossary.θύρετρα: θύρετρον — door, doorway; neut. nom./acc. pl. (the plural for the doors of one house)
glossary.θύσανοι: θύσανος — tassel, fringe; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον (= Attic θᾶττον) ’more swiftly, the sooner’
glossary.θῦνον: θύνω — rush, dash, charge; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθυνον)
glossary.κάπνισσάν: καπνίζω — make smoke, kindle fires; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic double σ (= ἐκάπνισαν), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.κίκλησκεν: καλέω — call, summon; impf. 3 sg. of the reduplicated κικλήσκω, unaugmented (= ἐκίκλησκεν): ’was summoning’
glossary.κακοῦ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. sg., substantive: ’of evil, of trouble’
glossary.καμεῖται: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; fut. 3 sg. (middle in form): ’will grow tired’
glossary.καρδίῃ: καρδίη — heart; fem. dat. sg., Ionic (= Attic καρδίᾳ), of place: ’in the heart’
glossary.κατέκαιον: κατακαίω — burn up, burn down; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’were burning up’
glossary.καϋστρίου: Κάϋστριος — the Cayster, river of Lydia (also Κάϋστρος); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κεδασθέντες: κεδάννυμι (= σκεδάννυμι) — scatter, disperse; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’scattered’
glossary.κελαινεφὲς: κελαινεφής — dark with cloud, black-clouded (epithet of Zeus); masc. voc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., of blood: ’dark-clouded’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with αἷμα (object): ’dark-clouded’
glossary.κηρύσσοντες: κηρύσσω — proclaim as herald, summon; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’proclaiming’
glossary.κλαγγηδὸν: κλαγγηδόν — with clanging cry, noisily; adv. (κλαγγή ’clang’ + -δόν)
glossary.κονάβιζε: κοναβίζω — ring, resound, clatter; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’rang’
glossary.κονίῃσιν: κονία — dust, ashes; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.κορυφῇς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. pl., epic short -ῇς (= κορυφῇσι, Attic κορυφαῖς)
glossary.κρίνοντες: κρίνω — separate, sort out, marshal; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’marshalling’
glossary.κρινώμεθ: κρίνω — separate, decide; mid. fight it out, contend; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., elided (κρινώμεθ’ = κρινώμεθα), in purpose after ὥς κε
glossary.λαζοίατο: λάζομαι — take hold of, seize; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο), in a wish: ’may they seize’
glossary.λείπει: λείπω — leave, forsake, abandon; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’leaves’
glossary.λεγώμεθα: λέγω — speak, talk (mid. perhaps ’tarry’; sense disputed); pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory: ’let us talk’
glossary.λειμών: λειμών — meadow, grassland; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of place, with ἐπ’ ἀριστερά: ’on the left of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀδαήμονι: ’ignorant of (battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐξαποδίωμαι: ’out of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἔργον: ’of battle’ (ἔργον … μάχης ’work of battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on νίκην: ’victory of battle’ (μάχης νίκην) · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντήσειε: ’meet (in) battle’ (μάχης ἀντήσειε ’would meet in battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἄρχε: ’(begin) the battle’ (ἄρχε μάχης ’begin the fight’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of παυσώμεσθα: ’cease from battle’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with σχήσεσθαι: ’from battle’ (or governed by μεμαώς: ’eager for battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀπέληγε: ’from (the fighting)’ (ἀπέληγε μάχης ’left off the fighting’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἐπιτάρροθοι: ’helpers in battle’
glossary.μέγιστε: μέγας — great; superlative μέγιστος, masc. voc. sg., address: ’greatest’
glossary.μέλαθρον: μέλαθρον — roof-beam, roof; the roof standing for the house; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μίαν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; numeral, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μαχεσσάμεθ: μάχομαι (epic μαχέομαι) — fight, quarrel; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic σσ, elided (μαχεσσάμεθ’ = μαχεσσάμεθα)
glossary.μεδέσθω: μέδομαι — be mindful of, take thought for (+ gen.); pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him heed’
glossary.μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετέσσεται: μέτειμι — be among, be present; fut. 3 sg., epic double σ (= Attic μετέσται): ’there will be among’
glossary.μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
glossary.μιμνάζειν: μιμνάζω — linger, stay behind, hang back; pres. inf. act. (by-form of μίμνω)
glossary.μυρίοι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; masc. nom. pl. (later ’ten thousand’)
glossary.μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
glossary.μὰν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (= Attic μήν); ἦ μάν ’truly indeed’ · also ἄγρει μάν ’come then’ (with the interjection ἄγρει)
glossary.μῶλον: μῶλος — toil of battle, struggle; masc. acc. sg. (μῶλον Ἄρηος ’the toil of Ares’)
glossary.νέστορα: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; acc. sg.
glossary.ναίων: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dwelling’
glossary.νείκεα: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκη)
glossary.νικᾷς: νικάω — conquer, win, surpass; pres. 2 sg. act. + dat. of respect
glossary.νοήσω: νοέω — perceive, notice, catch sight of; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, with κε in a general clause: ’whomever I notice’
glossary.ξυνάγωμεν: συνάγω (epic ξυνάγω) — bring together, join; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that we may join’
glossary.οἰωνούς: οἰωνός — bird (of prey), bird of omen; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οὔρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic οὔρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
glossary.παγχρύσεοι: πάγχρυσος — all of gold, wholly golden; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πάγχρυσοι)
glossary.παιφάσσουσα: παιφάσσω — dart about, rush glittering; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’darting’
glossary.παμφανόωσα: παμφανάω — shine all over, gleam brightly; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic diectasis (= Attic παμφανῶσα)
glossary.παναχαιῶν: Πανάχαιοι — all the Achaeans, i.e. the whole Greek host; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.παντοίων: παντοῖος — of all kinds, of every sort; masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.παυσωλή: παυσωλή — pause, respite, rest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πενταέτηρον: πενταέτηρος — five years old; adj. of two endings, masc./fem. acc. sg., agreeing with βοῦν: ’five-year-old’
glossary.περθομένη: πέρθω — sack, destroy; pres. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’being sacked’
glossary.περιστήσαντο: περιίστημι — set around, place around; aor. 3 pl. mid., transitive: ’stood (it) round’
glossary.πετεηνῶν: πετεηνός — winged; pl. as noun, birds; masc. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πετεινῶν), with ὀρνίθων
glossary.πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
glossary.ποτῶνται: ποτάομαι — fly about, flit; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’fly to and fro’
glossary.πρηνέες: πρηνής — headlong, face down; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πρηνεῖς)
glossary.πρηνὲς: πρηνής — headlong, face down; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’headlong’
glossary.προβλῆτι: πρόβλης — jutting out, projecting; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with σκοπέλῳ
glossary.προκαθιζόντων: προκαθίζω — sit down in front, settle down in advance; pres. part. gen. pl., gen. absolute: ’as they settle’
glossary.προχέοντο: προχέω — pour forth; mid./pass. stream forth; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= προεχέοντο): ’poured forth’
glossary.πρῆσαι: πίμπρημι (πρήθω) — burn, set on fire; aor. inf. act.: ’to burn’
glossary.πτερύγεσσι: πτέρυξ — wing; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πτέρυξι)
glossary.πόλεμος: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
glossary.σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.σκαμάνδριον: Σκαμάνδριος — of the Scamander, Scamandrian; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with πεδίον · also Σκαμάνδριος — Scamandrius, son of Strophius; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σκαμανδρίῳ: Σκαμάνδριος — of the Scamander, Scamandrian; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with λειμῶνι
glossary.σκοπέλῳ: σκόπελος — rock, crag, cliff; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.στήθεσφιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. in epic -φιν, a case ending serving as gen. or dat. (= Attic στήθους, στήθει); after ἀμφί: ’about the chest’ · also after διά: ’through the chest’
glossary.στυγερῷ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.συμφράδμονες: συμφράδμων — counselling together; as noun, fellow-counsellor; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σχίζῃσιν: σχίζα — split wood, billet, log; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.τελαμὼν: τελαμών — broad strap, shield-strap, baldric; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
glossary.τιταίνων: τιταίνω — stretch, strain; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’straining’
glossary.τοιοῦτοι: τοιοῦτος — of such a kind, such; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
glossary.τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’ · also fem. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (φιλότητος … τῆς ’that friendship’)
glossary.φαίνεται: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’appears, is plain to see’
glossary.φυγέειν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic φυγεῖν)
glossary.φυγεῖν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. inf. act. (Attic form, = epic φυγέειν): ’to flee’
glossary.χαλεπαίνων: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, be angry, rage; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’in anger’
glossary.χθὼν: χθών — earth, ground; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀΐδηλον: ἀΐδηλος — destructive, baneful (exact sense debated); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδ’ (two-ending adjective): ’destructive (child)’
glossary.ἀγήρων: ἀγήρως — ageless, never growing old; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαλλόμενα: ἀγάλλομαι — exult, glory in (+ dat.); pres. part. mid. neut. nom. pl.: ’exulting’
glossary.ἀγειρόντων: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; pres. imper. 3 pl. act.: ’let them gather’
glossary.ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
glossary.ἀδελφεὸν: ἀδελφεός — brother (epic form = Attic ἀδελφός); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
glossary.ἀθρόοι: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκτῇ: ἀκτή — headland, promontory, shore; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ῇ)
glossary.ἀμέγαρτον: ἀμέγαρτος — unenviable, wretched, dreadful; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμβαλλώμεθα: ἀναβάλλομαι — put off, delay; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., epic ἀμβ- for ἀναβ-: ’let us put off’
glossary.ἀμπείραντες: ἀναπείρω — pierce through, spit (meat); aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic ἀμπ- for ἀναπ-: ’having spitted’
glossary.ἀμφιβρότης: ἀμφιβρότη — covering the man on both sides (of a shield); fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ἀσπίδος
glossary.ἀνάβλησις: ἀνάβλησις — putting off, delay; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνθεμόεντι: ἀνθεμόεις — flowered, decorated with flowers; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀνστάντες: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intrans. aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic apocope (ἀνστάντες = ἀναστάντες)
glossary.ἀντιβίοις: ἀντίβιος — hostile, face to face, opposing; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
glossary.ἀπίθησεν: ἀπιθέω — disobey; aor. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἀπείθησεν); with οὐκ: ’did not disobey’
glossary.ἀπρήκτους: ἄπρηκτος — unavailing, fruitless, without result; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἄπρακτος)
glossary.ἀριστῆας: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief, champion; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀσίω: Ἄσιος — Asian, of Asia (the Lydian region); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with λειμῶνι
glossary.ἀφύλλοισιν: ἄφυλλος — leafless, stripped of leaves; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with σχίζῃσιν
glossary.ἁλοῦσά: ἁλίσκομαι — be taken, be captured; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε: ’having been taken’
glossary.ἄλληκτον: ἄλληκτος — unceasing, not to be stopped; adj. of two endings, neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σθένος
glossary.ἄνθεα: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄνθη)
glossary.ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
glossary.ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
glossary.ἄρκιον: ἄρκιος — sufficing, sure, safe; neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject
glossary.ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling (ἀ- + root of ’say’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κῦδος: ’boundless’
glossary.ἐΰξοον: εὔξοος — well-polished, smooth; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic ἐΰξοον
glossary.ἐγγυαλίζει: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hands of, deliver, grant; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐγείρομεν: ἐγείρω — rouse, awaken; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., short vowel, in a purpose clause after ὄφρα κε: ’that we may rouse’ · also pres. subj. 1 pl. in a temporal clause after ὁππότε: ’when we rouse’ · also pres. subj. 1 pl., short vowel, standing for the future in a main clause: ’we shall rouse’ · also pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us rouse’ · also pres. subj. 1 pl., purpose clause after ὄφρα without κε: ’so that we may rouse’
glossary.ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐπεκραίαινε: ἐπικραιαίνω — bring to pass, fulfil (a prayer); impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was fulfilling’
glossary.ἐπιφλέγει: ἐπιφλέγω — blaze over, set ablaze, consume; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐπονεῖτο: πονέομαι — toil, be busy with; impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐρίτιμον: ἐρίτιμος — much honoured, very precious; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρχομένων: ἔρχομαι — go, come, march; pres. part. mid. gen. pl. masc.: ’of those going’
glossary.ἐσσεῖται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic ἐσσεῖται (= Attic ἔσται)
glossary.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’)
glossary.ἐϋπλεκέες: ἐϋπλεκής — well-plaited, well-woven; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἑκατόμβοιος: ἑκατόμβοιος — worth a hundred oxen; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑκτόρεον: Ἑκτόρειος — of Hector, Hector’s; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χιτῶνα
glossary.ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
glossary.ἔρεζε: ῥέζω — do, perform; of sacrifice, offer (+ dat. of the god); impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἔρεζε = ἔρρεζε)
glossary.ἔριδας: ἔρις — strife, quarrel; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’go!’ · also pres. inf. mid., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι), after φαίης: ’to be going’
glossary.ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc., accented ἔς before an enclitic
glossary.ἔχουσ: ἔχω — have, hold, carry; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσα): ’holding’
glossary.ἕκαθεν: ἑκάς (ἕκαθεν) — far off, from afar; adv., epic -θεν (= Attic πόρρωθεν)
glossary.ἕκτον: ἕκτος — sixth; ordinal, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
glossary.ἠβαιόν: ἠβαιός — little, small; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, almost always with a negative: ’not even a little’
glossary.ἠβαιὸν: ἠβαιός — little, small; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, almost always with a negative: ’not even a little’
glossary.ἠερέθονται: ἠερέθομαι — hover, dangle, sway in the air; pres. 3 pl. mid./pass.: ’dangle’ · also ’flutter, be unsteady’ (of wits): ’are fluttering’
glossary.ἠμύσειε: ἠμύω — sink down, bow, collapse; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential with κε: ’would collapse’
glossary.ἡμετέρῃσιν: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), agreeing with χερσίν
glossary.ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; by metonymy, fire; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἦρχον: ἄρχω — begin, lead, rule; impf. 1 sg.: ’I began, I led’ · also impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (Βοιωτῶν … ἦρχον)
glossary.ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἱέρευσε: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter (a victim); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’sacrificed’
glossary.ἱδρώσει: ἱδρόω — sweat; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will sweat’
glossary.ἱρά: ἱερός (Ionic ἱρός) — sacred; neut. pl. as noun, offerings; neut. acc. pl. (= Attic ἱερά)
glossary.ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
glossary.ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
glossary.ἷκε: ἵκω — come, arrive at, reach; impf. 3 sg. (= ἷκεν), with long ι: ’reached’
glossary.ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth, biting; adv.
glossary.ὀρέοντο: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; mid. rise up, hasten; ὀρέοντο, Homeric 3 pl. mid. (impf. in force): ’rose up, hastened’
glossary.ὅσσά: ὅσος — as great, as many as; neut. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὅσα): ’as many as’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of its verb: ’whatever’ (ὅσσά κεν αὐτοὶ δῶσιν ’whatever they themselves may give’) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with its noun: ’as many (prizes) as’ (ὅσσά … ἀέθλια)
glossary.ὑπείρεχον: ὑπερέχω — hold over, hold above (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. act., epic ὑπείρεχον (= Attic ὑπερεῖχον)
glossary.ὑψηλῇ: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκυπόδεσσιν: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ὠκύποσι), agreeing with ἵπποισιν
glossary.ὥρῃ: ὥρα — season, time; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
glossary.ᾔδεε: οἶδα — know; plpf. (impf. in sense) 3 sg., epic ᾔδεε (= Attic ᾔδει): ’knew’
glossary.ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ῥωγαλέον: ῥωγαλέος — rent, torn, in tatters; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χιτῶνα
glossary.αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰπόλια: αἰπόλιον — herd of goats; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰπὺ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. sg. · also Αἰπύ — Aepy, a town of Messenia; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰχμηταὶ: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.αἴγιναν: Αἴγινα — Aegina, island in the Saronic Gulf; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.: ’which’ (with τε, in a simile) · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl., with γε: ’they, those’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with τε, of the Trojan women: ’who’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with κε + subj., of the Trojan women: ’those who may be’ · also relative, fem. nom. pl., without τε, of ships: ’which’ (αἵ οἱ ἕποντο ’which followed him’) · also relative, fem. nom. pl., with τε, continuing a list: ’those which’ (αἵ τ’ ἀπ’ ἐπισσώτρων ’and those from the tires’)
glossary.αὐγειὰς: Αὐγειαί — Augeiae, a Locrian town; fem. acc. pl. · also Αὐγειαί — Augeiae, a Laconian town; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βαθὺν: βαθύς — deep; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βοαγρίου: Βοάγριος — the Boagrius, a river of Locris; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.βοιωτῶν: Βοιωτοί — the Boeotians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.βόεσσι: βοῦς — ox, cow; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic βουσί): ’among the cows’ · also dat. pl., of hides, ox-hide shields: ’oxhides’ (τυκτῇσι βόεσσι ’with fashioned oxhides’)
glossary.βῆσσάν: Βῆσσα — Bessa, a Locrian town (also βῆσσα ’wooded glen’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γλαφυραὶ: γλαφυρός — hollow; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.γλισᾶντ: Γλίσας — Glisas, a Boeotian town; acc. sg., elided (Γλισᾶντ’ = Γλίσαντα)
glossary.γραῖάν: Γραῖα — Graea, a Boeotian town (also γραῖα ’old woman’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δίου: Δῖον — Dium, a town of Euboea; neut. gen. sg. (Δίου) · also δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. gen. sg. (δίου Ἀρηϊθόου ’of heavenly Areithous’)
glossary.δαυλίδα: Δαυλίς — Daulis, a Phocian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δηΐων: δήϊος — hostile; as noun, an enemy; masc. gen. pl., epic δηΐων (= Attic δηίων)
glossary.διακρίνωσιν: διακρίνω — separate, sort apart; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a general simile (subj. without κε in the comparison clause)
glossary.διαρραῖσαι: διαρραίω — shatter utterly, destroy; aor. inf. act.: ’to shatter’
glossary.διεκόσμεον: διακοσμέω — marshal, set in order; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic διεκόσμουν)
glossary.διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δυοκαίδεκα: δυοκαίδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable (= Attic δώδεκα)
glossary.δόμῳ: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γένος: ’heavenly’
glossary.εἰαρινῇ: εἰαρινός — of spring; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἐαρινῇ)
glossary.εἰλέσιον: Εἰλέσιον — Eilesion, a Boeotian town; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰρέτριάν: Ἐρέτρια — Eretria, a city of Euboea; fem. acc. sg., epic Εἰρέτρια (= Attic Ἐρέτρια)
glossary.εἰσαναβᾶσα: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having gone up’
glossary.εἶχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.): ’they held, occupied’ (of places)
glossary.εὐβοίης: Εὔβοια — Euboea, the long island off Attica; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.εὐρύαλος: Εὐρύαλος — Euryalus, an Argive leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρύχορον: εὐρύχορος — with wide dancing-places, spacious; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὔβοιαν: Εὔβοια — Euboea, the long island off Attica; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὔτρησίν: Εὔτρησις — Eutresis, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.ζείδωρος: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); adj., fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, anciently also ’life-giving’
glossary.ζώνην: ζώνη — belt, girdle, waist; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect · also fem. acc. sg., governed by κατά: ’at the girdle’ (κατὰ ζώνην)
glossary.θέσπειαν: Θέσπεια — Thespeia, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θίσβην: Θίσβη — Thisbe, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θεαί: θεά — goddess; fem. nom. pl., predicate: ’goddesses’
glossary.θοοὶ: θοός — swift, quick; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θρέψε: τρέφω — nourish, rear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθρεψε)
glossary.θρόνιον: Θρόνιον — Thronium, a Locrian town; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θωρήσσοντο: θωρήσσω — arm with a breastplate; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic θωρήττω): ’armed themselves’
glossary.θώρηκας: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κάρυστον: Κάρυστος — Carystus, a town of Euboea; acc. sg.
glossary.κήρινθόν: Κήρινθος — Cerinthus, a town of Euboea; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic)
glossary.κίον: κίω — go, move; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκιον; Attic uses ἔρχομαι, εἶμι)
glossary.καλλίαρόν: Κάλλιαρος — Calliarus, a Locrian town; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.καπανῆος: Καπανεύς — Capaneus, father of Sthenelus; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.κεφαλὴν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of a verb of lifting: ’head’
glossary.κηφισοῖο: Κηφισός — the Cephisus, a river of Phocis; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.κηφισὸν: Κηφισός — the Cephisus, a river of Phocis; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κλονίος: Κλονίος — Clonius, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοίρανοι: κοίρανος — ruler, lord, commander; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κορώνειαν: Κορώνεια — Coroneia, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κοσμῆσαι: κοσμέω — arrange, marshal, set in order; aor. inf. act., limiting inf.: ’in marshalling’
glossary.κρατερῷ: κρατερός — strong, mighty; adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κρῖσάν: Κρῖσα — Crisa, a Phocian town; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.κυπάρισσον: Κυπάρισσος — Cyparissus, a Phocian town (also ’cypress’); acc. sg.
glossary.κόλπον: κόλπος — bosom, hollow, gulf (of the sea); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κώπας: Κῶπαι — Copae, a Boeotian town on Lake Copais; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κῦνόν: Κῦνος — Cynus, a Locrian town; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.λάθρῃ: λάθρῃ — secretly, by stealth; adv. (dat. sg. used adverbially)
glossary.λήϊτος: Λήϊτος — Leitus, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λίλαιαν: Λίλαια — Lilaea, a Phocian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λινοθώρηξ: λινοθώρηξ — wearing a linen corselet; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λοκρῶν: Λοκροί — the Locrians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μάσητά: Μάσης — Mases, a town of the Argolid; acc. sg. (Μάσητα, accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.μέλαιναι: μέλας — black, dark; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μένεα: μένος — might, spirit, fury; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic μένη)
glossary.μίδειαν: Μίδεια — Mideia, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μείων: μείων — smaller, less (comparative of μικρός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μεγαλήτορος: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, great of spirit (μέγας + ἦτορ ’heart’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μεδεῶνά: Μεδεών — Medeon, a Boeotian town; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.μελίῃσι: μελίη — ash tree; ash-wood spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.μεμαῶτες: μέμονα — be eager, strive; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (μεμαώς, μεμαῶτ-), with present sense: ’eager’
glossary.μενεσθεύς: Μενεσθεύς — Menestheus, the Athenian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεταπρέπει: μεταπρέπω — be conspicuous among, stand out among; pres. 3 sg., + dat.
glossary.μηκιστέος: Μηκιστεύς — Mecisteus, father of Euryalus; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.μιγέωσιν: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. pass. subj. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (μιγέωσιν = Attic μιγῶσιν): ’have mingled’
glossary.μινύειον: Μινύειος — Minyan, of the Minyae; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μνησαίαθ: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. call to mind, remember; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., elided (μνησαίαθ’ = μνησαίατο): ’might call to mind’
glossary.μοῦσαι: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of song; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., in address: ’Muses’
glossary.μυθήσομαι: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; fut. 1 sg., or short-vowel aor. subj.; with οὐκ ἂν: ’I could not tell’
glossary.μυιάων: μυῖα — fly; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μυκαλησσόν: Μυκαλησσός — Mycalessus, a Boeotian town; acc. sg.
glossary.νέες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νέες (= Attic νῆες)
glossary.ναιετάασκον: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl., iterative -ασκον and uncontracted (= Attic ᾤκουν): ’used to dwell in’
glossary.ναυβολίδαο: Ναυβολίδης — son of Naubolus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ναῖον: ναίω — dwell in, inhabit; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔναιον), + acc.
glossary.νηῷ: ναός — temple, shrine; masc. dat. sg., Ionic νηός (= Attic νεώς, dat. νεῷ)
glossary.νομῷ: νομός — pasture, grazing-ground; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.νῆάς: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.νῖσάν: Νῖσα — Nisa, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; neut. acc. sg.: ’only, nothing but’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’alone’, agreeing with the object
glossary.πάρεστέ: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. 2 pl. (accent from enclitic τε): ’you are present’
glossary.πέρην: πέρην — across, on the far side; adv., used as prep. + gen.: ’across from’
glossary.πίονι: πίων — fat, rich, wealthy; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πανέλληνας: Πανέλληνες — all the Hellenes; masc. acc. pl. (πᾶν + Ἕλλην)
glossary.πανοπῆα: Πανοπεύς — Panopeus, a Phocian town; acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.παρελέξατο: παραλέγομαι — lie beside, lie with (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic
glossary.παρθένος: παρθένος — maiden, unmarried girl; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πεδίῳ: πεδίον — plain, flat land; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.περιτελλομένων: περιτέλλομαι — revolve, come round; pres. part. mid. gen. pl., gen. absolute with ἐνιαυτῶν: ’as the years come round’
glossary.πετεῶνα: Πετεών — Peteon, a Boeotian town; acc. sg.
glossary.πετεῶο: Πετεώς — Peteos, father of Menestheus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οο (= Attic -ῶ)
glossary.πετρήεσσαν: πετρήεις — rocky, craggy; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -ήεσσα
glossary.πηγῇς: πηγή — spring, source of a stream; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.πηνέλεως: Πηνέλεως — Peneleos, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πλάταιαν: Πλάταια — Plataea, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πλατέ: πλατύς — broad, wide; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (πλατέ’ = πλατέα)
glossary.πνείοντες: πνέω — blow, breathe; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., with an object: ’breathing (might)’
glossary.ποιήενθ: ποιήεις — grassy, rich in grass; adj., fem. acc. sg., elided (ποιήενθ’ = ποιήεντα)
glossary.ποιμνήϊον: ποιμνήϊος — of the flock, of the fold; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ποίμνιος)
glossary.πολλοῖσι: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic πολλοῖς)
glossary.πολυστάφυλον: πολυστάφυλος — rich in grapes; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πολυστάφυλόν: πολυστάφυλος — rich in grapes; adj., fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.πολυτρήρωνά: πολυτρήρων — rich in doves; adj., fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.πολύκνημόν: πολύκνημος — with many mountain spurs, many-spurred; adj., masc. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted (Ποσειδάων = Attic Ποσειδῶν)
glossary.ποσιδήϊον: Ποσιδήϊος — of Poseidon, sacred to Poseidon; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ποσείδειος)
glossary.προγενέστερος: προγενής — born before, elder; adj., comparative προγενέστερος, masc. nom. sg.: ’older’
glossary.προθοήνωρ: Προθοήνωρ — Prothoenor, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προπάσας: πρόπας — all together, every one; adj., fem. acc. pl.: ’all of them’
glossary.πυθῶνά: Πυθών — Pytho, the later Delphi; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.σαλαμῖνος: Σαλαμίς — Salamis, island off Attica; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σθένελος: Σθένελος — Sthenelus, son of Capaneus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σκάρφην: Σκάρφη — Scarphe, a Locrian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σκῶλόν: Σκῶλος — Scolus, a Boeotian town; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.στέρνον: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect
glossary.στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.σταθμὸν: σταθμός — steading, farmstead, fold; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.στόματ: στόμα — mouth; neut. nom. pl., elided (στόματ’ = στόματα)
glossary.στύρα: Στύρα — Styra, a town of Euboea; neut. pl. acc.
glossary.στῆσε: ἵστημι — set up, station, moor; aor. act. 3 sg., transitive, unaugmented (= ἔστησε)
glossary.σχεδίος: Σχεδίος — Schedius, a Phocian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σχοῖνόν: Σχοῖνος — Schoenus, a Boeotian town; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.τάρφην: Τάρφη — Tarphe, a Locrian town; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.τέκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἔτεκεν)
glossary.τίρυνθά: Τίρυνς — Tiryns, a city of the Argolid; acc. sg. Τίρυνθα
glossary.ταλαϊονίδαο: Ταλαϊονίδης — son of Talaïon (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ταύροισι: ταῦρος — bull; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ταύροις)
glossary.τειχιόεσσαν: τειχιόεις — walled, with strong walls; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα
glossary.τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τεσσαράκοντα: τεσσαράκοντα — forty; numeral, indeclinable, epic (= Attic τετταράκοντα)

glossary.τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’such a one’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’such (a thing)’, alone or correlative with οἷον (τοῖον … οἷον ’such … as’)
glossary.τρίτατος: τρίτατος — third; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic τρίτος)
glossary.τριήκοντα: τριήκοντα — thirty; numeral, indeclinable, epic (= Attic τριάκοντα)
glossary.τροιζῆν: Τροιζήν — Troezen, a city of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg., elided (Τροιζῆν’ = Τροιζῆνα)
glossary.τόσος: τόσος — so great, so big; masc. nom. sg., correlative with ὅσος
glossary.τόσσοι: τόσος — so many, so great; masc. nom. pl., epic τόσσος (= Attic τοσοῦτοι)
glossary.φάλαγγες: φάλαγξ — battle-line, line of battle; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.φωκήων: Φωκεῖς — the Phocians; masc. gen. pl., epic Φωκήων (= Attic Φωκέων)
glossary.φωνὴ: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φὼς: φώς — man; masc. nom. sg. (epic, φωτός in the gen.)

glossary.χαλκίδα: Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a city of Euboea; fem. acc. sg. · also Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a town of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χαλκωδοντιάδης: Χαλκωδοντιάδης — son of Chalcodon (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀβάντων: Ἄβαντες — the Abantes, a tribe of Euboea; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀγέληφι: ἀγέλη — herd; fem. dat. sg., epic -φι (= Attic ἀγέλῃ): ’in the herd’
glossary.ἀγακλειτοῦ: ἀγακλειτός — renowned, glorious; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀγρομένῃσι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. part. mid. fem. dat. pl., syncopated (ἀγρομένῃσι = Attic ἀγειραμέναις): ’assembling’
glossary.ἀζεΐδαο: Ἀζεΐδης — son of Azeus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀθήνῃς: Ἀθῆναι — Athens; fem. dat. pl. (locative), Ionic -ῃς (= Attic Ἀθήναις)
glossary.ἀθηναίων: Ἀθηναῖοι — the Athenians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀμπελόεντ: ἀμπελόεις — vine-clad, rich in vines; adj., fem. acc. sg., elided (ἀμπελόεντ’ = ἀμπελόεντα)

glossary.ἀνθηδόνα: Ἀνθηδών — Anthedon, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀριστερὰ: ἀριστερός — left; neut. acc. pl., used adverbially with ἐπί: ’on the left (hand)’
glossary.ἀρκεσίλαός: Ἀρκεσίλαος — Arcesilaus, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.ἀρχοὺς: ἀρχός — leader, commander; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀσίνην: Ἀσίνη — Asine, a town of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀσκάλαφος: Ἀσκάλαφος — Ascalaphus, son of Ares; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀσπιδιώτας: ἀσπιδιώτης — shield-bearing, armed with a shield; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀσπληδόνα: Ἀσπληδών — Aspledon, a Boeotian town; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀστυόχη: Ἀστυόχη — Astyoche, mother of Ascalaphus and Ialmenus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁλίαρτον: Ἁλίαρτος — Haliartus, a Boeotian town; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄβαντες: Ἄβαντες — the Abantes, a tribe of Euboea; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγγεα: ἄγγος — vessel, pail; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄγγη)
glossary.ἄγεν: ἄγω — lead, take, bring; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἦγεν) · also ἄγνυμι — break; aor. 2 pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐάγησαν): ’were bent, broken back’ (of arrow-barbs)
glossary.ἄκτορος: Ἄκτωρ — Actor, father of Astyoche; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄλσος: ἄλσος — sacred grove; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄργός: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition to a noun in the nominative (Ἄργός τε Σπάρτη τε ’Argos and Sparta’)
glossary.ἄρεϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
glossary.ἄρνην: Ἄρνη — Arne, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρουρα: ἄρουρα — ploughland, soil; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρρηκτος: ἄρρηκτος — unbroken, unbreakable; adj. (2 endings), fem. nom. sg.

glossary.ἐλεφήνωρ: Ἐλεφήνωρ — Elephenor, leader of the Abantes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλεῶν: Ἐλεών — Eleon, a Boeotian town; acc. sg., elided (Ἐλεῶν’ = Ἐλεῶνα)
glossary.ἐνέμοντ: νέμομαι — dwell in, inhabit; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἐνέμοντ’ = ἐνέμοντο), + acc.

glossary.ἐνιαυτῶν: ἐνιαυτός — year, cycle of the seasons; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπίδαυρον: Ἐπίδαυρος — Epidaurus, a city of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.ἐπιχθόνιος: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth, earthly; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐρατεινὰς: ἐρατεινός — lovely, delightful; adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρεχθῆος: Ἐρεχθεύς — Erechtheus, early king of Athens; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ἐρυθράς: Ἐρυθραί — Erythrae, a Boeotian town (also ἐρυθρός ’red’); fem. acc. pl.

glossary.ἐτεωνόν: Ἐτεωνός — Eteonus, a Boeotian town; masc. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic)
glossary.ἐχούσας: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. fem. acc. pl.: ’holding’
glossary.ἐϋκτίμενον: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ), agreeing with πτολίεθρον
glossary.ἑκάστῃ: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑρμιόνην: Ἑρμιόνη — Hermione, a town of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.ἔμπλην: ἔμπλην — hard by, next to; adv. or prep. + gen.
glossary.ἔναιον: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.): ’they dwelt’
glossary.ἔξοχος: ἔξοχος — standing out, pre-eminent (+ partitive gen.); adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.

glossary.ἔριζεν: ἐρίζω — contend, vie, rival; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔσπετε: ἐννέπω — tell, say; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic ἔσπετε (= Attic εἴπατε): ’tell!’
glossary.ἔφαλον: ἔφαλος — by the sea, sea-girt; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔχουσαι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’holding’
glossary.ἠλάσκουσιν: ἠλάσκω — wander, roam about (by-form of ἀλάομαι); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἠϊόνας: Ἠϊόνες — Eïones, a town of the Argolid (also ἠϊών ’shore’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἡγεμόνες: ἡγεμών — leader, commander; masc. nom. pl.

glossary.ἡγεμόνευε: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, be leader (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. (augment not visible on ἡ-)
glossary.ἡγεμόνευεν: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, be leader (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., movable ν
glossary.ἡγεῖτο: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was leading’
glossary.ἡρώεσσιν: ἥρως — hero; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἥρωσιν)
glossary.ἰάλμενος: Ἰάλμενος — Ialmenus, a Boeotian leader, son of Ares; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰδ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj., elided (ἰδ’ = ἰδέ)
glossary.ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰφίτου: Ἴφιτος — Iphitus, father of Schedius and Epistrophus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. acc. sg. (the neut. has the same spelling) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κνέφας: ’holy (darkness)’
glossary.ἱερῆς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
glossary.ἱλάονται: ἱλάομαι — propitiate, appease; pres. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἱλῶνται)
glossary.ἱστίαιαν: Ἱστίαια — Histiaea, a city of Euboea; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴκελος: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴστέ: οἶδα — know; pres. 2 pl. ἴστε (accent from enclitic τε): ’you know’
glossary.ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
glossary.ἵσταντο: ἵστημι — set, place; mid. impf. 3 pl., intransitive: ’took their stand, were standing’

glossary.ὀγδώκοντα: ὀγδώκοντα — eighty; numeral, indeclinable, epic (= Attic ὀγδοήκοντα)
glossary.ὀγχηστόν: Ὀγχηστός — Onchestus, a Boeotian town with a grove of Poseidon; acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλυμπιάδες: Ὀλυμπιάς — Olympian, of Olympus; adj., fem. nom. pl.

glossary.ὀπόεντά: Ὀπόεις — Opoeis, a Locrian town; acc. sg. Ὀπόεντα (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.ὀρεκτῇσιν: ὀρεκτός — stretched out, outstretched; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ὀρχομενὸν: Ὀρχομενός — Orchomenus, a Boeotian city; acc. sg. · also the Arcadian Orchomenus, acc. sg.
glossary.ὀϊλῆος: Ὀϊλεύς — Oileus, father of the lesser Ajax; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ὁμοῖος: ὅμοιος — like, similar; adj., masc. nom. sg., + dat.
glossary.ὄζος: ὄζος — branch, shoot; fig. scion, offshoot; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὅσος: ὅσος — as great/many as; correlative adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑάμπολιν: Ὑάμπολις — Hyampolis, a Phocian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπερώϊον: ὑπερῷον — upper room, upper storey; neut. acc. sg., epic ὑπερώϊον (= Attic ὑπερῷον)
glossary.ὑποθήβας: Ὑποθῆβαι — Hypothebae, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑρίην: Ὑρίη — Hyria, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑσμίνην: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκαλέην: Ὠκαλέη — Ocalea, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ῥήξειν: ῥήγνυμι — break, shatter; fut. inf. act.: ’to break’
glossary.ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
glossary.αἰγίλιπα: Αἴγιλιψ — Aegilips, a place in Odysseus’ realm; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.αἰζηῶν: αἰζηός — vigorous young man; masc. gen. pl.: ’young men’
glossary.αἰπεινὴν: αἰπεινός — steep, sheer (cf. αἰπύς); adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰπύτιον: Αἰπύτιος — of Aepytus, Aepytian; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τύμβον
glossary.αἰτωλοῖσι: Αἰτωλοί — the Aetolians; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἰτωλῶν: Αἰτωλοί — the Aetolians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.αἴγιον: Αἴγιον — Aegium, a town of Achaea; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.αὐγηϊάδαο: Αὐγηϊάδης — son of Augeas (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αὐταὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
glossary.βίης: βίη — strength, force, might; fem. gen. sg. · also periphrastic gen. with a proper adj.: βίης Ἡρακληείης ’the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles himself)
glossary.βουπράσιόν: Βουπράσιον — Buprasium, a town of Elis; neut. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.βρυσειάς: Βρυσειαί — Bryseiae, a Laconian town; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.γηράσκοντα: γηράσκω — grow old; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’growing old’
glossary.γονόεσσαν: Γονόεσσα — Gonoessa, a town of Achaea; fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα
glossary.γόρτυνά: Γόρτυν — Gortyn, a city of Crete; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.διώρης: Διώρης — Diores, an Epeian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δουλίχιον: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca; neut. acc. sg. · also with suffix -δε, ’to Dulichium’
glossary.δουλιχίοιο: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δουρὶ: δόρυ — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δορί)
glossary.δυώδεκα: δώδεκα — twelve; indeclinable numeral, epic δυώδεκα (= Attic δώδεκα)
glossary.δώριον: Δώριον — Dorium, a town of Messenia; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰνοσίφυλλον: εἰνοσίφυλλος — leaf-shaking, with quivering foliage; adj. of two endings, acc. sg., agreeing with Νήριτον · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with Πήλιον
glossary.εἵπετο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 sg., with augment εἵ- (= ἐ- + ἕπετο)
glossary.εὐπήκτῳ: εὔπηκτος — well-framed, well-fastened (εὖ + πήγνυμι); adj., neut. dat. sg., agreeing with μεγάρῳ
glossary.εὐρεῖαν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὐρύτου: Εὔρυτος — Eurytus, name of an Epeian leader’s father and of the king of Oechalia; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ζάκυνθον: Ζάκυνθος — Zacynthus, an island off western Greece; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θάλπιος: Θάλπιος — Thalpius, an Epeian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θάμυριν: Θάμυρις — Thamyris, a Thracian singer; masc. acc. sg., -ιν
glossary.θάνε: θνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθανε)
glossary.θαλάσσια: θαλάσσιος — of the sea; adj., neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.θεοειδὴς: θεοειδής — godlike in form; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεσπέσιον: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, more than human (lit. god-uttered); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θεσπεσίην: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, more than human (lit. god-uttered); adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θοαί: θοός — swift, quick; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.θρήϊκα: Θρῆϊξ — Thracian; masc. acc. sg., epic Θρήϊκα (= Attic Θρᾷκα)
glossary.θρύον: Θρύον — Thryum, a town on the Alpheus in Elis; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θόας: Θόας — Thoas, an Aetolian leader (son of Andraemon); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάλλιστος: καλός — beautiful, fair; superl. κάλλιστος, masc. nom. sg.: ’most beautiful’
glossary.κάμειρον: Κάμειρος — Cameirus, a city of Rhodes; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καλυδῶνά: Καλυδών — Calydon, a city of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.κατέκτα: κατακτείνω — kill; aor. 3 sg., epic root aorist κατέκτα (= Attic κατέκτεινε)
glossary.κατέχευε: καταχέω — pour down over; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic κατέχεεν), augmented, + dat.: ’shed upon’
glossary.καταφυλαδόν: καταφυλαδόν — tribe by tribe, by clans (κατά + φῦλον); adv.
glossary.κεφαλλῆνας: Κεφαλλήν — Cephallenian, subject of Odysseus; masc. acc. pl.

glossary.κλεωνάς: Κλεωναί — Cleonae, a town of the Argolid; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κλυτὸς: κλυτός — famous, renowned; adj., masc. nom. sg. · also the masc. form used with a fem. name, nom. sg., agreeing with Ἱπποδάμεια
glossary.κνωσόν: Κνωσός — Cnossus, a city of Crete; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κοίλην: κοῖλος — hollow; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κοσμηθέντες: κοσμέω — arrange, marshal, draw up in order; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having been ordered’
glossary.κοῦραι: κούρη — girl, daughter (Attic κόρη); fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., in address
glossary.κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κρητῶν: Κρῆτες — the Cretans; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κροκύλει: Κροκύλεια — Crocylea, a place in Odysseus’ realm; neut. acc. pl., elided (Κροκύλει’ = Κροκύλεια)
glossary.κτεάτου: Κτέατος — Cteatus, an Epeian, father of Amphimachus; masc. gen. sg.

glossary.κυλλήνης: Κυλλήνη — Cyllene, a mountain of Arcadia; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κυπαρισσήεντα: Κυπαρισσήεις — Cyparisseis (’abounding in cypresses’), a town of Messenia; acc. sg., epic -ήεντα
glossary.κόρινθον: Κόρινθος — Corinth, a city; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.λακεδαίμονα: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the land in which Sparta lies; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.λύκαστον: Λύκαστος — Lycastus, a city of Crete; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λύκτον: Λύκτος — Lyctus, a city of Crete; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μέγης: Μέγης — Meges, leader of the Dulichians (son of Phyleus); masc. nom. sg.

glossary.μαντινέην: Μαντινέη — Mantinea, a town of Arcadia; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μεγάρῳ: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.μεγαθύμους: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μελέαγρος: Μελέαγρος — Meleager, son of Oeneus; masc. nom. sg.

glossary.νήριτον: Νήριτον — Neriton, a mountain on Ithaca; neut. acc. sg.

glossary.νιρεὺς: Νιρεύς — Nireus, leader of the men of Syme; masc. nom. sg.

glossary.ξανθὸς: ξανθός — fair-haired, yellow, tawny; adj., masc. nom. sg.

glossary.οἴτυλον: Οἴτυλος — Oetylus, a Laconian town; acc. sg.

glossary.πέτρη: πέτρη — rock, crag; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.παρρασίην: Παρρασίη — Parrhasia, a district of Arcadia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη
glossary.παῦρος: παῦρος — few, small, scanty; adj., masc. nom. sg.

glossary.πελλήνην: Πελλήνη — Pellene, a town of Achaea; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.πηρὸν: πηρός — maimed, disabled (limb or sight); adj., masc. acc. sg.

glossary.πολύμηλον: πολύμηλος — rich in flocks (πολύς + μῆλον ’sheep, goat’); adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πολύξεινος: Πολύξεινος — Polyxeinus, an Epeian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προθυμίῃσι: προθυμία — eagerness, zeal; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.πρῶτ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (πρῶτ’ = πρῶτα): ’first, at first’
glossary.πτελεὸν: Πτελεός — Pteleum, a town of Messenia; acc. sg. · also Πτελεός — Pteleum, a town of Thessaly; acc. sg., with λεχεποίην
glossary.πυλήνην: Πυλήνη — Pylene, a town of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.σάμον: Σάμος — Samos, an island near Ithaca (Cephallenia); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σελλήεντος: Σελλήεις — the Selleis, a river near Ephyre; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.σικυῶν: Σικυών — Sicyon, a city; fem. acc. sg., elided (Σικυῶν’ = Σικυῶνα)
glossary.σπάρτην: Σπάρτη — Sparta, city in the Peloponnese, home of Menelaus; acc. sg.
glossary.στεῦτο: στεῦμαι — stand as if to do something; declare solemnly, vow, boast (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.στρατίην: Στρατίη — Stratie, a town of Arcadia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη
glossary.στύμφηλόν: Στύμφηλος — Stymphelus, a town of Arcadia; acc. sg.

glossary.τέσσαρες: τέσσαρες — four; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. (Attic τέτταρες)

glossary.τεγέην: Τεγέη — Tegea, a town of Arcadia; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τετάρτων: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal adj., masc. gen. pl.: ’of the fourth’

glossary.τρίχα: τρίχα — in three parts, threefold; adv. (cf. τριχθά)
glossary.τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same form)
glossary.τρηχεῖαν: τρηχύς — rugged, rough; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τριχθὰ: τριχθά — in three parts, threefold; adv., epic (cf. τρίχα)
glossary.τύμβον: τύμβος — burial mound, grave-mound; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.υἱέες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἱέες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
glossary.φίληθεν: φιλέω — love; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic ending -θεν (= Attic ἐφιλήθησαν): ’were loved’
glossary.φαιστόν: Φαιστός — Phaestus, a city of Crete; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φενεόν: Φενεός — Pheneus, a town of Arcadia; acc. sg.
glossary.φεύγων: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’fleeing’
glossary.φυλεΐδης: Φυλεΐδης — son of Phyleus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φυλεύς: Φυλεύς — Phyleus, father of Meges; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φᾶρίν: Φᾶρις — Pharis, a Laconian town; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)

glossary.χαρόποιό: Χάροπος — Charopus, father of Nireus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

glossary.ἀγασθένεος: Ἀγασθένης — Agasthenes, father of Polyxeinus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)

glossary.ἀγερώχων: ἀγέρωχος — lofty, proud (meaning uncertain); adj., masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀγκαίοιο: Ἀγκαῖος — Ancaeus, father of Agapenor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀγλαΐης: Ἀγλαΐη — Aglaie, mother of Nireus; fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας) · also ἀγλαΐη — splendour, finery
glossary.ἀγχίαλον: ἀγχίαλος — near the sea, coastal; adj., fem. acc. sg.

glossary.ἀκτορίωνε: Ἀκτορίων — of Actor’s line (patronymic); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of Actor’s line’
glossary.ἀλήσιον: Ἀλήσιον — Aleisium, a place in Elis; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλαπαδνὸς: ἀλαπαδνός — feeble, weak; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλφειοῖο: Ἀλφειός — the Alpheus, river of the Peloponnese; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἀλώμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’wandering’
glossary.ἀμαρυγκεΐδης: Ἀμαρυγκεΐδης — son of Amarynceus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.

glossary.ἀμφιγένειαν: Ἀμφιγένεια — Amphigeneia, a town of Messenia; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμύκλας: Ἀμύκλαι — Amyclae, a Laconian town; fem. acc. pl.

glossary.ἀρήνην: Ἀρήνη — Arene, a town of Messenia; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀραιθυρέην: Ἀραιθυρέη — Araethyrea, a town of the Argolid; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -έη

glossary.ἀρκαδίην: Ἀρκαδίη — Arcadia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη
glossary.ἀρχοὶ: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀστυόχεια: Ἀστυόχεια — Astyocheia, mother of Tlepolemus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτάλαντος: ἀτάλαντος — equal (in weight), a match for; adj., masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’equal to’
glossary.ἀφέλοντο: ἀφαιρέω — take away, deprive of; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (ἀφέλοντο = Attic ἀφείλοντο)
glossary.ἀφνειόν: ἀφνειός — rich, wealthy; adj., acc. sg.
glossary.ἄδρηστος: Ἄδρηστος — Adrastus, an early king of Sicyon; masc. nom. sg. · also Adrastus, a Trojan warrior taken alive in battle; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun
glossary.ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.

glossary.ἐμβασίλευεν: ἐμβασιλεύω — be king in, reign; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν

glossary.ἐνυαλίῳ: Ἐνυάλιος — Enyalius, a name of Ares; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐπειοί: Ἐπειοί — the Epeians (people of Elis); masc. nom. pl.

glossary.ἐφύρης: Ἐφύρη — Ephyra, name of several towns, not always identifiable; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐχινάων: Ἐχῖναι — the Echinae, islands off the coast of Elis; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἐϋκτιμένας: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., fem. acc. pl., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ)
glossary.ἐϋσσέλμους: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (of ships); adj. of two endings, acc. pl., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ)
glossary.ἑκατόμπολιν: ἑκατόμπολις — with a hundred cities; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑλίκην: Ἑλίκη — Helice, a town of Achaea; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑοῖο: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἔμβαινον: ἐμβαίνω — embark, step in; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἔπηξε: πήγνυμι — fix, fasten, put together; aor. 3 sg., augmented (ἔπηξε): ’built (ships)’
glossary.ἕλος: Ἕλος — Helos, name of towns in Laconia and Elis; neut. acc. sg. · also ἕλος — marsh, marshy meadow; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕποντ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl., elided (ἕποντ’ = ἕποντο)
glossary.ἠΰς: ἠΰς — good, noble, brave; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀγαθός)
glossary.ἠνεμόεσσαν: ἠνεμόεις — windy, wind-swept (ἄνεμος); adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσα
glossary.ἡγησάσθην: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first (+ gen.); aor. 3 dual mid.: ’the two led’
glossary.ἡρακλεΐδης: Ἡρακλεΐδης — son of Heracles (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἡρακληείης: Ἡρακληεῖος — of Heracles, Heraclean; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.ἡρακληείῃ: Ἡρακληεῖος — of Heracles, Heraclean; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -εία)
glossary.ἤλιδα: Ἦλις — Elis, region of the western Peloponnese; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἤλιδος: Ἦλις — Elis, region of the western Peloponnese; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἤπειρον: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἦγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
glossary.ἰηλυσόν: Ἰήλυσος — Ialysus, a city of Rhodes; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱεράων: ἱερός — holy, sacred; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἵετο: ἵεμαι — hasten, be eager (+ dat./inf.); impf. 3 sg. mid. (middle of ἵημι ’send’)
glossary.ἷξεν: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. 3 sg. ἷξε(ν), movable ν
glossary.ὀρνειάς: Ὀρνειαί — Orneae, a town of the Argolid; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὀτρύνων: ὀτρύνω — urge on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’urging’
glossary.ὄζον: ὄζος — branch, twig; figuratively ’scion, offshoot’ of a family; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
glossary.ὑπερησίην: Ὑπερησίη — Hyperesia, a town of Achaea; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη
glossary.ὑρμίνη: Ὑρμίνη — Hyrmine, a town of Elis; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὠλενίη: Ὠλένιος — Olenian, of Olenus; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
glossary.ὤλενον: Ὤλενος — Olenus, a town of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl. · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for whom’
glossary.ᾤκηθεν: οἰκέω — dwell, settle; aor. pass. 3 pl., augmented, epic ending -θεν (= Attic ᾠκήθησαν): ’they settled’
glossary.ῥίπην: Ῥίπη — Rhipe, a town of Arcadia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -η
glossary.ῥοδίων: Ῥόδιοι — the Rhodians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ῥόδον: Ῥόδος — Rhodes, an island; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ῥόδου: Ῥόδος — Rhodes, an island; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ῥύτιόν: Ῥύτιον — Rhytium, a city of Crete; neut. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.αἰγανέῃσιν: αἰγανέη — light javelin, hunting-spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.αἰθίκεσσι: Αἰθίκες — the Aethices, a people whose land the Greek does not name; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.αὐτοκασίγνητος: αὐτοκασίγνητος — own brother, full brother (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βοίβην: Βοίβη — Boebe, a town by the Boebeian lake; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βοιβηΐδα: Βοιβηΐς — of Boebe, Boebean; adj. used of the lake, fem. acc. sg. (-ηΐδα), agreeing with λίμνην
glossary.γενεῇ: γενεή — birth, lineage, descent; fem. dat. sg.: ’by birth’
glossary.γλαφύρας: Γλαφύραι — Glaphyrae, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.γουνεὺς: Γουνεύς — Gouneus, leader of the Enienes and Perrhaebians; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive after δῖα: ’the divine one among women’ · also fem. gen. pl., dependent on χερσί: ’of the women’ · also fem. gen. pl. after πρό: ’in defence of the wives’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’in front of, for their wives’) · also fem. gen. pl., dependent on φῦλα: ’tribes of women’ · also fem. gen. pl., in apposition to ἀνθρώπων with ἀνδρῶν: ’of women’ · also fem. gen. pl., with ἤτε … ἤτε, dependent on θέμις: ’of men or of women’ (θέμις … ἀνδρῶν ἤτε γυναικῶν)
glossary.γυρτώνην: Γυρτώνη — Gyrtone, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δάρδανος: Δάρδανος — Dardanian, of the Trojan people; masc. nom. sg., used as an adjective with ἀνήρ: ’a Dardanian man’
glossary.δήμητρος: Δημήτηρ — Demeter, goddess of grain; fem. gen. sg., with τέμενος: ’of Demeter’
glossary.δίσκοισιν: δίσκος — discus; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), dat. of means: ’with discuses’
glossary.δεινοῦ: δεινός — dread, awful, terrible; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ὅρκου
glossary.δεύονθ: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. mid., elided and aspirated (δεύονθ’ = δεύοντο): ’were lacking’
glossary.διαπορθήσας: διαπορθέω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having sacked’
glossary.δυσηχέος: δυσηχής — grim-sounding, dreadful in noise; adj. of two endings, masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς), agreeing with πολέμοιο
glossary.δυσχείμερον: δυσχείμερος — wintry, with hard winters; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Δωδώνην
glossary.δωδώνην: Δωδώνη — Dodona, seat of the oracle of Zeus in Epirus; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δόμος: δόμος — house, household; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of a noble woman · also fem. voc. sg., in address (δῖα θεάων): ’heavenly one among goddesses’
glossary.εἰδότες: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. pl. (+ gen. ’skilled in’): ’knowing’
glossary.εἶδος: εἶδος — form, look, beauty; neut. acc. sg. (accusative of respect): ’in beauty’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’form, good looks’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’)
glossary.εὐαίμονος: Εὐαίμων — Euaemon, father of Eurypylus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.εὐηνοῖο: Εὔηνος — Euenus, father of Mynes and Epistrophus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.εὐρυπύλοιο: Εὐρύπυλος — Eurypylus, a king of Cos; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.εὐρύπυλος: Εὐρύπυλος — Eurypylus, son of Euaemon, leader of the men of Ormenium; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὔμηλος: Εὔμηλος — Eumelus, son of Admetus and Alcestis, leader of the men of Pherae; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ζωὸς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θήβης: Θήβη — Thebe, a town whose walls Achilles sacked; fem. gen. sg.: ’of Thebe’ · also Θήβη — Thebes, the Boeotian city of the Cadmeans; fem. gen. sg.: ’of Thebes’
glossary.θαυμακίην: Θαυμακίη — Thaumacia, a town among Philoctetes’ places; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θεσσαλοῦ: Θεσσαλός — Thessalus, son of Heracles; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θηλείας: θῆλυς — female; adj., fem. acc. pl. θηλείας, agreeing with the mares: ’female’
glossary.θοὸς: θοός — swift, quick; masc. nom. sg., epithet of a man
glossary.θρέψ: τρέφω — rear, nourish; aor. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (θρέψ’ = θρέψε), unaugmented (= ἔθρεψε): ’reared’
glossary.θυγατρῶν: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. gen. pl., partitive after ἀρίστη: ’best of the daughters’
glossary.κάσον: Κάσος — Casus, an island of the south-east Aegean; fem. acc. sg. (Κάσον)
glossary.κάτα: κατά — down; adv./preverb standing after its verb in tmesis (anastrophe): ἔχεν κάτα = κατεῖχεν ’held down’ · also prep. + acc., accent thrown back when it stands after its noun (anastrophe): ’throughout’ (πόλεμον κάτα ’throughout the war’)
glossary.καθύπερθεν: καθύπερθεν — from above, on top; adv.
glossary.καινεΐδαο: Καινεΐδης — son of Caeneus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.κακῷ: κακός — bad, evil, painful; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἕλκεϊ · also masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μύθῳ: ’evil (word)’
glossary.καλεῦντο: καλέω — call, name; impf. 3 pl. pass., epic -εῦντο (= Attic ἐκαλοῦντο), unaugmented: ’were called’
glossary.καλλίρροον: καλλίρροος — fair-flowing, with a beautiful stream; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλλίρρουν), agreeing with ὕδωρ
glossary.καλλιγύναικα: καλλιγύναιξ — with fair women; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἑλλάδα · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀχαιΐδα ’Achaea’
glossary.καλύδνας: Κάλυδναι — the Calydnae, a group of islands; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κεῖτ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 sg., elided (κεῖτο → κεῖτ’ before a vowel): ’lay, was lying’
glossary.κεῖτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκειτο): ’lay’, also with a neut. pl. subject (ἅρματα κεῖτο ’the chariots lay’)
glossary.κλωμακόεσσαν: κλωμακόεις — stony or terraced (sense uncertain; from κλῶμαξ ’heap of stones’); fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσαν, agreeing with Ἰθώμην
glossary.κορωνίσι: κορωνίς — curved (of ships); adj. of two endings, fem. dat. pl., agreeing with νήεσσι
glossary.κορώνου: Κόρωνος — Coronus, father of Leonteus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κράπαθόν: Κράπαθος — Crapathus, an island of the south-east Aegean; acc. sg. (Κράπαθον)
glossary.κρατέρ: κρατερός — mighty, strong, harsh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρατέρ’ = κρατερά), agreeing with ἄλγεα
glossary.κόσμησε: κοσμέω — set in order, marshal, array; aor. 3 sg.: ’marshalled’
glossary.κόσμησεν: κοσμέω — set in order, marshal, array; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’marshalled’
glossary.κύφου: Κύφος — Cyphus, a place in northern Greece; gen. sg., after ἐκ
glossary.κῶν: Κῶς — Cos, an island of the Aegean; fem. acc. sg. (Κῶν)
glossary.λίμνην: λίμνη — mere, standing water, lake; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λίπον: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔλιπον) · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I left’
glossary.λαχνήεντας: λαχνήεις — shaggy, hairy; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with Φῆρας
glossary.λεοντεὺς: Λεοντεύς — Leonteus, joint leader with Polypoetes, son of Coronus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λευκήν: λευκός — white, bright; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πόλιν
glossary.λεχεποίην: λεχεποίης — grass-bedded, with beds of grass (traditional sense; from λέχος and ποίη); acc. sg., agreeing with Πτελεόν · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀσωπόν: ’with beds of grass’
glossary.λυρνησσοῦ: Λυρνησσός — Lyrnessus, a town sacked by Achilles; gen. sg., after ἐκ
glossary.λυρνησσὸν: Λυρνησσός — Lyrnessus, a town sacked by Achilles; acc. sg.
glossary.λωτὸν: λωτός — lotus, a plant (a fruit men eat in the Odyssey, fodder for horses in the Iliad; which plant is uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάχοντο: μάχομαι — fight; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμάχοντο): ’were fighting’
glossary.μέδων: Μέδων — Medon, bastard son of Oïleus, a leader of Philoctetes’ men; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μέλαινα: μέλας — black, dark; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.: ’of flocks’ · also μῆλον — apple, tree-fruit; neut. gen. pl.: ’of apples’
glossary.μήνιεν: μηνίω — be angry, nurse wrath; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἐμήνιε)
glossary.μαγνήτων: Μάγνητες — the Magnetes, people of Magnesia in Thessaly; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μαχάων: Μαχάων — Machaon, a healer, son of Asclepius; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μελίβοιαν: Μελίβοια — Meliboea, a town among Philoctetes’ places; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μενεπτόλεμοί: μενεπτόλεμος — steadfast in battle (μένω + πόλεμος); masc. nom. pl., agreeing with Περαιβοί
glossary.μενεπτόλεμος: μενεπτόλεμος — steadfast in battle (μένω + πόλεμος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μηθώνην: Μηθώνη — Methone, a town among Philoctetes’ places; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μητέρα: μήτηρ — mother; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to Ἴτωνα · also fem. acc. sg., pendent object resumed by a pronoun: ’as for my mother’ (μητέρα … τὴν … ἀπέλυσε) · also fem. acc. sg., after ὑπό of motion: ’under (his) mother’
glossary.μνήσεσθαι: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); fut. inf. mid.: ’to be mindful’
glossary.μογήσας: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having toiled’
glossary.μοχθίζοντα: μοχθίζω — toil, suffer hardship; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’toiling, suffering’
glossary.μοῦσα: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of poetic inspiration; fem. voc. sg. (same form as the nom.): ’O Muse’
glossary.μυρμιδόνες: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, the people of Achilles; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μύνητ: Μύνης — Mynes, son of Euenus, struck down by Achilles; masc. acc. sg., elided (Μύνητ’ = Μύνητα)
glossary.νέμοντο: νέμω — distribute; mid. dwell in, inhabit, hold (+ acc.); impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’inhabited’
glossary.νίσυρόν: Νίσυρος — Nisyrus, an island of the Aegean; acc. sg. (Νίσυρον)
glossary.ναίεσκον: ναίω — dwell; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκ- (epic), unaugmented: ’kept dwelling’
glossary.νόθος: νόθος — bastard, born out of wedlock; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with υἱός
glossary.νῶτον: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. sg. (usually pl. νῶτα)
glossary.οἰέτεας: οἰέτης — of the same age (first part uncertain; traditional sense); adj., acc. pl. οἰέτεας, epic -εας (= Attic -εις)
glossary.οἰκί: οἰκίον — dwelling, home; neut. pl. οἰκία (acc. pl.), elided (οἰκί’ = οἰκία)
glossary.οἰχαλίην: Οἰχαλίη — Oechalia, the city of Eurytus; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.οἷσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with ἅρμασιν: ’its own’ · also masc. dat. pl., used as a noun: ’his own (men)’ · also relative ὅς, masc. dat. pl.: ’on whom’ (οἷσιν ἐπὶ … θῆκε ’on whom … set’) · also relative, dat. pl. of interest: ’for whom’ (οἷσιν ἀνάγκη ’for whom there is need’)
glossary.οὗτοι: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. pl.: ’these’
glossary.πέλασσεν: πελάζω — bring near, drive to; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἐπέλασεν), + dat.
glossary.πήλιον: Πήλιον — Pelion, mountain in Thessaly; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.παραὶ: παρά (epic παραί) — beside, along; prep. + acc.: ’beside’ · also adv., ’aside, to one side’ (παραὶ δέ οἱ ἐτράπετ’ ἔγχος ’and aside for him turned the spear’)
glossary.παῖδε: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’ · also masc. voc. dual, in address: ’dear sons’ (παῖδε φίλω) · also masc. acc. dual, object: ’two sons’ (δύο παῖδε λάβε ’caught two sons’)
glossary.πειριθόοιο: Πειρίθοος — Peirithous, father of Polypoetes; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πειριθόῳ: Πειρίθοος — Peirithous, father of Polypoetes; masc. dat. sg., with ὑπό of the father: ’to Peirithous’
glossary.πελίαο: Πελίας — Pelias, father of Alcestis; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πελασγικὸν: Πελασγικός — Pelasgian, of the Pelasgians; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἄργος
glossary.πεπυκασμένα: πυκάζω — cover thickly, wrap; perf. part. pass., neut. nom. pl.: ’covered over’
glossary.περαιβοὶ: Περαιβοί — the Perrhaebians, a people of northern Thessaly; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πηλίου: Πήλιον — Pelion, mountain in Thessaly; neut. gen. sg., after ἐκ
glossary.πηνειὸν: Πηνειός — the Peneius, river of Thessaly; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πηνειῷ: Πηνειός — the Peneius, river of Thessaly; masc. dat. sg., after συμμίσγεται
glossary.πηρείῃ: Πηρείη — Pereia, a place named only as where Apollo reared the mares; fem. dat. sg., after ἐν
glossary.ποδαλείριος: Ποδαλείριος — Podaleirius, a healer, son of Asclepius; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ποδώκεας: ποδώκης — fleet-footed; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl., epic -εας (= Attic -εις), agreeing with the mares
glossary.ποθέοντες: ποθέω — long for, miss; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθοῦντες)
glossary.πολυμήλου: πολύμηλος — rich in flocks; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἰφίκλου
glossary.πολυποίτης: Πολυποίτης — Polypoetes, son of Peirithous and joint leader with Leonteus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ποντοπόροισι: ποντοπόρος — sea-crossing, sea-faring; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πρωτεσίλαος: Πρωτεσίλαος — Protesilaus, a leader of the men of Phylace and its neighbours, killed as he leapt from his ship; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρωτεσιλάου: Πρωτεσίλαος — Protesilaus, a leader of the men of Phylace and its neighbours; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πρόθοος: Πρόθοος — Prothous, leader of the Magnetes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρώτιστον: πρῶτος — first; the strengthened superlative πρώτιστος: ’very first’; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the participle ἀποθρῴσκοντα (πολύ ’by far’ before it)
glossary.πτολιπόρθῳ: πτολίπορθος — city-sacking, sacker of cities; masc. dat. sg., epic πτολι- (= πολι-)
glossary.πόθεόν: ποθέω — long for, miss; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.), epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐπόθουν): ’longed for’
glossary.πύρασον: Πύρασος — Pyrasus, a town of Thessaly; acc. sg. (Πύρασον)
glossary.σέλινον: σέλινον — celery or parsley (or a plant like them); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σεληπιάδαο: Σεληπιάδης — son of Selepus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Εὐηνοῖο
glossary.σταφύλῇ: σταφυλή — plumb-line, builder’s level; fem. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by the plumb-line’
glossary.στυγὸς: Στύξ — the Styx, the underworld river by which the gods swear their most binding oath; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.συμμίσγεται: συμμίσγω — mix together; mid. mingle with (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’mingles with’
glossary.τέκετο: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτέκετο): ’begot’, said of a father · also ’bore’, said of a mother
glossary.τέμενος: τέμενος — sacred precinct, plot of land set apart; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to Πύρασον · also neut. acc. sg., object of τάμον: ’a plot’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a precinct’ (τέμενος βωμός τε ’a precinct and an altar’)
glossary.τέρποντο: τέρπω — delight; mid. take pleasure, amuse oneself; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’amused themselves’
glossary.τείχεα: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τείχη)
glossary.τενθρηδόνος: Τενθρηδών — Tenthredon, father of Prothous; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τιτάνοιό: Τίτανος — Titanus, taken as a place-name (τίτανος is also ‘chalk, gypsum’; sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τιταρησσὸν: Τιταρησσός — the Titaressus, a river of Thessaly; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τρίκκην: Τρίκκη — Tricca, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τρηχῖνα: Τρηχίς — Trachis, a town of Achilles’ realm; acc. sg. Τρηχῖνα (stem Τρηχῖν-)
glossary.τόξοισίν: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), accented before the enclitic θ’: ’with bows’
glossary.τόξων: τόξον — bow; neut. gen. pl. (τόξα), gen. of respect after εἰδώς: ’skilled in bows’
glossary.τὰρ: ἄρα — then, so; τὰρ is taken as τε + ἄρα run together (compare τίς τ’ ἄρ), after interrogative τίς: ’who then?’ · also after interrogative πῶς: ’how then?’ (πῶς τὰρ ἔοι τάδε ἔργα ’how then could this be?’)
glossary.τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
glossary.υἱέας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἱέας (= Attic υἱούς/υἱεῖς)
glossary.υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’ · also masc. acc. dual, in apposition to ἀνέρε: ’two sons’ (υἷε δύω Μέροπος)
glossary.φέρτατος: φέρτατος — best, mightiest; superl. of φέρτερος, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φείδιππός: Φείδιππος — Pheidippus, son of Thessalus, a leader from Cos; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.φερὰς: Φεραί — Pherae, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φηρητιάδαο: Φηρητιάδης — son of Pheres (patronymic; usually taken to be Admetus); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.φιλοκτήταο: Φιλοκτήτης — Philoctetes, the Greek archer at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.φιλοκτήτης: Φιλοκτήτης — Philoctetes, the Greek archer at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φοίτων: φοιτάω — go to and fro, roam; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφοίτων): ’were roaming’
glossary.φορέεσκον: φορέω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκ- (epic), uncontracted, unaugmented: ’used to carry’
glossary.φορεούσας: φορέω — carry, bear; pres. part. fem. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φοροῦσας): ’bearing’
glossary.φυλάκην: Φυλάκη — Phylace, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φυλάκῃ: Φυλάκη — Phylace, a town of Thessaly; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Phylace’
glossary.φυλακίδαο: Φυλακίδης — son of Phylacus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Ἰφίκλου
glossary.φόβον: φόβος — fear, flight, panic; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φῆρας: φήρ — wild beast (Aeolic = Attic θήρ), used of the beasts Peirithous fought, traditionally the Centaurs; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγαθὼ: ἀγαθός — good, brave, able; masc. nom. dual, agreeing with ἰητῆρε
glossary.ἀγλαὸς: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγχίαλόν: ἀγχίαλος — near the sea, by the sea; adj. of two endings, acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀντρῶνα · also Ἀγχίαλος — Anchialus, a Greek warrior killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., accented ἀγχίαλόν before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἀδμήτοιο: Ἄδμητος — Admetus, king of Pherae; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀδμήτῳ: Ἄδμητος — Admetus, king of Pherae; masc. dat. sg., with ὑπό of the father: ’to Admetus’
glossary.ἀθάνατος: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλόπην: Ἀλόπη — Alope, a town of Achilles’ realm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιδρυφὴς: ἀμφιδρυφής — torn on both sides, i.e. with cheeks scratched in grief (traditional sense); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄλοχος
glossary.ἀνάκτων: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the lords’
glossary.ἀνθεμόεντα: ἀνθεμόεις — flowery, rich in blossoms; acc. sg. masc., agreeing with Πύρασον
glossary.ἀνστήσεσθαι: ἀνίστημι — raise up; mid. rise, get up; fut. inf. mid., syncopated ἀν- for ἀνα- (= Attic ἀναστήσεσθαι): ’to rise up’
glossary.ἀντρῶνα: Ἀντρών — Antron, a town; acc. sg. (Ἀντρῶνα)
glossary.ἀποθρῴσκοντα: ἀποθρῴσκω — leap off, spring down from (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’leaping from’
glossary.ἀπομηνίσας: ἀπομηνίω — be wrathful, with ἀπο- of uncertain force (‘away’, ‘utterly’); aor. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat. ’at’: ’having withdrawn in wrath’
glossary.ἀπορρώξ: ἀπορρώξ — broken-off piece, hence an offshoot; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρήϊος: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀργυροδίνῃ: ἀργυροδίνης — with silver eddies; adj. of two endings, masc. dat. sg., agreeing with Πηνειῷ
glossary.ἀργυρότοξος: ἀργυρότοξος — of the silver bow; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Apollo
glossary.ἀρείων: ἀρείων — better, braver; comparative of ἀγαθός (cf. ἄριστος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρηΐφιλον: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, warlike; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀρχόν · also masc. acc. sg., epithet of Menelaus
glossary.ἀρχόν: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀσκληπιοῦ: Ἀσκληπιός — Asclepius, the healer; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀστέριον: Ἀστέριον — Asterium, a town of Thessaly; acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδῃσιν: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (Agamemnon, Menelaus); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀχέων: ἀχέω — grieve, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. ἄχνυμαι): ’grieving’
glossary.ἀχιλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg., by-form with single -λ- (Ἀχιλεύς)
glossary.ἄλκηστις: Ἄλκηστις — Alcestis, daughter of Pelias, wife of Admetus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλον: Ἄλος — Alus, a town of Achilles’ realm; acc. sg. (Ἄλον)
glossary.ἄναρχοι: ἄναρχος — without a leader; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄντιφος: Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, son of Thessalus, a leader from Cos; masc. nom. sg. · also Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, a Maeonian leader, son of Talaemenes; masc. nom. sg. · also Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, a son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄργισσαν: Ἄργισσα — Argissa, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρισται: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; fem. nom. pl. ἄρισται, predicate (of mares): ’best, foremost’
glossary.ἐγχεσιμώρους: ἐγχεσίμωρος — spear-fighting, spear-wielding (second element of uncertain origin); adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐλέλειπτο: λείπω — leave; plpf. 3 sg. pass.: ’had been left (behind)’
glossary.ἐλεόθρεπτόν: ἐλεόθρεπτος — marsh-bred, grown in the marsh (ἕλος + τρέφω); epic ἐλεο-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σέλινον
glossary.ἐμβέβασαν: ἐμβαίνω — step in, embark; plpf. 3 pl. (= Attic ἐνεβεβήκεσαν), with the sense ‘stood in’: ’had embarked, were aboard’
glossary.ἐμνώοντο: μνάομαι — be mindful of, give thought to (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. mid., epic diectasis (= Attic ἐμνῶντο)
glossary.ἐνιῆνες: Ἐνιῆνες — the Enienes, a people of northern Greece; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐξείλετο: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. take out for oneself, pick out; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took out for himself’
glossary.ἐπίστροφον: Ἐπίστροφος — Epistrophus, a son of Euenus, brother of Mynes; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιρρέει: ἐπιρρέω — flow over, flow upon; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐπιρρεῖ), + acc.: ’flows over’
glossary.ἐρεπτόμενοι: ἐρέπτομαι — feed on, munch; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + acc.
glossary.ἐτίσατο: τίνω (mid. τίνυμαι) — pay, requite; mid. exact vengeance, take vengeance on; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took vengeance (on)’
glossary.ἐϋκτιμένην: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; fem. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ); said of a town
glossary.ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’being’
glossary.ἑλλάδα: Ἑλλάς — Hellas, a district beside Phthia in Achilles’ realm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔβαλεν: βάλλω — throw, hurl, strike; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’threw’ (κὰδ … ἔβαλεν = κατέβαλεν ’laid low’)
glossary.ἔθεντο: τίθημι — put, set; mid. make for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’made for themselves’ (οἰκία ἔθεντο ’made their homes’)
glossary.ἔκτανε: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., strong aorist ἔκτανον: ’killed’
glossary.ἔλαιον: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. nom. sg., after ἠΰτε: ’like oil’
glossary.ἔλαυνε: ἐλαύνω — drive; impf. 3 sg., without the lengthened augment (= Attic ἤλαυνε): ’drove’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’drive’
glossary.ἔννεπε: ἐννέπω — tell of, relate, speak; pres. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνεπε): ’told, spoke’
glossary.ἔτεκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable: ’bore’
glossary.ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’ · also of a feeling, ’seized, gripped’ (θάμβος … ἔχεν ’wonder held (them)’)
glossary.ἕλκεϊ: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκει)
glossary.ἕλληνες: Ἕλληνες — the Hellenes, a people of Achilles’ realm; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕστασαν: ἵστημι — stand; plpf. 3 pl., intransitive (= Attic εἱστήκεσαν): ’stood, were standing’ (reduplicated ἑ-στα-σαν)
glossary.ἠλώνην: Ἠλώνη — Elone, a town of Perrhaebia in Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
