glossary.καταξέμεν: κατάγω — lead down; fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic κατάξειν), of purpose after a verb of giving: ’to lead down’
glossary.κατελθέμεν: κατέρχομαι — go down, come down; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic κατελθεῖν)
glossary.κειμήλια: κειμήλιον — treasure, thing laid up (from κεῖμαι); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.κληῗδι: κληΐς — bolt, bar, key; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κλείς, dat. κλειδί): ’with a key’
glossary.κοῦρον: κοῦρος — boy, son; masc. acc. sg., Ionic-epic (= Attic κόρος)
glossary.κτείνωμεν: κτείνω — kill; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., hortatory: ’let us kill’
glossary.λῆξαν: λήγω — cease, leave off (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. act., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἔληξαν)
glossary.μάχεσθαί: μάχομαι — fight; pres. inf., accented before the enclitic τε: ’to fight’
glossary.μάχη: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μέγιστος: μέγας — great; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’greatest, largest’
glossary.μήστωρα: μήστωρ — deviser, planner (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μαχησόμεθ: μάχομαι — fight; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (μαχησόμεθ’ = μαχησόμεθα; Attic μαχούμεθα): ’we shall fight’
glossary.μελάνθιον: Μελάνθιος — Melanthius, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μηκιστηϊάδης: Μηκιστηϊάδης — son of Mecisteus (patronymic, Euryalus); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μιμνέτω: μίμνω — stay, wait, linger (reduplicated form of μένω); pres. imper. 3 sg. act.: ’let him linger’
glossary.μνήσασθε: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. be mindful of (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’be mindful of’
glossary.μυρικίνῳ: μυρίκινος — of tamarisk (from μυρίκη); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.νεστορίδης: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νηῒς: Νηΐς (Attic Ναΐς) — Naiad, water-nymph, in apposition to νύμφη; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νύμφη: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ξάνθοιο: Ξάνθος — Xanthus, the river of Troy (also Scamander); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου) · also Ξάνθος — Xanthus, the river of Lycia; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ξυνάγουσα: συνάγω — gather, bring together; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic ξυν- (= Attic συν-): ’gathering’
glossary.οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer has only neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.οἰώθη: οἰόομαι — be left alone, be left solitary; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was left alone’
glossary.οἴξασα: οἴγω — open; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having opened’
glossary.πήδασον: Πήδασος — Pedasus, a Trojan, son of Bucolion; masc. acc. sg. · also Pedasus, a town on the Satnioeis; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παραστὰς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist (ἔστην): ’standing beside’
glossary.παρειπών: παρεῖπον (aor. of παραφημί) — talk over, win over with words; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having persuaded’
glossary.πεποίηται: ποιέω — make, do, prepare; perf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, has been done’
glossary.πεπύθοιτ: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear, find out; reduplicated aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., elided (πεπύθοιτ’ = πεπύθοιτο; Attic πύθοιτο): ’should learn’
glossary.περκώσιον: Περκώσιος — of Percote (a town of the Troad); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πεσέειν: πίπτω — fall; aor. inf. act., epic -έειν (= Attic πεσεῖν): ’to fall’
glossary.πιδύτην: Πιδύτης — Pidytes, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πλεῖστα: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, neut. acc. pl.: ’the most, as much as possible’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with κτήματα: ’the most, the greatest store’
glossary.ποιμαίνων: ποιμαίνω — tend (a flock), shepherd; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’tending’
glossary.πολύκμητός: πολύκμητος — much-wrought, laboriously worked; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πρεσβύτατος: πρέσβυς — old, elder; superl. πρεσβύτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’eldest’
glossary.πρηνὴς: πρηνής — face down, headlong; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σατνιόεντος: Σατνιόεις — Satnioeis, a river of the Troad; masc. gen. sg., epic -εντος
glossary.σκότιον: σκότιος — secret, of hidden birth, illegitimate; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’in secret’
glossary.στήθεσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.στόμα: στόμα — mouth, face; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.στῆτ: ἵστημι — set; aor. intrans. stand; aor. imper. 2 pl., root aorist, elided (στῆτ’ = στῆτε): ’stand!’
glossary.συλήσετε: συλάω — strip off, despoil; fut. 2 pl. act.: ’you will strip’
glossary.τέκ: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. act., elided, unaugmented (τέκ’ = ἔτεκε): ’bore, begot’
glossary.τεθνηῶτας: θνήσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic τεθνεῶτας): ’dead’
glossary.τειρόμενοί: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic περ: ’hard-pressed’
glossary.τευθρανίδην: Τευθρανίδης — son of Teuthras (patronymic); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τεῦκρος: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, Greek hero at Troy, half-brother of Ajax; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τηλεκλειτοί: τηλεκλειτός — far-famed, renowned; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τ’
glossary.τροχὸν: τροχός — wheel, round disc; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τόθ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τόθ’ = τότε)
glossary.φάλαγγα: φάλαγξ — line of battle, battle-line; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., of wish: ’may she carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to bring’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might bring’ (ἵν’ … φέροι ’so that she might bring’)
glossary.φίλτατος: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’dearest’
glossary.φαίδιμα: φαίδιμος — shining, splendid (of limbs); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.φεύγοντ: φεύγω — flee, escape; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (φεύγοντ’ = φεύγοντα): ’fleeing’
glossary.φεύγοντας: φεύγω — flee, escape; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’fleeing’
glossary.φιλέεσκεν: φιλέω — love, be fond of, treat kindly; impf. iterative 3 sg., epic -εσκεν, uncontracted and unaugmented: ’used to befriend’
glossary.φοβέοντο: φοβέω — frighten; mid./pass. flee in terror; impf. 3 pl. mid., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐφοβοῦντο): ’were fleeing in panic’
glossary.φόνοιο: φόνος — murder, slaughter; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), as with verbs of ceasing: ’from slaughter’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on ἀράομαι: ’over the slaying’
glossary.φύγοι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., of wish: ’may he escape’
glossary.φύλακον: Φύλακος — Phylacus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φὰν: φημί — say, think; aor./impf. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= ἔφασαν), + acc. and inf.: ’they said, thought’
glossary.χαλκήρεα: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.χαρίσαιτο: χαρίζομαι — give freely, grant as a favour; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., with κεν, potential: ’would grant’
glossary.χαριέστατος: χαρίεις — graceful, beautiful; superl. χαριέστατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’most beautiful’
glossary.χρυσός: χρυσός — gold; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἀβαρβαρέη: Ἀβαρβαρέη — Abarbarea, a Naiad nymph; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α)
glossary.ἀγκύλον: ἀγκύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκάμαντ: Ἀκάμας — Acamas, a Thracian leader, son of Eussorus; masc. acc. sg., elided (Ἀκάμαντ’ = Ἀκάμαντα) · also Ἀκάμας — Acamas, a Trojan, a son of Antenor; masc. acc. sg., elided
glossary.ἀκήδεστοι: ἀκήδεστος — uncared-for, unmourned; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀλεξήσοντα: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend, help; fut. part. act. masc. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to help’
glossary.ἀλόχοισι: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀμύμονι: ἀμύμων — blameless (the real sense is not known); masc./fem. dat. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ἀναγκαίη: ἀναγκαῖος — necessary; fem. ἀναγκαίη as a noun, necessity (= ἀνάγκη); fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η
glossary.ἀναλκείῃσι: ἀναλκείη — lack of strength, cowardice; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’through cowardice’
glossary.ἀνετράπετ: ἀνατρέπω — turn over, upset; aor. 3 sg. mid. (intrans.), elided (ἀνετράπετ’ = ἀνετράπετο): ’was overturned, fell backward’
glossary.ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with the ending -α: ’took away’
glossary.ἀπόσχῃ: ἀπέχω — hold off, keep away; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., with κεν in a purpose clause: ’may keep off’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after αἴ κεν: ’if she will keep (him) off from’ + gen.
glossary.ἀρήσασθαι: ἀράομαι — pray (to); aor. inf. mid.: ’to pray’
glossary.ἀρίσβῃ: Ἀρίσβη — Arisbe, a town of the Troad; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀρετάονα: Ἀρετάων — Aretaon, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρηϊφίλων: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, warlike; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀστύαλον: Ἀστύαλος — Astyalus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτυζομένω: ἀτύζομαι — be bewildered, panic; pres. part. mid. masc. dual nom.: ’panic-struck’
glossary.ἀτυζόμενοι: ἀτύζομαι — be bewildered, panic; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’in panic’
glossary.ἀφνειοῦ: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀχιλῆά: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., Ionic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα), accented before the enclitic ποτε
glossary.ἁπάσας: ἅπας — all, quite all; fem. acc. pl.: ’all of them’
glossary.ἄβληρον: Ἄβληρος — Ableros, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄδρηστον: Ἄδρηστος — Adrastus, a Trojan taken alive; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄδραστος)
glossary.ἄξαντ: ἄγνυμι — break; aor. part. act. masc. dual nom., elided (ἄξαντ’ = ἄξαντε): ’having broken’
glossary.ἄξια: ἄξιος — worth, of equal value, worthy; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄξυλον: Ἄξυλος — Axylus, a Trojan of Arisbe; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄστύ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἄφαντοι: ἄφαντος — unseen, vanished, without trace; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐβήτην: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 3 dual act., root aorist (ἔβην): ’the two went’
glossary.ἐγκέκλιται: ἐγκλίνω — lean on, lay upon; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’rests on, has been laid upon’
glossary.ἐδείδιμεν: δείδω — fear; plpf. 1 pl. with impf. sense (perf. stem δεδι-), epic (= Attic ἐδέδιμεν): ’we feared’
glossary.ἐδύτην: δύω — go into, sink into; aor. 3 dual act., root aorist (ἔδυν): ’the two went into’ · also ’put on, clad oneself in’, with ἐν + dat. of the arms (ὅπλοισιν ἔνι … ἐδύτην ’the two clad themselves in’)
glossary.ἐκέκλετο: κέλομαι — command, call to; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, + dat.: ’called to, bade’
glossary.ἐλέλιχθεν: ἐλελίζω — make whirl, wheel round; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -θεν (= Attic -θησαν): ’wheeled round, rallied’
glossary.ἐλίσσετο: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; impf. 3 sg.: ’was begging’
glossary.ἐλεήσῃ: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after αἴ κε: ’if she take pity’
glossary.ἐνάρων: ἔναρα — spoils stripped from the slain (neut. pl. only); neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐξέμμεναι: ἐκ + εἰμί — be sprung from; pres. inf., epic ἐξέμμεναι (= ἐξ + ἔμμεναι; Attic ἐκ + εἶναι), one word, + gen. of source
glossary.ἐξέσπασε: ἐκσπάω — draw out, pull out; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’pulled out’
glossary.ἐξαπολοίατ: ἐξαπόλλυμι — destroy utterly; mid. perish utterly; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= -οιντο), elided, of wish: ’may they perish’
glossary.ἐξεκυλίσθη: ἐκκυλίω — roll out; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was rolled out, tumbled out’
glossary.ἐπείγει: ἐπείγω — press, drive, urge on; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπιβαλλόμενος: ἐπιβάλλω — throw upon; mid. throw oneself upon, set oneself to (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐποιχόμενοι: ἐποίχομαι — go about to, go among; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going about’
glossary.ἐποτρύνητον: ἐποτρύνω — urge on; aor. subj. 2 dual act., with ἐπεί κε: ’when you two have urged on’
glossary.ἐρυκάκετε: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl. act., epic: ’hold back!’
glossary.ἐϋρρείταο: ἐϋρρείτης — fair-flowing (of a river); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐϋσσώρου: Ἐΰσσωρος — Eussorus, father of Acamas; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἔλατον: Ἔλατος — Elatus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
glossary.ἔπειθε: πείθω — persuade, win over; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was persuading’
glossary.ἔσκεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg. with epic -σκε(ν) suffix: ’was, used to be’
glossary.ἔτρεψεν: τρέπω — turn, change; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’turned’
glossary.ἕλενος: Ἕλενος — Helenus, a son of Priam, a seer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠκέστας: ἤκεστος (?) — of a heifer, traditionally ’untouched by the goad’ (sense not certain); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἡμετέρῃς: ἡμέτερος — our; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ἤνις: ἤνις — yearling, a young heifer; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἤρκεσε: ἀρκέω — ward off, avail, suffice; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, + acc.: ’warded off’
glossary.ἥρω: ἥρως — hero; masc. acc. sg., elided ἥρω’ (= ἥρωα)
glossary.ἰθυνομένων: ἰθύνω — make straight, aim; mid. aim, direct oneself; pres. part. mid. gen. pl., in a genitive absolute: ’as they aimed’
glossary.ἰθύν: ἰθύς (noun) — a direct course, an undertaking, a purpose; fem. acc. sg., distinct from the homographic adverb ἰθύς ’straight’
glossary.ἰσοφαρίζειν: ἰσοφαρίζω — match, rival, be equal to (+ dat. of person); pres. inf. act.: ’to match’
glossary.ἱερευσέμεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice; fut. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἱερεύσειν), after a verb of promising: ’to sacrifice’
glossary.ἱεροῖο: ἱερός — holy, sacred; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἱρῆς: ἱερός — holy, sacred; fem. gen. sg., Ionic-epic ἱρός (= Attic ἱερᾶς)
glossary.ἴθυσε: ἰθύω — rush straight on, surge; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’rushed on’
glossary.ὀφέλτιον: Ὀφέλτιος — Opheltius, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg. · also Ὀφέλτιος — Opheltius, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὄεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
glossary.ὄρχαμον: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader (+ gen. ’of men’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπέλυσε: ὑπολύω — loosen from beneath, unnerve; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’
glossary.ὑπέρθυμοι: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, high-hearted; masc. nom./voc. pl.
glossary.ὑπαντιάσας: ὑπαντιάω — meet, come to meet; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having met’
glossary.ὑπεκφύγοι: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., of wish after μή: ’may he not escape’
glossary.ὑπεχώρησαν: ὑποχωρέω — give way, withdraw; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’gave ground’
glossary.ὑποκυσαμένη: ὑποκύω — conceive; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having conceived’
glossary.ὑποσχέσθαι: ὑπίσχομαι — promise, vow; aor. inf. mid. (ὑπεσχόμην): ’to promise, to vow’
glossary.ὑφηνίοχος: ὑφηνίοχος — charioteer, the one who holds the reins; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὔμμι: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; epic encl. dat. pl. ὔμμι (= Attic ὑμῖν): ’to/for you’
glossary.ὤσατο: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’thrust away from himself’
glossary.ῥυμῷ: ῥυμός — chariot pole; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰθομένοιο: αἴθω — burn, blaze; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’blazing’
glossary.αἰολίδης: Αἰολίδης — son of Aeolus; masc. nom. sg., patronymic, in apposition to Sisyphus
glossary.αἰσχυνέμεν: αἰσχύνω — shame, disgrace, dishonour; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic αἰσχύνειν): ’to disgrace’
glossary.αὐτάρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
glossary.βασιληΐδος: βασιληΐς — of a king, royal (fem. adj., gen. -ΐδος; Attic βασιλική); fem. gen. sg.: τιμῆς βασιληΐδος ’of kingly honour’
glossary.βελλεροφόντην: Βελλεροφόντης — Bellerophon, grandson of Sisyphus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βελλεροφόντης: Βελλεροφόντης — Bellerophon, grandson of Sisyphus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βελλεροφόντῃ: Βελλεροφόντης — Bellerophon, grandson of Sisyphus; masc. dat. sg., with δαΐφρονι: ’to Bellerophon’
glossary.βουπλῆγι: βουπλήξ — ox-goad, goad (lit. ox-striker); fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an ox-goad’
glossary.βροτῶν: βροτός — mortal; masc. gen. pl., partitive after τίς: ’of mortals’ · also masc. gen. pl. after ἕνεκα: ’for the sake of mortals’
glossary.γίγνωσκε: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐγίγνωσκε): ’was recognising, came to know’
glossary.γαμβροῖο: γαμβρός — son-in-law (a kinsman by marriage); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.γαμβροῦ: γαμβρός — son-in-law (a kinsman by marriage); masc. gen. sg., gen. of source after παρεδέξατο: ’from his son-in-law’
glossary.γενεήν: γενεή — birth, race, lineage; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενεὴ: γενεή — birth, lineage, generation; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γενεὴν: γενεή — generation, race, lineage; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
glossary.γλαῦκον: Γλαῦκος — Glaucus, son of Sisyphus and father of Bellerophon; masc. acc. sg. · also Γλαῦκος — Glaucus, Lycian ally of Sarpedon, son of Hippolochus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γνῶσιν: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., ν-movable (= Attic γνῶσι): ’may know’
glossary.γράψας: γράφω — scratch, incise, write; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having inscribed’
glossary.δέρμα: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object of a verb of putting on: ’skin’
glossary.δαήμεναι: δάω — learn, find out (aor. pass. ἐδάην, active sense); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic δαῆναι): ’to learn’
glossary.δειδιότα: δείδω — fear; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δεδιότα): ’frightened’
glossary.δεκάτη: δέκατος — tenth; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἠώς: ’the tenth (dawn)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with νύξ: ’the tenth (night)’
glossary.διωνύσοιο: Διώνυσος — Dionysus, god of wine; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.διώνυσος: Διώνυσος — Dionysus, god of wine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δρύαντος: Δρύας — Dryas, father of Lycurgus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δυστήνων: δύστηνος — wretched, ill-starred; masc. gen. pl., as a noun, possessive with παῖδες: ’of wretched men’
glossary.δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δύμεναι: δύω — go into, enter, plunge into; aor. inf. act., root aorist, epic -μεναι (= Attic δῦναι): ’to enter’
glossary.δύνηαι: δύναμαι — be able; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic δύνῃ): ’you may be able’
glossary.δύσεθ: δύω — go down, sink, plunge; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (δύσεθ’ = δύσετο): ’went down, plunged’
glossary.δώμασ: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. dat. pl., elided (δώμασ’ = δώμασι)
glossary.εἷσε: ἵζω — make sit, set, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.: ’set, stationed’
glossary.εὐρείης: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
glossary.εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
glossary.ζώοντες: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶντες)
glossary.θέεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἔθει): ’ran’
glossary.θήβῃσιν: Θῆβαι — Thebes; fem. pl., dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), after ἐν: ’at Thebes’
glossary.θεινόμεναι: θείνω — strike, beat; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. pl.: ’being struck’
glossary.θυμοφθόρα: θυμοφθόρος — heart-destroying, deadly (sense not clear); neut. acc. pl.: ’deadly (signs)’
glossary.θύσθλα: θύσθλον — (pl.) sacred implements or offerings of the Dionysiac rite (sense not certain); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κάκτανε: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., with apocope and assimilation (κάκτανε = κατάκτανε): ’kill!’
glossary.κάλλιφ: καταλείπω — leave behind, abandon; aor. 3 sg. act., with apocope, assimilation and elision (κάλλιφ’ = κατέλιπε, π aspirated before a rough breathing): ’left’
glossary.κάλλός: κάλλος — beauty; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.κέρδιστος: κέρδιστος — most cunning, craftiest (superlative of κερδίων); masc. nom. sg., + partitive gen. ἀνδρῶν
glossary.καρτίστην: κάρτιστος — strongest, mightiest (epic superlative, = Attic κράτιστος); fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μάχην
glossary.κατέδων: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., from epic κατέδω (= Attic κατεσθίων): ’eating away’
glossary.κατέκτανε: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg. act., root aorist
glossary.κατέλειπον: καταλείπω — leave behind, abandon; impf. 1 sg. act.: ’I left behind’
glossary.κατέπεφνε: καταπέφνω (φένω) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’killed’
glossary.κατέπεφνεν: καταπέφνω (φένω) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’killed’
glossary.κατέπηξεν: καταπήγνυμι — fix down, plant, stick fast; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’planted’
glossary.κατέρυκε: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic κατήρυκε): ’kept back, detained’
glossary.κατέχευαν: καταχέω — pour down, let fall; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -χευαν (= Attic κατέχεαν): ’let fall, dropped’
glossary.καταθνητῶν: καταθνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. gen. pl., epic by-form of θνητός: καταθνητῶν ἀνθρώπων ’of mortal men’
glossary.κλειτοί: κλειτός — famed, renowned; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic κλυτός)
glossary.κρίνας: κρίνω — pick out, choose, judge; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out’
glossary.κρυπταδίῃ: κρυπταδίος — secret, stealthy; fem. dat. sg., epic -ίῃ (= Attic -ίᾳ)
glossary.κτείνειν: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. inf. act., epexegetic: ’to kill’
glossary.κυδαλίμοισι: κυδάλιμος — glorious, renowned; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κυδιανείρῃ: κυδιάνειρα — bringing men glory, man-ennobling (of battle); fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ)
glossary.κόλπῳ: κόλπος — bosom, lap, fold of a garment; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κὰπ: κατά — down along, over; prep. + acc., with apocope and assimilation before π (κὰπ πεδίον = κατὰ πεδίον)
glossary.λαοδάμειαν: Λαοδάμεια — Laodamia, daughter of Bellerophon; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λαοδαμείῃ: Λαοδάμεια — Laodamia, daughter of Bellerophon; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ), after παρελέξατο
glossary.λυκίην: Λυκίη — Lycia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίην (= Attic Λυκίαν), goal of motion, once with the suffix -δε: Λυκίην δέ ’to Lycia’ · also fem. acc. sg., after κάτα: ’throughout Lycia’
glossary.λυκούργου: Λυκοῦργος — Lycurgus, son of Dryas; masc. gen. sg., the contracted form (beside the uncontracted Λυκόοργος)
glossary.λυκόοργος: Λυκοῦργος — Lycurgus, son of Dryas; masc. nom. sg., uncontracted epic Λυκόοργος (= contracted Λυκοῦργος)
glossary.λύκιοι: Λύκιος — Lycian, a man of Lycia; masc. nom. pl., as a noun
glossary.μένει: μένος — force, might, fury; neut. dat. sg., with ἀντιόωσιν: ’my might’ · also μένω — stay, remain; pres. 3 sg.: ’stays’ · also μένω with acc.: ’awaits, waits for’ (μένει ὀξὺν Ἄρηα ’awaits keen war’)
glossary.μέσση: μέσος — middle; fem. nom. sg., epic doubled-σ (= Attic μέση): ’in the middle’
glossary.μήσατο: μήδομαι — devise, contrive, plan; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμήσατο)
glossary.μαινομένοιο: μαίνομαι — rage, be frenzied; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’raving’
glossary.μαχέσσατο: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐμαχέσατο): ’fought’
glossary.μαχοίμην: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. opt. 1 sg., potential with ἂν (οὐκ ἂν … μαχοίμην): ’I would not fight’
glossary.μεγάθυμε: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.μειλιχίοισι: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μιγήμεναι: μίγνυμι — mix; pass. mingle, lie with (+ dat.); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic μιγῆναι): ’to lie with’
glossary.μυχῷ: μυχός — innermost part, nook, recess; masc. dat. sg.: ’in the recess (of)’
glossary.νυσήϊον: Νυσήϊον — Nyseion, a place sacred to Dionysus (site unknown); neut. acc. sg., adjective as noun, epic -ήϊον
glossary.ξείνισ: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest-friend; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (ξείνισ’ = ξείνισε; Attic ἐξένισε)
glossary.ξείνισσε: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest-friend; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐξένισε): ’entertained’
glossary.ξεινήϊα: ξεινήϊον — gift of a guest-friend, guest-gift; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ξένια)
glossary.ξεῖνοι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. nom. pl., predicate
glossary.οἰνεὺς: Οἰνεύς — Oeneus, king of Calydon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πάτον: πάτος — path, trodden way; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πέμπε: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπε): ’sent, was sending’
glossary.πίνακι: πίναξ — tablet, writing-board; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παλαιός: παλαιός — old, of long standing; masc. nom. sg., predicate with ξεῖνος: ’of old’
glossary.παρεδέξατο: παραδέχομαι — receive from another, accept; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep. (augment inside the compound)
glossary.πατρώϊοι: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal, hereditary; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic πατρῷος)
glossary.πατρώϊός: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal, hereditary; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πατρῷος), accented before the enclitic ἐσσι
glossary.πείραθ: πεῖραρ — end, limit, boundary; neut. acc. pl., elided (πείραθ’ = πείρατα; Attic πέρατα)
glossary.πενθερῷ: πενθερός — father-in-law; masc. dat. sg.: ’to his father-in-law’
glossary.πεφνέμεν: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. inf. act., epic -έμεν: ’to kill’
glossary.πεῖθ: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 sg. act., elided (πεῖθ’ = πεῖθε), unaugmented: ’tried to persuade’
glossary.πομπῇ: πομπή — convoy, escort, safe conduct; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.προίτοιο: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.προίτου: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. gen. sg., possessive with γυνή
glossary.προβέβηκας: προβαίνω — step forward, advance, go beyond; perf. 2 sg. act., + gen. of comparison: ’you have gone far beyond’
glossary.προῖτ: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. voc. sg., elided (Προῖτ’ = Προῖτε), in address
glossary.προῖτον: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.προῖτος: Προῖτος — Proetus, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πτυκτῷ: πτυκτός — folded, with leaves that fold together; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πίνακι
glossary.πυμάτη: πύματος — last, outermost; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὕστατος)
glossary.πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν): ’gave’
glossary.πόρῃ: πόρω (aor. ἔπορον) — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg., with κε in a relative clause: ’may grant’
glossary.σίσυφος: Σίσυφος — Sisyphus, the cunning man of Ephyre; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σεβάσσατο: σεβάζομαι — feel awe, hold in reverence, scruple at; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐσεβάσατο), unaugmented: ’felt awe’
glossary.σεῦε: σεύω — drive, chase, put to flight; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσευε): ’chased’
glossary.σολύμοισι: Σόλυμοι — the Solymi, a people of Lycia; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), object of μαχέσσατο: ’the Solymi’
glossary.συνίτην: σύνειμι (εἶμι) — come together, meet; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic συνῄτην): ’the two met’
glossary.τάμον: τέμνω — cut, cut out, mark off; aor. 3 pl. act., root aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἔτεμον): ’cut out, marked off’
glossary.τέκεθ: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (τέκεθ’ = τέκετο), active in sense: ’begot’
glossary.τίκτεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, unaugmented (= ἔτικτεν): ’begot’
glossary.ταύτης: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with γενεῆς: ’of this’
glossary.τεθναίης: θνῄσκω — die; perf. opt. act. 2 sg. (τέθνηκα), as a wish: ’may you be dead’
glossary.τηλεθόωσα: τηλεθάω — flourish, bloom luxuriantly; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., diectasis (uncontracted, stretched vowel)
glossary.τιθήνας: τιθήνη — nurse; fem. acc. pl.: ’the nurses (of Dionysus)’
glossary.τρία: τρεῖς, τρία — three; neut. acc. pl., with τέκνα
glossary.τυδέα: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τυφλὸν: τυφλός — blind; masc. acc. sg., predicate after ἔθηκε: ’blind’
glossary.τύπτε: τύπτω — strike, beat; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτυπτε): ’kept beating’
glossary.φέριστε: φέριστος — best, bravest (superlative beside φέρτερος); masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.φέροιτο: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., oblique optative in an indirect question: ’he was bringing’
glossary.φαεινόν: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζωστῆρα
glossary.φοβηθεὶς: φοβέω — frighten; pass. be afraid; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having been frightened, in fear’
glossary.φυταλιῆς: φυταλιά — orchard, planted land; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ιῆς (= Attic -ιᾶς), gen. of respect after καλόν: ’fair in orchard (land)’
glossary.φύει: φύω — bring forth, make grow; (intrans.) grow, spring up; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’brings forth’ · ’grows’
glossary.φῶτας: φώς — man, warrior, mortal; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.χέει: χέω — pour, shed, scatter; pres. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic χεῖ)
glossary.χίμαιρα: χίμαιρα — she-goat; fem. nom. sg., predicate: ’a goat’
glossary.χίμαιραν: Χίμαιρα — the Chimaera, a fire-breathing monster (lit. she-goat); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χαλκοκορυστήν: χαλκοκορυστής — armed in bronze, bronze-equipped; masc. acc. sg., epithet of Sarpedon
glossary.χρυσήνιος: χρυσήνιος — with golden reins; masc./fem. adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of Artemis
glossary.χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν), agreeing with δέπας
glossary.ψευσαμένη: ψεύδω — deceive; mid. speak falsely, lie; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having lied’
glossary.ἀγαθὰ: ἀγαθός — good; neut. acc. pl., internal accusative with φρονέοντα: ’good things’
glossary.ἀλέεινε: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun, shrink from; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + inf.: ’shrank from’ · also impf. 3 sg., + acc.: ’avoided’ (ἀλέεινε μάχην ’avoided the fighting’)
glossary.ἀλήϊον: Ἀλήϊος — Aleian, of the Aleian plain (in Cilicia, by tradition); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with πεδίον
glossary.ἀλᾶτο: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., contracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἠλᾶτο): ’wandered’
glossary.ἀμαζόνας: Ἀμαζών — Amazon, one of a nation of warrior women; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμαιμακέτην: ἀμαιμάκετος — of unknown meaning, guessed ’huge’ or ’irresistible’; fem. acc. sg., epithet of the Chimaera
glossary.ἀντιανείρας: ἀντιάνειρα — man-matching (sense disputed: a match for men, fighting like men, or opposed to men); fem. acc. pl., epithet of the Amazons
glossary.ἀντιόωσιν: ἀντιάω — meet, face, come against (+ dat.); pres. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted with diectasis (= Attic ἀντιῶσι): ’they meet’
glossary.ἀπολήγει: ἀπολήγω — leave off, cease, come to an end; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’ends’
glossary.ἀποπνείουσα: ἀποπνέω — breathe out, blow forth; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic -πνείουσα (= Attic ἀποπνέουσα): ’breathing out’
glossary.ἀπώλετο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’perished’
glossary.ἀριστεύειν: ἀριστεύω — be the best, excel, be foremost; pres. inf. act., after ἐπέτελλεν: ’to be the best’
glossary.ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. gen. pl., of comparison after προβέβηκας: ’beyond all’ · also partitive gen. after a superlative: ’of all’ (νεώτατος ἁπάντων ’youngest of all’) · also gen. after προμάχεσθαι: ’ahead of all’
glossary.ἄντεια: Ἄντεια — Anteia, wife of Proetus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄντυξ: ἄντυξ — rim (of a shield); fem. nom. sg., in apposition to δέρμα
glossary.ἐδάμασσε: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐδάμασε): ’subdued’
glossary.ἐθελούσῃ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. act. fem. dat. sg., with a negative: ’unwilling’ (οὐκ ἐθελούσῃ ’to me, unwilling’)
glossary.ἐμοῖσι: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with δώμασ(ι)
glossary.ἐναιρέμεν: ἐναίρω — kill, slay; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐναίρειν), epexegetic: ’to kill’
glossary.ἐπέτελλεν: ἐπιτέλλω — command, charge, enjoin; impf. 3 sg. act. (augment inside the compound), + dat. + inf.: ’charged’
glossary.ἐπαμείψομεν: ἐπαμείβω — exchange; fut. indic. 1 pl. act. (or short-vowel aor. subj., hortative): ’we shall exchange, let us exchange’
glossary.ἐπεμήνατο: ἐπιμαίνομαι — be frenzied with desire for; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep. (augment inside the compound), + inf.: ’was mad to’
glossary.ἐπιγίγνεται: ἐπιγίγνομαι — come after, come on, supervene; pres. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’comes on’
glossary.ἐπουρανίοισι: ἐπουράνιος — heavenly, dwelling in heaven; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐπουρανίοισιν: ἐπουράνιος — heavenly, dwelling in heaven; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐρέεινε: ἐρεείνω — question, ask; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’questioned’
glossary.ἐρεείνεις: ἐρεείνω — ask, question (epic, from ἔρομαι); pres. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἐρύξας: ἐρύκω — keep, hold back, detain; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having kept’
glossary.ἐφύρη: Ἐφύρη — Ephyre, a city of the Argive land (by tradition Corinth); fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic Ἐφύρα)
glossary.ἐφύρῃ: Ἐφύρη — Ephyre, a city of the Argive land (by tradition Corinth); fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Ἐφύρᾳ), after ἐν
glossary.ἔαρος: ἔαρ — spring; neut. gen. sg. (= Attic ἦρος): ’of spring’
glossary.ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
glossary.ἔθελεν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελεν): ’wished’
glossary.ἔκτα: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., root aorist ἔκτα
glossary.ἔμεινας: μένω — stay, remain; await, withstand; aor. 2 sg. act., + acc.: ’you withstood’
glossary.ἔτεκ: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔτεκ’ = ἔτεκε): ’bore’
glossary.ἔτεκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’bore’
glossary.ἠγάθεον: ἠγάθεος — most holy, very sacred (ἠ- intensive); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with Νυσήϊον
glossary.ἠνορέην: ἠνορέη — manliness, courage, vigour; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἀνδρεία)
glossary.ἠνώγειν: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; plupf. 3 sg. in -ειν, epic variant (= ἠνώγει), serving as a simple past: ’he bade’
glossary.ἠῢν: ἠΰς (= ἐΰς) — good, noble; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with γόνον
glossary.ἡμετέρην: ἡμέτερος — our; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with γενεήν
glossary.ἤματ: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἤματ’ = ἤματα), acc. of duration: ’for (twenty) days’
glossary.ἥμισυ: ἥμισυς — half; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’half’
glossary.ἰόντε: εἶμι — go; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two going’
glossary.ἱέρευσεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable
glossary.ἱππολόχοιο: Ἱππόλοχος — Hippolochus, son of Bellerophon and father of Glaucus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἱππόλοχον: Ἱππόλοχος — Hippolochus, son of Bellerophon and father of Glaucus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱππόλοχος: Ἱππόλοχος — Hippolochus, son of Bellerophon and father of Glaucus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴσανδρον: Ἴσανδρος — Isander, son of Bellerophon; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴσανδρόν: Ἴσανδρος — Isander, son of Bellerophon; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἴσασιν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 pl. (pres. force), ν-movable: ’they know’
glossary.ἵκηαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid. dep., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἵκῃ): ’you may reach’
glossary.ἷξε: ἵκω — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg. (ἷξον): ’reached’
glossary.ὀδύσαντο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry with, hate (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic, unaugmented (= ὠδύσαντο)
glossary.ὀλέθρου: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. gen. sg., depending on πείραθ(α): ’of destruction’
glossary.ὀμφαλοέσσης: ὀμφαλόεις — bossed, with a central boss (of a shield); fem. gen. sg., -όεσσα in the feminine, agreeing with ἀσπίδος
glossary.ὁμοκλῇ: ὁμοκλή — shout, threatening cry, rebuke; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’at the shouted rebuke’
glossary.ὑπείροχον: ὑπείροχος — outstanding, pre-eminent (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὑπέροχος): ’pre-eminent over (others)’ · also Ὑπείροχος — Hypeirochus, a Trojan killed by Odysseus; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ὑπεδέξατο: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, welcome; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep. (augment inside the compound)
glossary.ὤπασαν: ὀπάζω — give, bestow, grant; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented (ὀπάζω, aor. ὤπασα), + dat. of the recipient
glossary.ὥρη: ὥρα (Ionic ὥρη) — season, the right time of year; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ᾱ): ’the season’
glossary.ᾔτεε: αἰτέω — ask, ask for, request; impf. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic ᾔτει)
glossary.ῥέοντα: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’flowing’
glossary.αἰδοίῃς: αἰδοῖος — revered, venerable; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.αἰθούσῃσι: αἴθουσα — portico, colonnade; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’ · also fem. nom. pl., in αἱ μὲν … αἱ δέ: ’some … others’
glossary.γαμβροὶ: γαμβρός — son-in-law, brother-in-law; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γεραιάς: γεραιός — old, aged; fem. acc. pl., as a noun: ’old women’
glossary.γεραιαί: γεραιός — old, aged; fem. nom. pl., as a noun or adj.: ’old women’
glossary.γλαύκῳ: Γλαῦκος — Glaucus, Lycian leader; masc. dat. sg., of the person deprived: ’from Glaucus’
glossary.γυναιξὶν: γυνή — woman; fem. dat. pl., with movable ν (= Attic γυναιξί), grave accent mid-clause
glossary.δεδμημένοι: δέμω — build; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’built’ · also δάμνημι — overpower, subdue; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’overcome’
glossary.δμῳῇσι: δμῳή — female slave, handmaid; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.δυσώνυμοι: δυσώνυμος — ill-named, of evil name; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δώδεκ: δώδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable, elided (δώδεκ’ = δώδεκα)
glossary.δῶρον: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’as a gift’ · also neut. acc. sg., object, with a dependent gen.: ’the gift (of sleep)’ (ὕπνου δῶρον)
glossary.εἰπόντος: εἶπον — say; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg., object of ἀκουέμεν: ’(listen) to one speaking’
glossary.εἰρόμεναι: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire after; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ἐρόμεναι): ’asking’
glossary.εὐπατέρειαν: εὐπατέρεια — daughter of a good father, well-fathered; fem. acc. sg., epithet of Helen
glossary.εὐχετάασθαι: εὐχετάομαι — pray; vaunt, boast; pres. inf. mid./dep., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐχετᾶσθαι)
glossary.εὐχομένη: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. sg.: ’praying’
glossary.εὔχεσθαι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. inf. mid./dep.
glossary.θάλαμοι: θάλαμος — inner chamber, room; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θέε: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἔθει): ’ran’
glossary.θέον: θέω — run; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθεον): ’ran’
glossary.θέρηται: θέρομαι — grow hot, be set ablaze; pres. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it be set ablaze’
glossary.θρασὺν: θρασύς — bold, daring; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θυέεσσιν: θύος — offering, sacrifice; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic θύεσιν): ’with offerings’
glossary.θύγατρες: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic θυγατέρες)
glossary.θὲς: τίθημι — put, place; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’put!’
glossary.κέκλετο: κέλομαι — call on, bid, urge; aor. 3 sg. mid., reduplicated, unaugmented: ’called on’
glossary.κέκμηκας: κάμνω — grow weary, toil; perf. 2 sg. act., present force: ’you are weary’
glossary.καλέσσω: καλέω — call, summon; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic καλέσω), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I may summon’
glossary.καλλιπάρῃος: καλλιπάρῃος — fair-cheeked; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg., epic -ῃος, from παρῃά ’cheek’ (Attic παρειά); epithet of a woman
glossary.κατεβήσετο: καταβαίνω — go down, descend; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented, from the epic sigmatic middle aorist (= Attic κατέβη): ’went down’
glossary.κατελθόντ: κατέρχομαι — go down; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (κατελθόντ’ = κατελθόντα): ’gone down’
glossary.καὐτὸς: καὶ αὐτός (crasis καὐτός) — and ... himself, even yourself; masc. nom. sg.: ’you yourself too’
glossary.κεκμηῶτι: κάμνω — grow weary; perf. part. act. masc. dat. sg., epic -ηῶτι (= Attic κεκμηκότι): ’to a weary man’
glossary.κεῖνόν: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.κηώεντα: κηώεις — fragrant (traditional gloss, origin uncertain); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θάλαμον
glossary.κισσηῒς: Κισσηΐς — daughter of Cisseus; fem. nom. sg., patronymic, in apposition to Theano
glossary.κοιμῶντο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. sleep; impf. 3 pl. mid., contracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκοιμῶντο): ’were sleeping’
glossary.κουράων: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic κορῶν)
glossary.κούρῃ: κούρη — girl, maiden, daughter (Attic κόρη); fem. dat. sg.: ’to the daughter (of Zeus)’
glossary.λάθωμαι: λανθάνομαι — forget (+ gen.); aor. subj. mid. 1 sg., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest I forget’
glossary.λάμπετο: λάμπω — shine, gleam; impf. 3 sg. mid. form, active sense, unaugmented (= ἔλαμπε): ’gleamed’
glossary.λίθοιο: λίθος — stone; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.λαβέτην: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 dual act.: ’the two took’
glossary.λείβειν: λείβω — pour (a libation); pres. inf. act.: ’to pour’
glossary.λύθρῳ: λύθρον — gore, defiling filth; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.μέγαρ: μέγαρον — hall; neut. acc. pl., elided (μέγαρ’ = μέγαρα), plural for a single house
glossary.μαρνάμενοι: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. nom. pl.: ’fighting’
glossary.μαχέσαιο: μάχομαι — fight; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., potential with ἂν: ’you would fight’
glossary.μεθιέντα: μεθίημι — let go, slacken; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’slackening’
glossary.μελίφρονα: μελίφρων — honey-hearted, sweet to the heart; masc. acc. sg., epithet of wine · also masc. acc. sg., epithet of wheat (πυρόν): ’honey-hearted, heart-sweetening’
glossary.μελιηδέα: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic μελιηδῆ), agreeing with οἶνον
glossary.μετελεύσομαι: μετέρχομαι — go after, seek out; fut. 1 sg. mid./dep., epic -ελεύσομαι: ’I will go after’
glossary.μετεσσεύοντο: μετασεύομαι — hasten after; impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., epic -σσ-, augment inside the compound: ’hurried after’
glossary.μνηστῇς: μνηστός — wooed, wedded (of a wife); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.μολοῦσα: βλώσκω — go, come (aor. ἔμολον); aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having gone’
glossary.νείατος: νείατος (= νέατος) — undermost, last, lowest; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic νει- (= νέατος), + gen.: ’lowest of the others’
glossary.ξεστοῖο: ξεστός — polished, smoothed; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), agreeing with λίθοιο
glossary.ξεστῇς: ξεστός — polished, smoothed; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic ξεσταῖς)
glossary.πάριν: Πάρις — Paris, son of Priam (also called Alexander); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάροιθε: πάροιθε — in front, before; adv. of place
glossary.πίῃσθα: πίνω — drink; aor. subj. 2 sg., epic -σθα (= Attic πίῃς), after αἴ κε: ’if you drink’
glossary.παμποίκιλα: παμποίκιλος — all-intricate, richly variegated; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
glossary.παῖδάς: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πεντήκοντ: πεντήκοντα — fifty; numeral, indeclinable, elided (πεντήκοντ’ = πεντήκοντα)
glossary.πεπαλαγμένον: παλάσσω — splash, smear, defile; perf. mid./pass. part. masc. acc. sg., + dat. of material: ’spattered (with blood)’
glossary.περικλυτὰ: περικλυτός — very famous, renowned; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δῶρα: ’very famous (gifts)’
glossary.πιστώσαντο: πιστόω — make trustworthy; mid. pledge oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’they pledged themselves’
glossary.ποικίλμασιν: ποίκιλμα — piece of embroidery, variegated work; neut. dat. pl., with movable ν, dat. of respect: ’in embroideries’
glossary.πολλῇσι: πολύς — much, many; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic πολλαῖς)
glossary.πρηνέα: πρηνής — headlong, face down; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic πρηνῆ), predicative: ’headlong’
glossary.πτόλεμός: πτόλεμος — war (epic by-form of πόλεμος); masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πόρκης: πόρκης — ring, band (fastening the spear-head to the shaft); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πόσιας: πόσις — husband; masc. acc. pl., epic -ιας (= Attic πόσεις)
glossary.πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.: οὐδέ πῃ ’not in any way’
glossary.σιδονίηθεν: Σιδονίηθεν — from Sidon; adv., with the suffix -θεν of place from which (Σιδονίη, Sidon)
glossary.σιδονίων: Σιδόνιος — Sidonian, of Sidon (Phoenician city); adj., fem. gen. pl., agreeing with γυναικῶν: ’Sidonian (women)’
glossary.σκαιάς: Σκαιαί (πύλαι) — the Scaean Gates of Troy (σκαιός ’left’); fem. acc. pl., Σκαιάς (πύλας)
glossary.σοῖσιν: σός — your, yours; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.σπείσῃς: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after ὡς: ’that you may pour’
glossary.τέγεοι: τέγεος — roofed, under a roof (τέγος ’roof’); masc. nom. pl., agreeing with θάλαμοι
glossary.τέκτονες: τέκτων — builder, carpenter; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τείρουσι: τείρω — wear down, distress; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.τετυγμένον: τεύχω — make, build; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., + dat. of material: ’built with’
glossary.τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’for them’
glossary.φαίην: φημί — say; pres. opt. 1 sg. act., potential with κε: ’I would say’
glossary.φηγὸν: φηγός — oak (a kind of oak); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φθινύθουσι: φθινύθω — waste away, perish; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.φρέν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. acc. sg., elided (φρέν’ = φρένα)
glossary.φωνήσαντε: φωνέω — raise the voice, speak; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having spoken’
glossary.φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; aor. 3 sg. root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔφυ), intransitive; ἔν … φῦ in tmesis (= ἐνέφυ): ’clung to’
glossary.χαλκείων: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; neut. gen. pl., genitive of exchange: ’(gold) for bronze’
glossary.χρύσεα: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
glossary.χρύσεος: χρύσεος — golden; masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦς)
glossary.ἀΐξαντε: ἀΐσσω — leap, rush; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having leapt’
glossary.ἀέξει: ἀέξω — make grow, increase (Attic αὐξάνω); pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἀγελείης: ἀγελείη — driver of spoil, spoil-bringer (epithet of Athena); fem. gen. sg., epic (= ἀγελείας)
glossary.ἀειραμένη: ἀείρω (= αἴρω) — lift, raise, take up; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted: ’having taken up’
glossary.ἀθήνης: Ἀθήνη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
glossary.ἀλόχοισιν: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀμφιδέδηε: ἀμφιδαίω — blaze around; perf. 3 sg. act., present sense (perf. of δαίω ’burn’): ’is ablaze around, has blazed up’
glossary.ἀμφιπόλοισι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀμύνων: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’defending’
glossary.ἀνένευε: ἀνανεύω — throw back the head, nod ’no’, refuse by a sign; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀν-έ-νευε)
glossary.ἀνήγαγεν: ἀνάγω — lead up, bring up; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’led up, carried off’
glossary.ἀνίπτοισιν: ἄνιπτος — unwashed; adj. (2-term.), fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνασχεῖν: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. inf. act.: ’to lift up’
glossary.ἀολλίσσασα: ἀολλίζω — gather, collect; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having gathered’
glossary.ἀπέλαμπεν: ἀπολάμπω — shine forth, gleam; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was gleaming’
glossary.ἀπογυιώσῃς: ἀπογυιόω — unnerve, make limp; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest you unnerve’
glossary.ἀτέρπου: ἄτερπος — joyless, unpleasant; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ὀϊζύος
glossary.ἀϋτή: ἀϋτή — war-cry, shout, din; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀόλλισσαν: ἀολλίζω — gather, collect; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -σσ-, unaugmented: ’gathered’
glossary.ἁφόωντα: ἀφάω — handle, touch; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic -όωντα (= Attic ἁφῶντα): ’handling’
glossary.ἄειρε: ἀείρω (= αἴρω) — lift, raise, bring; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted: ’lift, bring’
glossary.ἄκρης: ἄκρος — topmost, high; adj., fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ᾱς), agreeing with πόλιος: ’of the high (city)’ · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with Περγάμου: ’high’ (κατὰ Περγάμου ἄκρης ’down from high Pergamos’) (or the noun ἄκρη ’height’, with Περγάμου depending on it)
glossary.ἄμειβε: ἀμείβω — exchange; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤμειβε): ’was exchanging’
glossary.ἅζομαι: ἅζομαι — stand in awe of, shrink from; pres. 1 sg. mid./dep.
glossary.ἆξον: ἄγνυμι — break, shatter; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’break!’
glossary.ἐγγύθι: ἐγγύθι — near, close by; adv., + gen.: ’near Priam’s’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg., elided (ἐθέλῃσ’ = ἐθέλῃσι), after αἴ κ’: ’if he is willing’
glossary.ἐκλελαθέσθαι: ἐκλανθάνομαι — forget utterly (+ gen.); aor. inf. mid., epic reduplicated: ’to have forgotten’
glossary.ἐλεήσῃς: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy on; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after αἴ κ’: ’if you take pity on’
glossary.ἐναντίη: ἐναντίος — opposite, face to face; fem. nom. sg., predicative: ’face to face, to meet him’
glossary.ἐνείκω: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic ἐνείκ- (= Attic ἐνέγκω), after ὄφρα: ’until I bring’
glossary.ἐννεαβοίων: ἐννεάβοιος — worth nine oxen; neut. gen. pl., genitive of price: ’(armour) worth nine oxen’
glossary.ἐξέλετο: ἐξαιρέω — take out, take away; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐξείλετο), with acc. and dat. of the person deprived: ’took away (from)’
glossary.ἐπιπλὼς: ἐπιπλέω — sail over; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic root aorist (= Attic ἐπιπλεύσας): ’having sailed over’
glossary.ἐποίησαν: ποιέω — make, do, build; aor. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἐρυσίπτολι: ἐρυσίπτολις — city-guarding, saving the city; adj. (2-term.), fem. voc. sg., epithet of Athena
glossary.ἐσάγουσα: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐσ- (= Attic εἰσάγουσα): ’leading in’
glossary.ἐφῆπτο: ἐφάπτω — fasten upon; plpf. pass. 3 sg., + dat.: ’had been fastened upon’
glossary.ἑκάβη: Ἑκάβη — Hecuba, wife of Priam; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑκατόμβοι: ἑκατόμβοιος — worth a hundred oxen; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἑκατόμβοι’ = ἑκατόμβοια)
glossary.ἑνδεκάπηχυ: ἑνδεκάπηχυς — eleven cubits long; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος
glossary.ἔθηκαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl. act., built on ἔθηκε (= Attic ἔθεσαν); with a predicate acc.: ’made (her) priestess’
glossary.ἔνδοθεν: ἔνδοθεν — from within, within; adv. (+ gen.), -θεν suffix
glossary.ἔνεσαν: ἔνειμι — be in, be within; impf. 3 pl., epic ἔσαν (= Attic ἐνῆσαν): ’were in it’
glossary.ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
glossary.ἔρχευ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic ἔρχευ (= Attic ἔρχου)
glossary.ἔσάν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν), accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’were’
glossary.ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., with movable ν: ’is’
glossary.ἔτας: ἔτης — kinsman, clansman; masc. acc. pl. (nom. pl. ἔται)
glossary.ἔτευξε: τεύχω — make, build; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’built’
glossary.ἔτῃσι: ἔτης — kinsman, clansman; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἔταις)
glossary.ἕν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἕν’ = ἕνα)
glossary.ἕποντα: ἕπω — be busy about, tend; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’busy with’
glossary.ἠπιόδωρος: ἠπιόδωρος — gentle in giving, kind-giving; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἤγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’brought’
glossary.ἱερεύσομεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter; short-vowel aor. subj. 1 pl. (or fut. indic.), after ὄφρα: ’so that we may sacrifice’
glossary.ἴδοιμι: ὁράω — see; aor. opt. 1 sg. (from εἶδον), in an εἰ-clause: ’if I should see’
glossary.ὀλολυγῇ: ὀλολυγή — cry (a women’s ritual cry at prayer); fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with a cry’
glossary.ὀνήσεαι: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; mid. profit, gain; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic ὀνήσῃ): ’you will profit’
glossary.ὀϊζύος: ὀϊζύς — woe, misery; fem. gen. sg., epic
glossary.ὤϊξε: ὀΐγω (ἀνοίγω) — open; aor. 3 sg. act., epic ὤϊξε (= Attic ἀνέῳξε): ’opened’
glossary.βασίλευεν: βασιλεύω — be king, rule (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐβασίλευεν): ’was queen, ruled’
glossary.βουσὶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; masc./fem. dat. pl.: ’cattle’
glossary.γαλόων: γαλόως — husband’s sister, sister-in-law; fem. gen. pl., epic γαλόων (= Attic γαλῴων)
glossary.γοόωσά: γοάω — wail, lament; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γοῶσα): ’wailing’
glossary.δαιδαλέοισιν: δαιδάλεος — skilfully wrought, finely worked; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with ἔντεσι
glossary.δαιμόνιε: δαιμόνιος — strange, uncanny (of one driven by a power beyond himself); masc. voc. sg., in address: ’strange man!’, tone from rebuke to affection
glossary.δαμόωσιν: δαμάζω (epic δαμάω) — overpower, subdue; pres. subj. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic δαμῶσιν), in an indirect question: ’will overcome’
glossary.διεξίμεναι: διέξειμι — go out through; pres. inf. of εἶμι with δια- and ἐκ-, epic -μεναι (= Attic διεξιέναι): ’to go out through’
glossary.διερχόμενος: διέρχομαι — go through, pass through; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’passing through’
glossary.δμῳαὶ: δμῳή — female slave, serving-woman (fem. of δμώς); fem. voc. pl. (same form as the nom.), in address: ’maids!’
glossary.δμῳῇσιν: δμῳή — female slave, serving-woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), after μετά: ’among the maids’
glossary.δόμους: δόμος — house, hall; masc. acc. pl., object of a verb of reaching: ’halls’ (plural for one dwelling)
glossary.δώματος: δῶμα — house, hall; neut. gen. sg., of separation after ἀπέσσυτο: ’out of the house’
glossary.δᾶερ: δαήρ — husband’s brother, brother-in-law; masc. voc. sg., in address (Ionic-epic δαήρ, Attic would be δᾱήρ)
glossary.εἰλιπόδεσσι: εἰλίπους — of rolling gait, shambling (said of cattle; traditional gloss); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι), agreeing with βουσίν
glossary.εἰνατέρων: εἰνάτηρ — husband’s brother’s wife, sister-in-law; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.εἴσελθε: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, come in; aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’come in!’
glossary.εὖτε: εὖτε — when; epic temporal conj. (= Attic ὅτε)
glossary.θέουσα: θέω — run; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’running’
glossary.θήβῃ: Θήβη — Thebe, city of Eëtion in the Troad; fem. dat. sg., place where: ’in Thebe’
glossary.θήῃς: τίθημι — put, make; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., epic -ῃ- (= Attic θῇς), after μή in a clause of fear: ’lest you make (so-and-so)’
glossary.θαλερὸς: θαλερός — flourishing, in bloom, lusty; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with παρακοίτης: ’flourishing’
glossary.θαλπωρὴ: θαλπωρή — comfort, solace, warmth; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic θαλπωρά)
glossary.θεοπροπίων: θεοπρόπιον — prophecy, oracle; neut. gen. pl., gen. of the thing known after εἰδώς: ’of prophecies’
glossary.θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κακομηχάνου: κακομήχανος — contriving evil, of evil devices; adj. of two endings, gen. sg., agreeing with κυνός · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ἔριδος: ’strife that contrives evil’
glossary.κακὴ: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with θύελλα · also fem. voc. sg. (as the nom.), in abuse: ’base, worthless’ (κακὴ γλήνη ’base doll’)
glossary.καλέεσκε: καλέω — call, name; impf. 3 sg., iterative -εσκε, unaugmented, uncontracted: ’used to call’
glossary.καλῷ: καλός — fair, beautiful; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀστέρι
glossary.κασίγνητος: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’brother’
glossary.κατέκηε: καίω (κατακαίω) — burn, burn up; aor. 3 sg., epic κατέκηε(ν) with augment inside the compound (= Attic κατέκαυσε): ’burned’
glossary.κατακτανέουσιν: κατακτείνω — kill; fut. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted -έουσιν (= Attic κατακτενοῦσι): ’will kill’
glossary.καταμάρψῃ: καταμάρπτω — overtake, catch; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., with κεν in a purpose clause: ’may overtake’
glossary.κιλίκεσσ: Κίλικες — the Cilicians; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι elided (Κιλίκεσσ’ = Κίλικεσσι), agreeing with ἄνδρεσσιν
glossary.κιλίκων: Κίλικες — the Cilicians (people of the Troad coast); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κιχήσεσθαι: κιχάνω — reach, overtake, catch; fut. inf. mid., in indirect statement after ὀΐω: ’that I shall catch up with’
glossary.κτεάτεσσιν: κτέαρ — possession (usually pl. κτέατα); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -εσι)
glossary.κῦμ: κῦμα — wave; neut. nom. sg., elided (κῦμ’ = κῦμα)
glossary.λευκώλενον: λευκώλενος — white-armed; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀνδρομάχην
glossary.λώϊον: λώϊος — better, more desirable (comparative sense; Attic βέλτιον); neut. nom./acc. sg., predicate: ’better’
glossary.μέτειμι: μέτειμι — go after, follow; pres. 1 sg. of εἶμι with μετά, with future sense: ’I will come after’
glossary.μίμν: μίμνω — stay, remain, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., elided (μίμν’ = μίμνε)
glossary.μαινομένῃ: μαίνομαι — rage, be mad; pres. part. mid. fem. dat. sg., with ἐϊκυῖα: ’like one raving’
glossary.μαλακοῖς: μαλακός — soft, gentle, mild; masc./neut. dat. pl. (neut. with ἐπέεσσιν)
glossary.μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), of separation after ἐκ: ’out of the hall’
glossary.μυθήσασθε: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; aor. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’tell!’
glossary.μυρομένη: μύρομαι — weep, lament; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’mourning’
glossary.μόρον: μόρος — portion, doom, fate; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νέμεσίν: νέμεσις — righteous resentment, indignation at wrong; fem. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ναιετάοντας: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶντας): ’inhabited’
glossary.ναιετάουσαν: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶσαν): ’inhabited’
glossary.νεμέσσι: νέμεσις — righteous resentment, indignation; fem. dat. sg., epic form with doubled σ (= Attic νεμέσει)
glossary.νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, true; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νημερτῆ), as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’
glossary.νηπίαχον: νηπίαχος — childish, infant, little (epic by-form of νήπιος); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδα
glossary.νύμφαι: νύμφη — nymph; also bride; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ξὺν: σύν (epic ξύν) — with, together with; prep. + dat.
glossary.οἴχεσθαι: οἴχομαι — be gone, go off; pres. inf., in a wish after ὄφελ’: ’to have gone off’
glossary.οὐδὸν: οὐδός — threshold; masc. acc. sg., after ἐπί: ’onto the threshold’
glossary.πέρσεν: πέρθω — sack, destroy; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπερσε), with ν-movable: ’sacked’
glossary.παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg., after ξύν · also masc. dat. sg., indirect object of δόμεν: ’to her child’
glossary.παρακοίτης: παρακοίτης — husband, bedfellow (παρά + κοίτη); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρειποῦσ: παρεῖπον — talk over, win round, persuade; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (παρειποῦσ’ = παρειποῦσα): ’having talked round’
glossary.πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
glossary.πελώμεθ: πέλομαι — be, become; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., elided (πελώμεθ’ = πελώμεθα), in a final clause after ὡς: ’we may be’
glossary.πλάκῳ: Πλάκος — Placus, wooded mountain above Thebe; fem. dat. sg., after ὑπό, agreeing with ὑληέσσῃ: ’beneath Placus’
glossary.ποθὴν: ποθή — a missing, longing, want; fem. acc. sg., + gen. of the person missed: ’the lack (of me)’
glossary.πολύδωρος: πολύδωρος — rich in gifts (rare; whether gifts brought or received is not known); fem. nom. sg., of a bride
glossary.πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
glossary.προτραπέσθαι: προτρέπω — turn forward; mid. turn oneself to, give oneself over to; aor. inf. mid. (2nd aor.), after ἔθελον: ’to give myself over’
glossary.προφέρουσα: προφέρω — carry forward, bear on; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying (me) forward’
glossary.στῆσον: ἵστημι — set, station; aor. imper. act. 2 sg., transitive: ’station!’
glossary.σῆμ: σῆμα — sign; mound, tomb; neut. acc. sg., elided (σῆμ’ = σῆμα)
glossary.τέτμεν: τέτμον (defective aor., ’find, come upon’) — find; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἔτετμε(ν))
glossary.ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman in charge of stores; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ταμία)
glossary.τείρεσθαι: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. inf. pass.: ’to be worn down’, in indirect statement after ἄκουσε
glossary.τεκμήραντο: τεκμαίρομαι — fix, ordain, appoint; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’fixed, ordained’
glossary.τρώεσσ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, elided (Τρώεσσ’ = Τρώεσσι), after ἐπαμύνω · also dat. after ἐπιμίσγομαι: ’with the Trojans’
glossary.φέρει: φέρω — bear, carry; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’carries’
glossary.φθίσει: φθίω — destroy, waste away; fut. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’will destroy’
glossary.χήρη: χήρα — widow (also adj. ’bereft’); fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic χήρα), predicate
glossary.χήρην: χήρα — widow; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic χήραν), predicate: ’a widow’
glossary.χόλῳ: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. dat. sg., dative of cause: ’in anger’
glossary.ἀγακλυτὸν: ἀγακλυτός — renowned, far-famed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγαπητὸν: ἀγαπητός — beloved, cherished (esp. of an only child); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἑκτορίδην
glossary.ἀλίγκιον: ἀλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic, agreeing with Ἑκτορίδην
glossary.ἀληθέα: ἀληθής — true; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀληθῆ), as a noun: ’the truth’
glossary.ἀμβατός: ἀμβατός — that may be scaled, climbable (cf. ἀναβαίνω); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἀμείνονος: ἀμείνων — better (comparative of ἀγαθός); masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ἀνδρός
glossary.ἀμφίπολος: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιβέβηκεν: ἀμφιβαίνω — go around, encompass, envelop; perf. 3 sg. with present sense (+ acc.): ’has come around’
glossary.ἀμφιπόλῳ: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; fem. dat. sg., after ξύν
glossary.ἀνάσσων: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’ruling’
glossary.ἀνδρομάχη: Ἀνδρομάχη — Andromache, wife of Hector, daughter of Eëtion; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνδρομάχην: Ἀνδρομάχη — Andromache, wife of Hector; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀοίδιμοι: ἀοίδιμος — subject of song, celebrated (ἀοιδή); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl., predicate
glossary.ἀπέκτανε: ἀποκτείνω — kill; aor. 3 sg. act., epic 2nd aor. ἀπέκτανε (= Attic ἀπέκτεινε): ’killed’
glossary.ἀπέσσυτο: ἀποσεύομαι — rush away, dart off; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic doubled σ (Attic would be ἀπεσεύθη): ’rushed away’
glossary.ἀπεόντος: ἄπειμι — be away, be absent; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted ἀπεόντος (= Attic ἀπόντος), agreeing with ἐμεῖο
glossary.ἀπόερσε: ἀποέρσω — sweep away (epic; formation not certain); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’swept away’
glossary.ἀρήϊα: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; neut. acc. pl., epic ἀρήϊα, agreeing with τεύχεα · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’warlike (gear)’
glossary.ἀργεννῇς: ἀργεννός — shining white, white; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= -ῇσι; Attic -αῖς), agreeing with ὀΐεσσι
glossary.ἀστέρι: ἀστήρ — star; masc. dat. sg., after ἀλίγκιον: ’to a star’
glossary.ἀστυάνακτ: Ἀστυάναξ — Astyanax (’lord of the city’), Hector’s son; masc. acc. sg., elided (Ἀστυάνακτ’ = Ἀστυάνακτα)
glossary.ἀταλάφρονα: ἀταλάφρων — childlike in mind, tender-minded, gentle; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδα
glossary.ἀτρεΐδας: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (Agamemnon or Menelaus); masc. acc. pl.: ’the sons of Atreus’, after ἀμφί
glossary.ἀφαμαρτούσῃ: ἀφαμαρτάνω — lose, miss (+ gen.); aor. part. act. fem. dat. sg.: ’having lost (you)’
glossary.ἀφικάνει: ἀφικάνω — arrive at, come to (by-form of ἀφικνέομαι); pres. 3 sg.: ’arrives’
glossary.ἁμὸν: ἁμός — my (Aeolic-epic form, = Attic ἐμός; ancient sources also read ’our’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πατέρα · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’my’
glossary.ἄκοιτιν: ἄκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄκουσον: ἀκούω — hear, listen to (+ gen.); aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’hear!’
glossary.ἄλλαι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄμμορον: ἄμμορος — without share, ill-fated, luckless; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., of a woman
glossary.ἄνωγας: ἄνωγα — bid, command, urge (perf. with present sense); perf. 2 sg., epic: ’you bid, you press’
glossary.ἄτης: ἄτη — ruin, blind folly sent by a god, bewilderment; fem. gen. sg., after ἕνεκα · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀλέγω: ’of Bewilderment’
glossary.ἄχεϊ: ἄχος — grief, distress; neut. dat. sg., epic ἄχεϊ (= Attic ἄχει), dative of cause or manner
glossary.ἐλέαιρε: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’pity!’
glossary.ἐλεαίρεις: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity, have compassion on; pres. 2 sg. act.
glossary.ἐλεύσομαι: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — go, come; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall go’
glossary.ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐξοίχεται: ἐξοίχομαι — go out, be gone out; pres. 3 sg., perfect in sense: ’has gone out’
glossary.ἐπίδρομον: ἐπίδρομος — open to a rush or assault, accessible; adj. of two endings, neut. nom. sg., predicate, agreeing with τεῖχος
glossary.ἐπίμεινον: ἐπιμένω — wait, stay on, remain; aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’wait!’
glossary.ἐπίσπῃς: ἐφέπω (aor. ἐπέσπον) — follow up; meet, undergo (a fate); aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after ἐπεὶ ἂν: ’you have met’
glossary.ἐπαμείβεται: ἐπαμείβω — exchange; mid. pass in turn to, go from one to another; pres. 3 sg. mid., + acc.: ’passes to’
glossary.ἐπαμύνω: ἐπαμύνω — come to the defence of, help (+ dat.); pres. subj. 1 sg. act., in a purpose clause: ’I may help’ · also pres. subj. 1 sg. in a temporal clause after ἐπήν: ’I have come to the defence of’
glossary.ἐπαυρήσεσθαι: ἐπαυρίσκω — get a share of, enjoy (or suffer) the result of; fut. inf. mid. (+ acc.), in indirect statement after ὀΐω
glossary.ἐπειγομένη: ἐπείγω — press, drive; mid. hasten, press on; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’hurrying’
glossary.ἐπειρήσανθ: πειράω — try, make trial of; aor. 3 pl. mid., elided with aspiration (ἐπειρήσανθ’ = ἐπειρήσαντο): ’made trial of’
glossary.ἐποτρύνει: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐρινεόν: ἐρινεός — wild fig-tree; masc. acc. sg., after παρά: ’beside the fig-tree’
glossary.ἐρύετο: ἐρύομαι — protect, guard, keep safe; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐρρύετο): ’guarded’
glossary.ἐφεστήκει: ἐφίστημι — set upon; intrans. perf. and plpf. stand upon; plpf. 3 sg. (= Attic ἐφειστήκει) + dat.: ’was standing on’
glossary.ἐφορμηθέντες: ἐφορμάω — set upon; pass. rush upon, charge; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’having rushed upon’
glossary.ἐφύτευσαν: φυτεύω — plant; aor. 3 pl. act., augment inside the compound with περί (tmesis): ’planted’
glossary.ἐϋπέπλῳ: ἐΰπεπλος — well-robed, fair-robed; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀμφιπόλῳ
glossary.ἐϋπλόκαμοι: ἐΰπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine braids; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl., agreeing with Τρῳαί
glossary.ἑκτορίδην: Ἑκτορίδης — son of Hector; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔκτανεν: κτείνω — kill; aor. 3 sg. act., epic 2nd aor. ἔκτανε(ν) (= Attic ἔκτεινε): ’killed’
glossary.ἔμπεδοι: ἔμπεδος — firm, steady, abiding; masc./fem. nom. pl., predicate: ’firm’
glossary.ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
glossary.ἔντοσθεν: ἔντοσθεν — inside, within; adv., with a gen.: ’inside (the city)’
glossary.ἔσομαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., middle in form: ’I shall be’
glossary.ἔσσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσεσθαι)
glossary.ἔσσονται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 pl., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσονται)
glossary.ἔχεεν: χέω — pour, heap up; aor. 3 sg. act., uncontracted with ν-movable (= Attic ἔχεε): ’heaped up’
glossary.ἔχεθ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., elided and aspirated (ἔχεθ’ = ἔχετο): ’was held (as wife by)’
glossary.ἕζεο: ἕζομαι — sit; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic ἕζεο (= Attic καθέζου): ’sit!’
glossary.ἠετίων: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe, father of Andromache; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠετίωνα: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἤγαγ: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἤγαγ’ = ἤγαγε): ’brought’
glossary.ἥμην: ἧμαι — sit, remain; impf. 1 sg. (= Attic ἐκαθήμην): ’I sat’
glossary.ἱλάσκονται: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; pres. 3 pl., middle deponent
glossary.ἵξομαι: ἱκνέομαι (fut. ἵξομαι) — come, reach; fut. 1 sg. mid. (epic; Attic uses ἥξω): ’I shall come’
glossary.ὀκρυοέσσης: ὀκρυόεις — chilling, horrible (from κρύος ’cold’); fem. gen. sg., epic -όεσσα type, agreeing with κυνός
glossary.ὀρεστιάδες: ὀρεστιάς — of the mountains; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl., agreeing with νύμφαι
glossary.ὀρφανικὸν: ὀρφανικός — orphaned, fatherless; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδα
glossary.ὀτρηρὴ: ὀτρηρός — brisk (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ταμίη
glossary.ὄρνυθι: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’rouse!’
glossary.ὄφελ: ὀφέλλω (= ὀφείλω) — owe; ought; ὄφελ’ = ὄφελε(ν), aor. 3 sg. unaugmented, + inf. in an unfulfilled wish: ’would that … had’
glossary.ὅρμησ: ὁρμάω — set in motion, urge on; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (ὅρμησ’ = ὥρμησε): ’urged on’
glossary.ὑληέσσῃ: ὑλήεις — wooded, forested; fem. dat. sg., epic -έσσῃ (fem. of -εις), agreeing with Πλάκῳ
glossary.ὑποπλακίῃ: ὑποπλάκιος — beneath Placus (ὑπό + Πλάκος); fem. dat. sg., Ionic ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ), agreeing with Θήβῃ
glossary.ὑπότροπος: ὑπότροπος — returning, back again; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’back again’
glossary.ὑψίπυλον: ὑψίπυλος — high-gated; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Θήβην
glossary.ὤφελλον: ὀφέλλω (= ὀφείλω) — owe; ought; impf. 1 sg., augmented, + inf. in an unfulfilled wish: ’would that I had been’
glossary.αἰδέομαι: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, be ashamed (before someone); pres. 1 sg. mid./dep., + acc.: ’I am ashamed before’
glossary.αἰειγενέτῃσι: αἰειγενέτης — ever-born, everlasting (of the gods); adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), agreeing with θεοῖς
glossary.αἴσχε: αἶσχος — shame, disgrace, insult; neut. acc. pl. αἴσχεα, elided (αἴσχε’): ’shameful things’
glossary.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a name: ’Hecuba herself’ · also fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive: ’of yourself’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’) · also fem. gen. sg., plain pronoun: ’it’ (ὑπ’ αὐτῆς ’under it’) · also fem. gen. sg., intensive in the sense of a possessive: ’her own’ (αὐτῆς μήτηρ ’her own mother’)
glossary.βοῆς: βοή — shout, cry; fem. gen. sg., gen. of what is heard of: ’of your cries’
glossary.βροτόεντα: βροτόεις — bloody, gory; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔναρα
glossary.γέ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle, accented γέ before a following enclitic (πρίν γέ τι)
glossary.γελάσασα: γελάω — laugh; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’laughing’
glossary.γοῦνα: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γοῦνα (= Attic γόνατα), subject: ’knees’
glossary.δήθυνεν: δηθύνω — linger, delay; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐδήθυνεν): ’lingered’
glossary.δακρυόεν: δακρυόεις — tearful, weeping; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially: ’through tears’
glossary.δακρυόεσσαν: δακρυόεις — tearful, weeping; fem. acc. sg., epic -όεσσαν (= Attic -όεισαν), agreeing with the understood σέ: ’in tears’
glossary.δεσμὸν: δεσμός — bond, fetter, tether; masc. acc. sg., object of ἀπορρήξας
glossary.δηθύνων: δηθύνω — linger, delay; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of the means: ’by lingering’
glossary.δούλιον: δούλιος — of a slave, of slavery; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ
glossary.δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
glossary.δότε: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. imper. 2 pl.: ’grant!’
glossary.δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a clause joined to εἰ κ’ + subj.: ’grants’ (δώῃ δέ μοι εὖχος ’and grants me glory’)
glossary.εἰωθὼς: ἔθω (perf. εἴωθα) — be accustomed; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + inf.: ’accustomed (to bathe)’
glossary.εἴπῃσιν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (ν-movable, = Attic εἴπῃ): ’may say’
glossary.θείῃ: θέω — run; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic θείῃ (= Attic θέῃ), in a simile: ’runs’ (not τίθημι ’put’)
glossary.καγχαλόων: καγχαλάω — laugh aloud, exult; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καγχαλῶν): ’exulting’
glossary.καλύπτοι: καλύπτω — cover, hide; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in a wish: ’may (the earth) cover’
glossary.κατερύκω: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. 1 sg. act.: ’I hold back’
glossary.κηώδεϊ: κηώδης — fragrant (Attic εὐώδης); adj., masc./neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= -ει), agreeing with κόλπῳ
glossary.κραιπνοῖσι: κραιπνός — swift, rushing; masc. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic -οῖς), agreeing with ποσί
glossary.κρατερὴ: κρατερός — strong, mighty, harsh; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἀνάγκη · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with λύσσα: ’strong’
glossary.κροαίνων: κροαίνω — pound, stamp (the ground); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of a horse: ’pounding’
glossary.κτείνας: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having killed’
glossary.κόμιζε: κομίζω — take care of, attend to; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.
glossary.κόρυθ: κόρυς — helmet; fem. acc. sg., elided (κόρυθ’ = κόρυθα)
glossary.κύσε: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκυσε): ’kissed’
glossary.λούεσθαι: λούω — wash; mid. bathe; pres. inf. mid., after εἰωθώς: ’to bathe’
glossary.λόφον: λόφος — crest, plume (of a helmet; also a ridge); masc. acc. sg. · also nape, neck: ’neck’ (κνήμας τε ἰδὲ λόφον ’shins and neck’)
glossary.μάθον: μανθάνω — learn; aor. 1 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔμαθον), + inf.: ’I have learned (to be)’
glossary.μεθιεῖς: μεθίημι — let go, slacken, be remiss; pres. 2 sg. act., absolute (= Attic μεθίης): ’you are slack’
glossary.μεσσηΐδος: Μεσσηΐς — Messeis, a spring (in Hellas); fem. gen. sg., source with ὕδωρ: ’water from Messeis’
glossary.μετά: μετά — after, in quest of, among; prep. + acc. (accented before the enclitic τε): ’to, among’ (μετά τ’ ἤθεα ’to the haunts’) · also prep. + acc., ’after’, accented before the enclitic γε (μετά γ’ αὐτόν ’after himself’)
glossary.νεύοντα: νεύω — nod; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λόφον: ’nodding’
glossary.νοήσας: νοέω — perceive, notice, look at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having noticed, seeing’
glossary.νομὸν: νομός — pasture, grazing ground; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάσῃσιν: πᾶς — all, every; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic πάσαις), agreeing with τῇσιν: ’all (of them)’
glossary.πέσοιεν: πίπτω — fall; aor. opt. 3 pl. act. (stem πεσ-), with relative οἵ κεν: ’may fall’
glossary.παμφαίνων: παμφαίνω — shine brightly, gleam; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gleaming’
glossary.παμφανόωσαν: παμφανάω — shine all over, gleam; pres. part. act. fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παμφανῶσαν): ’all-shining’
glossary.πατρός: πατήρ — father; masc. gen. sg.: ’(my) father’s’ (πατρός τε μέγα κλέος ’my father’s great glory’); also gen. of comparison after ἀμείνων: ’than his father’
glossary.πεφυγμένον: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. sg., with ἔμμεναι: ’has escaped’
glossary.προφυγόντα: προφεύγω — flee forth from, escape; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg., + acc.: ’having escaped’
glossary.προϊάψει: προϊάπτω — fling forth, send down; fut. 3 sg. act., + dat. of the goal: ’will send forth (to Hades)’
glossary.πῆλέ: πάλλω — swing, shake, dandle; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔπηλε), accented before the enclitic τε: ’dandled’
glossary.σεύατ: σεύω (mid. σεύομαι) — dart, rush, speed; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (σεύατ’ = σεύατο): ’sped, darted’
glossary.σοῦ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg.: ’of you, your’
glossary.στήσασθαι: ἵστημι — set up, make stand; aor. inf. mid., after δώῃ: ’to set up (for oneself)’
glossary.στατὸς: στατός — stalled, standing in the stall (verbal adj. of ἵστημι); masc. nom. sg., agreeing with ἵππος: ’stalled’
glossary.στρέψεσθ: στρέφω — turn; fut. inf. mid., elided (στρέψεσθ’ = στρέψεσθαι), after ἔμελλε: ’to turn away’
glossary.σῆς: σός — your, yours (sg.); possessive adj., fem. gen. sg., agreeing with βοῆς
glossary.τεθνηῶτα: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τεθνεῶτα): ’dead’
glossary.τοιοῦδ: τοιόσδε — such as this; masc. gen. sg., elided (τοιοῦδ’ = τοιοῦδε)
glossary.τροίης: Τροίη — Troy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Τροίας)
glossary.τρῳάδας: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. acc. pl., object of αἰδέομαι: ’Trojan women’ · also fem. acc. pl., object of ἐϋφρανέω: ’Trojan women’
glossary.τῇσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ταῖς): ’to them, among them’
glossary.φίλου: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πατρός
glossary.φορέοις: φορέω — carry, bear; pres. opt. 2 sg. act., with καί κεν: ’you might carry’
glossary.χέουσαν: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. acc. sg., κατὰ … in tmesis: ’shedding’
glossary.χήτεϊ: χῆτος — want, lack; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= -ει), causal, with gen.: ’for want of’
glossary.χαλκόν: χαλκός — bronze; masc. acc. sg., of the armour, object of ταρβήσας
glossary.χαρείη: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; aor. opt. pass. 3 sg. (χαρείη), in a wish: ’may she be glad’
glossary.χυτὴ: χυτός — poured out, heaped (of earth); fem. nom. sg., agreeing with γαῖα: ’heaped up’
glossary.χώρης: χώρη — place, spot; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic χώρας)
glossary.ἀΐσσονται: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, stream; pres. 3 pl. mid./dep. (Attic ᾄττω): ’stream, fly’
glossary.ἀγαθόν: ἀγαθός — good; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδ’ (βίην acc. of respect: ’good in strength’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’(for) good’ (εἰς ἀγαθόν ’for good’)
glossary.ἀγλαΐηφι: ἀγλαΐη — splendour, beauty; fem. dat. sg., epic -φι (instrumental, = Attic ἀγλαΐᾳ): ’in (his) splendour’
glossary.ἀεκαζομένη: ἀεκάζομαι — act unwillingly; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. sg. (Attic ἄκων): ’against her will’
glossary.ἀκαχίζεο: ἀκαχίζω — grieve, distress; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic -ου), after μή: ’do not grieve’
glossary.ἀκοστήσας: ἀκοστάω — feed on barley, grow fat; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’fed on barley’
glossary.ἀκούω: ἀκούω — hear; pres. 1 sg. act., + acc. of what is heard: ’I hear’
glossary.ἀκροτάτης: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superl. ἀκρότατος, fem. gen. sg., agreeing with κόρυθος: ’the very top (of the helmet)’
glossary.ἀλυσκάζω: ἀλυσκάζω — shun, keep clear of; pres. subj. 1 sg. act., short vowel (same form as the indic.), after αἴ κε: ’should I shun’
glossary.ἀμφεμάχοντο: ἀμφιμάχομαι — fight around; impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., + acc.: ’fought around’
glossary.ἀμφιπόλους: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμύνειν: ἀμύνω — ward off (+ acc. of what is warded off); pres. inf. act.
glossary.ἀνιόντα: ἄνειμι — come back, go up; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’coming back’
glossary.ἀπορρήξας: ἀπορρήγνυμι — break off, snap; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having broken’
glossary.ἀριπρεπέα: ἀριπρεπής — very conspicuous, outstanding; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with παῖδ’ · also neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with ἄστρα: ’outstanding’
glossary.ἀριστεύεσκε: ἀριστεύω — be the best, excel; iterative impf. 3 sg. act., epic -εσκε: ’used to excel’
glossary.ἀρνύμενος: ἄρνυμαι — strive to win, earn; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’winning’
glossary.ἀτιμήσειε: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight (Attic ἀτιμάζω); aor. opt. 3 sg. act., with οὐκ ἄν: ’would dishonour’
glossary.ἀτυχθεὶς: ἀτύζομαι — be dazed, scared; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., + acc. of cause: ’dazed (at the sight)’
glossary.ἄγηται: ἄγω — lead; mid. lead away for oneself; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., after ὅτε κέν: ’leads away’
