glossary.ἄλκιμός: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι
glossary.ἄλλης: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. gen. sg., with πρός: ’at another woman’s (bidding)’
glossary.ἄλλοισίν: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), accented before the enclitic τε, agreeing with θεοῖσι: ’other (gods)’
glossary.ἄργει: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. dat. sg., locative: ’in Argos’
glossary.ἄχνυται: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, be distressed; pres. 3 sg. mid./dep.: ’grieves’
glossary.ἐβεβήκει: βαίνω — go, step; plpf. 3 sg. act., with simple past force: ’had set out, was gone’
glossary.ἐγέλασσε: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 sg. act., epic σσ (= ἐγέλασε): ’laughed’
glossary.ἐγγεγάασιν: ἐγγίγνομαι — be born in, dwell in; perf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἐγγεγόνασιν): ’have been born in’
glossary.ἐκέλευες: κελεύω — order, bid; impf. 2 sg. act.: ’you bade’
glossary.ἐλάσαντας: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive out; aor. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’having driven’
glossary.ἐλεύθερον: ἐλεύθερος — free; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’of freedom’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρητῆρα: ’of freedom’
glossary.ἐναίσιμον: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure (from αἶσα); neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’as is fitting’
glossary.ἐναίσιμος: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, right, according to due measure (from αἶσα); masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’one with a sense of what is fitting’
glossary.ἐντροπαλιζομένη: ἐντροπαλίζομαι — keep turning round; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. sg., frequentative: ’turning back again and again’
glossary.ἐνῶρσεν: ἐνόρνυμι — rouse in, stir up; aor. 3 sg. act. (ὦρσε), ν-movable: ’roused’
glossary.ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα): ’being’
glossary.ἐπικείσετ: ἐπίκειμαι — lie upon, press upon; fut. 3 sg. mid./dep., elided (ἐπικείσετ’ = ἐπικείσεται): ’will press upon’
glossary.ἐποίχεσθαι: ἐποίχομαι — go about, ply (a task); pres. inf. mid./dep., after κέλευε: ’to go about’
glossary.ἐσσύμενον: σεύω — drive, hurry (mid. rush, hasten); perf. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. sg., epic doubled σ, agreeing with σε: ’hurrying’
glossary.ἐϋρρεῖος: ἐϋρρεής — fair-flowing; masc. gen. sg. (= Attic εὐρρεοῦς), agreeing with ποταμοῖο
glossary.ἑκάβης: Ἑκάβη — Hecuba, wife of Priam; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης
glossary.ἑλκεσιπέπλους: ἑλκεσίπεπλος — with trailing robes; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with Τρῳάδας
glossary.ἑλκηθμοῖο: ἑλκηθμός — dragging away; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), gen. of what is learned of: ’of your being dragged off’
glossary.ἑόν: ἑός, ἑή, ἑόν — his own, her own (possessive, = ὅς); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδ’: ’his own (son)’; not the relative
glossary.ἔναρα: ἔναρα — spoils stripped from a slain foe; neut. acc. pl., object of φέροι
glossary.ἔτετμεν: τέτμον (defective aor., ’find, come upon’) — find; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’came upon’
glossary.ἔφαντο: φημί — say; mid. ’think, suppose’; impf. mid. 3 pl. (= Attic ἔφασαν), + fut. inf.: ’they said, they supposed (he would …)’
glossary.ἠθεῖ: ἠθεῖος — dear, honoured (exact sense not known); masc. voc. sg., elided (ἠθεῖ’ = ἠθεῖε), in address: ’my honoured one’
glossary.ἠλέκτωρ: ἠλέκτωρ — the sun (the usual explanation; meaning not certain, perhaps ’the beaming one’); masc. nom. sg., epic (Attic ἥλιος): ’like the sun’
glossary.ἤθεα: ἦθος — accustomed place, haunt; neut. acc. pl. ἤθεα: ’usual places’
glossary.ἰλίῳ: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Ilium’
glossary.ἱππιοχαίτην: ἱππιοχαίτης — with a horse-hair mane; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λόφον: ’horse-maned’
glossary.ἱστόν: ἱστός — loom; masc. acc. sg. (and by extension the web woven on it)
glossary.ἵξεσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; fut. inf. mid./dep. (ἵξομαι), in indirect statement after ἔφαντο: ’that he would come’ · also after ἔμελλεν: ’was about to reach’
glossary.ὀάριζε: ὀαρίζω — talk intimately, converse; impf. 3 sg. act., + dat.: ’was talking with’
glossary.ὀρέξατο: ὀρέγω — stretch out; mid. reach out for; aor. 3 sg. mid., + gen.: ’reached out for’
glossary.ὄψιν: ὄψις — sight, appearance; fem. acc. sg., acc. of cause with ἀτυχθείς: ’at the sight’
glossary.ὑπερείης: Ὑπερείη — Hypereia, a spring (in Hellas); fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης
glossary.ὑπότροπον: ὑπότροπος — returning, back home; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the subject of ἵξεσθαι: ’returned’
glossary.ὑφαίνοις: ὑφαίνω — weave; pres. opt. 2 sg. act., with καί κεν: ’you might weave’
glossary.ὑψηλοῖσι: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ῥίμφά: ῥίμφα — lightly, swiftly; adv. (epic; Attic κούφως, ταχέως)
glossary.αἰγυπιοῖσι: αἰγυπιός — vulture; masc. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic -οῖς): ’vultures’
glossary.αὐχέν: αὐχήν — neck; masc. acc. sg., elided (αὐχέν’ = αὐχένα)
glossary.βούλετο: βούλομαι — wish, want, prefer; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, + acc.: ’he wished for’
glossary.δαμείετε: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. subj. 2 pl. pass., epic -είετε (= Attic δαμῆτε): ’you be overcome’
glossary.δεξιάδην: Δεξιάδης — son of Dexios (patronymic); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δηϊοτῆτα: δηϊοτής — hostile fighting, battle (δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. acc. sg., epic
glossary.διαπραθέειν: διαπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. inf., epic -έειν (= Attic διαπραθεῖν), with the root’s ρα for ερ: ’to sack’
glossary.δῷς: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 2 sg. (= Attic δῷς), after ἵνα: ’that you may give’
glossary.εἴπῃσι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic εἴπῃ): ’may say’
glossary.εἵατο: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic (= Attic ἧντο): ’sat, stood (of ranks)’
glossary.εὐχάλκου: εὔχαλκος — well-bronzed, of good bronze; adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg.
glossary.εὔπυργον: εὔπυργος — well-towered; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὕρωσιν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. subj. 3 pl., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until they find’
glossary.θανεῖν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. inf. act.: ’to die’
glossary.θανόντα: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’dead, having died’
glossary.κάμωσιν: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; aor. subj. 3 pl., after ἐπεί κε: ’have toiled, have tired’
glossary.κί: κίω — go; impf. 3 sg., elided (κί’ = κίε), unaugmented: ’went’
glossary.καμάτῳ: κάματος — toil, weariness; masc. dat. sg.: ’from toil’
glossary.καταπαυσέμεν: καταπαύω — make cease, put an end to; fut. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic καταπαύσειν): ’to end’
glossary.κατατεθνηῶτος: καταθνῄσκω — die, be dead; perf. part. masc. gen. sg., epic -ηῶτος (= Attic -εῶτος): ’dead’
glossary.κορύθεσσι: κόρυς — helmet; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κορυσί)
glossary.κρεμόω: κρεμάννυμι — hang up; fut. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κρεμῶ): ’I will hang up’
glossary.λελάχωσι: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot; reduplicated aor. subj. 3 pl., causative + gen.: ’give a share of’
glossary.λύντο: λύω — loose, undo; aor. 3 pl. mid. with passive sense, unaugmented (= ἐλύθησαν): ’were loosened’
glossary.μέμονας: μέμονα — be eager, intend, be set on; perf. 2 sg., present force: ’you intend’
glossary.μελάνει: μελαίνω — grow dark, blacken; pres. 3 sg.: ’darkens’
glossary.μητιόωσι: μητιάω — plan, devise; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μητιῶσι): ’planning’ · also pres. indic. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μητιῶσι): ’they are devising’
glossary.μυθέομαι: μυθέομαι — speak, say, declare; pres. 1 sg. mid. dep.: ’I speak’
glossary.ναιετάοντα: ναιετάω — dwell, be situated; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶντα): ’dwelling’
glossary.ναύτῃσιν: ναύτης — sailor; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ναύταις)
glossary.οἰόθεν: οἰόθεν — from alone, alone, by oneself; adv. (οἶος + -θεν): οἰόθεν οἶος ’quite alone’
glossary.οἴσω: φέρω — bring, carry; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall carry’
glossary.παύσωμεν: παύω — make cease, stop; aor. subj. 1 pl. act., hortatory: ’let us stop’
glossary.παῖς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πλέων: πλέω — sail; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sailing’ · also πλέων = πλείων (comparative of πολύς): ’more, further’; masc./fem. nom. sg. (πλέων … τῶν δύο μοιράων ’more than the two parts’)
glossary.πλατεῖ: πλατύς — broad, wide; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πολυκλήϊδι: πολυκλήϊς — with many thwarts or oar-locks (κληΐς; exact sense debated); adj., fem. dat. sg., epithet of a ship
glossary.προκαλέσσεται: προκαλέω — call forth, challenge; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., epic σσ, short vowel (= Attic προκαλέσηται): ’challenges’
glossary.πρόμος: πρόμος — foremost fighter, champion; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πυκναὶ: πυκνός — thick, close-set; fem. nom. pl.: ’close-packed’
glossary.πυλέων: πύλη — gate; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.πυρός: πῦρ — fire; neut. gen. sg., partitive: ’a share of fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., with μαλεροῦ, of the means after ἐμπρήσειν: ’with devouring fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on αὐγῇ: ’of the fire’ (ἐν πυρὸς αὐγῇ ’in the glare of the fire’)
glossary.σήμερον: σήμερον — today, this day; adv. (Attic τήμερον)
glossary.στεφάνης: στεφάνη — rim, ring; of a helmet, its rim (exact part uncertain); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.συλήσας: συλάω — strip, despoil of armour; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stripped’
glossary.συναντέσθην: συναντάομαι — meet; impf. 3 dual mid. dep., epic -έσθην: ’the two met’
glossary.σύλησας: συλάω — strip, despoil of armour; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (= συλήσας): ’having stripped’
glossary.σύνθετο: συντίθημι — put together; mid. take in, grasp; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, + acc.: ’grasped, took in’
glossary.σῆμά: σῆμα — sign, mark, grave-mound; neut. acc. sg., object: ’a mound’
glossary.σῶμα: σῶμα — body, corpse; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ταναήκεϊ: ταναήκης — long-edged, long-pointed; masc. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (ταναός ’long’ + ἀκή ’edge, point’)
glossary.ταρχύσωσι: ταρχύω — bury with due rites; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., after ὄφρα: ’may bury’
glossary.τεκμαίρεται: τεκμαίρομαι — fix, appoint (from τέκμωρ ’fixed end’); pres. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’fixes’
glossary.τερπόμενοι: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. pres. part. masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’taking delight in’
glossary.φανήτην: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. 3 dual pass., unaugmented: ’the two appeared’
glossary.φερέτω: φέρω — bring, carry; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him carry’
glossary.φρὶξ: φρίξ — ripple, shudder on the water; fem. nom. sg.: ’ripple’
glossary.φυλομέδουσα: Φυλομέδουσα — Phylomedusa (name, wife of Areithous); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χαλκοκνήμιδες: χαλκοκνήμις — bronze-greaved; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
glossary.χεύωσιν: χέω — pour, heap up; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., with ὄφρα carried on: ’may heap up’
glossary.ἀγασσάμενοι: ἀγάομαι (ἄγαμαι) — wonder at, be indignant at, resent; aor. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. pl., epic double σ (ἀγασσάμενοι)
glossary.ἀδελφεός: ἀδελφεός — brother; masc. nom. sg., epic/Ionic form (= Attic ἀδελφός)
glossary.ἀμφότεροι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀποδώσω: ἀποδίδωμι — give back, hand over; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will give back’
glossary.ἀπολλυμένους: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’perishing’
glossary.ἀρηϊθόοιο: Ἀρηΐθοος — Areithous (name); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀριστεύοντα: ἀριστεύω — be the best, excel in fight; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’excelling’
glossary.ἀριστῆες: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀτάλαντε: ἀτάλαντος — equal in weight, matching (+ dat.); masc. voc. sg.: Διὶ μῆτιν ἀτάλαντε ’equal to Zeus in cunning’
glossary.ἄμμ: ἐγώ — I; dat. pl. ἄμμι, Aeolic-epic (= Attic ἡμῖν), elided (ἄμμ’): ’to us, for us’ · also acc. pl. ἄμμε, Aeolic-epic (= Attic ἡμᾶς), elided (ἄμμ’): ’us’; the elided form does not show which
glossary.ἄρνῃ: Ἄρνη — Arne (a town); fem. dat. sg., of place: ’at Arne’
glossary.ἐελδομένοισι: ἐέλδομαι — long for, desire; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’longing’
glossary.ἐελδομένοισιν: ἐέλδομαι — long for, desire; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’longing’
glossary.ἐλάτῃσι: ἐλάτη — fir; an oar of fir; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’with oars’
glossary.ἐλαύνοντες: ἐλαύνω — drive, row; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’driving, rowing’
glossary.ἐξέσσυτο: ἐκσεύομαι — rush out; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic σσ: ’rushed out’
glossary.ἐπιάλμενον: ἐφάλλομαι — leap upon; aor. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., syncopated, epic (= ἐπαλόμενον): ’leaping on’
glossary.ἐπιμάρτυρος: ἐπιμάρτυρος — witness (to an oath); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as witness’
glossary.ἐπισπεῖν: ἐφέπω — follow, meet, come upon (+ acc., of fate); aor. inf. ἐπισπεῖν: πότμον ἐπισπεῖν ’to meet one’s doom’
glossary.ἐπόρσειαν: ἐπόρνυμι — rouse against, urge on; aor. opt. 3 pl. act., epic (= ἐπ- + ὄρσειαν): ’they might rouse’
glossary.ἐφήνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. with ἐπί, augmented ἥνδανε: ’was pleasing’
glossary.ἐϋξέστῃς: ἐΰξεστος — well-planed, well-polished; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἑζέσθην: ἕζομαι — sit down, seat oneself; impf. 3 dual mid. (cf. ἕζοντο): ’the two sat down’
glossary.ἑκάεργε: ἑκάεργος — far-working (epithet of Apollo; sense disputed, ’far-shooting’ is another guess); masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.ἑλλησπόντῳ: Ἑλλήσποντος — the Hellespont; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑτεραλκέα: ἑτεραλκής — turning the strength to the other side (victory now to one, now to the other); sense disputed; fem. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ)
glossary.ἕλητε: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. subj. 2 pl., after εἰς ὅ κεν: ’you take’
glossary.ἕλω: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, after εἰ κε: ’I take, I kill’
glossary.ἕλῃ: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., after εἰ κεν: ’takes, kills’
glossary.ἠϊονῆα: Ἠϊονεύς — Eioneus (name); masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἦλθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you came’
glossary.ἰφίνοον: Ἰφίνοος — Iphinous (name); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic Ἰφίνουν)
glossary.ἱερήν: ἱερός — holy, sacred; fem. acc. sg. (epic also ἱρός)
glossary.ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him go, let him come’
glossary.ὄπ: ὄψ — voice; fem. acc. sg., elided (ὄπ’ = ὄπα)
glossary.ὄρνισιν: ὄρνις — bird; masc./fem. dat. pl., after ἐοικότες: ’birds’
glossary.ὄρσωμεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. subj. 1 pl. act., hortatory: ’let us rouse’
glossary.αἴαντες: Αἴας — Ajax; masc. nom. pl., the two Ajaxes (Telamonian and Oilean)
glossary.αἴδεσθεν: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, be ashamed; aor. 3 pl. pass./dep., epic -εν (= Attic ᾐδέσθησαν), + inf.: ’were ashamed to’
glossary.γένοισθε: γίγνομαι — become, be; aor. opt. 2 pl. mid., in a wish or bidding: ’may you become’
glossary.γηθόσυνοι: γηθόσυνος — glad, joyful; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γόνυ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. sg., object of κάμψειν: γόνυ κάμψειν ’to bend the knee’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀμείβων: ’(changing) knee’ (γόνυ γουνὸς ἀμείβων ’changing knee after knee’)
glossary.δεξιτερῆς: δεξιτερός — right (of the hand), on the right; epic (= Attic δεξιᾶς); fem. gen. sg., agreeing with χειρός
glossary.δεῖσαν: δείδω — fear, be afraid; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδεισαν): ’they feared’
glossary.δηΐου: δήϊος — hostile, destructive; poetic (= Attic πολέμιος); masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πολέμοιο
glossary.διοτρεφές: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured (epithet of kings); adj., masc. voc. sg.
glossary.δόλῳ: δόλος — trick, guile, cunning; masc. dat. sg.: ’by a trick’
glossary.εἰρόμενος: εἴρομαι (ἔρομαι) — ask, question; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐρόμενος), + acc. of the person: ’asking me’
glossary.θάρσεϊ: θάρσος — courage, boldness; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει): ’in courage’
glossary.θοῦριν: θοῦρις (fem. of θοῦρος) — rushing, impetuous, furious; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀλκήν
glossary.θωρήξομαι: θωρήσσω — arm, put on armour; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall arm myself’, with dat. of the foe: ’against him’
glossary.κάμψειν: κάμπτω — bend; fut. inf. act., after φημί: γόνυ κάμψειν ’will bend the knee’
glossary.κίκλησκον: καλέω (κικλήσκω) — call, name; impf. 3 pl. of the reduplicated present κικλήσκω, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκάλουν); the -σκ- is part of the present stem, not an iterative suffix: ’used to call’
glossary.καλλίζωνοί: καλλίζωνος — fair-girdled, with beautiful girdle; adj., fem. nom. pl., agreeing with γυναῖκες
glossary.κατεδύσετο: καταδύω — go down into; mid. put on, don; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο (= Attic κατεδύσατο), + acc.: ’put on’ · also aor. 3 sg. mid. intrans., + acc. of a crowd: ’plunged into, entered’ (κατεδύσετο … ὅμιλον ’entered the throng’)
glossary.κελάδοντι: Κελάδων — the Celadon, a river of Elis; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κηδόμενός: κήδομαι — be troubled, be distressed, grieve; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., accent from the enclitic περ: ’though troubled’
glossary.κλήρῳ: κλῆρος — lot; masc. dat. sg., of means: ’by lot’
glossary.κλῆρον: κλῆρος — lot (a marked token drawn from a helmet); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κορυνήτην: κορυνήτης — club-man, club-wielder; masc. acc. sg., predicate: ’as the club-wielder’
glossary.κορύνη: κορύνη — club, mace; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κορύνῃ: κορύνη — club, mace; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with a club’
glossary.κράτεΐ: κράτος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg., epic κράτεϊ (= Attic κράτει), of means: ’by strength’
glossary.κτάνον: κτείνω — kill; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented 2nd aorist, epic (= Attic ἔκτανον, ἔκτεινα): ’I killed’
glossary.λάχῃσιν: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, draw; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σιν (= Attic λάχῃ), in a general relative clause: ’whoever draws’
glossary.λαχεῖν: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, draw; aor. inf. act. in a wish, after Ζεῦ πάτερ: ’(grant that) he draw the lot’
glossary.λώβη: λώβη — outrage, shameful abuse, disgrace; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μέμαθ: μέμονα (μέμαα) — be eager, strive; perf. 2 pl. μέματε with present sense, elided, the τ aspirated to θ before a rough breathing, + inf.: ’you are eager to’
glossary.μήκιστον: μακρός — long, tall; superl. μήκιστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’tallest’
glossary.μαχέσκετο: μάχομαι — fight; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε-, unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐμάχετο): ’used to fight’
glossary.μελέων: μέλος — limb; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μελῶν): ’of the limbs’
glossary.μυκήνης: Μυκήνη — Mycenae, Agamemnon’s city; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μόθου: μόθος — fray, close fighting; masc. gen. sg., after ἀκόρητος: ’of the fray’
glossary.νείκει: νεῖκος — quarrel, abuse, reproach; neut. dat. sg., epic -ει: ’with abuse’
glossary.νείκεσσ: νεικέω — quarrel with, rebuke, revile; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic σσ, elided (νείκεσσ’ = νείκεσσε): ’rebuked’
glossary.νεώτατος: νέος — young; superl. νεώτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’youngest’
glossary.οἰμώξειε: οἰμώζω — wail, groan aloud; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would wail’
glossary.παλάμῃσιν: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’in the hands’
glossary.παρέπεισεν: παραπείθω — talk round, win over; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’talked round’
glossary.παρήορος: παρήορος — of uncertain sense, ’stretched out, sprawling’ being a guess from the context (elsewhere of a horse harnessed beside the others); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πείρατ: πεῖραρ — end, limit; of a rope, its ends; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (πείρατ’ = πείρατα)
glossary.πεπάλασθε: πάλλω — shake; mid. shake the lots, draw lots; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: κλήρῳ πεπάλασθε ’cast lots’
glossary.περόνησεν: περονάω — pierce (properly pin through); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπερόνησεν): ’pierced’
glossary.πηλεὺς: Πηλεύς — Peleus, king of the Myrmidons, father of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολλὸς: πολύς — much, many, great; masc. nom. sg., epic πολλός (= Attic πολύς): ’huge’ of a body
glossary.πολυτλήμων: πολυτλήμων — much-enduring, very patient (πολύ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’); adj., masc. nom. sg., agreeing with θυμός
glossary.πολυχρύσοιο: πολύχρυσος — rich in gold; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πριαμίδῃ: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam (patronymic), i.e. Hector; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to Ἕκτορι
glossary.πτώσσοντας: πτώσσω — cower, crouch in fear; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’cowering’
glossary.πύλιοί: Πύλιοι — the Pylians, men of Nestor’s Pylos; masc. nom. pl., accent from the enclitic τε
glossary.σιδηρείη: σιδήρειος — of iron, iron; fem. nom. sg., epic -είη (= Attic σιδηρᾶ), agreeing with κορύνη
glossary.σιδηρείῃ: σιδήρειος — of iron, iron; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic σιδηρᾷ), agreeing with κορύνῃ
glossary.στεινωπῷ: στεινωπός — narrow; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic στενωπός), agreeing with ὁδῷ
glossary.στυγέουσι: στυγέω — hate, abhor; pres. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic στυγοῦσι): ’they hate’
glossary.σχέο: ἀνέχω (mid. ἀνέχομαι) — hold up; mid. hold oneself back; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid. σχέο (= Attic σχοῦ), with ἀνά in tmesis: ’hold back, restrain yourself’
glossary.τείχεσσιν: τεῖχος — wall; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic τείχεσι): ’by the walls’
glossary.τελευτὴ: τελευτή — end, fulfilment, death; fem. nom. sg.: βιότοιο τελευτή ’the end of life’
glossary.τόκον: τόκος — birth, offspring; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐρέων, paired with γενεήν
glossary.τόξοισι: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), of means: ’with the bow’
glossary.τῷδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. sg., standing alone: ’this man’
glossary.φειᾶς: Φειά — Pheia, a town of Elis; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φημί: φημί — say, declare; pres. 1 sg., + acc. and inf.: ’I say that he will …’
glossary.φόρει: φορέω — carry, wear, bear about; impf. 3 sg. act., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἐφόρει)
glossary.φύγῃσι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic φύγῃ), with αἴ κε: ’if he escape’
glossary.χραῖσμε: χραισμέω — ward off, avail; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπήρκεσε), + dat. and acc.: ’warded off (ruin) from’
glossary.ἀγρόμενοι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; syncopated aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ἀθροισθέντες): ’having gathered’
glossary.ἀδειής: ἀδεής — fearless, undaunted; adj., masc. nom. sg., Ionic ἀδειής (= Attic ἀδεής)
glossary.ἀείραι: ἀείρω — lift, raise; aor. opt. 3 sg. in -αι (= Attic ἄρειε), potential with κεν, with ἀνά in tmesis: ’would raise up’
glossary.ἀκήριοι: ἀκήριος — spiritless, lifeless (ἀ- + κῆρ ’heart’; the sense is taken from the context, and another word of the same shape means ’unscathed’, from κήρ ’doom’); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκλεὲς: ἀκλεής — inglorious, without fame; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’ingloriously’
glossary.ἀκούσαι: ἀκούω — hear; aor. opt. 3 sg. act. in -αι (= Attic ἀκούσειε), in a condition: ’should hear’
glossary.ἀκόρητος: ἀκόρητος — insatiate, never sated; adj., masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’insatiate of the fray’
glossary.ἀμείνονι: ἀμείνων — better, stronger; comparative of ἀγαθός, masc. dat. sg., agreeing with φωτί
glossary.ἀνήνασθαι: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, deny, disown; aor. mid. inf.
glossary.ἀνίστατο: ἀνίστημι — set up, raise; mid. rise, get up; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was rising, got up’
glossary.ἀναΐξαντες: ἀναΐσσω — spring up, rush up; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having sprung up’
glossary.ἀναστήσουσιν: ἀνίστημι — set up, raise; fut. 3 pl. act., transitive: ’will raise up’
glossary.ἀνδραιμονίδης: Ἀνδραιμονίδης — son of Andraemon (patronymic), i.e. Thoas; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀντήσειε: ἀντάω — meet, encounter, + gen.; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential with κε: ’would meet’
glossary.ἀπειλητῆρες: ἀπειλητήρ — threatener, one who threatens; masc. voc. pl., epic -ῆρες (= Attic ἀπειληταί), in address
glossary.ἀρηϊθόου: Ἀρηΐθοος — Areithous (name); masc. gen. sg., beside the epic Ἀρηϊθόοιο
glossary.ἀσπασίως: ἀσπάσιος — glad, welcome; adv. ἀσπασίως: ’gladly, joyfully’
glossary.ἀφραίνεις: ἀφραίνω — act senselessly, be witless; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you are acting senselessly’
glossary.ἀφροσύνης: ἀφροσύνη — senselessness, lack of wits; fem. gen. sg., of the thing needed after χρή: ’of senselessness’
glossary.ἐγήθεεν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐγήθει): ’was glad’
glossary.ἐγήρα: γηράω (γηράσκω) — grow old; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’grew old’
glossary.ἐγχεσίμωροι: ἐγχεσίμωρος — famed with the spear, spear-fighting; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπίκλησιν: ἐπίκλησις — surname, byname; fem. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by surname’
glossary.ἐπιειμένοι: ἐπιέννυμι — put on, clothe; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl., + acc. of respect: ’clad in’
glossary.ἐρέων: ἐρέω (= ἐρωτάω) — ask, inquire after; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρωτῶν), + acc. of the thing: ’asking after’ · also ἐρέω (fut. of εἶπον) — say, tell; fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρῶν), of purpose: ’to tell’ (ἔπος ἐρέων ’to tell a word’)
glossary.ἐρείσθη: ἐρείδω — prop, press, thrust; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was driven down’
glossary.ἐρευθαλίων: Ἐρευθαλίων — Ereuthalion, an Arcadian champion; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐρευθαλίωνι: Ἐρευθαλίων — Ereuthalion, an Arcadian champion; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐσημήναντο: σημαίνω — mark, give a sign; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’marked for themselves’
glossary.ἐτρόμεον: τρομέω — tremble, quake; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔτρεμον): ’they trembled’
glossary.ἔρριγ: ῥιγέω — shudder, shrink from; perf. 3 sg. with present sense, elided (ἔρριγ’ = ἔρριγε), + inf.: ’shudders to’
glossary.ἔσκον: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., iterative form in -σκον, epic (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’
glossary.ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
glossary.ἔχονται: ἔχω (mid./pass.) — hold; hold oneself, cling; pres. 3 pl. mid./pass.: πείρατα ἔχονται ’the limits are held’, + ἐν and dat.
glossary.ἡβώοιμι: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth; pres. opt. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡβῴην), in a wish
glossary.ἡβῷμ: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth; pres. opt. 1 sg., contracted, elided (ἡβῷμ’ = ἡβῷμι, Attic ἡβῴην), in a wish after αἲ γάρ
glossary.ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἰαρδάνου: Ἰάρδανος — the Iardanus, a river of Elis; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἵστατο: ἵστημι — set, stand; mid. take one’s stand; impf. 3 sg. mid., masc. sg. subject: ’stood forth, took his stand’
glossary.ὀνήσει: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will benefit’
glossary.ὀνήσεται: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will profit’, + acc. of the person
glossary.ὀνόμαζεν: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζεν) ’called by name’
glossary.ὀπάων: ὀπάων — attendant, companion in arms; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑμέων: σύ — you; pl. ὑμεῖς, gen. pl. ὑμέων, epic (= Attic ὑμῶν), partitive: ’of you’
glossary.ὑποδέχθαι: ὑποδέχομαι — take up, accept, undertake; aor. inf., syncopated epic form (= Attic ὑποδέξασθαι)
glossary.ὑποφθὰς: ὑποφθάνω — get in first, forestall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’getting in first’
glossary.ῥήγνυσκε: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε, unaugmented (= Attic ἔρρηγνυ): ’used to break’
glossary.αἰνὸς: αἰνός — fearsome, grim; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰχμή: αἰχμή — spear-point, point of a spear; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰχμητά: αἰχμητής — spearman; masc. nom. dual, predicate: ’spearmen’
glossary.αἰόλον: αἰόλος — glancing, quick-moving (sheen or colour uncertain); adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος
glossary.αἴαντι: Αἴας — Ajax, Greek hero at Troy; masc. dat. sg., Αἴαντι: ’to Ajax’
glossary.αὐτοσχεδὸν: αὐτοσχεδόν — at close quarters, hand to hand; adv.
glossary.βιβάς: βιβάω (βίβημι) — stride, step; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’striding’ (Attic βαίνων)
glossary.βλάψε: βλάπτω — hinder, damage, disable; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔβλαψε): ’harmed’
glossary.βλοσυροῖσι: βλοσυρός — grim, fierce; adj., neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς), agreeing with προσώπασι
glossary.βῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; also the ox-hide, i.e. a shield of hide; fem. acc. sg., epic βῶν (= Attic βοῦν), with ἀζαλέην
glossary.γιγνώσκοντες: γιγνώσκω — recognise, know; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’recognising’
glossary.γυναικός: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.δίηται: δίεμαι — drive off, chase away; pres. subj. mid. 3 sg., with οὐ, future-like: ’(no one) will drive (me)’
glossary.δαΐζων: δαΐζω — cleave, cut in pieces; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δείδιμεν: δείδω — fear, be afraid; perf. 1 pl. with pres. sense: ’we fear’
glossary.δεξιά: δεξιός — right, on the right; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, with ἐπί: ’to the right’
glossary.δεῖξ: δείκνυμι — show; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δεῖξ’ = δεῖξε; Attic ἔδειξε)
glossary.δοκέω: δοκέω — think, expect, suppose; pres. 1 sg., + fut. inf.: ’I expect (to win)’
glossary.εἴσεαι: οἶδα — know; fut. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἴσῃ): ’you will know’
glossary.εἶχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg. · also with an infinitive, ’be able’ (οὐκ εἶχεν ἑλέσθαι ’he could not take’)
glossary.εὔχεσθε: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’pray’
glossary.ζατρεφέων: ζατρεφής — well-fed, sleek, thriving; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζατρεφῶν); masc. with ταύρων, also with σιάλων, fem. with αἰγῶν
glossary.θυμοβόρου: θυμοβόρος — heart-devouring (θυμός + the root of βιβρώσκω ’eat’); adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ἔριδος
glossary.κείμενον: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λίθον: ’lying’
glossary.κλήρου: κλῆρος — lot (a marked token drawn or shaken to decide); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κοίρανε: κοίρανος — ruler; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.κορύσσετο: κορύσσω — arm, helm, equip; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’armed himself’
glossary.κραδάων: κραδάω — swing, shake; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic κραδῶν): ’swinging’
glossary.κυνέης: κυνέη — helmet, cap (properly of dog-skin); fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κυνῆς)
glossary.μάχεσθον: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. imper. 2 dual, in a prohibition with μηδέ: ’and do not fight’
glossary.μέλανα: μέλας — black, dark; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λίθον
glossary.μέλπεσθαι: μέλπομαι — sport, play, make music; pres. inf. mid., + dat.: ’to play at, sport with’ (Ἄρηϊ ’with Ares’)
glossary.μένεϊ: μένος — might, force, fury; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει), of means: ’by the force (of strife)’
glossary.μείζονα: μείζων — greater, larger; comparative of μέγας; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λᾶαν
glossary.μειδιόων: μειδιάω — smile; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μειδιῶν): ’smiling’
glossary.μετέασι: μέτειμι — be among, be present; pres. 3 pl., epic -έασι (= Attic μέτεισι): ’are among’
glossary.μυλοειδέϊ: μυλοειδής — millstone-like; adj., masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ), agreeing with πέτρῳ
glossary.μόθον: μόθος — press, the crush of battle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νήϊδά: νήϊς — ignorant, unskilled; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἐμέ; accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.νωμῆσαι: νωμάω — handle, wield, ply; aor. inf. act., after οἶδα: ’(know how) to wield’
glossary.νύξεν: νύσσω — prick, thrust at, stab; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔνυξε): ’thrust at’
glossary.νώροπι: νώροψ — flashing (traditional gloss; origin not known); masc. dat. sg., epithet of bronze, agreeing with χαλκῷ
glossary.ξιφέεσσ: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι, elided (ξιφέεσσ’ = ξιφέεσσι; Attic ξίφεσι): ’with swords’
glossary.οἶδεν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. (with pres. sense): ’knows’
glossary.οὐτάζοντο: οὐτάζω — wound, stab; impf. 3 pl. mid., reciprocal; with κε, past potential: ’would have been striking one another’
glossary.πάτασσεν: πατάσσω — beat, throb, pound; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’pounded’
glossary.πέτρῳ: πέτρος — stone, boulder; masc. dat. sg., of means: ’with a stone’
glossary.πειρήτιζε: πειρητίζω — make trial of (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 sg. act., in a prohibition with μή: ’do not make trial of’
glossary.πεπνυμένα: πέπνυμαι — be prudent, wise (perf. w/ pres. sense, from πνέω ’breathe’); part. neut. acc. pl.: ’prudent (counsels)’
glossary.περιήχησεν: περιηχέω — ring round, resound; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’rang round’
glossary.πιθέσθαι: πείθομαι — obey, trust, yield (+ dat.); aor. inf. mid. (2nd aor. ἐπιθόμην): ’to obey, give way to’
glossary.πολεμίζετε: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. imper. 2 pl., with μηκέτι: ’fight no longer’
glossary.ποσσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.προκαλέσσατο: προκαλέω — call forth, challenge; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic προὐκαλέσατο): ’challenged’
glossary.προσώπασι: πρόσωπον — face; neut. dat. pl., epic -ασι (= Attic προσώποις)
glossary.πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)
glossary.πτύχας: πτύξ — fold, layer (of hide); also a mountain-fold, the recesses of a mountain’s flank; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πόδ: πούς — foot; masc. acc. sg., elided (πόδ’ = πόδα)
glossary.πύθωνται: πυνθάνομαι — learn, find out; aor. subj. mid. 3 pl., in a purpose clause after ἵνα μή: ’(lest) they learn’
glossary.σαλαμῖνι: Σαλαμίς — Salamis, Ajax’s island; fem. dat. sg., of place
glossary.σκυτοτόμων: σκυτοτόμος — leather-cutter, leatherworker; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the leatherworkers’
glossary.σκῆπτρα: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.σταδίῃ: σταδίη (sc. ὑσμίνη) — standing fight, close fighting; fem. dat. sg., adj. used as noun: ’in the stand-up fight’
glossary.στυφέλιξε: στυφελίζω — thrust roughly, shove; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐστυφέλιξε)
glossary.σχέτο: ἔχω — hold, check; aor. mid. 3 sg., syncopated, unaugmented (σχέτο = ἔσχετο): ’was stopped’
glossary.ταλθύβιός: Ταλθύβιος — Talthybius, Agamemnon’s herald; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τελέθει: τελέθω — be, prove to be; pres. 3 sg., poetic: ’is, has come to be’
glossary.τελαμώνιε: Τελαμώνιος — Telamonian, of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. voc. sg., of Ajax
glossary.τμήδην: τμήδην — with a cut, cutting; adv. (from τέμνω ’cut’)
glossary.τοιοῦτον: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; masc. acc. sg., predicate with ἐόντα: ’being such a man’
glossary.τραφέμεν: τρέφω — rear, nourish; intr. aor. inf. τραφέμεν, epic -έμεν (= Attic τραφῆναι): ’to grow up, be reared’
glossary.τρηχύν: τρηχύς — rough, rugged; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τραχύς), agreeing with λίθον
glossary.τυχίος: Τυχίος — Tychius, a leatherworker of Hyle; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τόφρ: τόφρα — so long, during that time; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’as long as’, elided (τόφρ’ = τόφρα)
glossary.φίλω: φίλος — dear; masc. voc. dual, in address, agreeing with παῖδε
glossary.φιλέεις: φιλέω — love, hold dear; pres. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλεῖς)
glossary.χάρμῃ: χάρμη — joy of battle, battle; fem. dat. sg., with προκαλέσσατο: ’in the joy of battle’
glossary.χαίρω: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
glossary.ἀέκοντα: ἄκων — unwilling; masc. acc. sg., epic ἀέκων (= Attic ἄκοντα), agreeing with με: ’me unwilling’
glossary.ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
glossary.ἀζαλέην: ἀζαλέος — dry, parched; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with βῶν
glossary.ἀναδῦναι: ἀναδύομαι — draw back, shrink back, retreat; aor. inf. act. (2nd aor. ἀνέδυν): ’to shrink back’
glossary.ἀναχασσάμενος: ἀναχάζομαι — draw back, retire; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ: ’having drawn back’
glossary.ἀνδροκτασίας: ἀνδροκτασία — man-slaying, slaughter in battle; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνεκήκιεν: ἀνακηκίω — gush up, well up; impf. 3 sg., augmented, epic -ιεν: ’gushed up’
glossary.ἀντιάσαιμεν: ἀντιάω — meet, face (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 pl., potential with ἄν: ’we could meet’
glossary.ἀπέληγε: ἀπολήγω — cease from, leave off (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’left off’
glossary.ἀπειλήσας: ἀπειλέω — threaten; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having threatened’
glossary.ἀπηνήναντο: ἀπαναίνομαι — refuse, reject; aor. 3 pl. mid., with reduplication: ’they refused’
glossary.ἀρέσθαι: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain; aor. mid. inf. (2nd aor. ἀρόμην): ’to win’
glossary.ἀφαυροῦ: ἀφαυρός — weak; adj., masc. gen. sg., agreeing with παιδός
glossary.ἀχιλλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
glossary.ἁπάντῃ: ἁπάντῃ — on every side, everywhere; adv. (= πάντῃ)
glossary.ἐγήθεον: γηθέω — rejoice; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’rejoiced, were glad’
glossary.ἐγγύς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv., with a gen. as a preposition: ’near’
glossary.ἐγχριμφθείς: ἐγχρίμπτω — drive close, press against; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., middle sense: ’pressed against’
glossary.ἐκσπασσαμένω: ἐκσπάω — draw out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. dual, epic -σσ-: ’having drawn out’
glossary.ἐμός: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐξετανύσθη: ἐκτανύω — stretch out; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was stretched out’
glossary.ἐπάλμενος: ἐφάλλομαι — leap upon, spring at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (ἐπάλμενος = ἐφαλόμενος): ’leaping on (them)’
glossary.ἐπιγράψας: ἐπιγράφω — scratch on, mark; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having scratched (his mark)’
glossary.ἐποίησεν: ποιέω — make, build; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐπομφάλιον: ἐπομφάλιος — on the boss (ὀμφαλός) of a shield; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος or adverbial
glossary.ἐπῆλθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, pass over, arrive; aor. 3 sg. (same form in Attic)
glossary.ἑβδομάτῃ: ἑβδόματος — seventh (epic = Attic ἕβδομος); fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ῥινῷ: ’in the seventh (hide)’
glossary.ἑπταβόειον: ἑπταβόειος — of seven ox-hides; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted, agreeing with σάκος
glossary.ἔαξε: ἄγνυμι — break, shatter; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented ἔαξε (ε + α): ’shattered’
glossary.ἔθορε: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. (augmented): ’leapt out’
glossary.ἔλπομαι: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid./dep., + inf.: ’I expect’
glossary.ἔμβαλεν: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, put in; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’threw in’
glossary.ἔπεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), augmented (unaugmented πέσον); with σύν in tmesis, σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
glossary.ἕκτορά: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic περ
glossary.ἕκτορί: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg., of interest with θυμός: ’Hector’s own (heart)’
glossary.ἕσσατο: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ἕσσατο (Attic ἠμφιέσατο): ’put on’
glossary.ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came, passed’
glossary.ἧκ: ἵημι — send, hurl; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἧκ’ = ἧκε): ’hurled’
glossary.ἰδρείῃ: ἰδρείη — skill, knowledge, cunning; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by skill’
glossary.ὀπιπεύσας: ὀπιπεύω — look at, watch for, spy on; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’spying’
glossary.ὄγδοον: ὄγδοος — eighth; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χαλκόν: ’an eighth (layer of) bronze’
glossary.ὄγδοος: ὄγδοος — eighth; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’the eighth’
glossary.ὄπασσον: ὀπάζω — bestow, grant; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὄπασον): ’bestow’
glossary.ὑπέσχεθε: ὑπέχω — hold out, hold under; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σχεθε (= Attic ὑπέσχε): ’held out’
glossary.ὑπήλυθε: ὑπέρχομαι — go in under, creep beneath; aor. 3 sg., epic -ήλυθε (= Attic ὑπῆλθε): ’crept over’
glossary.ὑποτρέσαι: ὑποτρέω — shrink back, flinch; aor. inf. act.: ’to shrink back’
glossary.ὤρθωσεν: ὀρθόω — set upright, raise; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’set upright’
glossary.ῥηξήνορα: ῥηξήνωρ — man-breaking, breaker of men; adj., masc. acc. sg., epithet of Achilles
glossary.ῥινῷ: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. sg., a layer of hide
glossary.γέραιρεν: γεραίρω — honour, treat with honour; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγέραιρεν): ’honoured’
glossary.δέρον: δέρω — flay, skin; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔδερον): ’they flayed’
glossary.δείμομεν: δέμω — build; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic short vowel (= Attic δειμώμεν), hortatory: ’let us build’
glossary.δεῦτ: δεῦτε — come here, hither; adv. used as a call to several, elided (δεῦτ’ = δεῦτε)
glossary.διέχευαν: διαχέω — pour apart, cut up (a carcass); aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they cut up’
glossary.διακρίνῃ: διακρίνω — part, separate, decide between; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’parts (us)’
glossary.διακρινθέντε: διακρίνω — part, separate; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. dual: ’having been parted’ (of two men)
glossary.διηνεκέεσσι: διηνεκής — continuous, unbroken, whole; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic -έσι), agreeing with νώτοισιν
glossary.δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δύσονται: δύω — enter, go into (mid. and intrans. aor. act.); fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’they will enter’
glossary.δώομεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic lengthened vowel (= Attic δῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us give’
glossary.εἰπέμεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
glossary.εἰπέμεναι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
glossary.εἶλαρ: εἶλαρ — defence, shelter, protection; neut. nom./acc. sg., in apposition: ’a shelter’
glossary.εὐχόμεναι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. pl.: ’praying’
glossary.θεόφιν: θεός — god; dat. pl., epic suffix -φι(ν) (θεόφιν = θεοῖς), with ἀτάλαντος: ’to the gods’
glossary.θυμοβόροιο: θυμοβόρος — heart-devouring, heart-consuming; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with ἔριδος
glossary.κήομεν: καίω — burn; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic short vowel (= Attic κήωμεν), after εἰς ὅ κε: ’we burn’
glossary.κατακήομεν: κατακαίω — burn down, burn up; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic short vowel, hortatory: ’let us burn’
glossary.κατῆλθον: κατέρχομαι — go down; aor. 3 pl.: ’they went down’
glossary.κελεύετε: κελεύω — urge, bid, command; pres. imper. 2 pl. (indic. the same in form): ’bid!’
glossary.κεχαρηότα: χαίρω — rejoice; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic κεχαρηκότα): ’rejoicing’
glossary.κλισίῃσιν: κλισίη — hut, shelter, tent; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic κλισίαις)
glossary.κολεῷ: κολεόν (κολεός) — sheath, scabbard (Attic κουλεός); dat. sg., after σύν: ’with the sheath’
glossary.κυκλήσομεν: κυκλέω — wheel, haul on wheels, bring round; hortatory subj. 1 pl. (aor. subj. with short vowel, or fut.): ’let us haul’
glossary.μήστωρ: μήστωρ — counsellor, adviser, one who devises; masc. nom. sg., in apposition
glossary.μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat.: ’among’ · also prep. + acc., ’after, in quest of’ (μεθ’ ὕλην ’for wood’)
glossary.νίκῃ: νίκη — victory; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’in (his) victory’
glossary.νώτοισιν: νῶτον — back (of an animal or a person; a cut of meat); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.οἴκοθεν: οἴκοθεν — from home, from one’s own house; adv., -θεν suffix ’from’
glossary.πάμπρωτος: πάμπρωτος — first of all; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate (πᾶς + πρῶτος)
glossary.πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its relative pronoun: ’around’ (ἣν πέρι ’around which’)
glossary.παυσώμεσθα: παύω — make stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. subj. mid. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα), hortatory: ’let us cease from’
glossary.παῦσαι: παύω — make stop, stop; aor. inf. act.: ’to stop’ · also aor. imper. mid. 2 sg. (same form): ’cease!’
glossary.πείσομαι: πείθομαι — obey, trust, yield (+ dat.); fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall obey’ · also πάσχω — suffer; fut. 1 sg. (the same form)
glossary.πεδίου: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., after ἐκ: ’out of the plain’
glossary.πεῖράν: πείρω — pierce, skewer; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπειραν), accented before the enclitic τε: ’they pierced’
glossary.πινυτήν: πινυτή — discernment, good sense; fem. acc. sg., noun beside the adj. πινυτός
glossary.ποιήσομεν: ποιέω — make, build; hortatory subj. 1 pl. (aor. subj. with short vowel, or fut.): ’let us make’
glossary.πυρὴν: πυρή — funeral pyre; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σκάμανδρον: Σκάμανδρος — Scamander, the river of Troy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σούς: σός, σή, σόν — your, yours (possessive of σύ); masc. acc. pl.: ’your own’
glossary.σπουδῆς: σπουδή — haste, effort, earnestness; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’in earnest’
glossary.σόον: σόος — safe, sound (Attic σῶς); masc. acc. sg., predicate: ’safe’
glossary.τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τεθνᾶσι: θνῄσκω — die; perf. 3 pl. (= τεθνήκασι): ’have died’
glossary.τελαμῶνι: τελαμών — strap, baldric; masc. dat. sg.: ’with the strap’ · also Τελαμών — Telamon, father of Ajax and Teucer; masc. dat. sg., proper name
glossary.τετρηχυῖα: τετρήχω — be rough, be in turmoil (from the root of τρηχύς ’rough’); perf. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic, agreeing with ἀγορή: ’in turmoil’
glossary.τοῦδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; masc./neut. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than this’
glossary.φυλακῆς: φυλακή — watch, guard; fem. gen. sg., after μνήσασθε: ’of the watch’ · also gen. after λανθάνομαι: ’(forget) the watch’
glossary.χεύομεν: χέω — pour; heap up (a mound); aor. subj. 1 pl., epic short vowel, hortatory: ’let us heap up’
glossary.ψευσάμενοι: ψεύδομαι — lie, deceive, break (an oath); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having broken’
glossary.ψυχαὶ: ψυχή — soul, spirit, ghost; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγορεύσω: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; fut. 1 sg. (or aor. subj.): ’I shall speak’
glossary.ἀγόμην: ἄγω — lead, bring; mid. take with oneself; impf. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἠγόμην): ’I brought’
glossary.ἀγῶνα: ἀγών — gathering, assembly; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀελπτέοντες: ἀελπτέω — be without hope, not hope; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀελπτοῦντες): ’not hoping’
glossary.ἀντῆνορ: Ἀντήνωρ — Antenor, one of the Trojan elders; masc. voc. sg., with short ο for the nominative’s ω, in address
glossary.ἀπόφημι: ἀπόφημι — say outright, declare, refuse; pres. 1 sg.: ’I say plainly’
glossary.ἀρθμήσαντε: ἀρθμέω — be joined in friendship, be friends; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’having become friends’
glossary.ἀρχέτω: ἄρχω — begin, rule; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him begin’
glossary.ἄγῃ: ἄγω — lead, bring, take; pres. subj. 3 sg., with ὥς κε in a purpose clause: ’may take’
glossary.ἄκριτον: ἄκριτος — unending, ceaseless (literally ’undecided’); neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’endlessly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τύμβον: ’unsorted, undivided’
glossary.ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλα): ’others’
glossary.ἄρσενα: ἄρσην — male (Attic ἄρρην); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with βοῦν: ’male’
glossary.ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with μιν: ’the whole of it’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a noun: ’all (the sorrows)’
glossary.ἐΰρροον: ἐΰρρους (ἐΰρροος) — fair-flowing; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὔρουν), agreeing with Σκάμανδρον
glossary.ἐγρήγορθε: ἐγείρω — rouse; perf. ἐγρήγορα ’be awake’; perf. imper. 2 pl., epic: ’keep awake’
glossary.ἐθέλωσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a conditional clause with κε: ’they are willing’
glossary.ἐκτελέεσθαι: ἐκτελέω — accomplish, bring about; inf. mid./pass., epic uncontracted -έεσθαι (= Attic -εῖσθαι), after ἔλπομαι: ’to be brought about’
glossary.ἐμαρνάσθην: μάρναμαι — fight; impf. 3 dual mid., -άσθην: ’the two fought’
glossary.ἐξαγαγόντες: ἐξάγω — lead out, bring out; 2nd aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having brought out’
glossary.ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
glossary.ἐπῄνησαν: ἐπαινέω — approve, agree; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’approved’
glossary.ἐρυκάκοι: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; 2nd aor. opt. 3 sg. act., reduplicated, with χ’ (potential): ’would hold back’
glossary.ἐσκέδασ: σκεδάννυμι — scatter; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἐσκέδασ’ = ἐσκέδασε): ’scattered’
glossary.ἐϋτμήτῳ: ἐΰτμητος — well-cut; adj., masc. dat. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὖ-), agreeing with τελαμῶνι
glossary.ἐϋφρήνῃς: εὐφραίνω — gladden, cheer; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐ-), after ὡς in a purpose clause: ’you may gladden’
glossary.ἐϋφρανέω: εὐφραίνω — gladden, cheer; fut. 1 sg. act., epic uncontracted ἐϋφρανέω (= Attic εὐφρανῶ): ’I shall gladden’
glossary.ἐϋφρονέων: εὐφρονέω (epic ἐϋφρονέω) — be well-minded, be well-disposed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic εὐφρονῶν): ’with kindly intent’
glossary.ἑτέροισί: ἕτερος — the other, one of two; masc. dat. pl., accented before the enclitic γε: ’to one side or the other’
glossary.ἕπον: ἕπω — be busy about, tend, dress (meat); impf. 3 pl., in tmesis with ἀμφί (= ἀμφέπον)
glossary.ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. (= Attic ἕῳ): ’at dawn’
glossary.ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
glossary.ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶ: ’our (house)’
glossary.ἡμιόνοισιν: ἡμίονος — mule; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’with mules’
glossary.ἤρχετο: ἄρχομαι — begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid., + inf.: ’began (to weave)’
glossary.ἰδαῖ: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, herald of Priam; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἰδαῖ’ = Ἰδαῖε), in address
glossary.ἱππηλασίη: ἱππηλασίη (ἱππηλάσιος) — for driving horses, fit for chariots; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), agreeing with ὁδός
glossary.ἱπποδάμοις: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming, tamer of horses; adj., masc. dat. pl., agreeing with Τρώεσσι
glossary.ἵππον: ἵππος — horse; masc. acc. sg., collective: ’horse’
glossary.ὀξὺς: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares
glossary.ὀρύξομεν: ὀρύσσω — dig; hortatory subj. 1 pl. (aor. subj. with short vowel, or fut.): ’let us dig’
glossary.ὁδὸς: ὁδός — road, way; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄπτησάν: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. 3 pl. act., the unaugmented form of ὤπτησαν, accented before the enclitic τε: ’roasted’
glossary.ὄρωρε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; perf. 3 sg. intrans.: ’has arisen’
glossary.ὅμαδον: ὅμαδος — din, uproar of a crowd; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
glossary.ὑφαίνειν: ὑφαίνω — weave; pres. inf. act., of a plan: ’to weave (a scheme)’
glossary.ὤλεσαν: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’destroyed’
glossary.ῥέξομεν: ῥέζω — do, perform; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic short vowel (or fut.), after ἵνα μή: ’(that) we do (not)’ · also deliberative, in a direct question: ’what are we to do?’ (τί ῥέξομεν ’what shall we do?’)
glossary.αἱματόεντα: αἱματόεις — bloody, blood-stained; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic -όεντα (= Attic αἱματηρόν), agreeing with βρότον · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’bloody’
glossary.αὐτῇσι: αὐτός — self; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic αὐταῖς): intensive with a noun, ’themselves’ (αὐτῇσι βόεσσιν ’the oxen themselves’)
glossary.βαθυρρόου: βαθύρροος — deep-flowing; adj., masc. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic βαθύρρου), epithet of Ocean
glossary.βουφόνεον: βουφονέω — slaughter oxen, kill cattle; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐβουφόνουν): ’they slaughtered oxen’
glossary.βρότον: βρότος — gore, blood from a wound; masc. acc. sg. (not βροτός ’mortal’)
glossary.βόεσσιν: βοῦς — ox, cow; dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic βουσί)
glossary.γίγνετ: γίγνομαι — become, arise, come to be; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (γίγνετ’ = γίγνεται): ’there is, there comes to be’ · also impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (γίγνετ’ = γίγνετο): ’came about’ (ἄραβος … γίγνετ’ ὀδόντων ’a clatter of teeth came about’)
glossary.γνωτὸν: γνωτός — known, plain, knowable (verbal adj. of γιγνώσκω); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’known, plain’
glossary.δαίνυντο: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. feast, banquet; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’were feasting’
glossary.δαρδανίωνες: Δαρδανίων — Dardanian, man of Dardania in the Troad (another form of Δάρδανος); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δείσειε: δείδω — fear, be afraid of; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential with κέν: ’might fear’
glossary.δεπάων: δέπας — cup; neut. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), after ἐκ: ’out of cups’
glossary.δεχέσθω: δέχομαι — receive, accept, take; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid./dep.: ’let him accept’
glossary.διαγνῶναι: διαγιγνώσκω — distinguish, tell apart, recognise; aor. inf. act., with χαλεπῶς ἦν: ’to tell apart’
glossary.δύσετο: δύω (mid. δύομαι) — enter, sink, set (of the sun), put on; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδύσατο): ’set’
glossary.εἰσανιών: εἰσάνειμι (εἰς + ἄνειμι) — go up into, climb into; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg. of εἶμι: ’climbing into’
glossary.εἴα: ἐάω — allow, permit, let be; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἔα- → εἴα): ’allowed’
glossary.εἵλοντο: αἱρέω — take; mid. take for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid., augmented: ’took for themselves’; with δόρπον ’took their supper’
glossary.εὐρυσθενές: εὐρυσθενής — of wide strength, mighty (εὐρύς + σθένος); adj., masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.εὔνηος: Εὔνηος — Euneus, son of Jason and Hypsipyle, ruler of Lemnos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θάλειαν: θάλεια — abundant, flourishing, rich (fem. adj., from θάλλω ’flourish’); fem. acc. sg., of a feast
glossary.θάνωσι: θνῄσκω — die; aor. subj. 3 pl. act. (Attic ἀποθάνωσι), after ἐπεί κε: ’have died’
glossary.θεράποντας: θεράπων — attendant, servant, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.θερμὰ: θερμός — hot, warm; adj., neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δάκρυα
glossary.θηεῦντο: θεάομαι — gaze at, marvel at; impf. 3 pl., Ionic θηεῦντο, unaugmented (= Attic ἐθεῶντο)
glossary.κέλονται: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; pres. 3 pl. mid. (Attic κελεύουσι), + inf.: ’they urge’
glossary.καλύψαι: καλύπτω — cover, hide, bury; aor. inf. act.: ’to cover’
glossary.κατέπηξαν: καταπήγνυμι — fix in, plant, drive in; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they drove in’
glossary.κατακαιέμεν: κατακαίω — burn up, burn down; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic κατακαίειν)
glossary.κατατεθνηώτων: καταθνήσκω — die; perf. part. masc. gen. pl., epic -ηώτων (= Attic κατατεθνεώτων): ’dead’
glossary.καταχεῦαι: καταχέω — pour down, pour over; aor. inf. act., epic -εῦαι (= Attic καταχέαι): ’to pour down’
glossary.κλαίειν: κλαίω — weep, mourn; pres. inf.: ’to weep’
glossary.κλειτὰς: κλειτός — famous, renowned, glorious; adj., fem. acc. pl., epic (= κλυτός), agreeing with ἑκατόμβας
glossary.κλύον: κλύω — hear, hearken; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they heard’
glossary.κοιμήσαντ: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. go to sleep, lie down; aor. mid. 3 pl., elided (κοιμήσαντ’ = κοιμήσαντο): ’they lay down to sleep’
glossary.κουριδίην: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a wife); adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄλοχον
glossary.κριτὸς: κριτός — picked, chosen (verbal adj. of κρίνω); masc. nom. sg., agreeing with λαός
glossary.κτήματ: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. acc. pl., elided (κτήματ’ = κτήματα)
glossary.κτυπέων: κτυπέω — crash, thunder, resound; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic κτυπῶν): ’thundering’
glossary.λήμνοιο: Λῆμνος — Lemnos, island of the northern Aegean; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after ἐκ
glossary.λαομέδοντι: Λαομέδων — Laomedon, king of Troy, father of Priam; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λεῖψαι: λείβω — pour, pour as a libation; aor. inf. act.: ’to pour a libation’
glossary.μέθυ: μέθυ — wine; neut. acc. sg., object of ἀγέμεν · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’the wine’
glossary.μέσσοισιν: μέσος — middle; adj. used as a noun, masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’in the midst’ (ἐν μέσσοισιν)
glossary.μήθ: μήτε (elided μήθ’ before a rough breathing) — nor, and not; conj. continuing a negative command
glossary.μήτ: μήτε (elided μήτ’) — nor, and not; negative conj. in a command, ’let no one’
glossary.μειλισσέμεν: μειλίσσω — soothe, appease, propitiate; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic μειλίσσειν): ’to appease’
glossary.μετεφώνεεν: μεταφωνέω — speak among, address a company; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted -εεν (= Attic μετεφώνει)
glossary.νέκυάς: νέκυς — dead man, corpse; masc. acc. pl. (νέκυας), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.νέκυς: νέκυς — dead man, corpse; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. pl., epic contracted νέκῡς (= νέκυας): ’the dead’
glossary.νήπιός: νήπιος — foolish, childish, witless; adj., masc. nom. sg., accented νήπιός before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.νίζοντες: νίζω — wash, wash off; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’washing’ (with ἄπο in tmesis, = ἀπονίζοντες)
glossary.νεκροῖσιν: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), after ἀμφί: ’about the dead’
glossary.νόημα: νόημα — thought, notion, idea, purpose; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.οἰνίζοντο: οἰνίζομαι — get wine, supply oneself with wine; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ᾠνίζοντο): ’they got wine’
glossary.οἴχωνται: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone; pres. subj. 3 pl. with perfect force, after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’whenever they have gone’
glossary.παννύχιος: παννύχιος — all night long; adj., masc. nom. sg. used adverbially
glossary.παρέσταν: παρίστημι — stand beside, come up; aor. 3 pl. act. (intrans.), epic -σταν (= Attic παρέστησαν): ’they came alongside, arrived’
glossary.ποίεον: ποιέω — make, build; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐποίουν): ’they made’
glossary.πολίσσαμεν: πολίζω — found, build (a city or its walls); aor. 1 pl. act., epic double σ and unaugmented (= Attic ἐπολίσαμεν): ’we built’
glossary.ποτιδέγμενοι: προσδέχομαι (epic ποτιδέχομαι) — wait for, await, expect; athematic part. mid. masc. nom. pl. (ποτιδέγμενος, with present sense): ’waiting for’
glossary.πρήσαντες: πίμπρημι (πρήθω) — burn; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having burned’
glossary.πρίαμός: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg., accented πρίαμός before the enclitic τε
glossary.προέηκεν: προΐημι — send forth, let go; aor. 3 sg., epic προέηκεν (= Attic προῆκε): ’he sent forth’
glossary.προσέβαλλεν: προσβάλλω — strike against, cast upon; impf. 3 sg.: ’was striking’ (of the sun’s rays falling on the fields)
glossary.πρύμνῃ: πρύμνη — stern (of a ship); fem. dat. sg., Ionic η (= Attic -α), of place
glossary.πυρκαϊῆς: πυρκαϊή — funeral pyre; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς), of place: ’on the pyre’
glossary.σκόλοπας: σκόλοψ — stake, sharpened pale; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τίθεντο: τίθημι — put, set; mid. make, prepare for oneself; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they made (a feast)’
glossary.τελέεσσιν: τέλος — company, troop, body of men; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -εσι): ’in companies’
glossary.τετέλεστο: τελέω — finish, accomplish; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had been completed’
glossary.τροίηνδ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. with the suffix -δε ’to’, elided (Τροίηνδ’ = Τροίηνδε): ’to Troy’
glossary.τῆμος: τῆμος — then, at that time; correlative temporal adv. answering ἦμος ’when’
glossary.φειδὼ: φειδώ — sparing, restraint, holding back; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φησιν: φημί — say, declare; pres. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable), enclitic, with οὔ and a fut. inf.: ’he says … not’
glossary.χέον: χέω — pour, shed; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented and uncontracted (= Attic ἔχεον)
glossary.χέοντες: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’shedding’
glossary.χίλια: χίλιοι — a thousand; adj., neut. acc. pl., agreeing with μέτρα
glossary.χαλεπῶς: χαλεπῶς — with difficulty, hardly; adv. from χαλεπός
glossary.χλωρὸν: χλωρός — green, pale green; of fear, ’pale, ashen’; adj., neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέος
glossary.ψαμάθοισι: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀθλήσαντε: ἀθλέω — toil, labour at a task; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’having toiled’ (of two men)
glossary.ἀκαλαρρείταο: ἀκαλαρρείτης — gently-flowing; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), epithet of Ocean
glossary.ἀκούεις: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. 2 sg., + acc.
glossary.ἀμαλδύνηται: ἀμαλδύνω — efface, wipe out, make vanish; pres. subj. 3 sg. pass., after ὥς κέν: ’may be wiped out’
glossary.ἀμαξάων: ἅμαξα — wagon, cart; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), of place with ἐπ- (ἐπάειραν): ’onto the wagons’
glossary.ἀμφιλύκη: ἀμφιλύκη — twilight, half-lit (of night; traditionally from λύκη ’light’, the word occurring only here); adj., fem. nom. sg., with νύξ
glossary.ἀνέσχεθε: ἀνέχω — hold up, lift up; aor. 3 sg., epic ἀνέσχεθε (= Attic ἀνέσχε): ’held up’
glossary.ἀναρρήξας: ἀναρρήγνυμι — break up, break open; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having broken up’
glossary.ἀνδραπόδεσσι: ἀνδράποδον — slave (a captive taken in war); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἀνδραπόδοις)
glossary.ἀπέειπε: ἀπεῖπον — say out, deliver (a message), tell out; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπεῖπε) · also ’refuse, renounce’ (ἀπέειπε ’has refused’)
glossary.ἀρούρας: ἄρουρα — ploughland, field; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀστεροπητῇ: ἀστεροπητής — lightning-flasher, lord of lightning; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus, agreeing with Ζηνί
glossary.ἀφαυρότερος: ἀφαυρός — weak, feeble; compar. ἀφαυρότερος, masc. nom. sg., with gen. of comparison σέο: ’weaker (than you)’
glossary.ἀχνύμενοι: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, sorrow; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄγουσαι: ἄγω — lead, bring, carry; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl., agreeing with νῆες: ’bringing’
glossary.ἄλλός: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg., accented ἄλλός before the enclitics κέν τις: ’another’
glossary.ἄψορρον: ἄψορρος — backward, back again; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’back’
glossary.ἐθέλητε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 2 pl., after αἴ κ’: ’if you wish’
glossary.ἐνίψει: ἐνέπω (ἐνίσπω) — tell, declare; fut. 3 sg. (= Attic ἐρεῖ): ’will tell, will declare’ (the form has also been assigned to ἐνίπτω ’rebuke’)
glossary.ἐνεποίεον: ἐμποιέω — make in, build into; impf. 3 pl., augmented and uncontracted (= Attic ἐνεποίουν): ’they made in’
glossary.ἐννοσίγαι: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon; masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐννοσίγαι’ = ἐννοσίγαιε)
glossary.ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπάειραν: ἐπαείρω — lift onto, raise upon; aor. 3 pl. act., epic ἐπάειραν (= Attic ἐπῆραν): ’they lifted onto’
glossary.ἐπιανδάνει: ἐπιανδάνω — please, be pleasing to (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.: ’it pleases’
glossary.ἐπιλήσονται: ἐπιλανθάνομαι (epic ἐπιλήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’they will forget’
glossary.ἐπινήνεον: ἐπινηνέω — heap upon, pile on; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐπενήνουν): ’they heaped on’
glossary.ἐρίγδουπος: ἐρίγδουπος — loud-crashing, traditionally loud-thundering (ἐρι- intensive; exact sense uncertain), epithet of Zeus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐτειχίσσαντο: τειχίζω — build a wall, fortify; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic double σ (= Attic ἐτειχίσαντο): ’they built for themselves’
glossary.ἐϋσσέλμων: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (of ships); adj., fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic εὔσελμος), agreeing with νηῶν
glossary.ἔδειμαν: δέμω — build, construct; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they built’
glossary.ἔτεχ: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (ἔτεχ’ = ἔτεκε)
glossary.ἕατ: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic ἕατο, elided (ἕατ’ = ἕατο, Attic ἧντο): ’were sitting’
glossary.ἕτεροι: ἕτερος — the other, the other of two, a second party; masc. nom. pl.: ’others’
glossary.ἠγάγετο: ἄγω — lead, bring; mid. take with oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’brought with him’
glossary.ἠνώγει: ἄνωγα (old perf. with pres. force) — bid, command; plpf. 3 sg. with past force, augmented (beside ἀνώγει), + inf.: ’bade’
glossary.ἠνώγεον: ἄνωγα (old perf. with pres. force) — bid, command; plpf. 3 pl. with past force, augmented and uncontracted (= ἠνώγεσαν), + inf.: ’they bade’
glossary.ἠπύτα: ἠπύτα — loud-voiced (of a herald, from ἠπύω ’call aloud’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form (= -ης)
glossary.ἠϊόνα: ἠϊών — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἤντεον: ἀντάω — meet, encounter; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἤντων), + dat.: ’they met’
glossary.ἥρῳ: ἥρως — hero, noble warrior (title of honour); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἰήσονι: Ἰήσων — Jason, leader of the Argonauts; masc. dat. sg., after ὑπό
glossary.ἰδαῖον: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, herald of Priam; masc. acc. sg., object of προσέφη
glossary.ἰησονίδης: Ἰησονίδης — son of Jason; patronymic, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴστω: οἶδα — know; perf. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him know’ (calling a god to witness)
glossary.ὀτρύνοντο: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass.: ’were urged on, bestirred themselves’
glossary.ὁπλίζοντο: ὁπλίζω — make ready, equip; mid. arm oneself, get ready; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’were making ready’
glossary.ὁράᾳς: ὁράω — see; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρᾷς)
glossary.ὄρυξαν: ὀρύσσω — dig; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ὤρυξαν): ’they dug’
glossary.ὅσ: ὅσος — as much/many as; relative correlative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσ’ = ὅσα)
glossary.ὑποκρίνονται: ὑποκρίνομαι — answer, reply; pres. 3 pl. mid./dep.: ’they answer’
glossary.ὑψηλούς: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; adj., masc. acc. pl., agreeing with πύργους
glossary.ὑψιπύλη: Ὑψιπύλη — Hypsipyle, queen of Lemnos, mother of Euneus; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η
glossary.ὕδατι: ὕδωρ — water; neut. dat. sg., of means
glossary.ὤφελλ: ὀφέλλω (ὀφείλω) — owe, be bound; in an unfulfilled wish ’ought’; impf. 3 sg., elided (ὤφελλ’ = ὤφελλε), with ὡς: ’would that’
glossary.ῥινοῖς: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. pl., of payment: ’with hides’
glossary.αἰνεῖτ: αἰνέω — approve, agree to, praise; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (αἰνεῖτ’ = αἰνεῖτε): ’approve!’
glossary.αἴσιμον: αἴσιμος — fated, due, fitting; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg., attributive: ’fated’ (αἴσιμον ἦμαρ ’the fated day’) · also predicate with an infinitive: ’it was fated’
glossary.βάθιστον: βαθύς — deep; superl. βάθιστος, epic (= Attic βαθύτατος), neut. nom. sg.: ’deepest’
glossary.βέλε: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. nom. pl., elided and uncontracted (βέλε’ = βέλεα; Attic βέλη)
glossary.βέρεθρον: βέρεθρον — pit, abyss, chasm (Attic βάραθρον); neut. nom. sg.
glossary.γάργαρον: Γάργαρον — Gargarus, a peak of Mount Ida; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to Ἴδην
glossary.γέντο: γέντο — took, grasped (= ἕλετο); defective aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, epic, with no present in use
glossary.γνώσετ: γιγνώσκω — know, come to know; fut. 2 pl. act., elided (γνώσετ’ = γνώσετε; Attic γνώσεσθε): ’you will know’
glossary.δαιόμενον: δαίω — kindle; mid./pass. blaze, burn; pres. part. mid./pass. neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σέλας: ’blazing’
glossary.δησαίμην: δέω — bind, tie; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’I would tie (for myself)’
glossary.διακέρσαι: διακείρω — cut through, cut across; aor. inf. act. (epic διακέρσαι), complementary to πειράτω: ’to cut across’, of a word, ’to thwart’
glossary.δῦ: δύω — go into, sink, enter; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἔδυ): ’sank in’
glossary.εἰμὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg. (grave, mid-clause form): ’I am’ · also with περί in tmesis (περί … εἰμί ’surpass’) + gen.: ’I surpass’
glossary.εἴδετε: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 pl., short-vowel epic (εἴδετε = Attic εἰδῆτε), after ἵνα: ’that you may know’
glossary.εἴμ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., elided (εἴμ’ = εἰμί): ’I am’ · also with περί in tmesis (περί … εἴμ’ ’surpass’) + gen.: ’I surpass’
glossary.θάμβησαν: θαμβέω — marvel, be amazed; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.θέαιναι: θέαινα — goddess; fem. nom. pl., epic by-form of θεά
glossary.θήλεια: θῆλυς — female; fem. nom. sg. θήλεια, agreeing with θεός (a goddess): ’female’
glossary.θαλάσσῃ: θάλασσα — sea; fem. dat. sg. (Attic θαλάττῃ)
glossary.θηρῶν: θήρ — wild beast; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.θυήεις: θυήεις — fragrant with incense, incense-burning (θύος ’offering’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάμοιτε: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; aor. opt. 2 pl., in a concessive condition after οὐδ’ εἰ: ’even if you toiled’
glossary.κάρτιστος: κράτιστος — strongest, mightiest; superl. of κρατύς, epic κάρτιστος, masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’the strongest’
glossary.καίριόν: καίριος — vital, deadly (of the spot where a wound kills); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’deadly’
glossary.κομόωντε: κομάω — wear the hair long, have a flowing mane; pres. part. masc. dual nom./acc., epic uncontracted (= Attic κομῶντε): ’with long manes’
glossary.κορυφήν: κορυφή — peak, summit, top; crown of the head; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κρανίῳ: κρανίον — skull; neut. dat. sg.: ’in the skull’
glossary.κρατερῶς: κρατερῶς — mightily, strongly, forcefully; adv. from κρατερός
glossary.κρειόντων: κρείων — ruling, lord; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’among those who rule’
glossary.κρεμάσαντες: κρεμάννυμι — hang up, suspend; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having hung’
glossary.κροκόπεπλος: κροκόπεπλος — saffron-robed (κρόκος ’saffron’ + πέπλος ’robe’), epithet of Dawn; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κυλινδόμενος: κυλίνδομαι — roll about, wallow; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κὰκ: κατά (apocope κὰκ before κ-) — down; prep. + acc. of the place struck: ’down on, on’ (κὰκ κορυφήν ’on the crown’) · also + gen., ’down from’
glossary.κῆρε: κήρ — death-spirit, doom of death; fem. acc. dual (epic κῆρε = κῆρας): ’two death-spirits’ (a different word from κῆρ ’heart’)
glossary.λαβών: λαμβάνω — take, seize, take hold of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
glossary.λύσας: λύω — loose, unyoke; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having loosed, having unyoked’
glossary.μέσσα: μέσος (epic μέσσος) — middle; neut. acc. pl., epic -σσ-, of the part taken hold of: ’by the middle’
glossary.μήτέ: μήτε — and not, nor; correlative negative conj., μήτε … μήτε ’neither … nor’ with a command; accented before the enclitic τις
glossary.μίμνειν: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain, hold one’s ground; pres. inf., epic (= Attic μένειν)
glossary.μενέτην: μένω — stay, remain, stand firm; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐμενέτην): ’the two stood their ground’
glossary.μετήορα: μετέωρος (epic μετήορος) — raised up, hanging in mid-air; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’hanging in mid-air’
glossary.οὐρανός: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὖρος: οὖρος — warden, guardian, watcher (related to ὁράω ’see, watch’; not οὖρος ’fair wind’); masc. nom. sg., in apposition: ’warden’
glossary.πάντές: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πήξῃ: πήγνυμι — fix, plant; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after μή ’lest’: ’lest someone fix’
glossary.παρηορίας: παρηορίη (Attic παρηορία) — the traces of the outer trace-horse, harness straps; fem. acc. pl. (usually plural): ’the traces’
glossary.παυρότεροι: παῦρος — few, little; comparative παυρότερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’fewer, scantier in number’
glossary.πειράτω: πειράω — try, attempt (+ inf.); pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him try’ · also + gen., ’make trial of’ (μή μευ πειράτω ’let him not make trial of me’)
glossary.πειρήσασθε: πειράω — try, test, make trial of (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’make trial!’
glossary.περί: περί — around, about; adv. ’exceedingly, beyond others’ · also in tmesis with εἰμί + gen. (περί … εἰμί ’surpass’): ’be above, surpass’
glossary.πληγεὶς: πλήσσω — strike; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’struck, smitten’
glossary.πολυπίδακα: πολυπίδαξ — of many springs (πολύς + πίδαξ ’spring’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., epithet of Ida
glossary.πρόφρονι: πρόφρων — eager, ready-minded, willing; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with θυμῷ: ’ready’
glossary.πρῶται: πρῶτος — first; fem. nom. pl.: ’the first (hairs)’
glossary.πᾶσαί: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.σέλας: σέλας — light, gleam, flash; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.σειρὴν: σειρά — cord, rope; fem. acc. sg., epic -ήν (Ionic η for α)
glossary.σιδήρειαί: σιδήρειος — of iron (= Attic σιδηροῦς); fem. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τάλαντα: τάλαντον — scales, balance (also a weight, a talent); neut. acc. pl., the plural for a pair of scales · also neut. acc. pl., talents, a weight of gold: ’talents’
glossary.τάρταρον: Τάρταρος — Tartarus, the pit beneath the earth and Hades; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τανηλεγέος: τανηλεγής — meaning unknown (traditionally ’laying at full length’ or ’bringing long sorrow’), epithet of death; gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.τελευτήσω: τελευτάω — bring to pass, accomplish; aor. subj. 1 sg. (same spelling as the fut.), in a purpose clause: ’that I may accomplish’
glossary.τεοῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic τεοῖο (= Attic σοῦ), with a participle: ’you being (angry)’
glossary.τερπικέραυνος: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τιτύσκετο: τιτύσκομαι — make ready, prepare, fit out; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (poetic verb, no Attic present): ’was making ready’
glossary.τρίχες: θρίξ — hair; fem. nom. pl. (stem τριχ-)
glossary.τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., also + gen.: ’far from’
glossary.φεύγοντι: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to one fleeing, as you flee’
glossary.φορέοντες: φορέω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φοροῦντες): ’carrying’
glossary.χαλκόποδ: χαλκόπους — bronze-footed, bronze-hoofed; masc. acc. dual, elided (χαλκόποδ’ = χαλκόποδε), agreeing with ἵππω
glossary.χθονός: χθών — earth, ground; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.χρειοῖ: χρειώ (Attic χρεώ) — need, necessity; fem. dat. sg., epic χρειοῖ, dative of cause: ’by need’
glossary.χροΐ: χρώς — skin, body; masc. dat. sg., epic χροΐ (= Attic χρωτί)
glossary.χρυσέῃσιν: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έῃσιν (= Attic χρυσαῖς), agreeing with ἐθείρῃσιν
glossary.ἀΐδεω: Ἀΐδης (Ἅιδης) — Hades, the god and his realm; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (Attic Ἅιδου)
glossary.ἀΐσσων: ἀΐσσω (Attic ᾄσσω) — dart, rush, dash; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’darting’
glossary.ἀέξετο: ἀέξω — make grow, increase; pass. grow; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠέξετο): ’was growing’
glossary.ἀγόρευσεν: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευσε), ν-movable: ’declared’
glossary.ἀμφιβεβήκει: ἀμφιβαίνω — go about, bestride, stand astride; plpf. 3 sg., unaugmented (Attic ἀμφεβεβήκει): ’had bestridden, had reached’
glossary.ἀνέπαλτο: ἀναπάλλομαι — leap up, spring up (πάλλω ’swing, shake’); syncopated aor. 3 sg. mid., ἀνέπαλτο: ’leapt up’
glossary.ἀναπλήσαντες: ἀναπίμπλημι — fill up, fill full; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having filled up’
glossary.ἀπέταμνε: ἀποτέμνω (epic ἀποτάμνω) — cut off, cut away; impf. 3 sg., epic stem ταμν- (Attic ἀπέτεμνε): ’was cutting off’
glossary.ἀπώσομεν: ἀπωθέω — push away, drive off; aor. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel (= Attic ἀπώσωμεν), in a purpose clause: ’that we may drive away’ · also fut. indic. (same spelling)
glossary.ἀρηγέμεν: ἀρήγω — help, aid (+ dat.); pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀρήγειν): ’to help’
glossary.ἀφεξόμεθ: ἀπέχω — hold off; mid. keep away from (+ gen.); fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἀφεξόμεθ’ = ἀφεξόμεθα): ’we will keep away from’
glossary.ἄερθεν: ἀείρω — lift, raise; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic (ἄερθεν = Attic ἤρθησαν): ’were lifted up’
glossary.ἄκουον: ἀκούω — hear, listen; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἤκουον): ’listened’
glossary.ἄρσην: ἄρσην (Attic ἄρρην) — male; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with θεός understood: ’male’
glossary.ἐβόησεν: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’shouted’
glossary.ἐθείρῃσιν: ἔθειρα — hair, mane (of horses); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἐθείραις)
glossary.ἐκίδνατο: κίδναμαι — spread, spread abroad (poetic by-form of σκίδναμαι); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was spreading’
glossary.ἐμπεφύασι: ἐμφύω — implant; perf. intrans. grow in, grow on; perf. 3 pl., epic ἐμπεφύασι (= Attic ἐμπεφύκασι): ’have grown in’
glossary.ἐξάπτεσθε: ἐξάπτω — fasten to, hang from; mid. fasten oneself to; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’fasten yourselves to it’
glossary.ἐπεβήσετο: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot upon, mount (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg., epic -σετο (= Attic ἐπέβη): ’mounted’
glossary.ἐπιεικτόν: ἐπιεικτός — yielding, giving way; neut. nom. sg., with οὐκ: ’unyielding’
glossary.ἐποτρύνων: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, spur on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐρύσαιμ: ἐρύω (epic, = Attic ἕλκω) — drag, pull, draw; aor. opt. 1 sg., elided (ἐρύσαιμ’ = ἐρύσαιμι), potential with κεν: ’I would drag’
glossary.ἐρύσαιτ: ἐρύω (epic, = Attic ἕλκω) — drag, pull, draw; aor. opt. 2 pl., elided (ἐρύσαιτ’ = ἐρύσαιτε), potential with ἄν: ’you could drag’
glossary.ἐρύσσαι: ἐρύω (epic, = Attic ἕλκω) — drag, pull, draw; aor. inf. act., epic doubled σ (ἐρύσσαι = ἐρύσαι): ’to pull’
glossary.ἐτάραξε: ταράσσω — stir up, trouble, throw into confusion; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐτίθει: τίθημι — put, place; impf. 3 sg.; in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … ἐτίθει = ἐνετίθει): ’put in’
glossary.ἐτίταινε: τιταίνω — stretch, draw out, hold out; impf. 3 sg., epic (Attic τείνω): ’was holding out’
glossary.ἐτείρετο: τείρω — wear down, distress, harass; impf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was being worn down’
glossary.ἑκών: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own free will; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔδυνε: δύνω (by-form of δύω) — put on, enter; impf. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’put on’
glossary.ἔκτυπε: κτυπέω — crash, resound, thunder; aor. 3 sg., strong aorist: ’thundered’
glossary.ἔμιμνε: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔμενε): ’remained’
glossary.ἔνερθ: ἔνερθε(ν) — beneath, below; adv./prep. + gen., elided (ἔνερθ’ = ἔνερθε): ’beneath’
glossary.ἔχευεν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., epic ἔχευα (Attic ἔχεα), ν-movable; in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἔχευεν = κατέχευεν): ’poured down’
glossary.ἠερόεντα: ἠερόεις — misty, murky, dim (ἠήρ ’mist’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Τάρταρον
glossary.ἡμέτερε: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἤπιος: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἥπτετο: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of, reach; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’took hold, reached its mark’, of missiles
glossary.ἰωχμὸν: ἰωχμός — press of battle, onset (from διώκω ’pursue’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱμάσθλην: ἱμάσθλη — whip, lash; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴδην: Ἴδη — Mount Ida, near Troy; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἵπποιο: ἵππος — horse; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ὀδυσσαμένοιο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry, be wroth; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with a gen. pronoun: ’you being angry’
glossary.ὀλοφυρόμεθ: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, grieve for (+ gen.); pres. 1 pl. mid. dep., elided (ὀλοφυρόμεθ’ = ὀλοφυρόμεθα): ’we grieve for’
glossary.ὄλεσσεν: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin, lose; aor. 3 sg. act., doubled σ, unaugmented (= Attic ὤλεσε), ν-movable: ’lost’
glossary.ὄλωνται: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., short-vowel (Attic ἀπόλωνται): ’may perish’; with κεν, ’shall perish’
glossary.ὑποθησόμεθ: ὑποτίθημι — put under; mid. suggest, propose; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (ὑποθησόμεθ’ = ὑποθησόμεθα), + dat.: ’we will suggest’
glossary.ὕπατε: ὕπατος — highest, supreme; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὠκυπέτα: ὠκυπέτης — swift-flying (ὠκύς + πέτομαι ’fly’); masc. acc. dual, agreeing with ἵππω
glossary.ῥέπε: ῥέπω — sink, incline downward (of a scale-pan); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρρεπε): ’sank’
glossary.ῥίον: ῥίον — crag, headland, jutting peak; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ῥίψω: ῥίπτω — hurl, throw; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall hurl’
glossary.αἴθων: Αἴθων — Aethon, name of one of Hector’s horses (αἴθων ’blazing, tawny’); masc. voc. sg. (same as the nom.), in address
glossary.αὐτονυχὶ: αὐτονυχί — that very night, in the night itself; adv. (αὐτός + νύξ, with locatival -ι)
glossary.βάλες: βάλλω — throw, strike; aor. 2 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔβαλες): ’you struck down, laid low’
glossary.βέλεα: βέλος — missile, shaft; neut. nom./acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic βέλη)
glossary.βήτην: βαίνω — step, go; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐβήτην): ’the two went, stepped’
glossary.βραδέες: βραδύς — slow, sluggish; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic βραδεῖς)
glossary.βροντήσας: βροντάω — thunder; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having thundered’
glossary.γένωμαι: γίγνομαι — become, come to be, arrive; aor. subj. mid. 1 sg.: ’I may come to be, I may arrive’
glossary.γενέσθω: γίγνομαι — become, come to pass; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’let it come to pass, let there be’
glossary.γιγνώσκεις: γιγνώσκω — come to know, perceive, recognise; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you know, you see’
glossary.γλήνη: γλήνη — doll, puppet (also the pupil of the eye); sense in abuse uncertain; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δαίμονα: δαίμων — divine power, allotted divinity, fortune; masc. acc. sg., object of δώσω
glossary.δαιδάλεον: δαιδάλεος — cunningly wrought, of skilled work; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θώρηκα
