glossary.δαναοῖσί: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.δευέσθην: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); impf. 3 dual mid./dep., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδεύεσθην): ’the two lacked’
glossary.δώσω: δίδωμι — give; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will give’
glossary.δῖε: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.εἰρύσσαιτο: ἐρύομαι (εἰρύομαι) — ward off, hold back, guard; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., epic εἰρ-, -σσ- (= Attic ἐρύσαιτο), potential with κεν: ’could ward off’
glossary.εἴασε: ἐάω — let, allow, leave alone; aor. 3 sg. act. (augment εἰ-): ’let (him lie), left’
glossary.εἴξαντος: εἴκω — yield, give way; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute with ἐμεῖο: ’(I) having yielded’
glossary.θαλεροὺς: θαλερός — flourishing, in bloom, lusty; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with παρακοίτας
glossary.θεείου: θέειον (θεῖον) — sulphur; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic θείου), dependent on φλόξ: ’of sulphur’
glossary.θηβαίου: Θηβαῖος — Thebaeus, a Trojan, father of Eniopeus (the name = ’Theban’, of Thebes); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θρασύν: θρασύς — bold, daring, confident; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἡνίοχον or Ἀρχεπτόλεμον
glossary.καιομένοιο: καίω — burn; pres. part. mid./pass. neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with θεείου: ’burning’
glossary.κανόνας: κανών — straight rod, bar; on a shield, rods or bars of uncertain use (handles or cross-bars); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.καπνοῦ: καπνός — smoke; masc. gen. sg., of cause after ὑπό: ’from the smoke’
glossary.κατένευσε: κατανεύω — nod assent, grant by a nod; aor. 3 sg. act., augment inside the compound (κατ-έ-νευσε): ’nodded assent’
glossary.καταπτήτην: καταπτήσσω — cower down, crouch in fear; aor. 3 dual act., unaugmented (= Attic κατεπτήτην): ’the two cowered’
glossary.κομείτην: κομέω — tend, take care of; impf. 3 dual act., unaugmented: ’the two tended’
glossary.κομείτων: κομέω — tend, take care of; pres. imper. 3 dual act.: ’let the two tend’
glossary.κομιδὴν: κομιδή — care, tending, provision; fem. acc. sg., object of ἀποτίνετον: ’the care’
glossary.κρέασίν: κρέας — flesh, meat; neut. dat. pl., epic -ασιν (= Attic -ασι), of means: ’with meats’
glossary.κτείνω: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. subj. 1 sg. act., in a purpose clause after ὡς: ’so that I may kill’
glossary.κτύπε: κτυπέω — crash, thunder; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔκτυπε): ’thundered’
glossary.λάβ: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented and elided (λάβ’ = λάβε, Attic ἔλαβε): ’took’
glossary.λάβωμεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize, capture; aor. subj. 1 pl. act., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that we may take’
glossary.λάμπέ: Λάμπος — Lampus (’Shiner’), name of one of Hector’s horses; masc. voc. sg. Λάμπε, accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.λέλυται: λύω — loose, undo, slacken; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been loosed, is slackened’
glossary.λοιγὸς: λοιγός — ruin, destruction, deadly harm; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μαζόν: μαζός — breast, nipple; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μαχηταί: μαχητής — fighter, warrior; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μεμαῶτος: μέμονα — be eager, strive, charge; perf. part. masc. gen. sg. (μεμαώς), epic, with present sense: ’eager, charging’
glossary.μηχανόωντο: μηχανάομαι — devise, contrive; impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμηχανῶντο), unaugmented
glossary.μνημοσύνη: μνημοσύνη — remembrance, memorial, reminder; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νήπιοι: νήπιος — childish, foolish, witless; masc. nom. pl., in exclamation: ’fools!’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition to the subject: ’foolish ones’
glossary.νεστορέας: Νεστόρειος — of Nestor, Nestor’s; adj. masc. acc. pl., epic -έας (= Attic -είους), agreeing with ἵππους
glossary.νεστορέην: Νεστόρειος — of Nestor, Nestor’s; adj. fem. acc. sg., Ionic -έην (= Attic -είαν), agreeing with ἀσπίδα
glossary.νηληϊάδαο: Νηληϊάδης — son of Neleus (patronymic, of Nestor); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ξάνθέ: Ξάνθος — Xanthus (’Chestnut’), name of one of Hector’s horses; masc. voc. sg. Ξάνθε, accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.οἶνόν: οἶνος — wine; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.οὐδενόσωρα: οὐδενόσωρος — worthless, of no account (οὐδέν + a second element ’care, heed’; formation uncertain); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τείχεα
glossary.παρακοίτας: παρακοίτης — husband, one who lies beside; masc. acc. pl., object of βάλες
glossary.πείσονται: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, believe, heed; fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’will believe, will heed’
glossary.πιεῖν: πίνω — drink; aor. inf. act.: ’to drink’
glossary.πλείοις: πλεῖος — full; adj. neut. dat. pl., agreeing with δεπάεσσι: ’full’
glossary.πολλὴν: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κομιδήν: ’great’
glossary.πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.προτέροισι: πρότερος — earlier, before, first (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with ὑμῖν: ’the earlier ones’
glossary.πόδαργε: Πόδαργος — Podargus (’Swift-foot’ or ’White-foot’), name of one of Hector’s horses; masc. voc. sg. Πόδαργε
glossary.πύκασε: πυκάζω — cover thickly, wrap about, enshroud; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπύκασε)
glossary.πύργων: πύργος — tower, wall-tower; masc. gen. pl., after ἐπιβήσεαι (+ gen.) · also masc. gen. pl., after ἐπί: ’on the towers’ · also masc. gen. pl., dependent on ὅμαδος and δοῦπος: ’of towers being struck’ · also masc. gen. pl., dependent on δούρατα: ’of the towers’ · also masc. gen. pl., after ἀπό: ’from the towers’
glossary.σήκασθεν: σηκάζω — pen in, shut up in a fold; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -θεν for -θησαν, unaugmented: ’were penned in’
glossary.σημάντορος: σημάντωρ — one who gives orders, commander; masc. gen. sg., after δευέσθην (+ gen.)
glossary.σθένελός: Σθένελος — Sthenelus, son of Capaneus, comrade of Diomedes; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.σπεύδετον: σπεύδω — hasten, press on; pres. imper. 2 dual act.: ’(you two) hasten!’
glossary.στονόεντα: στονόεις — full of groaning, grievous; neut. acc. pl., epic -όεντα, agreeing with βέλεα
glossary.στρέψαι: στρέφω — turn; aor. inf. act.: ’to turn’
glossary.τέτυξο: τεύχω — make; mid./pass. be made, become; perf. 2 sg. mid./pass. τέτυξο, epic: ’you have become’
glossary.τίον: τίω — honour, value; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔτιον): ’they honoured’
glossary.ταχύπωλοι: ταχύπωλος — with swift colts (ταχύς + πῶλος); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τιθεὶς: τίθημι — put, place, set; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’setting, putting’
glossary.τώδε: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); demonstrative pron., dual nom./acc.: ’these two’
glossary.φήσει: φημί — say, speak; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will say, will call’
glossary.φοβεύμενος: φοβέομαι — flee in terror, be put to flight; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg., epic -εύμενος (= Attic φοβούμενος): ’fleeing’
glossary.φύγαδε: φύγαδε — to flight, in flight; adv. (φυγή + -δε, ’toward’)
glossary.χέοντο: χέω — pour; mid. pour forth, stream; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐχέοντο): ’were poured out’
glossary.χαλεπὸν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with γῆρας: ’harsh’
glossary.ἀβλήχρ: ἀβληχρός — weak, feeble, flimsy; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἀβλήχρ’ = ἀβληχρά), agreeing with τείχεα
glossary.ἀγχιμαχηταὶ: ἀγχιμαχητής — close-fighter, one who fights hand to hand; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address
glossary.ἀμήχανα: ἀμήχανος — impossible to deal with, past remedy; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
glossary.ἀνάλκιδα: ἄναλκις — without strength, unwarlike, cowardly; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σε: ’a coward’
glossary.ἀντὶ: ἀντί — instead of, in place of; prep. + gen., placed after its noun
glossary.ἀπειλήσει: ἀπειλέω — threaten, vaunt; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will vaunt’
glossary.ἀποτίνετον: ἀποτίνω — pay back, repay; pres. imper. 2 dual act.: ’(you two) repay!’
glossary.ἀργῆτα: ἀργής — bright, gleaming, white; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆτα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with κεραυνόν
glossary.ἀρχεπτόλεμον: Ἀρχεπτόλεμος — Archeptolemus, a Trojan, Hector’s new charioteer (’ruler of battle’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτιμήσουσι: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, hold in contempt; fut. 3 pl. act. (ἀτιμήσουσι(ν), ν-movable)
glossary.ἀτυζομένους: ἀτύζομαι — be struck with panic, flee in terror; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. pl., agreeing with Ἀργείους: ’panic-stricken’
glossary.ἀφάμαρτεν: ἀφαμαρτάνω — miss, fail to hit (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἀφήμαρτε), ν-movable: ’missed’
glossary.ἀφῆκ: ἀφίημι — send forth, let go, hurl; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἀφῆκ’ = ἀφῆκε): ’hurled’
glossary.ἄρνες: ἀρήν — lamb, sheep (stem ἀρν-); masc./fem. nom. pl. ἄρνες: ’lambs’
glossary.ἐγκεράσασα: ἐγκεράννυμι — mix in, mix (wine) with water; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having mixed in’
glossary.ἐελποίμην: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid./dep., epic ἐε- (= Attic ἐλποίμην), potential with κεν: ’I would expect’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σι (= Attic ἐθέλῃ), after αἴ κ’: ’if he wishes’ · also in a general relative clause after ἥν κ’: ’whichever he wishes’
glossary.ἐναντίβιον: ἐναντίβιος — face to face, in open opposition; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’face to face’
glossary.ἐνιπρήσω: ἐμπίμπρημι (epic ἐνιπρήθω) — set on fire, burn up; aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short-vowel subj. in a purpose clause after ὡς: ’so that I may burn’
glossary.ἐπέβησε: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon; causative aor. act. set upon, make mount (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’set (him) upon’
glossary.ἐπιβήσεαι: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon, mount, set foot on (+ gen.); fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -σεαι (= Attic ἐπιβήσῃ): ’you will mount’
glossary.ἐπιβησέμεν: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon; causative fut. act. set upon (+ gen.); fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπιβήσειν): ’to set upon’
glossary.ἐρύξει: ἐρύκω — hold back, check, restrain; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will check’
glossary.ἐσάκουσε: ἐσακούω — listen to, give ear to (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic εἰσήκουσε): ’listened’
glossary.ἐφομαρτεῖτον: ἐφομαρτέω — keep pace with, accompany; pres. imper. 2 dual act., contracted: ’(you two) keep pace!’
glossary.ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’)
glossary.ἔρρε: ἔρρω — go away, be gone, go to ruin; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’begone!’
glossary.ἕδρῃ: ἕδρη — seat, place of honour; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with a seat’
glossary.ἕπετ: ἕπομαι — follow, attend, accompany; pres. 3 sg. mid./dep., elided (ἕπετ’ = ἕπεται) · also impf. 3 sg. mid./dep., elided (ἕπετ’ = ἕπετο): ’followed’
glossary.ἠνιοπῆα: Ἠνιοπεύς — Eniopeus (’rein-holder’), a Trojan, Hector’s charioteer; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἠπεδανὸς: ἠπεδανός — weak, feeble, infirm; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with θεράπων
glossary.ἡμετέρων: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. gen. pl., agreeing with πύργων
glossary.ἡνί: ἡνία — reins; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἡνί’ = ἡνία)
glossary.ἡνιόχοιο: ἡνίοχος — charioteer, driver; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἰδαίων: Ἰδαῖος — of Ida, Idaean; adj. gen. pl., agreeing with ὀρέων
glossary.ἰθύνομεν: ἰθύνω — make straight, steer, direct; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., short-vowel subj. (-ομεν for -ωμεν), hortatory: ’let us steer’
glossary.ἰφιτίδην: Ἰφιτίδης — son of Iphitus (patronymic, of Archeptolemus); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰωχμόν: ἰωχμός — onset, press of battle, rout; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴφθιμοι: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout, doughty; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἵκει: ἵκω — come to, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg. act., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
glossary.ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
glossary.ὀρυκτήν: ὀρυκτός — dug; adj. fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τάφρον: ’dug’
glossary.ὑπερθορέονται: ὑπερθρῴσκω — leap over; fut. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὑπερθοροῦνται): ’will leap over’
glossary.ὑπερώησαν: ὑπερωέω — swerve aside, shy (sense uncertain); aor. 3 pl. act., epic, unaugmented
glossary.ὠκυπόδων: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc./fem. gen. pl., epithet of horses
glossary.αἰγὰς: Αἰγαί — Aegae, a town of Achaea with a cult of Poseidon; fem. acc. pl., place name
glossary.αἰετὸν: αἰετός (Attic ἀετός) — eagle; masc. acc. sg., epic
glossary.αἴανθ: Αἴας — Ajax, son of Telamon; masc. acc. sg., elided (Αἴανθ’ = Αἴαντα)
glossary.αὐτοῖσιν: αὐτός — self, very; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς): ’together with the very …’ (αὐτοῖσιν ὄχεσφιν ’chariot and all’) · also masc. dat. pl. plain pronoun after σύν: ’with them’ (σὺν αὐτοῖσιν ’along with them’)
glossary.βεβλήκοι: βάλλω — throw, shoot; hit with a missile; perf. opt. 3 sg. act., epic (Attic βεβληκὼς εἴη), in a past general clause after ἐπεί: ’(whenever) he had hit’
glossary.βούλεο: βούλομαι — wish, want; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic βούλου), + acc.: ’wish (victory)!’
glossary.γένηαι: γίγνομαι — become, be; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic γένῃ), after αἴ κεν: ’you may become’
glossary.γεγωνέμεν: γεγωνέω — call out, make oneself heard; perf. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic γεγωνέναι): ’to be heard’
glossary.γεγωνώς: γεγωνέω — call out, make oneself heard; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., present sense: ’calling aloud’
glossary.γυναῖχ: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg., elided (γυναῖχ’ = γυναῖκα)
glossary.δάμνασθαι: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — subdue, overpower; pres. inf. pass., epic (= Attic δαμάζεσθαι), + acc. after ἔα: ’to be subdued’
glossary.δαίτορά: Δαΐτωρ — Daetor, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.δημὸν: δημός — fat; masc. acc. sg.: ’fat’ (of sacrificial animals)
glossary.διαπρύσιον: διαπρύσιος — piercing, carrying far; adj., neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’piercingly’
glossary.διηκοσίων: διηκόσιοι — two hundred; numeral adj., masc. gen. pl., epic (= Attic διακοσίων): ’of two hundred’
glossary.δύσκεν: δύω (δύνω) — go under, slip into; iterative impf. 3 sg., epic -σκε(ν), unaugmented (= Attic ἔδυ): ’used to slip under’
glossary.εἰμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic εἰμέν (= Attic ἐσμέν): ’we are’
glossary.εἰνὶ: ἐν (epic εἰνί, ἐνί) — in, at, on; prep. + dat.
glossary.εἰσαναβαίνοι: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into, mount; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a relative clause with κεν: ’might go up into (a bed)’
glossary.εἴλει: εἴλω (εἰλέω) — press together, shut in, hem in; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was pressing’
glossary.εἴνατος: ἔνατος (epic εἴνατος) — ninth; ordinal adj., masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’ninth (to come)’
glossary.εἴρυσαν: ἐρύω (εἰρύω) — draw, haul; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented εἴρυσαν (ει- from ἐ-ϝ-; Attic prose ἕλκω, aor. εἵλκυσαν): ’drew up’ (of ships onto the shore)
glossary.εὐχωλαί: εὐχωλή — boast, vow, prayer; fem. nom. pl.: ’boasts’
glossary.εὔξατο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, claim, boast; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’claimed’ (+ inf.: ’claimed to …’)
glossary.θήσω: τίθημι — put, place; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall put’
glossary.θρόνῳ: θρόνος — throne, chair of state; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.θόρον: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (θόρον = ἔθορον): ’leapt’
glossary.θῆκ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (θῆκ’ = θῆκε, = Attic ἔθηκε): ’put’
glossary.κάββαλε: καταβάλλω — throw down, drop; aor. 3 sg., κατά assimilated before β, unaugmented (κάββαλε = κατέβαλε)
glossary.κάρτεϊ: κάρτος — strength, might (= Attic κράτος); neut. dat. sg., epic κάρτεϊ (= κράτει), after πίσυνος: ’(trusting) in might’
glossary.καθήμενος: κάθημαι — sit; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.κενεαυχέες: κενεαυχής — empty-boasting, vainly vaunting; adj., masc. voc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κενεαυχεῖς), in address
glossary.κεφαλή: κεφαλή — head; fem. nom. sg., also used in address (φίλη κεφαλή ’dear head’, a term of affection)
glossary.κηλέῳ: κήλεος — burning, blazing (traditional gloss; exact sense uncertain); adj., neut. dat. sg., epithet of fire: ’blazing’
glossary.κομίσσατο: κομίζω — take care of, carry off; mid. take in, look after; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκομίσατο): ’took care of’
glossary.κρατεροῦ: κρατερός — strong, mighty; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κρύπτασκε: κρύπτω — hide, conceal; iterative impf. 3 sg., epic -ασκε (= Attic ἔκρυπτε): ’used to hide’
glossary.λυκοφόντην: Λυκοφόντης — Lycophontes, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.μεγακήτεϊ: μεγακήτης — huge, vast (of a ship; exact sense uncertain); adj. of two endings, dat. sg. m./f./n., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.μελάνιππον: Μελάνιππος — Melanippus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.μεσσάτῳ: μέσσατος (μέσος) — middlemost, in the middle; adj., masc./neut. dat. sg., epic -σσ-, in ἐν μεσσάτῳ ’in the middle’
glossary.μεταστρεφθέντι: μεταστρέφω — turn about; aor. part. pass. masc. dat. sg., with intransitive sense: ’having turned about’
glossary.οἴνοιο: οἶνος — wine; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πέλασε: πελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπέλασε): ’brought down (to)’
glossary.πίσυνοι: πίσυνος — trusting, relying on (+ dat.); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παλίντονα: παλίντονος — bent back, back-stretched (of a bow; sense uncertain); adj., neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πανομφαίῳ: πανομφαῖος — source of every divine voice or omen (epithet of Zeus); adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παρελθέμεν: παρέρχομαι — go past, pass by; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic παρελθεῖν): ’to have passed by’
glossary.πεσὼν: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (aor. stem πεσ-): ’having fallen’
glossary.πλῆθεν: πλήθω — be full; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπληθε(ν)), + gen.: ’was full of’
glossary.ποιπνύσαντι: ποιπνύω — bustle, hurry about; aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with a dative: ’bustling’
glossary.πολυαιμονίδην: Πολυαιμονίδης — son of Polyaemon; masc. acc. sg., patronymic (of Amopaon)
glossary.ποσειδάωνα: Ποσειδῶν (epic Ποσειδάων) — Poseidon; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.πρεσβήϊον: πρεσβήϊον — prize of honour, privilege of precedence (from πρέσβυς); neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic πρεσβεῖον)
glossary.πύργου: πύργος — tower; wall with towers, rampart; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.σάκεϊ: σάκος — shield; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.σείσατο: σείω — shake; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐσείσατο): ’shook (herself)’
glossary.στήσεσθ: ἵστημι — set; mid. take one’s stand; fut. 2 pl. mid., elided (στήσεσθ’ = στήσεσθε): ’you will take your stand’
glossary.σχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic σχεῖν): ’to hold, to check’
glossary.τάφρος: τάφρος — ditch, trench; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τάφρου: τάφρος — ditch, trench; fem. gen. sg., of separation: ’out of the ditch’ · also fem. gen. sg., after μέσον: ’(midway) between the ditch (and the wall)’
glossary.ταχείης: ταχύς — swift, fleet; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.τελαμωνιάδαο: Τελαμωνιάδης — son of Telamon, i.e. Ajax; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τελειότατον: τέλειος — perfect, unblemished; superl. τελειότατος, masc. acc. sg.: ’most perfect’ (of an eagle, as an omen bird)
glossary.τεῦκρε: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, half-brother of Ajax; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.τηλόθ: τηλόθι (elided τηλόθ’) — far off, at a distance; adv. of place, epic (-θι suffix ’place where’)
glossary.τρίποδ: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg., elided (τρίποδ’ = τρίποδα)
glossary.τῇδ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative adj., fem. dat. sg. τῇδε, elided (τῇδ’): ’with this’
glossary.φάμεν: φημί — say, speak; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἔφαμεν): ’we said’
glossary.φραδμονίδην: Φραδμονίδης — son of Phradmon; masc. acc. sg., patronymic (of Agelaus)
glossary.φύγαδ: φύγαδε (elided φύγαδ’) — to flight, in flight; adv. (φυγή + -δε ’toward’)
glossary.χέοντα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’shedding’
glossary.χερὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. sg., epic χερί (= χειρί)
glossary.ἀγέλαον: Ἀγέλαος — Agelaus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name · also Ἀγέλαος — Agelaus, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ἀκάχοιτο: ἀκαχίζω — distress, grieve; mid. be grieved; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., reduplicated aor., with κε: ’would be grieved’
glossary.ἀλύξαι: ἀλύσκω — flee from, escape, avoid; aor. inf. act., epic: ’to escape’
glossary.ἀμοπάονα: Ἀμοπάων — Amopaon, a Trojan, son of Polyaemon; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ἀμφοτέρωσε: ἀμφοτέρωσε — to both sides, both ways; adv. (-σε suffix ’toward’)
glossary.ἀνάγουσι: ἀνάγω — lead up, bring up; pres. 3 pl. act., ν-movable: ’they bring up’
glossary.ἀπηύρας: ἀπαυράω — take away from, strip (Homeric; Attic ἀφαιρέω); aor. 2 sg. act., augmented (ἀπ-ηύρ-), + double acc.: ’you took away from (him)’
glossary.ἀπτοεπὲς: ἀπτοεπής — reckless of speech, unrestrained in speech (sense uncertain); adj., fem. voc. sg., in address
glossary.ἀπώσασθαι: ἀπωθέω — push away, thrust off; aor. inf. mid.: ’to thrust off’
glossary.ἀρωγοί: ἀρωγός — helper, helping; masc. nom. pl., as a noun: ’helpers’
glossary.ἄασας: ἀάω — bewilder, blind, delude; aor. 2 sg. act., epic (= Attic ἤασας): ’you have bewildered’
glossary.ἄνθ: ἀντί (elided ἄνθ’ before a rough breathing) — against, in exchange for, equal to; prep. + gen.: ’(one) against (a hundred)’
glossary.ἄξιοί: ἄξιος — worth, worthy of (+ gen.); adj., masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic εἰμεν
glossary.ἐλέλιξε: ἐλελίζω — whirl, make shake; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’shook’
glossary.ἐνέπρησεν: ἐμπίπρημι — set on fire, burn; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, with κεν in a past unreal apodosis: ’would have burned’
glossary.ἐνιπρήσει: ἐμπίπρημι — set on fire, burn; fut. 3 sg. act., epic ἐνι- (= Attic ἐμπρήσει): ’will burn’
glossary.ἐξελάσαι: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. inf. act., + gen. of separation: ’to drive out (of)’
glossary.ἐπίβησον: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon; causative aor.: set upon; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., + gen.: ’cause to step upon’
glossary.ἐπασσυτέρους: ἐπασσύτερος — one close upon another, in quick succession; adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐπιστεφέας: ἐπιστεφής — crowned, filled to the brim (of a bowl); adj., masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἐρυκέμεν: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep off; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐρύκειν): ’to hold back’
glossary.ἐϋκλείης: ἐΰκλεια — good repute, glory; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -κλείης (= Attic -κλείας), epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ)
glossary.ἐόντων: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντων): ’being’ (πολλῶν περ ἐόντων ’though they were many’)
glossary.ἑνὸς: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἔασον: ἐάω — allow, let be; aor. imper. 2 sg. (+ acc. and inf.): ’allow’
glossary.ἔεργε: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, enclose; impf. 3 sg., epic ἔεργε (= Attic εἶργε): ’enclosed’
glossary.ἔρρων: ἔρρω — go wretchedly, go to one’s hurt; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’coming wretchedly’
glossary.ἔσθοντες: ἔσθω (ἐσθίω) — eat; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic: ’eating’
glossary.ἔσχατα: ἔσχατος — farthest, outermost; neut. acc. pl. used as an adverb: ’at the farthest end’
glossary.ἠγοράασθε: ἀγοράομαι — speak in assembly, declare, boast; impf. 2 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἠγορᾶσθε): ’you declared’
glossary.ἠνορέῃ: ἠνορέη — manliness, courage; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ἀνδρεία)
glossary.ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
glossary.ἤϋσεν: ἀΰω (= αὔω) — shout, call out; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, ν-movable: ’shouted’
glossary.ἱέμενος: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. be eager, long (+ inf.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’longing’
glossary.ὀλέκοντα: ὀλέκω — destroy, kill; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’destroying’
glossary.ὀλοφύρατο: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, grieve for, feel compassion for; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ὀλοφύρεται: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, grieve, feel pity; pres. 3 sg.: ’grieves’
glossary.ὀνύχεσσι: ὄνυξ — claw, talon; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -ξι)
glossary.ὀρθοκραιράων: ὀρθόκραιρα — straight-horned; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with βοῶν
glossary.ὀρσίλοχον: Ὀρσίλοχος — Orsilochus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ὀτρῦναι: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; aor. inf. act., after ἐπὶ φρεσὶ θῆκε: ’to urge on’
glossary.ὀφελέστην: Ὀφελέστης — Ophelestes, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ὁμὸν: ὁμός — same, common; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’the same’
glossary.ὁπότ: ὁπότε (elided ὁπότ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj.
glossary.ὄρμενον: Ὄρμενος — Ormenus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ὑπεκφυγέειν: ὑπεκφεύγω — flee from under, escape; aor. inf., epic -έειν (= Attic ὑπεκφυγεῖν)
glossary.ὑπερμενέων: ὑπερμενής — of exceeding might, overweening; adj., masc. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ῥέζεσκον: ῥέζω — do, perform; sacrifice; iterative impf. 3 pl., epic -σκον (= Attic ἔδρων): ’used to sacrifice’
glossary.αἰπὰ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ῥέεθρα: ’steep’
glossary.αἰσύμηθεν: Αἰσύμη — Aisyme, a town in Thrace; place name with the suffix -θεν ’from’: ’from Aisyme’
glossary.αὐερύοντα: ἀνερύω — draw back, pull back; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic αὐ- (= Attic ἀνερύοντα): ’drawing back’
glossary.βαρέα: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; adj., neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’heavily’
glossary.βαρυνθέν: βαρύνω — weigh down, burden; aor. pass. part. neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with κάρη: ’weighed down’
glossary.βλεμεαίνων: βλεμεαίνω — exult, swell with pride (sense traditional, not certain); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’exulting’
glossary.βριθομένη: βρίθω — be heavy, be laden; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’weighed down (with fruit)’
glossary.βροτολοιγοῦ: βροτολοιγός — man-destroying, ruinous to mortals (βροτός ’mortal’ + λοιγός ’ruin’); adj., masc. gen. sg., epithet of Ares
glossary.γενείου: γένειον — chin; neut. gen. sg., after a verb of taking hold (+ gen.): ’of the chin’
glossary.γηθήσει: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will rejoice’
glossary.γλαυκώπιδα: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain), epithet of Athena; fem. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’the gleaming-eyed one’
glossary.γοργοῦς: Γοργώ — the Gorgon; fem. gen. sg. (nom. Γοργώ): ’of the Gorgon’
glossary.γοργυθίωνα: Γοργυθίων — Gorgythion, a son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δάμεν: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐδάμησαν): ’were subdued’, i.e. slain
glossary.δημῷ: δημός — fat; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with fat’
glossary.διά: διά — through; prep. + acc.: ’through’ · also preverb in tmesis (διὰ … ῥήξασθαι = διαρρήξασθαι ’break through’)
glossary.δοκεύει: δοκεύω — watch for, watch closely; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’watches’
glossary.δύναμίς: δύναμις — power, strength; fem. nom. sg., extra accent on the last syllable before the enclitic γε
glossary.εἰαρινῇσιν: εἰαρινός — of spring, springlike (Attic ἐαρινός); adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς): ’of spring’
glossary.εὐρυσθῆος: Εὐρυσθεύς — Eurystheus, king of Mycenae; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic Εὐρυσθέως)
glossary.εὐχετόωντο: εὐχετάομαι — pray, vow, boast (by-form of εὔχομαι); impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic diectasis (= Attic εὐχετῶντο): ’they prayed’
glossary.θεῇσι: θεά — goddess; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic θεαῖς), after ἐϊκυῖα ’like’: ’like goddesses’
glossary.θόρε: θρῴσκω — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔθορε): ’leapt’
glossary.καλὴ: καλός — beautiful, fair; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καστιάνειρα: Καστιάνειρα — Castianeira, mother of Gorgythion; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καταδῦσα: καταδύω — go down into, enter; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (intransitive root aorist ἔδυν): ’having gone down into’
glossary.κατόπισθε: κατόπισθε(ν) — behind, from behind; adv., epic (= Attic ὄπισθεν): ’from behind’
glossary.κεβριόνην: Κεβριόνης — Cebriones, a Trojan, Hector’s brother; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεκαδησόμεθ: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned for (+ gen.); reduplicated fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (κεκαδησόμεθ’ = κεκαδησόμεθα): ’we shall care for’
glossary.κεκλόμενοι: κέλομαι — call to, urge, command; reduplicated aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’calling to’
glossary.κλαίεσκε: κλαίω — weep, wail; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -εσκε, unaugmented (Attic ἔκλαιε): ’he would weep’
glossary.κληῒς: κληΐς — collarbone; fem. nom. sg. (Attic κλείς)
glossary.κορέει: κορέννυμι — sate, glut; fut. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic κορεῖ): ’will sate’
glossary.κύνα: κύων — dog; masc./fem. acc. sg. (common gender)
glossary.κύων: κύων — dog; masc./fem. nom. sg. (common gender)
glossary.λίθῳ: λίθος — stone; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with a stone’
glossary.λυσσητῆρα: λυσσητήρ — raging, frenzied (agent noun from λυσσάω ’rage’); masc. acc. sg., in apposition: ’frenzied’
glossary.μέμνηται: μιμνήσκομαι — remind; mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. 3 sg. mid., present force: ’remembers’
glossary.μενέων: μένος — might, force; neut. gen. pl., uncontracted (= Attic μενῶν): ’of … might’
glossary.μηκιστεὺς: Μηκιστεύς — Mecisteus, a Greek warrior, son of Echius; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νάρκησε: ναρκάω — grow numb; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐνάρκησε): ’was numbed’
glossary.νευρήν: νευρή — bowstring; fem. acc. sg., Ionic-epic (= Attic νευρά)
glossary.νευρῆφιν: νευρή — bowstring, string; fem. sg. with epic ending -φιν, ablatival or locative sense: ’from the string’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν)
glossary.νοτίῃσί: νοτίη — moisture, dampness; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), accent before the enclitic τε: ’with moisture’
glossary.νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
glossary.οἰωνοὺς: οἰωνός — bird, bird of prey; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οὐρανόν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οὑμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; possessive adj., masc. nom. sg., crasis with the article (ὁ ἐμός = οὑμός): ’my’
glossary.πάρεστι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. 3 sg. (παρά + ἐστι): ’is at hand’
glossary.πήληκι: πήληξ — helmet; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the helmet’
glossary.παμφανόωντος: παμφανάω — shine all over, gleam (παν- + φαίνω); pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic diectasis (= Attic παμφανῶντος): ’all-gleaming’
glossary.παρέσφηλεν: παρασφάλλω — trip aside, throw off course (παρά + σφάλλω); aor. 3 sg. act., augment after the prefix: ’threw off course’
glossary.παύομαι: παύω — stop, cease; mid. pres. 1 sg.: ’I cease’
glossary.περίβη: περιβαίνω — go round, stand over to guard; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augment dropped and accent thrown back (= περιέβη): ’strode about’
glossary.πευκαλίμῃσιν: πευκάλιμος — keen, sharp (sense traditional, not certain); adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), with φρεσί: ’keen’
glossary.ποσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.προΐαλλεν: προϊάλλω — send forth, hurl forth (πρό + ἰάλλω); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable: ’sent forth’
glossary.προέηκα: προΐημι — send forth, shoot; aor. 1 sg. act., epic προέηκα (= Attic προῆκα): ’I sent forth’
glossary.προφανέντε: προφαίνομαι — show oneself, appear; aor. pass. part. dual masc. nom./acc.: ’we two appearing’
glossary.προὔπεμψεν: προπέμπω — send forth; aor. 3 sg., crasis of πρό + ἔπεμψεν (= Attic προὔπεμψε), ν-movable: ’sent forth’
glossary.πτολίπορθον: πτολίπορθος — city-sacker (πτόλις = Attic πόλις + πέρθω ’sack’); adj., masc. acc. sg., epithet of a hero: ’sacker of cities’
glossary.πυλάρταο: πυλάρτης — gate-fastener, gate-closer (epithet of Hades); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πῆχθεν: πήγνυμι — fix, fasten; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented, -εν for -ησαν: ’were fixed’
glossary.σάρκεσσι: σάρξ — flesh; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic σαρξί)
glossary.σθένεϊ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic σθένει): ’in strength’
glossary.στενάχοντα: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’groaning’
glossary.στυγέει: στυγέω — hate, loathe; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic στυγεῖ): ’hates’
glossary.στῆθός: στῆθος — chest, breast; neut. acc. sg., extra accent on the last syllable before the enclitic τε
glossary.συὸς: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig, boar, sow; masc./fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σώεσκον: σώω (σῴζω) — save, keep safe; iterative impf. 1 sg. in -εσκον, unaugmented (Attic ἔσῳζον): ’I used to save’
glossary.τάφροιο: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after ἰθύς: ’straight at the ditch’ · also gen. of the way traversed: ’across the ditch’ (τάφροιο διήλασε ’drove across the ditch’)
glossary.τανυγλώχινας: τανυγλώχιν — long-barbed (τανυ- ’long’ + γλωχίς ’barb’); adj., masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ὀϊστούς
glossary.ταχέεσσι: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic ταχέσι)
glossary.τεύκρου: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, Greek archer; masc. gen. sg., after ἰθύς: ’straight at Teucer’ · also masc. gen. sg., possessive: ’Teucer’s’ (Τεύκρου … τόξα ’Teucer’s bow’)
glossary.τιμῆσαι: τιμάω — honour; aor. inf. act.: ’to honour’
glossary.φερέτην: φέρω — bear, carry; impf. 3 dual act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφερέτην): ’the two were bearing’
glossary.φεύγοντες: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’fleeing’
glossary.φθίμενος: φθίνω — perish, waste away; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’perishing, having perished’
glossary.ἀέθλων: ἄεθλον (ἄεθλος) — trial, labour, contest (Attic ἄθλον); gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἄθλων)
glossary.ἀγαθῇσι: ἀγαθός — good; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.ἀλάστωρ: Ἀλάστωρ — Alastor, a Greek warrior; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλιτρός: ἀλιτρός — sinner, offender (built on the root of ἀλιταίνω ’sin against’); masc. nom. sg., in apposition: ’sinful’
glossary.ἀλλήλοισί: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), accent before the enclitic τε: ’to one another’
glossary.ἀμέλησε: ἀμελέω — neglect, take no care of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’neglected’
glossary.ἀμφιπεριστρώφα: ἀμφιπεριστρωφάω — wheel round about (ἀμφί + περί + στρωφάω ’turn’); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἀμφιπεριεστρώφα): ’wheeled round’
glossary.ἀνίσχοντες: ἀνίσχω — hold up, lift up (= Attic ἀνέχω); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’lifting up’
glossary.ἀντικρύ: ἀντικρύ — straight against, right at (Attic ἄντικρυς); adv., or prep. + gen.: ’straight at’
glossary.ἀπερωεύς: ἀπερωεύς — one who thrusts away or hinders (meaning uncertain, inferred from the context); masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’thwarter’
glossary.ἀποέργει: ἀπείργω — ward off, keep off; keep apart; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted by-form ἀποέργω (= Attic ἀπείργει): ’wards off, holds apart’
glossary.ἀποκτείνων: ἀποκτείνω — kill; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’killing’
glossary.ἀρηϊθόων: ἀρηΐθοος — swift in war, warlike (traditional sense; Ἄρης + θοός ’swift’); masc. gen. pl., epic -όων uncontracted (= Attic ἀρηϊθῶν)
glossary.ἀφάμαρθ: ἀφαμαρτάνω — miss (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἀφάμαρθ’ = ἀφάμαρτε): ’missed’
glossary.ἄξοντα: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. part. act. masc. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to bring’
glossary.ἅμαρτε: ἁμαρτάνω — miss (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἥμαρτε): ’missed’
glossary.ἅπτηται: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, lay hold of (+ gen.); pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., without κεν in a simile after ὡς ὅτε: ’lays hold of’
glossary.ἐκέλευσεν: κελεύω — command, order, bid; aor. 3 sg.: ’ordered’
glossary.ἐναίρω: ἐναίρω — slay, kill; pres. 1 sg. act.: ’I slay’
glossary.ἐξήνυσε: ἐξανύω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’fulfilled’
glossary.ἐπέντυε: ἐπεντύω — make ready, harness (ἐπί + ἐντύω); pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’make ready!’
glossary.ἐπαλεξήσουσαν: ἐπαλέξω — come to the aid of, ward off for (+ dat.); fut. part. act. fem. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to come to the aid of’
glossary.ἐρέβευς: Ἔρεβος — Erebus, the dark place under the earth; neut. gen. sg., Ionic -ευς (= Attic Ἐρέβους)
glossary.ἐρητύοντο: ἐρητύω — hold back, check, restrain; pass. be held back; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were held back’
glossary.ἐριπών: ἐρείπω — throw down; intrans. aor. ἤριπον fall headlong; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fallen down’
glossary.ἐχίοιο: Ἐχίος — Echius, father of Mecisteus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐῢν: ἐΰς — good, noble; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἀγαθός, ἐσθλός)
glossary.ἑλισσόμενόν: ἑλίσσω — turn, wheel; mid. turn about; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., accent before the enclitic τε: ’turning about’
glossary.ἑτέρωσε: ἑτέρωσε — to the other side, to one side; adv.
glossary.ἔβησαν: βαίνω — go, walk, set off; aor. 3 pl.: ’they went’
glossary.ἔκυσσε: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 3 sg., doubled σ: ’kissed’
glossary.ἡνιοχῆα: ἡνιοχεύς — charioteer, driver (by-form of ἡνίοχος); masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἤμυσε: ἀμύω — sink, droop, bow down (stem and sense taken from the context; uncertain); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’drooped’
glossary.ἰσχία: ἰσχίον — hip, haunch; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἱέμενον: ἵεμαι — hasten, make for; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’rushing’
glossary.ἴαλλεν: ἰάλλω — send forth, hurl; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (≈ Attic ἔπεμπε)
glossary.ὀλέσειε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish: ’may he lose’
glossary.ὀπίστατον: ὀπίστατος — hindmost, last (superlative of the root of ὄπισθε ’behind’); masc. acc. sg.: ’the hindmost’
glossary.ὀπυιομένη: ὀπυίω — take as wife; mid. be married; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’being wedded’
glossary.ὀτρύνεις: ὀτρύνω — urge on, stir up; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you urge on’
glossary.ὀϊστούς: ὀϊστός — arrow; masc. acc. pl. (= Attic ὀιστούς)
glossary.ὀϊστὸν: ὀϊστός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ὀιστόν)
glossary.ὅση: ὅσος — as great as, as much as; relative adj., fem. nom. sg., of measure
glossary.ὑπεξέφυγε: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from under, slip away from; aor. 3 sg., augment after the prefixes: ’escaped’
glossary.ὑποδύντε: ὑποδύω — go under, get under; aor. part. act. dual masc. nom.: ’the two getting under’
glossary.ὑστάτιόν: ὑστάτιος — last, final (by-form of ὕστατος); neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, accent before the enclitic περ: ’at the last’
glossary.ὠσάμεθ: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 1 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (ὠσάμεθ’ = ὠσάμεθα; Attic ἐωσάμεθα): ’we pushed’
glossary.ὤπαζε: ὀπάζω — make follow, press hard after; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’pressed’
glossary.ᾔδε: οἶδα — know; plup. 1 sg. with past sense, elided (ᾔδε’ = ᾔδεα): ’I had known’
glossary.ῥιπῇ: ῥιπή — rush, onset, force; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by the onset’
glossary.αἰνοτάτη: αἰνός — dread, terrible; superl. fem. nom. sg., used as a vocative in address: ’most dreadful one’
glossary.αὐτὰς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’themselves’ · also personal pron. after a preposition: ’them’ (κατ’ αὐτάς)
glossary.βαλέω: βάλλω — throw, cast, hurl; fut. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic βαλῶ): ’I will throw’
glossary.βιώτω: βιόω — live; aor. imper. 3 sg. act. (aor. ἐβίων): ’let him live’
glossary.βωμοῖσι: βωμός — pedestal, raised base (usually ’altar’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.γλαυκῶπι: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain), epithet of Athena; fem. voc. sg.
glossary.γυιώσειν: γυιόω — lame, cripple (γυῖον ’limb’); fut. inf. act., after a verb of threatening: ’to lame’
glossary.γυιώσω: γυιόω — lame, cripple (γυῖον ’limb’); fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I will lame’
glossary.δίωκε: διώκω — drive on, chase, pursue; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίωκε): ’drove on’
glossary.δεκάτους: δέκατος — tenth; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἐνιαυτούς
glossary.δικαζέτω: δικάζω — give judgment, judge; pres. imper. 3 sg. act., + dat.: ’let him judge’
glossary.θην: θήν — surely, I warrant, to be sure; emphatic particle
glossary.θρόνον: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θώκους: θῶκος — seat; masc. acc. pl.: ’seats’ (of the gods in assembly)
glossary.κάθιζον: καθίζω — sit down, take a seat; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκάθιζον): ’were sitting’
glossary.κάμετόν: κάμνω — toil, grow weary (+ part.: ’tire of doing’); aor. 2 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκάμετον); accent shifted before enclitic γε
glossary.κάπῃσιν: κάπη — manger, feeding-trough; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.κατέδησαν: καταδέω — bind, tether, fasten down; aor. 3 pl., augmented (κατα- + ἔδησαν, elided to κατέδησαν): ’they tethered’
glossary.κλισμοῖσι: κλισμός — reclining chair, seat; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κύον: κύων — dog; masc./fem. voc. sg., a term of abuse
glossary.λῖτα: λίς — smooth linen cloth; acc. sg.
glossary.μάρπτῃσι: μάρπτω — seize, catch; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῃ), in a general relative clause with κεν: ’whatever seizes’
glossary.μάχηαι: μάχομαι — fight; pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic -ῃ), + dat., in a temporal clause with ἂν: ’when you fight’
glossary.μέματον: μέμαα (μάομαι) — strive, be eager, rush; perf. with pres. sense, 2 dual (= Attic μεμάτον, no Attic pres.): ’you two are rushing’
glossary.μέρμερα: μέρμερος — grievous, baneful, causing care (sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
glossary.μίγδ: μίγδα — mingled, in company with; adv. + dat., elided (μίγδ’ = μίγδα): ’mixed among’
glossary.νεμεσίζεται: νεμεσίζομαι — feel indignation, be ashamed; pres. 3 sg., + dat.: ’is indignant at’
glossary.νεμεσίζομαι: νεμεσίζομαι — feel righteous indignation, resent; pres. 1 sg., + dat.: ’resent’
glossary.οἶαι: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. pl. (= Attic μόναι), agreeing with αἳ
glossary.πάντως: πάντως — altogether, certainly, in every way; adv.
glossary.πελεμίζετ: πελεμίζω — shake, make tremble; impf. 3 sg. pass., elided (πελεμίζετ’ = πελεμίζετο), unaugmented: ’was shaken’
glossary.περιτελλομένους: περιτέλλομαι — revolve, come round (of years); pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἐνιαυτούς
glossary.πληγέντε: πλήσσω — strike; aor. part. pass. nom. dual (-έντε, masc. form used for two goddesses): ’the two being struck’
glossary.πολέμοιό: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου); accent added before enclitic τε
glossary.πολυπτύχου: πολύπτυχος — many-folded, with many ridges and glens; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Olympus
glossary.πρώτῃσιν: πρῶτος — first; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic πρώταις)
glossary.πτολεμίζειν: πτολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf. act., epic π-τ form (= Attic πολεμίζειν)
glossary.πτόλεμον: πτόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεμος); goal of motion with the -δε ’to’ that follows
glossary.συνοισόμεθα: συμφέρω — bring together; mid. come together, clash; fut. 1 pl. mid., from the stem οἰσ- of φέρω: ’we shall clash’
glossary.ταχεῖα: ταχύς — swift, fleet; fem. voc. sg., in address: ’swift one’
glossary.τελέει: τελέω — accomplish, complete, fulfill; fut. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖ)
glossary.τετίησθον: τετίημαι — be distressed, be downcast (perf. with pres. sense; stem uncertain); 2 dual: ’you two are dejected’
glossary.τετιημέναι: τετίημαι — be distressed, be downcast (perf. with pres. sense; stem uncertain); perf. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’distressed’
glossary.τολμήσεις: τολμάω — dare, have the heart; fut. 2 sg. act., + inf.: ’you will dare’
glossary.τοῖσίν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.; also relative: ’against whom’ (accented τοῖσίν before the enclitic τε)
glossary.τρέπε: τρέπω — turn, turn back; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’turn!’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτρεπε): ’turned’
glossary.τρέψειαν: τρέπω — turn, turn aside; aor. opt. 3 pl. act. (-ειαν), with ἄν, potential: ’could turn’
glossary.τύχῃ: τυγχάνω — hit, light upon, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg. (aor. ἔτυχον), in a general relative clause with κε: ’whichever chances’
glossary.φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
glossary.χολοῦμαι: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. 1 sg. mid. dep. (contracted -οῦμαι)
glossary.χολοῦται: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. 3 sg. mid. dep. (contracted -οῦται)
glossary.χρυσέοισιν: χρύσεος — golden; masc. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έοισιν (= Attic χρυσοῖς)
glossary.χρυσόπτερον: χρυσόπτερος — gold-winged; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἶριν
glossary.χώσατ: χώομαι — be incensed, be angry; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (χώσατ’ = χώσατο; = Attic ἐχώσατο): ’was incensed’
glossary.ἀγγελέουσα: ἀγγέλλω — bring news, announce; fut. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγγελοῦσα), of purpose: ’to bring news’
glossary.ἀγγελέουσαν: ἀγγέλλω — bring news, announce; fut. part. act. fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγγελοῦσαν), of purpose: ’to bring news’
glossary.ἀδεὲς: ἀδεής — fearless, reckless, shameless (ἀ- + δέος ’fear’); fem. voc. sg. (or adverbial neut. acc.; the form allows both), in address; accent grave before the next word
glossary.ἀελλόπος: ἀελλόπος — storm-footed, swift as a gale (ἄελλα + πούς); fem. nom. sg., epithet of Iris
glossary.ἀεῖραι: αἴρω — lift, raise; aor. inf. act., epic ἀεῖραι (= Attic ἆραι): ’to raise’
glossary.ἀμβροσίῃσι: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine, ambrosial; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀντομένη: ἀντάομαι (ἄντομαι) — meet, encounter; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., epic: ’meeting’
glossary.ἀπαλθήσεσθον: ἀπαλθήσκομαι — be healed, recover; fut. 2 dual mid.: ’you two will be healed’
glossary.ἀποφθίσθω: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die away; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him perish’
glossary.ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; neut. acc. pl.: ’his own’ (τὰ ἃ φρονέων ’thinking his own thoughts’)
glossary.ἄαπτοι: ἄαπτος — irresistible, invincible (sense and origin uncertain); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with χεῖρες
glossary.ἄξειν: ἄγνυμι — break, break to pieces; fut. inf. act., in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἄξειν = κατάξειν): ’to break down’
glossary.ἐάᾳ: ἐάω — let, allow; pres. 3 sg. act., epic diectasis (= Attic ἐᾷ): ’allows’
glossary.ἐΰτροχον: ἐΰτροχος — well-rolling, with good wheels (Attic εὔτροχος); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἅρμα
glossary.ἐνικλᾶν: ἐνικλάω — thwart, cross, break in upon (sense uncertain); pres. inf. act., contracted, complementary inf. after ἔωθα: ’to thwart’
glossary.ἐννοσίγαιος: ἐννοσίγαιος — ’earth-shaker’, epithet/name of Poseidon (built on γαῖα, distinct from ἐνοσίχθων built on χθών); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐνώπια: ἐνώπια — the inner wall-faces of the porch (fixed architectural term); neut. acc. pl. · also the inner wall-faces of a hall: ’inner walls’ (πρὸς ἐνώπια παμφανόωντα ’against the shining inner walls’)
glossary.ἐξίκετο: ἐξικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg. mid., + acc.
glossary.ἐπαμυνέμεν: ἐπαμύνω — come to the defence of (+ dat.); pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπαμύνειν)
glossary.ἐπιεικές: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’as is fitting’
glossary.ἐῶ: ἐάω — let, allow; pres. 1 sg. act., contracted (ἐάω → ἐῶ), + acc. and inf.: ’I allow’
glossary.ἔθεσθε: τίθημι — put, place; mid. take up, conceive; aor. 2 pl. mid. (aor. ἐθέμην): κότον ἔθεσθε ’you conceived resentment’
glossary.ἔωθεν: ἔωθα (εἴωθα) — be accustomed; perf. 3 sg. act. with pres. sense, movable -ν (= Attic εἴωθε), + inf.: ’is accustomed’
glossary.ἠπείλησε: ἀπειλέω — threaten (+ dat., + inf.); aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’threatened’
glossary.ἰδεῖν: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. inf. act.: ’to see’
glossary.ἰδῇ: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’may see’
glossary.ἰδῇς: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’you may see’
glossary.ἵκεσθον: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; 2 dual mid., short-vowel form after ἄν, ambiguous (aor. subj. or past form); sense here past: ’you two would have come’
glossary.ἶρι: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. voc. sg.
glossary.ἶριν: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλλῦσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, kill; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl. (for two subjects), supplementary after κάμνω: ’destroying’
glossary.ὄλυμπος: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑμετέρων: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.), yours; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.αἰγίλιπος: αἰγίλιψ — sheer, steep (of a rock; ’goat-forsaken’ is only the ancient guess); gen. sg., two-ending adj., agreeing with the fem. noun πέτρης
glossary.βασιλεύτατός: βασιλεύς — king, chief; superl. adj. βασιλεύτατος, masc. nom. sg. (accent from the enclitic): ’most kingly’
glossary.βεβολήατο: βάλλω — strike, hit; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ήατο (= Attic ἐβέβληντο): ’were struck’
glossary.βεβολημένος: βάλλω — strike, hit; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic βεβλημένος): ’struck’
glossary.βορέης: Βορέας — the North Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg., epic Βορέης (= Attic Βορέας)
glossary.βουλεύσῃ: βουλεύω — plan, devise, take counsel; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause with κεν: ’may devise’
glossary.βουλεύῃσθα: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ῃσθα (= Attic -ῃ), in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’you may take counsel’
glossary.βοᾶν: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; pres. inf. act., negated by μὴ δέ, depending on κελεύων: ’not to shout’
glossary.γενεῆφιν: γενεή — birth, age, generation; fem. dat. sg. in -φιν, dative of respect (= Attic γενεᾷ): ’in birth’
glossary.γεραίτερος: γεραιός — old; comparative γεραίτερος, masc. nom. sg., + gen. of comparison: ’older (than)’
glossary.γηθήσειε: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., with ἄν, potential: ’would rejoice’
glossary.δήϊοι: δήϊος — hostile; as a noun, an enemy; masc. nom. pl., epic (= δάϊος): ’enemies’
glossary.δαίνυ: δαίνυμι — give a feast, entertain; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., athematic: ’give a feast’
glossary.δηΐπυρόν: Δηΐπυρος — Deipyrus, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the enclitic τε)
glossary.διίξομαι: διϊκνέομαι — go through, pass through; fut. 1 sg., epic διίξομαι: ’I shall go through’ (a tale, in full)
glossary.διαπέρσομεν: διαπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. subj. 1 pl. act., short-vowel epic (= διαπέρσωμεν), after εἰς ὅ κε: ’we sack’
glossary.διαρραίσει: διαρραίω — break in pieces, shatter utterly; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will shatter’
glossary.δνοφερὸν: δνοφερός — gloomy, dark; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ (also masc. acc. sg. in form)
glossary.δοκεῖ: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg., impersonal with dat. and inf.: ’it seems (to me)’
glossary.δόρπά: δόρπον — supper, evening meal; neut. acc. pl. (accent from the enclitic τ’)
glossary.δόρπα: δόρπον — supper, evening meal; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.δώροισίν: δῶρον — gift; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic δώροις; accent from the enclitic τ’)
glossary.εἰλήλουθμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; perf. 1 pl., epic εἰλήλουθμεν with lengthened reduplication (= Attic ἐληλύθαμεν): ’we have come’
glossary.εἴης: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might be’
glossary.εἴξας: εἴκω — yield, give way (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having yielded’
glossary.εὕρωμεν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. subj. act. 1 pl., in a temporal clause with κε: ’(until) we find’
glossary.θεσπεσίη: θεσπέσιος — divinely wonderful, marvellous; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic θεσπεσία)
glossary.θρασυμήδεα: Θρασυμήδης — Thrasymedes, a son of Nestor; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
glossary.θρῄκηθεν: Θρῄκη — Thrace; with the suffix -θεν of place from which: adv., ’from Thrace’ (Ionic Θρῄκη = Attic Θρᾴκη)
glossary.κήαντο: καίω — kindle, burn; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic and unaugmented (κήαντο = ἐκήαντο; Attic ἐκαύσαντο): ’they kindled’
glossary.καίουσιν: καίω — burn, kindle; pres. 3 pl. act., ν-movable: ’they burn’
glossary.κικλήσκειν: καλέω — call, summon; pres. inf. act., epic reduplicated κικλήσκω (= Attic καλεῖν), after κελεύων: ’to summon’
glossary.κλήδην: κλήδην — by name, by calling out (from καλέω); adv.
glossary.κορθύεται: κορθύω — raise up, heap up; mid. rear up (of a wave); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’rears itself up’
glossary.κούροισιν: κοῦρος — boy, youth, young man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic κόροις)
glossary.κρήνη: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κρείοντος: κρείων — ruler, lord; masc. gen. sg. · also the proper name Κρείων, Creon (father of Lycomedes); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κρηῆναι: κραίνω — accomplish, bring to fulfilment; aor. inf. act., epic κρηῆναι (= Attic κρᾶναι)
glossary.κρυόεντος: κρυόεις — chilling, icy (κρύος ’frost’); masc. gen. sg., agreeing with φόβου
glossary.λήξω: λήγω — cease, leave off, end; fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I shall end’
glossary.λεξάσθων: λέγω — lay; mid. lay oneself down, lie down; aor. imper. 3 pl. mid.: ’let them lie down’
glossary.λυκομήδεα: Λυκομήδης — Lycomedes, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
glossary.μελάνυδρος: μελάνυδρος — dark-watered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., agreeing with κρήνη
glossary.μενέουσι: μένω — stay, remain, wait; fut. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -έουσι (= Attic μενοῦσι): ’they will stay’
glossary.μενοεικέα: μενοεικής — satisfying, to one’s heart’s desire (μένος + ἔοικα); fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μενοεικῆ) · also neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic μενοεικῆ), agreeing with πολλά: ’satisfying things’
glossary.μηριόνην: Μηριόνης — Meriones, a Cretan warrior, squire of Idomeneus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μυκήνηθεν: Μυκήνη — Mycenae; with the suffix -θεν of place from which: adv., ’from Mycenae’
glossary.νέος: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. sg.: ’young’
glossary.νεστορίδην: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νοέω: νοέω — perceive, think, form a judgment; pres. 1 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic νοῶ): ’I think’
glossary.νοήσει: νοέω — perceive, think, devise; fut. 3 sg. act. (νοήσω): ’will think of’
glossary.πένθεϊ: πένθος — grief, mourning; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πένθει)
glossary.πίθοντο: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπίθοντο): ’they obeyed’
glossary.παρὲξ: παρέξ — out beyond, past, outside; prep. + acc. (also an adverb)
glossary.πείσεαι: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic πείσῃ): ’you will obey’
glossary.πεπίθωμεν: πείθω — persuade; aor. subj. 1 pl. act., with epic reduplication (aor. 2 ἐπέπιθον): ’we may persuade’
glossary.πολέεσσι: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic πολλοῖς): ’over many’ (of persons)
glossary.πονεῖτο: πονέομαι — toil, busy oneself; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπονεῖτο): ’toiled’
glossary.προκείμενα: πρόκειμαι — lie before, be set out; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’set before them’
glossary.πυκινῆς: πυκινός — thick, close-set, shrewd; fem. gen. sg. (of counsel: ’close-packed’)
glossary.πυρὰ: πῦρ — fire; neut. acc. pl. πυρά, of watch-fires: ’fires’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’fires’ (πυρὰ … καίετο ’fires were burning’)
glossary.πᾶσά: πᾶς — all, every, whole; fem. nom. sg. (accent from the enclitic τοι)
glossary.σαώσει: σαόω — save, keep safe; fut. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic σώσει): ’will save’
glossary.στεῖχον: στείχω — go, march, walk; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔστειχον): ’went, marched’
glossary.τείχεος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -εος (= Attic τείχους)
glossary.τετιηότες: τετιηώς — grieved, dejected (perf. part. with present sense; the verb is not otherwise found); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τετιμῆσθαι: τιμάω — honour, value; perf. pass. inf.: ’to be honoured’
glossary.φέριστον: φέριστος — best, bravest (superl. of φέρτερος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φραζώμεσθ: φράζομαι — consider, take thought, devise; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory, elided (φραζώμεσθ’ = φραζώμεθα)
glossary.φυλάκων: φύλαξ — guard, watchman; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the guards’
glossary.φυλακτῆρες: φυλακτήρ — guard, sentry (= φύλαξ); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φυλακὰς: φυλακή — watch, guard (φυλακὰς ἔχειν ’keep watch’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φόβου: φόβος — fear, panic; masc. gen. sg., gen. depending on ἑταίρη: ’of terror’
glossary.φύζα: φύζα — flight, panic, rout; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φὰς: φημί — say, declare; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with ἔμεν in indirect statement: ’saying (that)’
glossary.χολωθῇς: χολόω — enrage; pass. become angry; aor. subj. pass. 2 sg., prohibitive after μή: ’(do not) become angered’
glossary.χρεὼ: χρεώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. (indeclinable), with ἐστί understood, + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need (for X of Y)’
glossary.χωομένου: χώομαι — be angry, be incensed; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute: ’being incensed’
glossary.ἀγανοῖσιν: ἀγανός — gentle, kindly; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ἀγρομένων: ἀγείρω — gather; aor. part. mid., syncopated (ἀγρόμενος = ἀγειρόμενος), masc. gen. pl., gen. absolute: ’having assembled’
glossary.ἀεικές: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful (ἀ- + ἔοικα); neut. nom. sg., epic
glossary.ἀθάνατοί: ἀθάνατος — immortal; masc. nom. pl., as a noun: ’the immortals’ (accent from the enclitic περ)
glossary.ἀθέμιστος: ἀθέμιστος — lawless, regardless of right (ἀ- + θέμις); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλκὴν: ἀλκή — strength, might, prowess; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνέστιός: ἀνέστιος — hearthless, without a home (ἀ- + ἑστία); masc. nom. sg. (accent from the enclitic ἐστιν)
glossary.ἀνώγῃ: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); subj. 3 sg., after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’may bid’
glossary.ἀολλέας: ἀολλής — gathered together, in a close mass; masc. acc. pl., epic -έας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀπεμυθεόμην: ἀπομυθέομαι — speak against, advise against; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπεμυθούμην): ’I spoke against’
glossary.ἀπτολέμους: ἀπτόλεμος — unwarlike, unfit for war; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with υἷας (epic = Attic ἀπόλεμος)
glossary.ἀπτόλεμον: ἀπτόλεμος — unwarlike, unfit for war; masc. acc. sg. (epic = Attic ἀπόλεμος)
glossary.ἀρεσσάμενοι: ἀρέσκω — appease, satisfy, make amends; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἀρεσάμενοι): ’having made amends’
glossary.ἀσκάλαφον: Ἀσκάλαφος — Ascalaphus, a son of Ares, leader of the Minyans of Orchomenus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτιμήσει: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., elided (ἀτιμήσει’ = ἀτιμήσειε), with κε: ’would dishonour’
glossary.ἀτλήτῳ: ἄτλητος — unendurable, not to be borne (ἀ- + τλάω); neut. dat. sg., agreeing with πένθεϊ
glossary.ἀφαρῆά: Ἀφαρεύς — Aphareus, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἀφρήτωρ: ἀφρήτωρ — clanless, outside the brotherhood (ἀ- + φρήτρη); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀφραδέοντι: ἀφραδέω — be senseless, act foolishly; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἀφραδοῦντι): ’being senseless’
glossary.ἄητον: ἄημι — blow; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (of two winds): ’the two were blowing’
glossary.ἄμυδις: ἄμυδις — together, at once, in a body; adv.
glossary.ἄρξομαι: ἄρχω — begin, rule; fut. 1 sg. mid., + gen.: ’I shall begin from’
glossary.ἄρχῃ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause with κεν: ’may begin’
glossary.ἐγγυάλιξε: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hand, hand over; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’has put into (your) hands’
glossary.ἐγών: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., epic form with ν (ἐγών = ἐγώ)
glossary.ἐδαΐζετο: δαΐζω — tear apart, rend; impf. 3 sg. pass.: ’was torn’
glossary.ἐκεῖνος: ἐκεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron. (full form, beside the shortened epic κεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐκτός: ἐκτός — outside, out of; prep. + gen. (placed after its noun) · also adv., ’outside’
glossary.ἐξείπω: ἐξεῖπον — speak out, tell in full (ἐκ + εἶπον); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., volitive: ’let me speak out’
glossary.ἐπακοῦσαι: ἐπακούω — listen to, hear (+ gen. or acc.); aor. inf. act.: ’to listen’
glossary.ἐπιδημίου: ἐπιδήμιος — among one’s own people, civil (ἐπί + δῆμος); masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πολέμου
glossary.ἐσθ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἐσθ’ = ἐστί)
glossary.ἐφοπλισόμεσθα: ἐφοπλίζω — make ready, prepare (ἐπί + ὁπλίζω); fut. 1 pl. mid., epic ending -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we shall make ready’
glossary.ἑταίρη: ἑταίρη — companion, comrade (fem.); fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἑταίρα), in apposition
glossary.ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ὀνείαθ’
glossary.ἔβης: βαίνω — go, step, come; aor. 2 sg. act.: ’you went’
glossary.ἔλπεαι: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect, suppose; pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic ἔλπῃ): ’you expect’
glossary.ἔοικέ: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting (perf. with pres. sense); 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is fitting’ (accent from the enclitic τοι)
glossary.ἔπεσσί: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι; accent from the enclitic τε)
glossary.ἔπλευ: πέλομαι — be, become; 2 sg. mid. ἔπλευ (= ἔπλεο), aorist with present sense: ’you are, you have proved’
glossary.ἔραται: ἔραμαι — love, desire (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg. mid., epic athematic ἔραται (beside ἐράω, Attic ἐρᾷ): ’loves’
glossary.ἔτισαν: τίω — honour, value; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they honoured’ · also τίνω — pay, pay for; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they paid for’
glossary.ἕξεται: ἔχω — have, hold; fut. 3 sg. mid. (ἕξομαι), + gen.: ’will hold to, will rest on’
glossary.ἕπτ: ἑπτά — seven; indeclinable numeral, elided (ἕπτ’ = ἑπτά)
glossary.ἠμάτιαι: ἠμάτιος — daily, by day; fem. nom. pl., epic, predicative with the subject (νῆες): ’day by day’
glossary.ἠτίμησας: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. 2 sg. act., augmented (ἀ- becomes ἠ-): ’you dishonoured’
glossary.ἡμέτερόν: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with νόον (accent from the enclitic γε) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’our’ (ἡμέτερον μένος ’our might’)
glossary.ἦγεν: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’led, brought’
glossary.ἧδ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg., elided (ἧδ’ = ἥδε)
glossary.ἰάλμενον: Ἰάλμενος — Ialmenus, a son of Ares, leader of the Minyans of Orchomenus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰχθυόεντα: ἰχθυόεις — fish-filled, teeming with fish; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόντον
glossary.ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they put out’
glossary.ἴσασ: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 pl., elided (ἴσασ’ = ἴσασι): ’they know’
glossary.ἵκεο: ἱκνέομαι — come, reach; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic ἵκεο (= Attic ἵκου), unaugmented: ’you reached’
glossary.ἷζον: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they sat down, were sitting’
glossary.ὀκρυόεντος: ὀκρυόεις — chilling, horrible (a rare word; ’chilling’ is the traditional gloss); masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πολέμου
glossary.ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
glossary.ὀνείδισας: ὀνειδίζω — reproach, upbraid (+ dat. of the person); aor. 2 sg. act.: ’you reproached’
glossary.ὀνόσσεται: ὄνομαι — find fault with, scorn (+ acc.); fut. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀνόσεται): ’will find fault with’
glossary.ὀρίνετον: ὀρίνω — stir up, trouble, agitate; pres. 3 dual act. (two winds): ’the two stir up’
glossary.ὀρυκτὴν: ὀρυκτός — dug (verbal adj. of ὀρύσσω); fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τάφρον
glossary.ὁδός: ὁδός — way, path, journey; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁμήλικας: ὁμήλιξ — of the same age, a peer; masc. acc. pl.: ’age-mates’
glossary.ὁπλότατος: ὁπλότερος — younger; superl. ὁπλότατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’youngest’
glossary.ὑποδεξίη: ὑποδεξίη — reception, entertainment of a guest (ὑποδέχομαι); fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ίη (= -ία), a rare noun
glossary.αἰακίδην: Αἰακίδης — descendant of Aeacus, used of Achilles; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴθωνας: αἴθων — blazing, gleaming (of bronze); adj., masc. acc. pl., agreeing with λέβητας: ’fire-bright’
glossary.αἴπειαν: Αἴπεια — Aepeia, a town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βαθύλειμον: βαθύλειμος — deep-meadowed (βαθύς + λειμών); adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a town’s name
glossary.βασιλεύτερός: βασιλεύς — king; comparative adj. βασιλεύτερος, masc. nom. sg. (accent from the enclitic εἰμί): ’more kingly’
glossary.βροτοῖσι: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.γαιηόχῳ: γαιήοχος — earth-holder, epithet of Poseidon; masc. dat. sg., with εὐχομένω
glossary.γαμβρός: γαμβρός — son-in-law; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’a son-in-law’
glossary.δάμασσε: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- and unaugmented (= Attic ἐδάμασε): ’subdued’
glossary.δαιδαλέῃ: δαιδάλεος — skilfully wrought, cunning; adj., fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ), agreeing with φόρμιγγι
glossary.δατεώμεθα: δατέομαι — divide, share out; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., epic -εώ- (= Attic δατώμεθα), after ὅτε κεν: ’(when) we divide’
glossary.δεικνύμενος: δείκνυμι — show, point out; mid. also greet by a gesture; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’gesturing’
glossary.δενδίλλων: δενδίλλω — cast glances, signal with the eyes (rare verb); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’casting glances’
glossary.διδοῖς: δίδωμι — give; pres. 2 sg. act., epic -οῖς (= Attic δίδως): ’you give’
glossary.δμηθήτω: δαμάζω — subdue, tame; aor. imper. pass. 3 sg., shortened stem δμη-: ’let him be subdued’
glossary.δωτίνῃσι: δωτίνη — gift; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’with gifts’
glossary.δόμεναί: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic δοῦναι), accented before the enclitic τε, complementing ἐθέλω: ’to give’
glossary.δώωσ: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., epic δώωσι (= Attic δῶσι), elided, in a condition with εἰ κεν: ’should grant’
glossary.εἰσελθών: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’going in’
glossary.εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.εὐφημῆσαί: εὐφημέω — keep holy silence; aor. inf. act., accented before the enclitic τε, after κέλεσθε: ’to keep silence’
glossary.εὐχομένω: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. part. mid. masc. dual nom., agreeing with τὼ: ’praying’
glossary.ζαθέας: ζάθεος — most holy, sacred (ζα- intensive); adj., fem. acc. pl., agreeing with a town’s name
glossary.ζωρότερον: ζωρός — strong, undiluted (of wine); comparative ζωρότερος, neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’stronger’
glossary.θάασσεν: θάσσω — sit; impf. 3 sg., epic lengthened θάασσεν, unaugmented (= Attic ἔθασσε): ’was sitting’
glossary.θαλίῃ: θαλία — abundance, festive plenty; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ): ’in plenty’
glossary.κάλλει: κάλλος — beauty; neut. dat. sg., dative of respect: ’in beauty’
glossary.κάλλισται: καλός — beautiful, fair; superl. κάλλιστος, fem. nom. pl.: ’fairest’
glossary.κέλεσθε: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’bid!’
glossary.κέραιε: κεράννυμι — mix (wine with water); pres. imper. 2 sg. act., epic κεραίω (Attic imper. κεράννυ): ’mix!’
glossary.καθίστα: καθίστημι — set up, set in place; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., -α by-form (= Attic καθίστη): ’set up!’
glossary.καλήν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καρδαμύλην: Καρδαμύλη — Cardamyle, a town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κατέλεξας: καταλέγω — recount, tell in order; aor. 2 sg.: ’you have recounted’
glossary.κηρύκων: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the heralds’
glossary.κλέα: κλέος — fame, glory, glorious deeds; neut. acc. pl. (epic also κλέεα): κλέα ἀνδρῶν ’glories of men’
glossary.κλητοὺς: κλητός — summoned, called; verbal adj. of καλέω, masc. acc. pl., as a noun: ’men summoned’
glossary.κρονίδῃ: Κρονίδης — son of Cronos; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.λέβητας: λέβης — cauldron, basin; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.λέσβον: Λέσβος — Lesbos, an island of the Aegean; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λήξειεν: λήγω — cease, leave off; aor. opt. 3 sg., after ὁπότε in a clause of waiting: ’when he should cease’
glossary.λαοδίκη: Λαοδίκη — Laodice, a daughter of Agamemnon; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λεσβίδας: Λεσβίς — woman of Lesbos, Lesbian; fem. acc. pl., in apposition to γυναῖκας
glossary.λευγαλέῃσι: λευγαλέος — wretched, pitiful, baneful; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), agreeing with φρεσί
glossary.ληΐδ: ληΐς — booty, spoil; fem. acc. sg., elided (ληΐδ’ = ληΐδα)
glossary.λιγείῃ: λιγύς — clear-toned, shrill; adj. (fem. λιγεῖα), dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ), agreeing with φόρμιγγι
glossary.λιπαρὰς: λιπαρός — gleaming, sleek, rich; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with θέμιστας
glossary.μείλια: μείλια — bridal gifts, dowry-gifts (neut. pl. noun); acc. pl., object of δώσω
glossary.μεγάλας: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.μελάθρῳ: μέλαθρον — roof-beam, rafter, hence roof; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.μενοιτίου: Μενοίτιος — Menoetius, father of Patroclus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μεταλήξαντι: μεταλήγω — cease from, leave off (+ gen.); aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with οἱ: ’who has ceased’ · also agreeing with σοί or τοι: ’you who have ceased’
glossary.μιγῆναι: μίγνυμι — mix; mid./pass. unite with (+ dat.), of sexual union; aor. pass. inf.: ’to have lain with’
glossary.μώνυχες: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed (with an undivided hoof); adj., masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
glossary.νέαται: νέατος — furthest, last (= νείατος); adj., fem. nom. pl., with the gen. Πύλου: ’the furthest ones of’
glossary.ναιόμενα: ναίω — dwell; mid./pass. be inhabited; pres. part. mid. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’inhabited’
glossary.νηησάσθω: νηέω — heap up, load; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg.: ’let him load (for himself)’
glossary.οὖθαρ: οὖθαρ — udder; fig. richness; neut. nom./acc. sg., in apposition: ’udder’
glossary.πάτροκλον: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πεπίθοιεν: πείθω — persuade; strong aor. opt. 3 pl. act., epic reduplicated (= Attic πίθοιεν), in an indirect clause after ὡς: ’they might persuade’
glossary.πεπιθεῖν: πείθω — persuade; strong aor. inf. act., epic reduplicated (= Attic πιθεῖν): ’to persuade’
glossary.πηγοὺς: πηγός — stout, strong-set, well-compacted; adj., masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
glossary.πιθέσθων: πείθομαι — obey, listen to; aor. imper. mid. 3 pl., in the short ending -σθων (Attic also -σθωσαν): ’let them obey’
glossary.ποιήεσσαν: ποιήεις — grassy; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a town’s name
glossary.πολυβοῦται: πολυβούτης — rich in cattle; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πολύρρηνες: πολύρρην — rich in sheep (πολύς + ἀρήν); adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πορφυρέοισιν: πορφύρεος — purple, dark red; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic πορφυροῖς), agreeing with τάπησι
glossary.προσεφώνεεν: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεφώνει)
glossary.πτολίεθρα: πτολίεθρον — citadel, town; neut. acc. pl., epic
glossary.σκυζομένῳ: σκύζομαι — be angry, sullen; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg., concessive with περ, agreeing with μοι: ’though I am sullen’
glossary.σπεῖσάν: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσπεισαν; accent from the enclitic τε)
glossary.στὰν: ἵστημι — make stand, set up; the strong aor. ἔστην is intrans., stand; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (στὰν = ἔσταν; Attic ἔστησαν): ’they stood’
glossary.τάπησί: τάπης — rug, carpet; masc. dat. pl. (accent from the enclitic τε)
glossary.τίσω: τίω — honour, value; fut. 1 sg. τίσω: ’I shall honour’ · also τίνω — pay (a penalty), pay for; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will pay’
glossary.ταφὼν: τέθηπα — be astounded; aor. part. ταφών (ἔταφον), masc. nom. sg.: ’astounded’
glossary.τελέουσι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; fut. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελοῦσι)
glossary.τελέσαιμι: τελέω — accomplish, bring to pass; aor. opt. 1 sg. act., potential with κε: ’I could accomplish’
glossary.τερπόμενον: τέρπω — delight; mid. take delight; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’delighting’
glossary.τηλύγετος: τηλύγετος — late-born (or, on another view, tenderly loved, darling — meaning disputed, no etymology certain); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τρέφεται: τρέφω — rear, nourish; pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is reared’
glossary.τρωϊάδας: Τρωϊάς — Trojan, of Troy; fem. adj., acc. pl., agreeing with γυναῖκας: ’Trojan’
glossary.φέρτε: φέρω — bear, bring; pres. imper. 2 pl. act., syncopated φέρτε (= Attic φέρετε): ’bring!’
glossary.φίλτατοί: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. pl. with a dual verb (accent from the enclitic): ’dearest’
glossary.φίλτατοι: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. pl.: ’dearest’
glossary.φηράς: Φηραί — Pherae, a town; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φιλήσῃ: φιλέω — love; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause (ὅν τε): ’may love’
glossary.φοῖνιξ: Φοῖνιξ — Phoenix, Achilles’ old tutor; masc. nom. sg. · also φοῖνιξ, a Phoenician; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χαίρετον: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. imper. 2 dual: ’welcome, you two’
glossary.χρεώ: χρεώ — need, necessity; nom. sg., impersonal noun: ’need’
glossary.χρυσοῖο: χρυσός — gold; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.χρυσόθεμις: Χρυσόθεμις — Chrysothemis, a daughter of Agamemnon; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀέθλια: ἀέθλιον — prize, contest-prize (epic; cf. Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀασάμην: ἀάω — bewilder, blind (by ἄτη); mid./pass. be bewildered; aor. 1 sg., epic ἀασάμην: ’I was bewildered’
glossary.ἀδάμαστος: ἀδάμαστος — unsubdued, untamed; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀείδων: ἀείδω — sing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., supplementary with λήγω: ’singing’
glossary.ἀθλοφόρους: ἀθλοφόρος — prize-bearing, prize-winning; adj., masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
glossary.ἀκτήμων: ἀκτήμων — without possessions, poor; adj., masc. nom. sg., + gen. of what is lacking: ’lacking (gold)’
glossary.ἀλήϊος: ἀλήϊος — without grain-land, landless (ἀ- + ληΐον); adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’without a field of grain’
glossary.ἀλαπάξαι: ἀλαπάζω — sack, plunder; aor. inf. act., epic, complementing δώωσ’: ’to sack’
glossary.ἀμείλιχος: ἀμείλιχος — ungentle, unappeasable; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἀνάεδνον: ἀνάεδνος — without bridal gifts (ἀ- + ἕδνον); adj., fem. acc. sg., predicate: ’without bridal gifts’
glossary.ἀναίνομαι: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject, deny; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀνόρουσεν: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 sg., epic (Attic prose would say ἀνήλατο): ’sprang up’
glossary.ἀπύρους: ἄπυρος — unfired, not yet put on the fire; adj., masc. acc. pl., agreeing with τρίποδας
glossary.ἀρέσαι: ἀρέσκω — please, satisfy, make content; aor. inf. act., complementing ἐθέλω: ’to make content’
glossary.ἀργύρεον: ἀργύρεος — silver, of silver; adj., neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυροῦν), agreeing with a neuter noun
glossary.ἀρησόμεθ: ἀράομαι — pray; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἀρησόμεθ’ = ἀρησόμεθα), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’we shall pray’
glossary.ἀχαιϊκὸν: Ἀχαιϊκός — Achaean; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with οὖθαρ
glossary.ἁλός: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄγετε: ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 pl., in the interjection ἄγε/ἄγετε: ’come now!’
glossary.ἄνθειαν: Ἄνθεια — Antheia, a town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρετ: ἄρνυμαι — win, take for oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (ἄρετ’ = ἄρετο): ’took’
glossary.ἄροντο: ἄρνυμαι — win, take for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (ἄροντο = ἤροντο): ’won’
glossary.ἄτας: ἄτη — bewilderment, blind folly (sent by the gods); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
glossary.ἐνίκων: νικάω — conquer, surpass; impf. 3 pl. act., + acc.: ’surpassed’
glossary.ἐναντίος: ἐναντίος — opposite, face to face; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’facing’
glossary.ἐννοσιγαίῳ: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon; masc. dat. sg., epic (cf. ἐνοσίχθων)
glossary.ἐνόπην: Ἐνόπη — Enope, a town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐξελόμην: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. choose out for oneself; aor. 1 sg. mid.: ’I chose out’
glossary.ἐπέδωκε: ἐπιδίδωμι — give in addition; aor. 3 sg. act. (κ-aorist): ’gave besides’
glossary.ἐπιβήμεναι: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐπιβῆναι)
glossary.ἐπιόψομαι: ἐφοράω — look over, inspect, single out; fut. 1 sg. ἐπιόψομαι, with ἄν (irregular; sometimes taken as a short-vowel subj.): ’I will single out’
glossary.ἐριτίμοιο: ἐρίτιμος — much-honoured, precious; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with χρυσοῖο
glossary.ἐστον: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 dual: ’you two are’
glossary.ἑαδότα: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (perf. ἕαδα): ’pleasing’, with μῦθον
glossary.ἑλέσθω: αἱρέω — take; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg.: ’let him choose (for himself)’
glossary.ἑπέσθων: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. imper. mid. 3 pl., in the short ending -σθων (Attic also -σθωσαν): ’let them follow’
glossary.ἑῇ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive; epic ἑός) — his own, her own; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a fem. noun: ’own’
glossary.ἔλθωσ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 pl., elided (ἔλθωσ’ = ἔλθωσι), in a relative purpose clause with κε: ’may go’
glossary.ἔντυνον: ἐντύνω — make ready; imper. 2 sg. in -ον (= ἔντυνε), the form disputed: ’make ready!’ · also impf. 3 pl. (same form): ’they made ready’
glossary.ἔοι: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg., epic (= Attic εἴη)
glossary.ἔπιόν: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 pl. (accent from the following enclitic θ’): ’they drank’
glossary.ἔτερπεν: τέρπω — delight; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was delighting’
glossary.ἔτισε: τίω — honour, value; aor. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἐτίμησε): ’honoured’ · also τίνω — pay (a penalty); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’paid’
glossary.ἔωσιν: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 pl., epic ἔωσιν (= Attic ὦσιν)
glossary.ἠνείκαντο: φέρω — bear, bring; mid. carry off, win; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic ἠνείκαντο (= Attic ἠνέγκαντο): ’carried off’
glossary.ἡγησάσθω: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg.: ’let him lead’
glossary.ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἰδυίας: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic (= Attic εἰδυίας): ’skilled in’
glossary.ἰφιάνασσα: Ἰφιάνασσα — Iphianassa, a daughter of Agamemnon; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱκάνετον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive; pres. 2 dual: ’you two have come’
glossary.ἱκοίμεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. opt. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἱκοίμεθ’ = ἱκοίμεθα), in a condition after εἰ κεν: ’we should come to’
glossary.ὀλέσσας: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλέσας): ’having destroyed’
glossary.ὀνοστὰ: ὀνοστός — to be made light of, to be faulted (ὄνομαι); verbal adj., neut. acc. pl., predicate: ’to be faulted’
glossary.ὀρέστῃ: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, son of Agamemnon; masc. dat. sg., after ἶσον ’equal to’
glossary.ὀτρύνομεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. (or aor.) subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ὀτρύνωμεν): ’let us urge on’
glossary.ὁρμῶντ: ὁρμάω — set in motion; mid. set out, hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (ὁρμῶντ’ = ὁρμῶντο): ’set out’
glossary.ὑπέασι: ὕπειμι — be under; pres. 3 pl., epic ὑπέασι (= Attic ὕπεισι): ’are under’
glossary.ὑποστήτω: ὑφίστημι — place under; aor. intrans. submit, yield; aor. imper. 3 sg., intransitive: ’let him submit’
glossary.αὐγῇ: αὐγή — light, radiance, sunlight; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.αὐτάς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. acc. pl., with the ships understood: ’the (ships) themselves’
glossary.αὐτομέδων: Αὐτομέδων — Automedon, a companion of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αὖλιν: αὖλις — place to spend the night, lodging; fem. acc. sg., epic (no ordinary Attic equivalent)
glossary.βάλλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλλε)
glossary.δαίνυσθ: δαίνυμι — feast, feast on; pres. inf. mid., elided (δαίνυσθ’ = δαίνυσθαι): ’to feast on’
glossary.δείδεκτ: δειδίσκομαι — greet by holding out a cup, pledge (meaning traditional); reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (δείδεκτ’ = δείδεκτο), formation not certain, no Attic equivalent: ’pledged’
glossary.δοιῇ: δοιός — twofold, double; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ), in the phrase ἐν δοιῇ: ’in doubt’
glossary.δύσεαι: δύω — mid. δύομαι, put on, enter; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid. (the fut. indic. has the same form), epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic δύσῃ), after εἰ μή: ’(unless) you put on’
glossary.δώσουσ: δίδωμι — give; fut. 3 pl., elided (δώσουσ’ = δώσουσι(ν))
glossary.δῃώσειν: δηϊόω (δῃόω) — cut down, slay; fut. inf. act., contracted spelling δῃώσειν, after στεῦται: ’to cut down’
glossary.εὑρεῖν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. inf. act.: ’to find’
glossary.θυηλάς: θυηλή — offering of first portions burnt for the gods; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.θῦσαι: θύω — sacrifice, make an offering; aor. inf. act., after ἀνώγει: ’to sacrifice’
glossary.κάρτος: κράτος (epic κάρτος, metathesis) — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.; object of δώσουσ’: ’strength’
glossary.καλοῖς: καλός — beautiful, fine; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.κανέοισιν: κάνεον — basket; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.καταλέξω: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I will tell in full’
