glossary.κηάμενοι: καίω (epic κήω) — kindle, burn; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic κηα- (= Attic καυσάμενοι): ’having kindled (for themselves), having lit’
glossary.κηρόθι: κῆρ — heart; with the suffix -θι of place: ’in the heart’, adv.
glossary.κρατευτάων: κρατευτής — spit-rest, fork on which the spits lie (sense disputed); masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.κρεῖον: κρεῖον — meat-block, board on which meat is cut or served; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.κόρυμβα: κόρυμβος — topmost point; of ships, traditionally the curved ends of the stern (sense not certain); neut. acc. pl. κόρυμβα (the singular lemma is masc.), agreeing with ἄκρα
glossary.λήθεαι: λήθομαι — forget (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic λήθῃ): ’you forget’
glossary.ληγέμεναι: λήγω — cease from (+ gen.); pres. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic λήγειν), as an imperative: ’(you must) cease’
glossary.λύσσα: λύσσα — rage, frenzy; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λύσσαν: λύσσα — rage, frenzy; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μέμονάς: μέμονα — be eager, be minded; perf. 2 sg. with present sense: ’you are minded’
glossary.μίστυλλε: μιστύλλω — cut into small pieces; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμίστυλλε): ’cut up’
glossary.μαλεροῦ: μαλερός — devouring, consuming (of fire); neut. gen. sg., agreeing with πυρός
glossary.μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’great-hearted’
glossary.μελαίνῃσιν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic μελαίναις), agreeing with νηυσίν
glossary.μενοιτιάδης: Μενοιτιάδης — son of Menoetius, i.e. Patroclus; masc. nom. sg., patronymic
glossary.μετόπισθ: μετόπισθε — afterward, thereafter, hereafter; adv., elided (μετόπισθ’ = μετόπισθε)
glossary.νεῖμεν: νέμω — distribute, deal out; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with movable ν (= ἔνειμε)
glossary.νεῦσ: νεύω — nod, make a sign; aor. 3 sg., elided (νεῦσ’ = νεῦσε), unaugmented (= ἔνευσε)
glossary.νηήσασθαι: νηέω — heap up, load; aor. inf. mid., epic (= Attic νήσασθαι): ’to load for oneself’
glossary.παναχαιοὺς: Πανάχαιοι — all the Achaeans, the whole Greek host; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.παύε: παύω — make cease; mid. leave off, cease; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., elided (παύε’ = παύεο, = Attic παύου): ’cease!’
glossary.πεσέεσθαι: πίπτω — fall; fut. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic πεσεῖσθαι): ’to fall (upon)’
glossary.πλησάμενος: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., ’having filled (for himself)’
glossary.σαωσέμεν: σαόω — save, keep safe; fut. inf. act. in form, epic -σέμεν (= Attic σώσειν), with the ships as subject read as passive: ’to be saved’ (usual explanation)
glossary.σιάλοιο: σίαλος — fat, fatted (of swine); adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with συός
glossary.στορέσας: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σχήσεσθ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. hold oneself back; fut. inf. mid., elided (σχήσεσθ’ = σχήσεσθαι): ’to hold back’
glossary.τάμνεν: τάμνω — cut, carve (epic by-form of τέμνω); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, with movable ν (= ἔτεμνε): ’carved’
glossary.τάνυσσε: τανύω — stretch out; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- and unaugmented (= ἐτάνυσε): ’stretched’
glossary.τίει: τίω — honour, hold in honour; pres. 3 sg. (long ι; = Attic τιμᾷ)
glossary.τίσει: τίω — honour, hold in honour; fut. 3 sg. act. (= Attic τιμήσει): ’will honour’ · also τίνω — pay, pay for; fut. 3 sg. act.
glossary.τίσουσ: τίω — honour; fut. 3 pl., elided (τίσουσ’ = τίσουσι(ν); = Attic τιμήσουσι): ’will honour’ · also τίνω — pay; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.τίωσ: τίω — honour; pres. subj. 3 pl., elided (τίωσ’ = τίωσι(ν)), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’may honour’
glossary.τεθαλυῖαν: θάλλω — bloom, thrive, swell; perf. part. fem. acc. sg. ’thriving, flourishing’ (masc. τεθηλώς)
glossary.τειρομένους: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. pl.: ’worn down’
glossary.τελέσειε: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would accomplish’
glossary.τοίχου: τοῖχος — wall (of a house or room); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τραπέζῃ: τράπεζα — table; fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (Ionic η for α), locative: ’at table, on the table’
glossary.φανήμεναι: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. inf. pass., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic φανῆναι): ’to appear’
glossary.φθίης: Φθίη — Phthia, the land of Peleus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.φθίσθαι: φθίνω — perish, waste away; aor. inf. mid.: ’to perish’
glossary.φιλοφροσύνη: φιλοφροσύνη — kindliness, friendly feeling; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φράζευ: φράζω — mid. think out, devise, plan; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -ευ (= Attic -ου): ’devise! plan!’
glossary.χαῖρ: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (χαῖρ’ = χαῖρε), a greeting: ’welcome!’
glossary.ἀλεξήσεις: ἀλέξω — ward off, keep off (+ acc. of the harm, dat. of those protected); fut. 2 sg. act., after ὅπως: ’you will ward off’
glossary.ἀλοιφῇ: ἀλοιφή — ointment, anything smeared on (fat, oil); fem. dat. sg., instrumental
glossary.ἀνθρακιὴν: ἀνθρακιά — heap of glowing coals, bed of embers; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπειλὰς: ἀπειλή — threat, boast; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀποκόψειν: ἀποκόπτω — cut off; fut. inf. act., after στεῦται: ’to cut off’
glossary.ἀρᾶται: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; pres. 3 sg. mid., + inf.: ’prays that’
glossary.ἄκος: ἄκος — remedy, cure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄκρα: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; adj., neut. acc. pl., agreeing with κόρυμβα
glossary.ἐκάη: καίω — burn; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented κάη), in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἐκάη = κατεκάη): ’burned down’
glossary.ἐκτελέσωσι: ἐκτελέω — bring to completion, fulfil; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., after μή in a clause of fear: ’(lest) they fulfil’
glossary.ἐλεοῖσιν: ἐλεός — a board or table on which meat was set (exact object uncertain); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐμαράνθη: μαραίνω — quench, make die away; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented: ’died away’
glossary.ἐμπρήσειν: ἐμπίμπρημι — set on fire, burn; fut. inf. act., after στεῦται: ’to burn’
glossary.ἐξέλεθ: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. choose out for oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided before an aspirate (ἐξέλεθ’ = ἐξέλετο): ’chose out’
glossary.ἐπένειμε: ἐπινέμω — deal out to, distribute (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’dealt out’
glossary.ἐπέτελλ: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give orders to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. act., elided (ἐπέτελλ’ = ἐπέτελλε): ’gave his charge’
glossary.ἐπαείρας: ἐπαείρω — lift up on; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἐπάρας): ’raising (them) on’
glossary.ἐπηράτου: ἐπήρατος — lovely, desirable; adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., agreeing with δαιτός
glossary.ἐπιδευεῖς: ἐπιδευής — in want of, lacking (+ gen.); adj., masc. nom. pl.: ’short of’
glossary.ἐρύεσθαι: ἐρύομαι — rescue, protect, draw to safety; pres. inf. mid.: ’to rescue’
glossary.ἐφύπερθε: ἐφύπερθε — over the top, above, on top of; adv.
glossary.ἔθηκ: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔθηκ’ = ἔθηκε): ’put’
glossary.ἔνεικαν: φέρω — bring; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤνεγκαν): ’they brought’
glossary.ἔοις: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἴης), potential with κε: ’you would be’
glossary.ἔπειρε: πείρω — pierce, run through; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’pierced’
glossary.ἕλες: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. 2 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλες): ’you took’
glossary.ἤτ: ἤτε — whether … or (ἤτε … ἤτε); conj., epic ἤ + τε, elided (ἤτ’ = ἤτε)
glossary.ἤτε: ἤτε — whether … or (ἤτε … ἤτε); conj., epic ἤ + τε
glossary.ἴσχειν: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, keep; pres. inf. act., as an imperative: ’(you must) hold’ · also pres. inf. act., complementary after δύναται: ’to hold back’
glossary.ἷζεν: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀλοήν: ὀλοός — baneful, destructive; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with λύσσαν
glossary.ὀμεῖται: ὄμνυμι — swear; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will swear’
glossary.ὀρινομένους: ὀρίνω — stir up, throw into turmoil; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. pl.: ’thrown into turmoil’
glossary.ὀρυμαγδοῦ: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀψέ: ὀψέ — late, at a late hour; adv.
glossary.ὤπτησε: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’roasted’
glossary.ῥάχιν: ῥάχις — back, chine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ῥεχθέντος: ῥέζω — do, perform; aor. part. pass. neut. gen. sg., with κακοῦ: ’once done’
glossary.αἰθήρ: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰνοτάτῳ: αἰνός — dread, terrible; superl. αἰνότατος, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’most dreadful’
glossary.αὐγῇς: αὐγή — beam, ray of light; fem. gen. sg., Ionic ending (= Attic αὐγῆς): ’of the rays’
glossary.αὐτούς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. acc. pl., with a first-person pronoun: ’ourselves’ (ἡμέας αὐτούς) · also plain pronoun, ’them’
glossary.αὔριον: αὔριον — tomorrow; adv. · ἐς αὔριον ’until tomorrow’
glossary.βάλλετ: βάλλω — throw, put; pres. imper. 2 pl. act., elided (βάλλετ’ = βάλλετε), in tmesis with παρά: ’set (food) beside’
glossary.γέγηθε: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; epic perf. γέγηθα, 3 sg. with present force: ’is glad’
glossary.διαείσεται: διαείδομαι (lemma uncertain) — see through, find out; rare fut. 3 sg. mid.; exact sense uncertain: ’will find out’
glossary.διεφαίνετο: διαφαίνω (mid. διαφαίνομαι) — shine through, show through; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’showed through, was clear’
glossary.δῃώσας: δηϊόω (δῃόω) — cut down, slay; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having slain’
glossary.εἰρημένος: ἐρέω (εἴρω) — say, speak; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’spoken’
glossary.εἰσέλθῃσι: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic ending -σι (= Attic εἰσέλθῃ), after μή: ’lest it enter’
glossary.εἴατο: ἧμαι — sit; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἧντο): ’sat’
glossary.εἴσομαι: οἶδα — know; fut. 1 sg. mid. form: ’I shall know, find out’
glossary.ζείδωρον: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); fem. acc. sg.; meaning disputed: ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, or ’life-giving’ (from ζάω)
glossary.θέσφατόν: θέσφατος — declared by a god, decreed, fated; neut. nom. sg., predicate (accented before enclitic ἐστι)
glossary.θανόντος: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. act. masc. gen. sg. (aor. ἔθανον): ’dead’, lit. ’having died’
glossary.θεοδμήτων: θεόδμητος — god-built (θεός + δέμω); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.θηλύτεραι: θῆλυς — female; comparative θηλύτερος (without real comparative force), fem. nom. pl.: ’the female ones’
glossary.θωρηχθέντες: θωρήσσω — arm, put on armour; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. pl., with reflexive sense: ’having armed themselves’
glossary.καίετο: καίω — burn, kindle; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκαίετο), intransitive: ’was burning’
glossary.καίωμεν: καίω — burn, kindle; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., in a purpose clause after ὥς κεν: ’that we may burn’
glossary.καθαρῷ: καθαρός — clean, clear; neut. dat. sg., used as a noun: ’a clear (open) place’
glossary.καιόντων: καίω — burn, kindle; pres. imper. 3 pl. act.: ’let them burn’ · also pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl., in a gen. absolute: ’(the Trojans) burning’
glossary.κελάδησαν: κελαδέω — make a din, cry aloud; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἐκελάδησαν)
glossary.κηρεσσιφορήτους: κηρεσσιφόρητος — borne along by the Κῆρες (the fates of death); masc. acc. pl.; sense uncertain
glossary.κνίσην: κνίση — savour of burnt fat; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic κνίσα)
glossary.κύντερον: κύντερος — more dog-like, more shameless (comparative built on κύων ’dog’); neut. nom. sg., with ἄλλο
glossary.λέγεσθε: λέγω — gather, collect; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’gather for yourselves’
glossary.λέγοντο: λέγω — gather, collect; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλέγοντο): ’they gathered for themselves’
glossary.λόχος: λόχος — ambush, body of men lying in wait; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λύσαθ: λύω — loose, unyoke; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (λύσαθ’ = λύσασθε): ’unyoke’
glossary.μέσφ: μέσφα — until; prep. + gen., elided (μέσφ’ = μέσφα)
glossary.μείνῃ: μένω — stay, wait for, withstand; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a condition after εἴ κ’: ’if he awaits’
glossary.μεγάρων: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.μεγαλήτορες: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, high in courage; masc. nom. pl., also voc. in address: ’great-spirited (Trojans)!’
glossary.μεσηγὺ: μεσηγύ — in between; prep. + gen. (also adv.)
glossary.νάπαι: νάπη — wooded dell, glen; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.νήνεμος: νήνεμος — windless, still; masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ναῦφι: ναῦς — ship; fem. pl. with suffix -φι, in the sense ’by, beside’ (= Attic dat. ναυσί)
glossary.νείατα: νείατος — lowest, furthest down; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ξύλα: ξύλον — wood, firewood; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.οἰνίζεσθε: οἰνίζομαι — get wine, supply oneself with wine; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’get yourselves wine’
glossary.οἴκοθι: οἴκοθι — at home; adv., locative suffix -θι (= Attic οἴκοι)
glossary.οὐτηθείς: οὐτάω — wound, stab at close quarters; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’stabbed’
glossary.πέσσῃ: πέσσω — cook, digest; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a purpose clause after ὥς τις; βέλος πέσσειν ’to nurse a missile-wound’
glossary.πατρόκλοιο: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ποδώκεα: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic -η)
glossary.πολιοκροτάφους: πολιοκρόταφος — grey-templed (πολιός + κρόταφος ’temple’); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πρωθήβας: πρωθήβης — in first youth, just grown to manhood (πρῶτος + ἥβη); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πρύμνῃσι: πρύμνη — stern, hind part of a ship; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.πρώονες: πρών — headland, jutting peak; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πρῶϊ: πρῴ (πρῶϊ) — early, in the morning; adv., epic (= Attic πρῲ)
glossary.πόντοιο: πόντος — sea; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.σέλᾳ: σέλας — flame, blaze, brightness; neut. dat. sg., contracted σέλᾳ (from σέλαϊ): ’in the blaze’
glossary.σκοπιαὶ: σκοπιά — lookout, peak with a wide view; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.σκυζομένης: σκύζομαι — be sullen, angry; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. gen. sg.: ’being sullen’
glossary.στείνει: στεῖνος — narrow place, tight space, crush; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.στυγέῃσι: στυγέω — hate, shrink from; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic στυγῇ), after ἵνα: ’may hate’
glossary.σῖτόν: σῖτος — grain, bread, food; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.τάρταρος: Τάρταρος — Tartarus, the pit beneath the earth; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τέρποντ: τέρπω — delight; mid. take delight (+ dat.); pres. 3 pl. mid., elided (τέρποντ’ = τέρπονται): ’they take delight’
glossary.τίετ: τίω — honour; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass., elided (τίετ’ = τίεται): ’is honoured’
glossary.τιοίμην: τίω — honour; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid./pass., in a wish: ’may I be honoured’
glossary.τούτων: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this, that; demonstrative pron., masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of these’
glossary.τρίλλιστος: τρίλλιστος — thrice-prayed-for, much longed for (τρι- + λίσσομαι ’pray’); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φέρωμαι: φέρω — carry, bear; mid. carry off for oneself, win; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid.: ’I may carry off’
glossary.φρονέοντες: φρονέω — think, have in mind; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντες); μέγα φρονέω ’think great thoughts’
glossary.φυλάξομεν: φυλάσσω — guard, watch; fut. 1 pl. act.: ’we shall guard’
glossary.φυλακὴ: φυλακή — watch, guard; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χίλι: χίλιοι — a thousand; neut. nom./acc. pl. χίλια, elided (χίλι’)
glossary.χωομένης: χώομαι — be angry, incensed; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. gen. sg.: ’being angry’
glossary.χῶρος: χῶρος — place, spot; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀέκουσιν: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄκουσι)
glossary.ἀγήρως: ἀγήραος — ageless, not growing old (ἀ- + γῆρας); masc./fem. nom. sg., contracted ἀγήρως
glossary.ἀγαγὼν: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having led’
glossary.ἀγγελλόντων: ἀγγέλλω — announce, bring word; pres. imper. 3 pl. act.: ’let them announce’
glossary.ἀλέγω: ἀλέγω — care for, heed (mostly with a negative); pres. 1 sg., + gen.
glossary.ἀλωμένη: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. sg.: ’wandering’
glossary.ἀνέμοισι: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνιόντος: ἄνειμι — go up, rise (of the sun); pres. part. masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute: ’as it rises’
glossary.ἀπεόντων: ἄπειμι (εἰμί) — be away, be absent; pres. part. masc. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπόντων), in a gen. absolute
glossary.ἀποπαύσεται: ἀποπαύω — stop; mid. cease from (+ gen.); fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will cease from’
glossary.ἀπώσεται: ἀπωθέω — thrust away, push back; fut. 3 sg. mid. (or short-vowel aor. subj. after εἴ κε): ’will thrust back’
glossary.ἀρετὴν: ἀρετή — excellence, worth, prowess; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀσπασίη: ἀσπάσιος — welcome, gladly received; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α)
glossary.ἀσπουδί: ἀσπουδί — without exertion, without trouble (ἀ- + σπουδή); adv. in -ί
glossary.ἀφίκηαι: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἀφίκῃ), after ἢν: ’you come’ · also after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until you reach’
glossary.ἄκροι: ἄκρος — topmost, high; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄξεσθε: ἄγω — lead, bring; mid. bring for oneself; imper. 2 pl. mid., thematic -σ- stem: ’bring for yourselves’
glossary.ἄξοντο: ἄγω — lead, bring; mid. bring for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid., thematic -σ- stem, unaugmented: ’they brought for themselves’
glossary.ἄρουραν: ἄρουρα — tilled land, ploughland, earth; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄσπετος: ἄσπετος — boundless, immense; masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.ἐΰθρονον: εὔθρονος — fair-throned, with a goodly seat; epithet of Dawn; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐνθένδε: ἐνθένδε — from this place, hence; adv.
glossary.ἐξελάαν: ἐξελαύνω — drive out, drive off; pres. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐξελᾶν), after ἔλπομαι: ’to drive out’
glossary.ἐπήλυθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come on, come upon; aor. 3 sg., epic ἐπήλυθε (= Attic ἐπῆλθε)
glossary.ἐπιβαῖεν: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, go aboard (+ gen.); aor. opt. 3 pl. act., after μή in a prohibition: ’let them not go aboard’
glossary.ἐρεβεννή: ἐρεβεννός — dark, murky (ἔρεβος); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐσάωσε: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save, preserve; aor. 3 sg., augmented ἐσάωσε (= Attic ἔσωσε): ’saved’
glossary.ἑκάστη: ἕκαστος — each, each one; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔπεσ: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπεσ’ = ἔπεσε), in tmesis with ἐν: ’fell into’
glossary.ἔρδον: ἔρδω — do, perform; of a sacrifice, offer (= ῥέζω); impf. 3 pl.: ’they were offering’
glossary.ἔφανεν: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic ending -εν (= Attic ἐφάνησαν), in tmesis with ἐκ: ’stood out’
glossary.ἕλκον: ἕλκω — drag, draw; pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with φάος: ’drawing’
glossary.ἠελίου: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἠοῦς: Ἠώς — Dawn; fem. gen. sg. Ἠοῦς: ’of dawn’ · also gen. of time: ’at dawn, next morning’ (ἠοῦς δὴ) · μέσφ’ ἠοῦς ’until dawn’
glossary.ἠριγενείης: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), epithet of Dawn
glossary.ἡδεῖαν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἡμέρη: ἡμέρα — day; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ἡμέρα)
glossary.ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
glossary.ἰάπετός: Ἰάπετος — Iapetus, a Titan; masc. nom. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἰλιόθι: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; ἰλιόθι, locative adv. with suffix -θι: ’at Ilios’
glossary.ἱδρώοντας: ἱδρώω — sweat; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’sweating’
glossary.ἱμάντεσσι: ἱμάς — strap, thong; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἱμᾶσι): ’with straps’
glossary.ἱπποδάμοισι: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἱρή: ἱερός — holy, sacred; fem. nom. sg., Ionic ἱρή (= Attic ἱερά)
glossary.ἵκῃ: ἵκω — come, reach; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a purpose clause after ὥς κεν: ’may reach’
glossary.ὀλέσας: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having destroyed’
glossary.ὀλλύντ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (ὀλλύντ’ = ὀλλύντα): ’destroying’
glossary.ὁρμήσωνται: ὁρμάω — set in motion; mid. rush, set out; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., after μή: ’lest they set out’
glossary.ὄρθαι: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid./intrans. rise up; epic syncopated aor. inf.: ’to rise up’
glossary.ὑγιὴς: ὑγιής — sound, whole; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπερίονος: Ὑπερίων — Hyperion, a name of the Sun-god; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὑπερράγη: ὑπερρήγνυμι (ὑπέρ + ῥήγνυμι) — burst open; aor. 3 sg. pass. (2 aor. ὑπερράγη)
glossary.ὑπηοῖοι: ὑπηοῖος — at dawn, toward morning (ὑπό + ἠώς); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑπὲξ: ὑπέκ (ὑπέξ) — out from under, forth from; prep. + gen.
glossary.ὠκεανῷ: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river around the earth; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰγυπτίας: Αἰγύπτιος — Egyptian; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with Θήβας
glossary.αἰπεινῆς: αἰπεινός — steep, sheer, lofty; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.βασιλεῦσι: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.βόες: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.γήμαντα: γαμέω — marry (of a man); aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having married, to marry’
glossary.γαμέω: γαμέω — marry (of a man); fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic γαμῶ; or short-vowel subj. with future sense): ’I will marry’
glossary.γλαυκώπιδι: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena, ’gleaming-eyed’ (sense uncertain); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.γλαφυρῇς: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.δήετε: δήω — find, come upon; fut. 2 pl., epic (Attic εὑρήσετε)
glossary.δαναούς: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.δασάσκετο: δατέομαι — divide, share out; iterative aor. 3 sg. mid. in -σκ-, unaugmented: ’he used to share out’
glossary.δεξάμενος: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having received’
glossary.δεῖ: δεῖ — it is necessary, one must (δέω ’lack, need’); impers. pres. 3 sg.
glossary.δηΐοισιν: δήϊος — hostile, enemy; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic δηίοις)
glossary.διηκόσιοι: διακόσιοι — two hundred; masc. nom. pl., epic διη- (= Attic διακόσιοι)
glossary.διχθαδίας: διχθάδιος — twofold, double; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might give’, ’should give’ (after εἰ), ’may (he) give’ (wish)
glossary.δουρικτητήν: δουρικτητός — won by the spear, captive; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δόσκον: δίδωμι — give; iterative impf. 1 sg. in -σκ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίδουν): ’I would give, used to give’
glossary.εἰδότος: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. gen. sg. (εἰδώς): ’knowing’
glossary.εἵλετ: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (εἵλετ’ = εἵλετο): ’took (for himself)’
glossary.εὐπλοίην: εὔπλοια — fair voyage, good sailing; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic εὔπλοιαν)
glossary.εὑ: ἕ, οὗ, οἷ — him, her, himself; 3rd-person pron., gen. sg. εὑ, epic (= Attic οὗ)
glossary.θοῇσι: θοός — swift; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.θυμαρέα: θυμαρής — pleasing to the heart (θυμός with the root of ἀραρίσκω ’fit’); adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic θυμαρῆ)
glossary.κάλλιπον: καταλείπω — leave behind; aor. 1 sg., with apocope (κάλλιπον = κατέλιπον): ’I left’
glossary.κάλλος: κάλλος — beauty; neut. acc. sg.: ’in beauty’
glossary.κάτθαν: καταθνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 sg., with apocope, elided and unaugmented (κάτθαν’ = κατέθανε)
glossary.καρὸς: Κάρ — a Carian; masc. gen. sg. Καρός (reading disputed; ancient alternatives were offered)
glossary.κατακοιμηθήτω: κατακοιμάομαι — go to sleep, lie down to sleep; aor. imper. 3 sg. (passive form, middle sense): ’let him sleep’
glossary.κεύθῃ: κεύθω — hide, conceal; pres. subj. 3 sg. (in a general relative clause with κε): ’hides’
glossary.κτητοὶ: κτητός — to be acquired, gettable; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κύνεός: κύνεος — dog-like, shameless as a dog; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic κύνειος)
glossary.λάβῃσι: λαμβάνω — take, catch, get hold of; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic λάβῃ)
glossary.λάϊνος: λάϊνος — of stone; masc. nom. sg. (Attic λίθινος)
glossary.λεϊστὴ: λεϊστός (ληϊστός) — to be taken as plunder; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ληϊστοὶ: ληϊστός — to be taken as plunder, raidable; masc. nom. pl. (Attic ληστός)
glossary.μάρνασθαι: μάρναμαι — fight, battle; pres. inf.: ’to fight’
glossary.μάσσεται: μαίομαι — seek out, procure; fut. 3 sg. mid., doubled σ (= μάσεται)
glossary.μάστακ: μάσταξ — mouth, jaws; morsel of food; fem. acc. sg. μάστακα, elided (μάστακ’ = μάστακα)
glossary.μένοντι: μένω — stay, remain; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to the one who stays’
glossary.μαρνάμενος: μάρναμαι — fight, battle; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’fighting’
glossary.μεμαῶτας: μέμονα (μάω) — be eager, strive; perf. part. masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic μεμαότας), present sense: ’eager’
glossary.μνηστὴν: μνηστός — wooed, wedded (of a wife won by wooing); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μούνου: μόνος (Ionic, epic μοῦνος) — only, alone; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μοῦνοι: μόνος (Ionic, epic μοῦνος) — only, alone; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νεοσσοῖσι: νεοσσός — young bird, nestling; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.νηήσας: νηέω — heap up, pile, load; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having loaded’
glossary.νωλεμὲς: νωλεμής — unceasing, unbroken; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unceasingly, without a break’
glossary.ξανθὰ: ξανθός — yellow, golden-brown, chestnut; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.οὔθ: οὔτε (elided οὔθ’, before a rough breathing) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.πάθον: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπαθον); the form also serves 3 pl.
glossary.παρήμενοι: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit by; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παραβαλλόμενος: παραβάλλω — throw beside; mid. risk, stake; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’risking’
glossary.παραμυθησαίμην: παραμυθέομαι — exhort, advise, encourage; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with ἄν: ’I would advise’
glossary.παριαύων: παριαύω — lie beside, sleep beside (ἰαύω); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πασέων: πᾶς — all, every; fem. gen. pl. πασέων, epic (= Attic πασῶν)
glossary.πείσει: πείθω — persuade; fut. 3 sg.: ’will persuade’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (πείσει’ = πείσειε): ’would persuade’
glossary.περίκειται: περίκειμαι — lie around; be left over, remain as a surplus; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.πετρηέσσῃ: πετρήεις — rocky, craggy; fem. dat. sg., epic -ήεσσα (= Attic πετρώδης)
glossary.πηλεύς: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πλεούσας: πλέω — sail; pres. part. fem. acc. pl.: ’sailing’
glossary.ποθεν: ποθέν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’whence?’
glossary.ποιήσομ: ποιέω — make, do; mid. make for oneself; fut. 1 sg. mid., elided (ποιήσομ’ = ποιήσομαι): ’I will make’
glossary.πολέμιζον: πολεμίζω — fight, wage war; impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπολέμιζον), + dat.: ’fought against’
glossary.πολεμιζέμεναι: πολεμίζω — wage war, fight; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic πολεμίζειν): ’to wage war’
glossary.πολιόν: πολιός — grey, hoary; masc. acc. sg. (also neut. nom./acc. sg.)
glossary.πονήσατο: πονέομαι — toil, labour; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’toiled’
glossary.ποτινίσεται: ποτινίσσομαι (= προσνίσσομαι) — go to, come to; pres. 3 sg., epic ποτι- for πρός (= Attic προσέρχεται)
glossary.προερύσσω: προερύω — drag forward, launch; aor. subj. 1 sg., doubled σ (= προερύσω), after ἐπήν: ’I have launched’
glossary.προφέρῃσι: προφέρω — bring forward, offer; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.πυθοῖ: Πυθώ — Pytho, the older name of Delphi, seat of Apollo’s oracle; fem. dat. sg. Πυθοῖ
glossary.πύλῃσιν: πύλη — gate; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic πύλαις)
glossary.σαῶσι: σαόω — save, keep safe (= σῴζω); pres. subj. 3 pl., contracted from σαόωσι
glossary.σαῷ: σαόω — save, keep safe (= σῴζω); pres. subj. 3 sg., contracted from σαόῃ
glossary.συμφράσσομαι: συμφράζομαι — plan together with, take counsel with; fut. 1 sg. mid., doubled σ (= συμφράσομαι)
glossary.σφετεράων: σφέτερος — their own; possessive adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.τέρπεσθαι: τέρπω — delight; mid. take pleasure, enjoy oneself (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.: ’to enjoy’
glossary.τεθαρσήκασι: θαρσέω — be bold, take heart; perf. 3 pl.: ’have taken heart’
glossary.τερπέσθω: τέρπω — delight; mid. take pleasure, enjoy oneself; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him enjoy himself’
glossary.τετλαίη: τλάω — endure, dare, bring oneself to; perf. opt. 3 sg. (τέτληκα), with ἄν: ’would dare’ (Attic τολμήσειεν)
glossary.τρίποδές: τρίπους — tripod, three-legged cauldron-stand; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τριτάτῳ: τρίτος — third; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic -ατος (= Attic τρίτῳ)
glossary.τρύζητε: τρύζω — murmur, grumble; pres. subj. 2 pl., after ὡς μή: ’that you not murmur’
glossary.τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’
glossary.φίλεον: φιλέω — love, be fond of; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐφίλουν): ’I loved’
glossary.φασὶν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl. (ν-movable), accented from the enclitic
glossary.φερέμεν: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φέρειν)
glossary.φιλέει: φιλέω — love, be fond of; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλεῖ)
glossary.φιλέουσ: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, elided (φιλέουσ’ = φιλέουσι; Attic φιλοῦσι)
glossary.φράζωνται: φράζομαι — consider, devise, plan; pres. subj. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.χάρις: χάρις — grace, favour, gratitude, thanks; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χρυσείῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
glossary.ψυχὴ: ψυχή — life, breath of life, soul, ghost; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ψυχῆς: ψυχή — life, breath of life, soul; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀΰπνους: ἄϋπνος — sleepless; fem. acc. pl. (two-ending adjective)
glossary.ἀεργὸς: ἀεργός — idle, not working; masc. nom. sg. (Attic ἀργός)
glossary.ἀλάπαξ: ἀλαπάζω — lay waste, sack, plunder; aor. 1 sg., elided (ἀλάπαξ’ = ἀλάπαξα): ’I laid waste’
glossary.ἀμείψεται: ἀμείβω — change, exchange; mid. cross, pass over; 3 sg. mid., aor. subj. (short vowel) with κεν, or fut.: ’passes’
glossary.ἀμφιμάχωμαι: ἀμφιμάχομαι — fight around, fight for; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid., after εἰ κε
glossary.ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; fem. dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
glossary.ἀπάτησε: ἀπατάω — deceive, cheat; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠπάτησε): ’deceived’
glossary.ἀπηλεγέως: ἀπηλεγέως — bluntly, without regard for consequence (sense traditional, origin uncertain); adv.
glossary.ἀποειπεῖν: ἀπεῖπον — speak out, declare plainly; aor. inf., epic uncontracted ἀποειπ- (= Attic ἀπειπεῖν)
glossary.ἀπομηνίσαντος: ἀπομηνίω — rage in wrath, hold aloof in wrath (the force of ἀπο- uncertain); aor. part. masc. gen. sg., gen. absolute with ἐμεῦ: ’with me withdrawn in wrath’
glossary.ἀποπλείειν: ἀποπλέω — sail away, sail off; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀποπλεῖν)
glossary.ἀπτῆσι: ἀπτήν — unfledged, not yet able to fly; adj., masc. dat. pl. ἀπτῆσι, agreeing with νεοσσοῖσι
glossary.ἀπόφασθε: ἀποφημί — say out, declare, report; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.
glossary.ἀριστήεσσι: ἀριστεύς — chief, best man; masc. dat. pl., epic -ήεσσι (= Attic ἀριστεῦσι)
glossary.ἀριστήων: ἀριστεύς — chief, best man; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
glossary.ἀφήτορος: ἀφήτωρ — archer (traditional gloss; another ancient view linked it with prophecy, so sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., of Apollo
glossary.ἀφροδίτῃ: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄλλην: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄξομαι: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. mid. 1 sg.: ’I will lead away, take (for myself)’
glossary.ἐθέλεσκε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελε): ’used to be willing’
glossary.ἐκτήσατο: κτάομαι — acquire, get for oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’acquired’
glossary.ἐκτῆσθαι: κτάομαι — acquire; perf. inf. mid.-pass., Ionic ἐκτῆσθαι (= Attic κεκτῆσθαι): ’to possess’
glossary.ἐμάς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐξαπάφοιτ: ἐξαπαφίσκω — deceive utterly, cheat; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐξαπάφοιτ’ = ἐξαπάφοιτο), with ἄν: ’would deceive’
glossary.ἐξαπατήσειν: ἐξαπατάω — deceive utterly; fut. inf.: ’to deceive’
glossary.ἐξοιχνεῦσι: ἐξοιχνέω — go out; pres. 3 pl., epic contracted -εῦσι (= ἐξοιχνέουσι; Attic ἐξίασι)
glossary.ἐοργώς: ῥέζω (ἔρδω) — do, accomplish; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (= Attic ἐοργώς, from ἔοργα): ’having done’
glossary.ἐπιειμένος: ἐπιέννυμι — put on, clothe; mid. clothe oneself in (+ acc.); perf. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’clothed in’
glossary.ἐπισκύζωνται: ἐπισκύζομαι — be angry at, resent; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα
glossary.ἐρίβωλον: ἐρίβωλος — rich-soiled, fertile; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρίζοι: ἐρίζω — vie, contend, rival (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’should vie’, ’could vie’
glossary.ἐρεσσέμεναι: ἐρέσσω — row; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἐρέττειν): ’to row’
glossary.ἐρρέτω: ἔρρω — go to one’s ruin, be off, be gone; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him go to ruin, be gone’ (a curse)
glossary.ἐσθλός: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐφράσσαντο: φράζω — point out; mid. consider, plan, notice; aor. 3 pl. mid., doubled σ (= Attic ἐφράσαντο)
glossary.ἐφυβρίζων: ἐφυβρίζω — insult, vaunt insolently over; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’insulting’
glossary.ἐχέφρων: ἐχέφρων — sensible, prudent (ἔχω + φρήν); adj., masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐχθρὰ: ἐχθρός — hateful, hostile; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐχθρὸς: ἐχθρός — hateful, hated; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐϊκυῖαν: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting, seem; perf. part. fem. acc. sg. (ἐοικυῖα): ’fitting, suitable’
glossary.ἐϋζώνους: ἐΰζωνος — well-girdled; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἑκατόμπυλοί: ἑκατόμπυλος — with a hundred gates; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἑλετή: ἑλετός — to be taken, capturable (αἱρέω); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑλλήσποντον: Ἑλλήσποντος — the Hellespont; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑτοίμη: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑὴν: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-person possessive adj., fem. acc. sg. ἑήν; not the relative
glossary.ἔκφυγεν: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’escaped’
glossary.ἔλαχόν: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, receive as one’s share; aor. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.)
glossary.ἔμεγ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg. ἔμε with γε, elided (ἔμεγ’ = ἔμε γε): ’me, at least’
glossary.ἔμπεδα: ἔμπεδος — steadfast, secure, firm; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἕκηλος: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἕλετο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἵλετο): ’took (for himself/herself)’
glossary.ἕνδεκά: ἕνδεκα — eleven; numeral, indecl. (accent from the enclitic)
glossary.ἕπηται: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause
glossary.ἤλιτεν: ἁλιταίνω — do wrong, sin against; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἤλιτε(ν))
glossary.ἤματί: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἡμέρᾳ), dat. of time: ’on the day’
glossary.ἥδέ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg. (article-form ἡ + -δε; Homeric pronoun)
glossary.ἦρι: ἦρι — early, early in the morning; adv., epic (from ἦρ): μάλ’ ἦρι ’very early’
glossary.ἰσοφαρίζοι: ἰσοφαρίζω — match, rival (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’should match’
glossary.ἰῇ: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. dat. sg. ἰῇ, epic (= Attic μιᾷ): ’one, the same’
glossary.ἱρὰ: ἱερός (ἱρός) — holy, sacred; neut. pl. ἱρά (shortened, = Attic ἱερά) as noun: ’sacrifices’
glossary.ἴαυον: ἰαύω — sleep, lie down to sleep; impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl. (poetic, no ordinary Attic equivalent)
glossary.ἴση: ἴσος — equal, the same; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἵκωμι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic -μι ending (= Attic ἵκωμαι): ’I come to’
glossary.ὀάρων: ὄαρ — wife, spouse; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ὀδυσεῦ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., single-σ form (Attic Ὀδυσσεῦ)
glossary.ὀρνύμεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic ὀρνύναι)
glossary.ὁρμήν: ὁρμή — onset, rush, impulse; fem. acc. sg.: ’onrush, attack’
glossary.ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’
glossary.ὑπερέσχε: ὑπερέχω — hold over, rise above; aor. 3 sg.: ’held over’
glossary.ὤλετο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’has perished, is gone’
glossary.ὤλετό: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’has perished, is gone’
glossary.ῥύονται: ῥύομαι — protect, defend, guard; pres. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.αἰδέσεται: αἰδέομαι — respect, revere (+ acc.); fut. 3 sg. mid. (or short-vowel aor. subj.), in a general relative clause: ’whoever shall revere’
glossary.αἰθούσῃ: αἴθουσα — portico, colonnaded hall; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰτωλοὶ: Αἰτωλοί — the Aetolians; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.αἰτωλοῖσιν: Αἰτωλοί — the Aetolians; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.αὐτοῖς: αὐτός — self, same; masc./neut. dat. pl., intensive with a noun: ’the very …’
glossary.αὐτῇσιν: αὐτός — self, same; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic αὐταῖς), intensive with a noun: ’the very …’
glossary.βάλλεαι: βάλλω — throw, cast, strike; pres. mid. 2 sg., uncontracted -εαι (= Attic βάλλῃ); μετὰ φρεσὶ βάλλεσθαι ’to turn over in one’s mind’
glossary.βαθυζώνους: βαθύζωνος — deep-girdled (the picture is uncertain); stock epithet of women; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βαλλομένων: βάλλω — throw, strike; pres. pass. part. gen. pl., agreeing with πύργων: ’being struck’ · also pres. pass. part. gen. pl., of men or shields being hit, with a pronoun or as gen. absolute: ’as they were struck’
glossary.βλάπτουσ: βλάπτω — harm, hinder; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (βλάπτουσ’ = βλάπτουσα): ’harming’
glossary.βλαφθεὶς: βλάπτω — harm, hinder; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having been harmed’
glossary.γεγαῶτα: γίγνομαι — be born, come to be; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., epic γεγαώς (= Attic γεγονώς): ’born, begotten’
glossary.γουνούμενος: γουνόομαι — supplicate, entreat (lit. clasp by the knees, γόνυ); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γουνῷ: γουνός — rising ground or fertile plot (sense uncertain); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.γούνεσσι: γόνυ — knee; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic γόνασι)
glossary.δάκρυσι: δάκρυον (by-form δάκρυ) — tear; neut. dat. pl. (from the athematic stem δάκρυ-)
glossary.δάμασον: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — subdue, tame, master; aor. imper. 2 sg. · also Δάμασος — Damasus, a warrior slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δάμη: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue, kill; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδάμη): ’was subdued’
glossary.δένδρεα: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δένδρα)
glossary.δέρματι: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.δαίνυνθ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυνθ’ = δαίνυντο), τ>θ before rough breathing: ’they feasted’
glossary.δαῖτ: δαίς — feast, meal; acc. sg., elided (δαῖτ’ = δαῖτα)
glossary.δεύοντο: δεύω — wet, drench; impf. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐδεύοντο): ’were wetted’
glossary.διδασκέμεναι: διδάσκω — teach; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic διδάσκειν)
glossary.διδοῖ: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 sg., epic διδοῖ (= Attic δίδωσι)
glossary.δμῳάς: δμῳή — female slave, maidservant (Attic δούλη); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δολόπεσσιν: Δόλοπες — the Dolopes, a people of Thessaly; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν
glossary.δοῦπος: δοῦπος — thud, heavy din; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δωρητοί: δωρητός — to be won by gifts, giftable; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δύναντο: δύναμαι — be able; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδύναντο)
glossary.δύῃς: δύω — enter, plunge into; aor. subj. 2 sg. (ἔδυν), with κε in a future condition: ’you enter’
glossary.δώρων: δῶρον — gift; neut. gen. pl., with ἄτερ ’without’ · also with ἐπί ’for’ (force uncertain) · also neut. gen. pl., after a verb of reaching for (ἐπεμαίετο): ’of great gifts’
glossary.εἰδόθ: οἶδα (εἴδω) — know; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εἰδόθ’ = εἰδότα), τ>θ before rough breathing; + gen.: ’knowing of’
glossary.εἰλίποδας: εἰλίπους — rolling-gaited, swaying-footed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εἰνάνυχες: εἰνάνυχος — lasting nine nights (Attic ἐννέα νύκτας); masc. nom. pl., used as an adverb: ’for nine nights’
glossary.εὐερκέος: εὐερκής — well-fenced, strongly walled; fem. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.εὐηνίνης: Εὐηνίνη — daughter of Evenus (patronymic); fem. gen. sg., epic -ης
glossary.εὐρυχόροιο: εὐρύχορος — with wide dancing-grounds, spacious; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.εὐχομένοιο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.εὐχωλῇς: εὐχωλή — prayer, vow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic εὐχαῖς; Ionic η for α)
glossary.εὑόμενοι: εὕω — singe; pres. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’being singed’
glossary.θάλαμος: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θαλέθοντες: θαλέθω — bloom, flourish; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’in full bloom, thriving’
glossary.θαλύσια: θαλύσια — first-fruits of the harvest, offered to a god; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.θυέεσσι: θύος — offering, burnt sacrifice; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic θύεσι)
glossary.θυράων: θύρα — door; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θυρῶν)
glossary.κάκιον: κακός — bad, evil; comparative κακίων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’worse’
glossary.κέλαδον: κέλαδος — din, clamour, noise; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.καθίσσας: καθίζω — seat, set down; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic καθίσας)
glossary.καθεζομένη: καθέζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καιομένῃσιν: καίω — burn; pres. part. pass. fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’burning’
glossary.καλέεσκον: καλέω — call, name; iterative impf. 3 pl. in -εσκ-, unaugmented, uncontracted: ’used to call’
glossary.καλλικόμοιο: καλλίκομος — with fair hair; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.καλλισφύρου: καλλίσφυρος — fair-ankled; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., agreeing with a woman’s name or νύμφης
glossary.καλυδῶνα: Καλυδών — Calydon, city of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καλυδῶνος: Καλυδών — Calydon, city of Aetolia; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κατέλεξεν: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; aor. 3 sg.: ’told over, told in full’
glossary.καταχθόνιος: καταχθόνιος — of the underworld, beneath the earth; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κατερήτυον: κατερητύω — hold back, restrain; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.κατηρᾶτο: καταράομαι — curse, call down curses; impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.κεδνότατοι: κεδνός — careful, trusty; superl. κεδνότατος, masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κελοίμην: κέλομαι — bid, urge; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential after ἄν: ’I would bid’
glossary.κεράμων: κέραμος — jar of baked clay; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κεχολωμένος: χολόω — anger, enrage; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’angered’
glossary.κεχολῶσθαι: χολόω — anger, enrage; perf. mid./pass. inf. (κεχόλωμαι ’be angry’): ’to be angry’
glossary.κικλήσκουσ: κικλήσκω — call, call upon; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (κικλήσκουσ’ = κικλήσκουσα)
glossary.κιοῦσαι: κίω — go; pres. part. fem. nom. pl. (κιοῦσα, = Attic ἰοῦσα): ’going, coming’
glossary.κλαῖεν: κλαίω — weep; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιεν): ’wept’
glossary.κλεοπάτρῃ: Κλεοπάτρη — Cleopatra, wife of Meleager; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κολλητὰς: κολλητός — glued, closely joined (κολλάω); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κουρήτεσσι: Κουρῆτες — the Curetes, neighbours of the Aetolians; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.κουρήτων: Κουρῆτες — the Curetes, neighbours of the Aetolians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.κουρῆτές: Κουρῆτες — the Curetes, neighbours of the Aetolians; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κουρῆτες: Κουρῆτες — the Curetes, neighbours of the Aetolians; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κούρας: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. acc. pl., Ionic/epic (= Attic κόρας)
glossary.κούρῃσιν: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic κόραις)
glossary.κρινάμενος: κρίνω — pick out, choose, select; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out (for himself)’
glossary.κτείνουσι: κτείνω — kill; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic κτείνουσι(ν))
glossary.κόλποι: κόλπος — bosom, lap, fold of a robe; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λάθετ: λήθομαι — forget, forget about; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (λάθετ’ = ἐλάθετο)
glossary.λίσσεσθαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. inf., of purpose: ’to beseech’ · also pres. inf. after ὄφελες in an unfulfilled wish, negated by μή: ’that you had not begged’ · also pres. inf. complementing ἔμελλε: ’was about to beseech’
glossary.λίσσετ: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λίσσετ’ = λίσσετο)
glossary.λαθὼν: λανθάνω — escape the notice of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. + acc.: ’escaping the notice of’
glossary.λαχνήεντι: λαχνήεις — shaggy, hairy; neut. dat. sg., epic -ήεντ- (= Attic λαχνώδει)
glossary.λείπεσθ: λείπω — leave; mid./pass. be left behind; pres. inf. mid./pass., elided (λείπεσθ’ = λείπεσθαι)
glossary.λιποίμην: λείπω — leave; mid. be left behind; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential after ἄν: ’I should be left behind’
glossary.λισσέσκετο: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκ-, unaugmented: ’kept beseeching’
glossary.λισσόμενοι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λιτάνευε: λιτανεύω — beseech, pray to; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐλιτάνευε)
glossary.λιταί: λιτή — prayer, entreaty (personified as Prayers, daughters of Zeus); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.λοιβῇ: λοιβή — libation, drink-offering; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μέγαρα: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μαρπήσσης: Μάρπησσα — Marpessa, mother of Cleopatra; fem. gen. sg., epic -ης
glossary.μείζων: μέγας — great; comparative μείζων, fem. nom. sg. (the form serves all genders): ’greater’
glossary.μελέαγρον: Μελέαγρος — Meleager, hero of Calydon; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μενεχάρμαι: μενεχάρμης — standing firm in battle, steadfast in the fray; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μητέρ: μήτηρ — mother; acc. sg., elided (μητέρ’ = μητέρα)
glossary.μνηστῇ: μνηστός — wooed, wedded (of a wife); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μοῦνον: μοῦνος — alone, single (epic = Attic μόνος); masc. acc. sg.: ’only, sole’
glossary.νηλεὲς: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἦτορ
glossary.νηπιέῃ: νηπιέη — childishness, infancy; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic νηπιότης)
glossary.νόει: νοέω — perceive, think, take to heart; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’think, ponder’
glossary.νύμφης: νύμφη — young bride, nymph; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.οἰδάνει: οἰδάνω — cause to swell; pres. 3 sg., of anger swelling the mind
glossary.οἰνοπέδοιο: οἰνόπεδον — vineyard, vine-land; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οἴῃ: οἶος — alone, only; fem. dat. sg. (= Attic μόνῃ): ’to her alone’
glossary.οὐδοῦ: οὐδός — threshold; masc. gen. sg., with ἐπεμβεβαώς
glossary.οὐκέθ: οὐκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (οὐκέθ’ = οὐκέτι), τ>θ before rough breathing
glossary.πάσασθαι: πατέομαι — taste, eat (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to eat of’
glossary.πέλοντο: πέλομαι — be, become; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐγίγνοντο)
glossary.πέμπον: πέμπω — send, convey; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπον)
glossary.πέσσων: πέσσω — cook, ripen, brood over; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic πέττων): ’brooding over’
glossary.πίνετο: πίνω — drink; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίνετο): ’was drunk’
glossary.παράρρητοί: παράρρητος — to be talked round, open to persuasion; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παραβλῶπές: παραβλώψ — squinting, looking askance; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.παρατρωπῶσ: παρατρωπάω — turn aside, bend from a course; pres. 3 pl., elided (παρατρωπῶσ’ = παρατρωπῶσι), epic frequentative of παρατρέπω
glossary.παρκατέλεκτο: παρακαταλέγομαι — lie down beside; aor. 3 sg. mid., apocopated παρκατ- (= παρακατ-)
glossary.παύροισι: παῦρος — few, little; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’few’
glossary.πεντηκοντόγυον: πεντηκοντόγυος — of fifty gyes (γύης, a land-measure of uncertain size); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος
glossary.περικαλλὲς: περικαλλής — very fair, very beautiful; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.περιχώσατο: περιχώομαι — be greatly angered (at, over + gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.περσεφόνεια: Περσεφόνεια — Persephone, queen of the dead; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.περσεφόνειαν: Περσεφόνεια — Persephone, queen of the dead; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πηλῆα: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic Πηλέα)
glossary.πιότατον: πίων — fat, rich; superl. πιότατος, neut. nom. sg.: ’richest’
glossary.ποιεύμην: ποιέω — make, do; make one’s own, adopt; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἐποιούμην)
glossary.πολέμιζε: πολεμίζω — fight, make war; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπολέμιζε)
glossary.πολλοὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πολλοῖσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic πολλοῖς): ’many’
glossary.πολυπενθέος: πολυπενθής — much-grieving, full of sorrow; fem. gen. sg. (2-term.), uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς), agreeing with ἀλκυόνος
glossary.πολυφόρβην: πολύφορβος — much-nourishing, bountiful; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πρηκτῆρά: πρηκτήρ — doer, one who accomplishes; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.προδόμῳ: πρόδομος — vestibule, the room before the main chamber; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.προθέλυμνα: προθέλυμνος — with the roots, torn up from the base; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.προμιγῆναι: προμίγνυμι — mingle first, lie with first (+ dat.); aor. pass. inf. (μιγῆναι)
glossary.προταμὼν: προτέμνω — cut off first, carve beforehand (of meat); aor. 2 part. masc. nom. sg., epic τάμ- (= Attic προτεμών)
glossary.πρόχνυ: πρόχνυ — down on the knees, bent forward (sense disputed); adv.
glossary.πυκινῶς: πυκινός — close-packed, shrewd, well-considered; adv. πυκινῶς: ’closely, shrewdly’
glossary.πύκ: πύκα — thickly, closely; adv., elided (πύκ’ = πύκα)
glossary.σανίδας: σανίς — board, plank, door-leaf; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.σθεναρή: σθεναρός — strong, mighty; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.στρεπτοὶ: στρεπτός — turnable, that can be turned or swayed; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.στρωφᾶσθαι: στρωφάω — turn about, go to and fro; pres. inf. mid., contracted, epic by-form of στρέφω: ’to go to and fro’
glossary.στυγερὰς: στυγερός — hateful, dreaded, loathsome; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.σύες: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.σῦν: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, hog, boar; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τέλεσσαν: τελέω — accomplish, finish, pay; aor. 3 pl., epic σσ, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτέλεσαν)
glossary.τίσουσιν: τίω — honour, value; fut. 3 pl. (= Attic τιμήσουσι): ’they will honour’
glossary.ταμέσθαι: τέμνω — cut; aor. 2 inf. mid., epic τάμ- (= Attic τεμέσθαι): ’to cut out for oneself’
glossary.τανύοντο: τανύω — stretch, strain; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented: ’were stretched out’
glossary.τελέθουσι: τελέθω — come to be, become, be; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.τηλύγετον: τηλύγετος — late-born, or on another view tenderly loved (meaning disputed); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τιμή: τιμή — honour, esteem, prerogative; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τοσοῦτον: τοσοῦτος — so great, so much; masc. acc. sg. (Attic form; epic τόσος, τόσσος)
glossary.τρέψειε: τρέπω — turn; aor. opt. 3 sg., optative of wish after μή: ’let … not turn’
glossary.τόσσος: τόσος — so great, so much; masc. nom. sg., epic τόσσος (= Attic τοσοῦτος)
glossary.φαίδιμ: φαίδιμος — gleaming, glorious (epic epithet of heroes); masc. voc. sg., elided (φαίδιμ’ = φαίδιμε)
glossary.φεῦγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφευγον): ’I fled’
glossary.φθάνει: φθάνω — get ahead of, outstrip; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.φιλέων: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλῶν)
glossary.φρονεόντων: φρονέω — think, be minded; pres. part. masc. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονούντων)
glossary.φύλακάς: φύλαξ — guard, watchman; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.χαλεπαίνοι: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, be angry; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to grow harsh’
glossary.χατέουσί: χατέω — need, lack, wish for; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χατοῦσι): ’though they need’
glossary.χλούνην: χλούνης — meaning not known, ’solitary’ being an ancient guess; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σῦν
glossary.ψιλὴν: ψιλός — bare, stripped; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀΐδην: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god of the dead; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀΐδην (= Attic Ἅιδην)
glossary.ἀάσατο: ἀάω — bewilder, cloud the mind; aor. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’was bewildered’
glossary.ἀγανῇσι: ἀγανός — gentle, kindly; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀγαναῖς)
glossary.ἀγορέων: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. gen. pl., epic uncontracted -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἀκούοντος: ἀκούω — hear, listen; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with the pronoun τοῦ: ’as he heard’
glossary.ἀλέγουσι: ἀλέγω — care for, heed, see to; pres. 3 pl., + gen. or acc.
glossary.ἀλαλκών: ἀλέξω — ward off; 2nd aor. part. (ἀλαλκεῖν) masc. nom. sg.: ’warding off’
glossary.ἀλθαίῃ: Ἀλθαίη — Althaea, mother of Meleager; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλκυόνην: Ἀλκυόνη — Alcyone (’halcyon’), the by-name given to Cleopatra; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλκυόνος: ἀλκυών — halcyon, kingfisher; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλοία: ἀλοιάω — beat, strike; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠλοία)
glossary.ἀλωήν: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard, cultivated plot; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard, cultivated plot; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμαθύνει: ἀμαθύνω — level to dust, reduce to rubble; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀμείλιχον: ἀμείλιχος — ungentle, relentless; adj. (2-term.), neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμειβόμενοι: ἀμείβομαι — take turns, alternate; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμυνέμεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
glossary.ἀμυνόμενοι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; mid. pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’defending themselves, defending’
glossary.ἀμύντορος: Ἀμύντωρ — Amyntor, father of Phoenix; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμύνῃς: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα
glossary.ἀνήνηται: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject, disdain; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a general relative clause with κε
glossary.ἀνήρπασε: ἀναρπάζω — snatch up, snatch away; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀναίνετο: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject, disdain; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠναίνετο): ’refused’
glossary.ἀναπρήσας: ἀναπρήθω (root uncertain) — burst out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: δάκρυ’ ἀναπρήσας ’bursting into tears’, the traditional sense
glossary.ἀπέειπεν: ἀπεῖπον — refuse, renounce; aor. 3 sg., epic ἀπέειπεν (= Attic ἀπεῖπεν)
glossary.ἀπήμυνεν: ἀπαμύνω — ward off (from, + dat.); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀποβλύζων: ἀποβλύζω — spurt out; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀποείπῃ: ἀπεῖπον — refuse, renounce; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ἀποείπῃ (= Attic ἀπείπῃ), in a general relative clause with κε
glossary.ἀποξύσας: ἀποξύω — scrape off; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπορρίψαντα: ἀπορρίπτω — throw away, cast off; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀποτίσῃ: ἀποτίνω — pay back, atone for; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’he may pay for’
glossary.ἀρέων: ἀρή — curse, prayer; fem. gen. pl., epic uncontracted -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἀργιόδοντα: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed, white-tusked; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρετὴ: ἀρετή — excellence, valour; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀριπρεπέες: ἀριπρεπής — outstanding; masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀριπρεπεῖς)
glossary.ἀρτίπος: ἀρτίπους — sound of foot, with sound feet; fem. nom. sg. (2-term.)
glossary.ἀτιμάζεσκε: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, slight; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’used to dishonour’
glossary.ἀφνειὸν: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀχέουσ: ἀχέω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἀχέουσ’ = ἀχέουσα), epic uncontracted
glossary.ἀϋτὴν: ἀϋτή — shout, battle-cry; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἁλώῃ: ἁλίσκομαι — be caught, be taken; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἁλῷ), in a general relative clause: ’is taken’
glossary.ἁμάρτῃ: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, err, do wrong; aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὅτε κέν: ’has erred’
glossary.ἄναχθ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. acc. sg., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἄναχθ’ = ἄνακτα)
glossary.ἄνθεσι: ἄνθος — blossom, flower; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄνθρωποι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄρηι: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg. (Ἄρηϊ)
glossary.ἄροσιν: ἄροσις — ploughing, ploughland; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄσαιμι: ἄω — satiate, fill full; aor. opt. 1 sg. (ἄσα-), of a repeated past action: ’I would fill’
glossary.ἄτη: ἄτη — bewilderment, blind folly (personified as a goddess); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐΰζωνος: εὔζωνος — well-girdled; fem. nom. sg. (2-term.), epic ἐΰ-
glossary.ἐβάλλετο: βάλλω — throw, strike; impf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was struck’ · also βάλλω, impf. mid. 3 sg.: ’threw about himself, slung’ (ἀμφ’ ὤμοισιν ἐβάλλετο τόξα ’slung the bow about his shoulders’)
glossary.ἐθέλεσκες: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; iterative impf. 2 sg. in -εσκ-: ’you would (not) consent’
glossary.ἐλέγξῃς: ἐλέγχω — put to shame, disgrace, refute; aor. subj. 2 sg., prohibitive with μή
glossary.ἐλλίσσονθ: ἐλλίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; impf. 3 pl., elided (ἐλλίσσονθ’ = ἐλλίσσοντο), τ>θ before rough breathing
glossary.ἐμήν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐμοῖσιν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ἐνάριζον: ἐναρίζω — slay, strip of armour; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἠνάριζον)
glossary.ἐνέπρηθον: ἐμπρήθω — set on fire, burn; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐνταῦθα: ἐνταῦθα — there, in that direction; adv.
glossary.ἐξακέονται: ἐξακέομαι — heal completely, cure; pres. 3 pl. mid., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξακοῦνται)
glossary.ἐξελθεῖν: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. inf.
glossary.ἐξετέλειον: ἐκτελέω — bring fully to completion, fulfil; impf. 3 pl., epic -ει- (= Attic ἐξετέλουν)
glossary.ἐξικόμην: ἐξικνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 1 sg.: ’I came to’
glossary.ἐξῆλθον: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.)
glossary.ἐπέβησ: ἐπιβαίνω — mount, step upon; aor. 1 causal: ’set upon’; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐπέβησ’ = ἐπέβησε)
glossary.ἐπαινὴ: ἐπαινός — dread, awful, grim (exact sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Persephone
glossary.ἐπαινὴν: ἐπαινός — dread, awful, grim (exact sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg., stock epithet of Persephone
glossary.ἐπαρὰς: ἐπαρά — curse, imprecation; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐπεκέκλετ: ἐπικέλομαι — call upon, invoke; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπεκέκλετ’ = ἐπεκέκλετο)
glossary.ἐπεμβεβαὼς: ἐπεμβαίνω — step upon, tread on (+ gen.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -αώς (= Attic -βεβηκώς)
glossary.ἐπευθόμεθα: πεύθομαι (= πυνθάνομαι) — learn by inquiry, hear tell of; 1 pl. past tense, augmented ἐ-πευθ-, epic (= Attic ἐπυθόμεθα)
glossary.ἐπιείκελ: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐπιείκελ’ = ἐπιείκελε)
glossary.ἐπιζάφελος: ἐπιζάφελος — violent, vehement; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιπροέηκεν: ἐπιπροΐημι — send forth to, send after; aor. 3 sg., epic ἐπιπροέηκεν (= Attic ἐπιπροῆκεν)
glossary.ἐπισχών: ἐπέχω — hold out to, hold to; aor. 2 part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπώνυμον: ἐπώνυμος — given as a name, by-name; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., predicate: ’as a by-name’
glossary.ἐρέβεσφιν: Ἔρεβος — Erebus, the dark underworld; neut. gen./abl., epic -φιν: ’from Erebus’
glossary.ἐραννῆς: ἐραννός — lovely, delightful; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐρητύετ: ἐρητύω — restrain, hold back; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἐρητύετ’ = ἐρητύετο)
glossary.ἐρινὺς: Ἐρινύς — an Erinys, an avenging spirit that answers a curse; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐρινῦς: Ἐρινύς — an Erinys, an avenging spirit that answers a curse; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐσχατιὴν: ἐσχατιή — edge, border, remotest part; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐτέλειον: τελέω — fulfil, accomplish; impf. 3 pl., epic -ει- (= Attic ἐτέλουν)
glossary.ἐφέσσεσθαι: ἐφέζομαι — sit upon (+ dat.); fut. inf., epic -σσ-: ’would sit’
glossary.ἐφίλησ: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐφίλησ’ = ἐφίλησε)
glossary.ἐχθήρειε: ἐχθαίρω — hate; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might hate’
glossary.ἑλλάδος: Ἑλλάς — Hellas, the land of the Hellenes; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑρκίον: ἑρκίον — fence, enclosing wall; neut. acc. sg. (diminutive of ἕρκος)
glossary.ἔγωγέ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with emphatic γε (ἔγωγε): ’I for my part’
glossary.ἔθηκα: τίθημι — put, place; make (so-and-so); aor. 1 sg. (κ-aorist): ’I made’
glossary.ἔθων: ἔθω — be accustomed (probably); part. masc. nom. sg., epic, from the perfect stem of εἴωθα: ’haunting’ (traditional, not certain)
glossary.ἔκλυεν: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔπειθον: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 pl. (the ending also serves 1 sg.): ’they tried to persuade’
glossary.ἔργων: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ἔρεξα: ῥέζω — do, perform; esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ἔρρεξε: ῥέζω — do, perform; esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔσβη: σβέννυμι — quench, extinguish; intr. root aor. 3 sg. ἔσβη: ’went out, was quenched’
glossary.ἔσφαζον: σφάζω — slaughter; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were slaughtering’
glossary.ἔται: ἔτης — kinsman, clansman (not ἔτος ’year’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἕρδεσκεν: ἕρδω — do, work; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’used to do’
glossary.ἠεροφοῖτις: ἠεροφοῖτις — walking in the mist or darkness; fem. nom. sg., epithet of the Erinys
glossary.ἡβώοντα: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic -ώοντα (= Attic ἡβῶντα)
glossary.ἤμυνε: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἤνωγον: ἄνωγα — order, bid, urge (perf. with pres. sense); impf. 3 pl. ἤνωγον, epic: ’they urged’
glossary.ἰούσας: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. fem. acc. pl.: ’coming’
glossary.ἱερῆας: ἱερεύς — priest; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic ἱερεῖς)
glossary.ἴδεώ: Ἴδας — Idas, a hero of Messene, husband of Marpessa; masc. gen. sg., Ionic -εω (= Attic Ἴδου)
glossary.ἵκοι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general clause after ὅτε κε: ’came upon’
glossary.ὀνομάζοι: ὀνομάζω — name, mention; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ
glossary.ὀρμενίδαο: Ὀρμενίδης — son of Ormenus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ὀφθαλμώ: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the two eyes’
glossary.ὀϊσθεὶς: ὀΐομαι — suppose, suspect; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suspecting’
glossary.ὁμοιΐου: ὁμοίϊος — common to all, shared (sense disputed; ’impartial’ and ’levelling’ also guessed); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὁππόθι: ὁππόθι — where; rel. adv., epic (= Attic ὅπου)
glossary.ὄπισθ: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, afterwards, later; adv., elided (ὄπισθ’ = ὄπισθε)
glossary.ὄψου: ὄψον — relish, prepared food eaten with bread; neut. gen. sg., after ἄσαιμι
glossary.ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, welcome; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ὑπέρθορον: ὑπερθρῴσκω — leap over; 2nd aor. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.): ’I leapt over’
glossary.ὑπέστη: ὑφίστημι — promise, undertake; 2nd aor. 3 sg. intr.: ’has promised’
glossary.ὑπεκπροθέει: ὑπεκπροθέω — run forth ahead, outrun; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ὑπεκπροθεῖ)
glossary.ὑπερβήῃ: ὑπερβαίνω — step over, transgress; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ήῃ (= Attic ὑπερβῇ), after ὅτε κέν
glossary.ὑποσταίη: ὑφίστημι — promise, undertake; 2nd aor. opt. 3 sg. intr., in a remote condition after εἰ κεν: ’were to promise’
glossary.ὑποσχόμενοι: ὑπίσχομαι — promise, undertake; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’promising’
glossary.ὑψηρεφέος: ὑψηρεφής — high-roofed; masc. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.ὠρίνετο: ὀρίνω — stir up, agitate; impf. 3 sg. pass.: ’was stirred, was shaken’
glossary.ὤνησαν: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; aor. 3 pl. (gnomic): ’they benefit’
glossary.ὤπασε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ῥέξ: ῥέζω — do, perform; esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ῥέξ’ = ῥέξε)
glossary.ῥήξας: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ῥίζῃσι: ῥίζα — root; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ῥίζαις)
glossary.ῥητῆρ: ῥητήρ — speaker, orator; masc. acc. sg., elided (ῥητῆρ’ = ῥητῆρα)
glossary.αἰπεῖαν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer, lofty; fem. acc. sg. (fem. αἰπεῖα; = αἰπεινός in sense)
glossary.αἱματόεντος: αἱματόεις — bloody, blood-stained; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -όεντος
glossary.αἴδεσσαι: αἰδέομαι — respect, show reverence for (+ acc.); aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic doubled σσ (= Attic αἰδέσαι): ’show respect to’
glossary.αὐτόθι: αὐτόθι — on the spot, in that very place, right there; adv. (= Attic αὐτοῦ)
glossary.βασίλευε: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’be king!’ (same form as the unaugmented impf. 3 sg.)
glossary.γεραιὲ: γεραιός — old, aged; as a noun, an old man; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.γυνή: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δεξαμένῳ: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’having accepted’
glossary.διδούς: δίδωμι — give, offer; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’giving’
glossary.διομήδη: Διομήδη — Diomede, a woman from Lesbos, daughter of Phorbas; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δμωῇσι: δμῳή (δμωή) — maidservant, female slave; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic δμωαῖς)
glossary.εὐπήκτου: εὔπηκτος — well-framed, well-built; adj. (2-term.), gen. sg., agreeing with a fem. noun
glossary.εὗδε: εὕδω — sleep; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was sleeping, slept’
glossary.κήδειν: κήδω — distress, trouble, vex; pres. inf. act., after καλόν: ’to distress’
glossary.κήδιστοί: κήδιστος — closest-tied, nearest and dearest (superl. of κήδιος, from κῆδος ’care, tie’); masc. nom. pl., predicative with ἔμεναι
glossary.κήδῃ: κήδω — distress, trouble, vex (+ acc.); pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause after ὅς κε: ’whoever distresses’
glossary.κατέλεκτο: καταλέγω — lay down; mid. lie down; aor. 3 sg. mid., root aorist: ’lay down’
glossary.κατελέξατο: καταλέγομαι — lie down, go to sleep; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’laid himself down’
glossary.κεῖνός: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοιμήσασθε: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. lie down to sleep; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’lie down to sleep!’
glossary.κρανέεσθαι: κραίνω — accomplish, bring to an end; fut. inf. mid. (passive sense), epic κρανέεσθαι (= Attic κρανεῖσθαι): ’to be brought to an end’
glossary.κτείνοντ: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (κτείνοντ’ = κτείνοντα): ’killing’
glossary.κυπέλλοις: κύπελλον — cup, goblet; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.κώεά: κῶας — fleece, sheepskin; neut. nom./acc. pl. κώεα, epic uncontracted, accented before enclitic τε
glossary.λέξεο: λέγω (II) — lay; mid. lie down; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic λέξαι)
glossary.λίνοιό: λίνον — flax, linen thread, linen; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), accented before enclitic τε
glossary.λεπτὸν: λεπτός — fine, thin, delicate; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λεσβόθεν: Λέσβος — Lesbos, island in the Aegean; with the suffix -θεν ’from’: ’from Lesbos’; adv.
glossary.μέμαμεν: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. 1 pl. (pres. sense), + inf.: ’we are eager to’
glossary.μένωμεν: μένω — stay, remain; pres. subj. 1 pl., in an indirect alternative question after ἦ κε: ’whether we are to stay’
glossary.μένῃ: μένω — stay, remain; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a clause of duration after εἰς ὅ κε: ’as long as … stays’ · also in an indirect alternative question after ἤ κεν … ἦ κε: ’whether he stays’
glossary.μίμνων: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’staying’
glossary.μαχήσεται: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); fut. 3 sg. (= Attic μαχεῖται): ’will fight’
glossary.μείρεο: μείρομαι — receive as one’s share, take one’s portion; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic μείρου), + gen. of the whole
glossary.μεδήσομαι: μέδομαι — think of, take thought for (+ gen.); fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall give thought to’
glossary.μεδοίατο: μέδομαι — think of, take thought for (+ gen.); pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο), in a purpose clause after a past tense
glossary.μετανάστην: μετανάστης — migrant, one who has moved to a new home and has no standing in it; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μετατρέπεται: μετατρέπω — turn about; mid. turn oneself to, give heed to (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’pays regard to’
glossary.μνήσομαι: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember, call to mind (+ gen.); fut. 1 sg. mid. (or short-vowel aor. subj.), in a temporal clause: ’whenever I remember’
glossary.μυρία: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun
glossary.μύθοιο: μῦθος — word, speech, talk; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.νεώμεθ: νέομαι — go, go back, return; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., elided (νεώμεθ’ = νεώμεθα), in an indirect alternative question: ’whether we are to go back’
glossary.νηλής: νηλεής — pitiless, merciless; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., contracted epic νηλής (= νηλεής)
glossary.νόστοιο: νόστος — return home; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the thing thought of, after μέδομαι: ’of going home’
glossary.οἰδάνεται: οἰδάνω (= οἰδέω) — swell, make swell; mid./pass. swell; pres. 3 sg. mid., of a heart swelling with anger: ’swells’
glossary.οἴης: οἶος — alone, only, sole; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.πάντά: πᾶς — all, every, everything; neut. acc. pl. πάντα, accent thrown back by the enclitic τι: ’everything’
glossary.παρίσχομεν: παρίσχω (epic by-form of παρέχω) — offer, furnish, provide; pres. 1 pl. act.: ’we offer’
glossary.παραμυθήσασθαι: παραμυθέομαι — exhort, advise, win over by words; aor. inf. mid., after ἔφη: ’that he would advise’
glossary.πατρόκλῳ: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πιμπλάνεται: πίμπλημι — fill; mid./pass. be filled, + gen.; epic by-form πιμπλάνομαι; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’is filled with’
glossary.πληθύος: πληθύς — throng, crowd, multitude; fem. gen. sg. πληθύος, object of ἐκ though the preposition may stand after it: ’from the throng’
glossary.πολύαιν: πολύαινος — much-praised, of great renown; masc. voc. sg., elided (πολύαιν’ = πολύαινε)
glossary.σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the thing one takes one’s fill of
glossary.σαῷς: σαόω (= σώζω) — save, keep safe; pres. subj. 2 sg. act., contracted from σαόῃς, in an indirect question after ὅππως κεν: ’you may save’
glossary.σβέσσαι: σβέννυμι — quench, put out; aor. inf. act., epic doubled σσ (= Attic σβέσαι): ’to quench’
glossary.σκῦρον: Σκῦρος — Scyros, island in the Aegean; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σμῦξαι: σμύχω — burn slowly, consume in smouldering fire; aor. inf. act., with κατά in tmesis (= κατασμῦξαι): ’burn down’
glossary.σπείσαντες: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.στορέσαι: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. inf. act.: ’to spread’
glossary.στόρεσαν: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they spread’
glossary.σχήσεσθαι: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. hold oneself back, refrain; fut. inf. mid. σχήσεσθαι (fut. of the aor. stem σχ-): ’will hold himself back’
glossary.σύγχει: συγχέω — pour together, confuse, trouble; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., epic σύγχει (= Attic συγχέε), after μή: ’do not confuse!’
glossary.σὰ: σός — your (sg.); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’your (gifts)’
glossary.τεθνηῶτος: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. gen. sg., epic τεθνηώς (Attic τεθνεώς): ’dead’
glossary.τελαμωνιάδης: Τελαμωνιάδης — son of Telamon, i.e. Ajax; masc. nom. sg., patronymic
glossary.τεταρπόμενοι: τέρπω — delight; mid. take one’s fill of, enjoy (+ gen.); reduplicated aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having had one’s fill’
glossary.τῇδέ: ὅδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., fem. dat. sg., accented before enclitic γε, with a noun: ’this’ (τῇδε ὁδῷ ’by this road’)
glossary.φαινομένηφι: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; pres. part. mid. fem. dat. sg. with epic -ηφι (= Attic -ῃ): ’appearing’
glossary.φανῇ: φαίνω — show; mid./pass. appear, shine; aor. subj. 3 sg. pass. (ἐφάνην), after ἐπεί κε: ’appears’
glossary.φιλέειν: φιλέω — love, be fond of; pres. inf., uncontracted (= Attic φιλεῖν)
glossary.φιλέοντι: φιλέω — love, treat as a friend; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= φιλοῦντι)
glossary.φιλότητος: φιλότης — friendship, love; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φονῆος: φονεύς — slayer, murderer; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.φράζεσθαι: φράζω — point out, tell; mid. φράζομαι consider, think out, devise; pres. inf. mid., after ἄνωγεν: ’to consider’
glossary.φρασσόμεθ: φράζομαι — consider, plan, devise; fut. 1 pl. mid., epic doubled σσ (= Attic φρασόμεθα), elided: ’we shall consider’
glossary.φόρβαντος: Φόρβας — Phorbas, a man of Lesbos; masc. gen. sg. Φόρβαντος
glossary.ἀγγελέουσι: ἀγγέλλω — announce, report, carry word; fut. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted -έουσι (= Attic ἀγγελοῦσι)
glossary.ἀγηνορίῃσιν: ἀγηνορίη — manliness, pride, arrogance; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἀγηνορίαις)
glossary.ἀγόρευσε: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευσε)
glossary.ἀναίνεται: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject, disown; pres. 3 sg. mid., + acc.
glossary.ἀνασταδόν: ἀνασταδόν — standing up, rising to one’s feet; adv. (from ἀνίστημι)
glossary.ἀντίθεος: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. nom. sg., general epithet of heroes
glossary.ἀπέχθηαι: ἀπεχθάνομαι — become hateful (to), incur hatred (+ dat.); aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., open epic -ηαι (= Attic ἀπέχθῃ), in a negative purpose clause after ἵνα μή: ’that you not become hateful’
glossary.ἀπαγγεῖλαι: ἀπαγγέλλω — bring word back, report; aor. inf.
glossary.ἀποτίσας: ἀποτίνω — pay back, pay in full; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having paid’
glossary.ἀσύφηλον: ἀσύφηλος — sense not known; the traditional gloss is ’insulting, disgraceful’; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’disgracefully’ (or masc. acc., predicative with a person)
glossary.ἀτίμητον: ἀτίμητος — unhonoured, without honour; adj. (2-term.), masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀϋτμὴ: ἀϋτμή — breath, breathing; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄληκτόν: ἄληκτος — unceasing, relentless, not to be stopped; adj. (2-term.), masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλά: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl., accent thrown back by enclitic τε: ’other things’ (not the conj. ἀλλά ’but’) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’other things’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα εἴλυται ’all other things are wrapped’)
glossary.ἄττα: ἄττα — father; voc. sg., a respectful address by a younger man to an older one, carrying no kinship
glossary.ἄωτον: ἄωτος — nap, flock; the fine finishing nap of cloth; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἅλαδ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε, elided (ἅλαδ’ = ἅλαδε): ’seaward’
glossary.ἐείσαο: εἴδομαι — seem, appear; aor. indic. 2 sg. mid. ἐείσαο (augment ἐ- before the root’s ϝ-), + inf.: ’you seemed (to)’
glossary.ἐλέξατο: λέχομαι — lie down, lay oneself down to sleep; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’lay down’
glossary.ἐνυῆος: Ἐνυεύς — Enyeus, a lord of Scyros, whose city Achilles took; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ἐνῆκας: ἐνίημι — send into, put into, drive into; aor. 2 sg. act. (κ-aorist), augmented: ’you drove into’
glossary.ἐξερέεινεν: ἐξερεείνω — ask out, question closely; impf. 3 sg., epic
glossary.ἐπιπειθόμεναι: ἐπιπείθομαι — obey, comply (with); pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’obeying’
glossary.ἐρητύεται: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain, check; pass. be held back; pres. 3 sg. pass.: ’is restrained’
glossary.ἔμιμνεν: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, wait, wait for (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. (Attic ἔμενεν): ’waited for’
glossary.ἔξοχ: ἔξοχα — exceedingly, surpassingly; adv., elided (ἔξοχ’ = ἔξοχα)
glossary.ἔρχεσθε: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’go, come’
glossary.ἕξει: ἔχω — have, hold; fut. 3 sg. (rough breathing): ’will have, will keep’
glossary.ἡμέτερ: ἡμέτερος — our; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἡμέτερ’ = ἡμέτερα), used as a noun: ’our own (places)’
glossary.ἥρωϊ: ἥρως — hero, warrior; masc. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἥρῳ)
glossary.ἴῃσιν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἴῃ), after ἤ κεν: ’whether he goes’
glossary.ἵλαον: ἵλαος — gracious, kindly, propitious; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ἵλεως)
glossary.ἶφις: Ἶφις — Iphis, a woman taken captive from Scyros; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
glossary.ὀρώρῃ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, set in motion; perf. subj. 3 sg. (of ὄρωρα ’have risen, am stirred’), intrans.: ’be stirring’
glossary.ὄρσῃ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., trans., in a clause after ὁππότε κε: ’may rouse’
glossary.ὑπωρόφιοι: ὑπωρόφιος — under one’s roof, as a guest; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ῥῆγός: ῥῆγος — rug, blanket; neut. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.αἴθωνος: αἴθων — blazing, tawny, fiery; adj., masc. gen. sg., of a lion
glossary.αὐδήσαντος: αὐδάω — speak, utter; aor. act. part. masc. gen. sg., with a verb of hearing: ’of one who spoke’
glossary.αὐλῶν: αὐλός — pipe, reed-pipe; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.βλεφάροισιν: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.βουλὴ: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βροτοὶ: βροτός — mortal; masc. nom. pl., as a noun: ’mortals, men’
glossary.γιγνομένοισιν: γίγνομαι — be born, come to be; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic γιγνομένοις): ’as they are born’
glossary.γλυκερὸς: γλυκερός — sweet; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic γλυκύς)
glossary.δαφοινὸν: δαφοινός — deep-red, blood-red; adj., neut. acc. sg., of a hide
glossary.δείδω: δείδω (= δέδοικα) — fear, be afraid; pres. 1 sg., + μή and a verb: ’I fear that…’
glossary.δηθά: δηθά — for long, a long while; adv., epic (= Attic πολὺν χρόνον)
glossary.δολιχόν: δολιχός — long; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’for long’ (= Attic μακρός)
glossary.δραίνεις: δραίνω — be active, be minded to act; pres. 2 sg. (epic verb related to Attic δράω): ’you have a plan’
glossary.δυσμενέας: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; used substantivally, ’enemies’; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενεῖς)
glossary.δυσμενέες: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; used substantivally, ’enemies’; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενεῖς)
glossary.εἵαται: ἧμαι — sit, be seated, be posted; perf. mid. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic κάθηνται)
glossary.εὕδουσι: εὕδω — sleep; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic καθεύδουσι): ’they sleep’
glossary.ζωστὴρ: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ζώννυθ: ζώννυμι — gird, put a belt on; impf. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (ζώννυθ’ = ζώννυτο = Attic ἐζώννυτο): ’girded himself’
glossary.θέω: θέω — run; pres. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’am I to run?’
glossary.θήκατο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic -κα- form, unaugmented (= Attic ἔθετο): ’put on (for himself)’
glossary.θαύμαζεν: θαυμάζω — marvel, wonder, gaze in wonder at; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐθαύμαζε)
glossary.θρασυκάρδιος: θρασυκάρδιος — bold-hearted; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θωρήσσοιτο: θωρήσσω — arm with a breastplate; mid. arm oneself; pres. opt. mid. 3 sg., in a past general clause: ’whenever he armed himself’
glossary.θῆχ: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (θῆχ’ = θῆκε = Attic ἔθηκε)
glossary.κέλευθοι: κέλευθος — path, way, road; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κακότητα: κακότης — badness, misery, trouble; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καταβήομεν: καταβαίνω — go down; aor. subj. 1 pl. act., epic -ήομεν (= Attic καταβῶμεν): ’let us go down’
glossary.κερδαλέης: κερδαλέος — crafty, shrewd, resourceful; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), agreeing with βουλῆς
glossary.κεφαλῆφιν: κεφαλή — head; fem. sg. with the epic suffix -φιν, locative or instrumental (= Attic dat. κεφαλῇ): ’on the head’ · also with ἀπό, separative: ’from the head’
glossary.κοιμήσωνται: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid./pass. fall asleep; aor. subj. mid. 3 pl., after μή: ’lest they fall asleep’
glossary.κορύσσεαι: κορύσσω — arm, equip with a helmet; mid. arm oneself; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic κορύσσῃ): ’you arm yourself’
glossary.κραδίης: κραδίη — heart; fem. gen. sg. (= Attic καρδίας)
glossary.κυδάλιμον: κυδάλιμος — glorious, noble; adj., masc./neut. acc. sg., epithet of the heart (κῆρ)
glossary.κυδαίνων: κυδαίνω — honour, glorify, cheer; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’giving glory to’
