glossary.κύκλοι: κύκλος — circle, ring; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κύπρον: Κύπρος — Cyprus; fem. acc. sg. (with the following -δε written apart, ’to Cyprus’)
glossary.λάμπ: λάμπω — shine, gleam; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λάμπ’ = λάμπε; Attic ἔλαμπε): ’shone’
glossary.λευκοί: λευκός — white, bright; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λεχέων: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic λεχῶν)
glossary.λιασθεὶς: λιάζομαι — turn aside, draw back; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λύγοισι: λύγος — withy, pliant willow-twig; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), instrumental
glossary.μάκαρος: μάκαρ — blessed, fortunate, prosperous; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μέσοισιν: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μακρά: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δένδρεα μακρά ’tall trees’)
glossary.μαρναμένοισιν: μάρναμαι — fight, battle; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to those fighting’
glossary.μετεκίαθον: μετακιάθω (epic κιάθω ’go’) — go after, follow; impf. 3 pl. act., augment inside the compound: ’went after, followed’
glossary.μετώπιον: μετώπιον — forehead, brow; neut. acc. sg., of the place struck: ’on the forehead’
glossary.μνώοντ: μνάομαι — be mindful of, think of (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic uncontracted, unaugmented, elided (μνώοντ’ = μνώοντο; Attic ἐμνῶντο)
glossary.μυδαλέας: μυδαλέος — damp, wet, dripping; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.μόσχοισι: μόσχος — young shoot, sapling; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also μόσχος — calf, young animal; same form
glossary.νέφεϊ: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.οἶμοι: οἶμος — strip, band (of metal inlay); masc. nom. pl. (distinct from the interjection οἴμοι)
glossary.οὔλιος: οὔλιος — ruinous, baneful (traditional sense; a longer form of οὖλος ’destructive’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὖς: οὖς — ear; neut. acc. sg. (gen. ὠτός)
glossary.πάμφαινον: παμφαίνω — shine brightly, gleam all over; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.πάρεσαν: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; impf. 3 pl., epic ἔσαν (= Attic παρῆσαν)
glossary.παμφαίνοντας: παμφαίνω — shine brightly, gleam; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’gleaming’
glossary.παρέβασκε: παραβάσκω (a -σκ- form beside παραβαίνω; rare) — go beside, stand beside; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound: ’stood beside’
glossary.παρετύγχανε: παρατυγχάνω — happen to be present, be at hand; impf. 3 sg., augment inside the compound: ’was present’
glossary.πεπάλακτο: παλάσσω — splash, spatter, besmear; plpf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’was spattered’
glossary.περίδυσε: περιδύω — strip off, strip all round; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic περιέδυσε): ’stripped off’
glossary.περικλυτός: περικλυτός — very famous, far-famed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεύθετο: πεύθομαι (epic by-form of πυνθάνομαι) — learn, hear of; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπεύθετο)
glossary.ποιμαίνοντ: ποιμαίνω — tend (a flock), shepherd; pres. part. act. masc. acc. dual, elided (ποιμαίνοντ’ = ποιμαίνοντε): ’the two tending’
glossary.πολυδαίδαλον: πολυδαίδαλος — richly wrought, much-adorned; masc./fem. acc. sg. (two-termination adj.)
glossary.πολύστονος: πολύστονος — much-groaning, full of sorrow (πολύς + στόνος ’groan’); masc./fem. nom. sg. (two-termination adj.)
glossary.πουλυδάμαντα: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, a Trojan, companion of Hector; masc. acc. sg., epic Πουλυ- (= Πολυ-)
glossary.πρυλέες: πρυλέες — foot-soldiers, men fighting on foot (plural noun; origin not certain); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πυκνὰ: πυκνός — thick, dense; neut. acc. pl.: ’thick’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with καρήαθ’: ’thick (heads)’
glossary.πυμάτοισι: πύματος — last, hindmost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the hindmost’
glossary.πόλυβον: Πόλυβος — Polybus, a Trojan, son of Antenor; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πᾶς: πᾶς, πᾶσα, πᾶν — all, whole, every; masc. nom. sg.: ’all, the whole man’
glossary.σπερχόμενος: σπέρχομαι — hasten, press on, be in haste; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’hastening’
glossary.σπεύδουσ: σπεύδω — hasten, hurry; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (σπεύδουσ’ = σπεύδουσα)
glossary.στήριξε: στηρίζω — fix firmly, set fast; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐστήριξε): ’set’
glossary.στεροπήν: στεροπή — lightning, flash; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἀστραπή)
glossary.στεφάνη: στεφάνη — rim of a helmet, crest-ring (also wreath, crown); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.συνέαξε: συνάγνυμι — break up, crush together; aor. 3 sg. act., augment inside the compound (aor. ἔαξα of ἄγνυμι): ’crushed’
glossary.σφε: σφε — them; epic enclitic acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτούς, αὐτάς), masc. or fem. pl.: ’them’
glossary.σφοῖσιν: σφός — their own; possessive adj., masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.σφῇ: σφός — their own; possessive adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.σχεδόν: σχεδόν — near, close at hand; adv.
glossary.τάμνων: τάμνω — cut; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic τέμνων)
glossary.τάφρῳ: τάφρος — ditch, trench; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ταρφέα: ταρφύς — thick, close-set, frequent; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic -έα
glossary.τιθωνοῖο: Τιθωνός — Tithonus, mortal prince loved by Dawn; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τιμῶσαι: τιμάω — honour; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’honouring’
glossary.τοτὲ: τοτέ (= τότε) — at one time, then, now; adv., correlative τοτὲ μέν … τοτὲ δέ ’now … now’
glossary.τοῖιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen./dat. dual, epic τοῖιν (= Attic τοῖν): ’of those two’
glossary.τύχῃσι: τυγχάνω — hit, light upon, happen (to be); aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.φάνεσκεν: φαίνομαι — appear, show oneself; aor. 3 sg. iterative -σκ-, unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’used to appear’
glossary.φέρ: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (φέρ’ = φέρε; Attic ἔφερε): ’was carrying’
glossary.φθὰν: φθάνω — be first, get ahead of; aor. 3 pl., athematic, unaugmented (= Attic ἔφθασαν): ’got ahead’
glossary.χάλκεοι: χάλκεος — of bronze; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῖ)
glossary.χαλκοβάρεια: χαλκοβάρεια — heavy with bronze (formation not certain: χαλκός + βαρύς); fem. adj., nom. sg.
glossary.χαριζόμενος: χαρίζομαι — gratify, please (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’gratifying, pleasing’
glossary.χραισμῆσαι: χραισμέω — ward off, avail, help (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.: ’to ward off’
glossary.ἀγήνορα: Ἀγήνωρ — Agenor, a Trojan, son of Antenor; masc. acc. sg. (the adj. ἀγήνωρ means ’manly, proud’)
glossary.ἀλέγιζε: ἀλεγίζω — care for, heed (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠλέγιζε): ’heeded’
glossary.ἀμητῆρες: ἀμητήρ — reaper, harvester; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφιβρότην: ἀμφιβρότη (ἀσπίς) — covering the man all round, man-covering (traditional sense); fem. adj., acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιστρεφέες: ἀμφιστρεφής — turning both ways, turned about; masc./fem. nom. pl., epic -εες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀναπλεύσεσθαι: ἀναπλέω — sail up, sail out; fut. inf. mid.: ’to sail up, to sail out’
glossary.ἀναφαίνεται: ἀναφαίνω — show forth; mid. appear, come into view; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’appears’
glossary.ἀντηνορίδας: Ἀντηνορίδης — son of Antenor; masc. acc. pl., patronymic
glossary.ἀορτήρεσσιν: ἀορτήρ — sword-strap, baldric; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἀορτῆρσι)
glossary.ἀποίνων: ἄποινα — ransom, price of release; neut. gen. pl. (plural noun), gen. of price: ’for ransom’
glossary.ἀργαλέην: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρετῇ: ἀρετή — excellence, valour, prowess; fem. dat. sg., dat. of cause or respect: ’by, in excellence’
glossary.ἀρηρός: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, fit with; ἀρηρός, a perf. participle form (formation and gender not certain; beside ἀρηρώς), + dat.: ’fitted’
glossary.ἁπαλόν: ἁπαλός — soft, tender; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. or masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄγαγεν: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg. act., reduplicated stem, unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἤγαγεν): ’led, brought’
glossary.ἄληκτον: ἄληκτος — unceasing, relentless (ἀ- + λήγω ’cease’); adj., neut. acc. sg. (masc. acc. sg. is the same), or used adverbially: ’unceasingly’
glossary.ἄλκιμα: ἄλκιμος — stout, valiant (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δοῦρε
glossary.ἄντιφον: Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, a son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἅδος: ἅδος — satiety, fill, surfeit; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅπας: ἅπας — all, the whole of, entirely; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐέρσας: ἐέρση — dew, dewdrops; fem. acc. pl., epic ἐέρση (= Attic ἕρση)
glossary.ἐβούλετο: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’he wished’
glossary.ἐγδούπησαν: ἐγδουπέω (formation not certain, perhaps ἐκ- + δουπέω) — crash, thunder; aor. 3 pl. act. (after ἐπί: ἐπεγδούπησαν)
glossary.ἐκορέσσατο: κορέννυμι — sate, satisfy; mid. have one’s fill; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐκορέσατο): ’had his fill of’
glossary.ἐκπεφυυῖαι: ἐκφύω — grow out of; perf. part. act. fem. nom. pl., epic -υυῖαι (= Attic ἐκπεφυκυῖαι): ’grown out of’
glossary.ἐλέλικτο: ἐλελίζω — coil, whirl round; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been coiled, was coiled’
glossary.ἐλαύνωσιν: ἐλαύνω — drive, push forward; pres. subj. 3 pl. act., without ἄν (epic): ’they drive’
glossary.ἐξεναρίξων: ἐξεναρίζω — strip of armour, despoil (a slain man); fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to strip’
glossary.ἐστεφάνωτο: στεφανόω — crown, set round as a crown, encircle; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was crowned, was set round’
glossary.ἑκάτερθ: ἑκάτερθε — on each side, on both sides; adv., elided (ἑκάτερθ’ = ἑκάτερθε)
glossary.ἔλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg. act., epic ἔλασε (= Attic ἤλασε): ’drove, struck’
glossary.ἔχαιρε: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; impf. 3 sg.: ’was glad’
glossary.ἔχουσαν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἠΐθεόν: ἠΐθεος — unmarried young man, youth (as epithet ’young, gallant’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἠῶθι: ἠώς — dawn, + place-suffix -θι: ’at dawn’ (ἠῶθι πρό ’before dawn’)
glossary.ἡνιόχευεν: ἡνιοχεύω — hold the reins, drive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was driving’
glossary.ἤϊξε: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented ἤϊ- (= Attic ᾖξε): ’darted’
glossary.ἧλοι: ἧλος — nail, stud; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἱδρώουσα: ἱδρόω — sweat, be in a sweat; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἱδρῶσα)
glossary.ἱππήων: ἱππεύς — horseman, charioteer; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic ἱππέων)
glossary.ἴρισσιν: ἶρις — rainbow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ισσιν (= Attic -ισι)
glossary.ἴσας: ἴσος — equal, even; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἶσόν: Ἶσος — Isus, a son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλλυμένους: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be killed; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl., epic ὀλλ- (= Attic ἀπολλυμένους): ’perishing’
glossary.ὀλλύντάς: ὄλλυμι — destroy, kill; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl., epic ὀλλ- (= Attic ἀπολλύντας): ’destroying, killing’
glossary.ὀμφαλοὶ: ὀμφαλός — navel; boss of a shield; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀρέξαι: ὀρέγω — stretch out, offer, grant; aor. inf. act.: ’to grant’ (+ acc. κῦδος ’glory’)
glossary.ὀρωρέχατο: ὀρέγω — stretch out; mid. reach, strain upward; plpf. mid./pass. 3 pl., reduplicated ὀρωρ-, epic -ατο for -ντο (no Attic prose form): ’reached up’
glossary.ὀστέου: ὀστέον — bone; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστοῦ)
glossary.ὀϊλῆα: Ὀϊλεύς — Oileus, a Trojan, comrade of Bianor (another Oileus is father of the lesser Ajax); masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ὁπλίσσατο: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare, arm; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ὡπλίσατο): ’prepared for himself’
glossary.ὁρμῆς: ὁρμή — onrush, onset, rush; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὁτὲ: ὁτέ (= τοτέ) — at one time, now; adv., correlative ὁτὲ μέν … ἄλλοτε δέ ’at one time … at another’
glossary.ὄγμον: ὄγμος — furrow, swath (row of cut grain); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄρθι: ὄρθιος — upright, steep; of the voice, high-pitched, shrill; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὄρθι’ = ὄρθια), used adverbially: ’shrilly’
glossary.ὄρνυθ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; mid. rise, arise; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (ὄρνυθ’ = ὄρνυτο; Attic ὤρνυτο): ’was rising’
glossary.ὄρουσ: ὀρούω — rush, dart, spring; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (ὄρουσ’ = ὄρουσε; augmented ὤρουσε): ’sprang, rushed’
glossary.ὑσμίνη: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight, the press of battle; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑψόθεν: ὑψόθεν — from on high, from above; adv., -θεν suffix
glossary.ὥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom./acc. dual (= Attic ὥ): ’the two whom’
glossary.ᾐτιόωντο: αἰτιάομαι — blame, accuse; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾐτιῶντο): ’blamed’
glossary.ῥήξαντο: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; mid. break (a line) for oneself; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐρρήξαντο): ’broke’
glossary.ῥώοντ: ῥώομαι — rush, dash, move swiftly; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., unaugmented, elided (ῥώοντ’ = ῥώοντο; no Attic prose form)
glossary.αἰπὺς: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. nom. sg. (αἰπὺς ὄλεθρος ’steep destruction’, ruin pictured as a fall from a height)
glossary.γουναζέσθην: γουνάζομαι — clasp the knees of, implore; impf. 3 dual mid./dep., unaugmented (= Attic ἐγουνάζεσθην)
glossary.γύπεσσιν: γύψ — vulture; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic γυψί)
glossary.δηϊόωντες: δηϊόω — cut down, slay; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δηοῦντες)
glossary.δύῃ: δύω — sink, set (of the sun); aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a clause with εἰς ὅ κε: ’sets’ (not the noun δύη ’woe’)
glossary.εἰλυφόων: εἰλυφάω — swirl, whirl, roll about; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -όων (= Attic -ῶν), with ἄνεμος: ’swirling’
glossary.εἴασχ: ἐάω — allow, let; impf. 3 sg., epic iterative -σκε- (εἴασκε), elided (εἴασχ’ = εἴασκε; Attic εἴα): ’would not allow, kept refusing to let’
glossary.ζωοὺς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ζῶντας), predicate with νῶϊ: ’alive’
glossary.θάμνοι: θάμνος — bush, shrub; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θῦεν: θύω — rage, surge, seethe; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔθυεν)
glossary.καταβάς: καταβαίνω — go down, come down; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come down’
glossary.κατακτεῖναι: κατακτείνω — kill; aor. inf. act., dependent on a verb of ordering: ’to kill’
glossary.κείατο: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., epic -ατο and unaugmented (= Attic ἔκειντο): ’lay’
glossary.κείν: κενός — empty; neut. nom. pl., epic κεινός, elided (κείν’ = κεινά; Attic κενά), agreeing with ὄχεα
glossary.κλαίοντε: κλαίω — weep, lament; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two weeping’
glossary.κολλητοῖσιν: κολλητός — glued together, well-joined; adj., neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), agreeing with ἅρμασι
glossary.κονίης: κονία — dust; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -η- (= Attic κονίας), after ἐκ: ’out of the dust’
glossary.κροτάλιζον: κροταλίζω — rattle, clatter; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκροτάλιζον)
glossary.κυδοιμοῦ: κυδοιμός — uproar, din of battle; masc. gen. sg., after ἐκ: ’out of the uproar’
glossary.κυκηθήτην: κυκάω — stir up, throw into confusion; aor. pass. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκυκήθητην): ’were thrown into confusion’
glossary.κυλίνδεσθαι: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. inf. mid./pass., of intransitive sense: ’to roll’
glossary.κόψας: κόπτω — strike, cut off; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck off’
glossary.κὰμ: κατά — down, through; prep. + acc., with apocope and assimilation before μ (κὰμ μέσσον = κατὰ μέσον): ’down through’
glossary.λαφύσσει: λαφύσσω — gulp down, devour greedily; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.μειλιχίοις: μειλίχιος — gentle, soothing; adj., neut. dat. pl., agreeing with ἐπέεσσιν
glossary.μενεχάρμην: μενεχάρμης — steadfast in battle (μένω + χάρμη ’fight’); masc. acc. sg., epithet of a warrior
glossary.μολὼν: βλώσκω — go, come (aor. ἔμολον, inf. μολεῖν); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
glossary.πίπτουσιν: πίπτω — fall; pres. 3 pl. act., ν-movable (πίπτουσι): ’fall’
glossary.παλαιοῦ: παλαιός — old, ancient; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἴλου
glossary.πείσανδρον: Πείσανδρος — Peisander, a son of Antimachus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πείσανδρόν: Πείσανδρος — Peisander, a son of Antimachus; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.πεζοὶ: πεζός — on foot; masc. nom. pl., used as a noun: ’men on foot’
glossary.πιδηέσσης: πιδήεις — rich in springs (from πίδαξ ’spring’); fem. gen. sg., epic -έσσης, agreeing with Ἴδης: ’spring-rich’
glossary.πλεῖσται: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl. superlative πλεῖστος, agreeing with φάλαγγες: ’the most numerous’
glossary.πρηνεῖς: πρηνής — face down, headlong; masc. nom. pl. (Attic πρανής)
glossary.προμάχεσθαι: προμάχομαι — fight in front of, be foremost in battle; pres. inf. mid./dep., + gen. of those surpassed, after ἔθελεν: ’to be foremost’
glossary.προσαυδήτην: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 dual, epic -ήτην and unaugmented (= Attic προσηυδάτην)
glossary.πρόρριζοι: πρόρριζος — root and all, by the roots; masc. nom. pl., predicate with θάμνοι
glossary.σφεδανὸν: σφεδανός — violent, impetuous; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’furiously’
glossary.τίσετε: τίνω — pay, pay for (a wrong); fut. 2 pl. act.: ’you shall pay’
glossary.τεῒν: σύ — you (sg.); epic dat. sg. τεΐν (= Attic σοί): ’to you’
glossary.τμήξας: τμήγω — cut, sever (epic; Attic τέμνω); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having cut off’
glossary.τυπεὶς: τύπτω — strike; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’struck, wounded’
glossary.φίλτεροι: φίλος — dear; masc. nom. pl. comparative (φίλτερος), followed by ἢ: ’dearer than’
glossary.ἀμείλικτον: ἀμείλικτος — unyielding, not to be softened (cf. ἀμείλιχος ’ungentle’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄπα
glossary.ἀμολγῷ: ἀμολγός — milking-time (?); only in νυκτὸς ἀμολγῷ ’in the dead of night, in the depths of the night’, sense and etymology disputed; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀνέμιμνον: ἀναμένω — wait for; impf. 3 pl. act., epic reduplicated -μιμν- and unaugmented (= Attic ἀνέμενον): ’waited for’
glossary.ἀνδροκτασίης: ἀνδροκτασία — man-slaying, slaughter; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), after ἐκ: ’out of the slaughter’
glossary.ἀντιμάχοιο: Ἀντίμαχος — Antimachus, a Trojan, father of Peisander and Hippolochus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνώχθω: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 3 sg. with present sense, epic (= Attic κελευέτω): ’let him bid, let him tell’
glossary.ἀξύλῳ: ἄξυλος — thick with wood, densely wooded (sense uncertain; ἀ- taken as intensive + ξύλον ’timber’); adj. of two endings, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ὕλῃ
glossary.ἀρτύνθη: ἀρτύνω — arrange, array, make ready; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠρτύνθη): ’was ordered, was set in array’
glossary.ἀστεροπὴν: ἀστεροπή — lightning, flash; fem. acc. sg. (Attic ἀστραπή)
glossary.ἀφίκηται: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid./dep., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until he reaches’
glossary.ἅλεται: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic short-vowel (= Attic ἅληται), in a general clause: ’leaps’
glossary.ἐγγυαλίξει: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hands of, hand over; fut. 3 sg. act., epic: ’will hand over’
glossary.ἐγγυαλίξω: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hands of, hand over; fut. 1 sg. act., epic: ’I shall hand over’
glossary.ἐκαρτύναντο: καρτύνω — make strong, strengthen (epic; Attic κρατύνω); aor. 3 pl. mid., augmented: ’they made firm for themselves’
glossary.ἐλθόντα: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Μενέλαον: ’having come’
glossary.ἐμπέσῃ: ἐμπίπτω — fall upon, fall into; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general simile after ὡς ὅτε: ’falls upon’
glossary.ἐνίσπες: ἐνέπω/ἐνίσπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’tell!’
glossary.ἐναίροντα: ἐναίρω — slay, kill; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀγαμέμνονα: ’slaying’
glossary.ἐνόρουσ: ἐνορούω — spring upon, rush in; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐνόρουσ’ = ἐνόρουσε), unaugmented: ’rushed in’
glossary.ἐξέμεν: ἐξίημι — send out, let go; aor. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic ἐξεῖναι): ’to let go’
glossary.ἐπειγόμενοι: ἐπείγομαι — press on, be hard pressed, hasten; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’hard pressed’
glossary.ἐρίγδουποι: ἐρίγδουπος — loud-crashing, thundering; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with πόδες
glossary.ἐριαύχενες: ἐριαύχην — strong-necked, thick-necked (ἐρι- intensive + αὐχήν); masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
glossary.ἐρινεὸν: ἐρινεός — wild fig-tree; masc. acc. sg., after παρά: ’beside the wild fig tree’
glossary.ἐστόν: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 dual (the same spelling is 3 dual): ’you two are’
glossary.ἐφέβοντο: φέβομαι — flee in terror; impf. 3 pl. mid./dep.: ’they fled in panic’
glossary.ἐφόβησε: φοβέω — put to flight, scare; aor. 3 sg. act., gnomic (in a simile): ’puts to flight’ · also aor. 3 sg. act., plain narrative: ’put to flight’ (Δαναοὺς ἐφόβησε ’put the Danaans to flight’)
glossary.ἔγκατα: ἔγκατα — entrails, innards; neut. nom./acc. pl. (only plural)
glossary.ἔκπεσον: ἐκπίπτω — fall out of; aor. 3 pl. act. (the 1 sg. has the same spelling), with gen. of that fallen from: ’fell out of’
glossary.ἔλθῃ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until … comes’
glossary.ἔσσευε: σεύω — drive, set rushing; aor. 3 sg. act., epic augmented form with doubled σ (ἔσσευε for ἔσευε): ’sent rushing’
glossary.ἔφεπε: ἐφέπω — pursue, press upon (poetic; Attic διώκω); impf. 3 sg. act.: ’pursued’
glossary.ἕπετο: ἕπομαι — follow; impf. 3 sg. mid./dep., unaugmented (= εἵπετο): ’followed’
glossary.ἡνιόχους: ἡνίοχος — charioteer, driver; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἱέμενοι: ἵεμαι — strain toward, long for, be eager; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. nom. pl., + gen.: ’making for’
glossary.ἱππεῖς: ἱππεύς — horseman; masc. nom. pl. (Attic form; epic ἱππῆες)
glossary.ὀδοῦσι: ὀδούς — tooth; masc. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with teeth’
glossary.ὁρμῇ: ὁρμή — rush, onset; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’by the rush’
glossary.ὁρᾷ: ὁράω — see; pres. subj. 3 sg. (the indic. has the same spelling), with ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν: ’as long as he sees’
glossary.ὁρᾷς: ὁράω — see; pres. subj. 2 sg. (the indic. has the same spelling), with ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν: ’as long as you see’
glossary.ὄλεκον: ὀλέκω — destroy, kill (epic by-form; Attic ἀπόλλυμι); impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented: ’were killing’
glossary.ὅλμον: ὅλμος — round block or rounded stone (sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπόεικε: ὑπείκω — give way, withdraw; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic ὑπόεικε (= Attic ὕπεικε), + gen.: ’give way from’
glossary.ὕπαγε: ὑπάγω — lead away, draw off; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὑπῆγε): ’drew away’
glossary.ὕπτιοι: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὦρσαν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise; aor. 3 pl. act., transitive: ’they raised’
glossary.αἴσυμνόν: Αἴσυμνος — Aesymnus, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.αἶγας: αἴξ — goat; masc./fem. (common gender) acc. pl.
glossary.αὐτόνοον: Αὐτόνοος — Autonous, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.βαθείῃ: βαθύς — deep; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic βαθείᾳ)
glossary.βροτολοιγῷ: βροτολοιγός — man-destroying, bane of mortals; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Ares
glossary.βόλεται: βούλομαι — wish, want; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass., epic βόλεται (= Attic βούλεται)
glossary.γήμας: γαμέω — marry, take as wife (of the man); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having married’
glossary.δάμνατο: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue; impf. 3 sg. mid.-pass., unaugmented (= ἐδάμνατο): ’was overcome’
glossary.δριμύ: δριμύς — keen, piercing, sharp; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.δόλοπα: Δόλοψ — Dolops, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.δῦνον: δύνω (δύω) — enter, sink into; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔδυνον): ’entered’
glossary.εἰλείθυιαι: Εἰλείθυια — Eileithyia, goddess of childbirth; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.εἴασαν: ἐάω — let, allow, leave alone; aor. 3 pl. act. (augment εἰ-): ’left’
glossary.θερμὸν: θερμός — hot, warm; neut. nom. sg. (also masc./neut. acc. sg.)
glossary.θηρευτῇσι: θηρευτής — hunter, hunting (of dogs); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.θρῄκῃ: Θρῄκη — Thrace; fem. dat. sg., Ionic (= Attic Θρᾴκῃ)
glossary.θυμβραῖον: Θυμβραῖος — Thymbraeus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.κάπρω: κάπρος — wild boar; masc. nom. dual: ’two boars’
glossary.καθαλλομένη: καθάλλομαι — leap down, spring down upon; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’leaping down’
glossary.καπρίῳ: κάπριος — of a boar, boarish (σῦς κάπριος ’boar’); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.καρήαθ: κάρη — head; neut. nom. pl., epic κάρηα/καρήατα (= Attic κάρα), elided and aspirated (καρήαθ’ = καρήατα)
glossary.κισσῆς: Κισσῆς — Cisses, a Thracian, father of Theano; masc. nom. sg., proper name
glossary.κιόντα: κίω — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going’
glossary.κλυτίδην: Κλυτίδης — son of Clytius; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
glossary.κοιμήσατο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. go to sleep, sleep; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκοιμήσατο)
glossary.κυδοίμεον: κυδοιμέω — make uproar, rage in the din of battle; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, uncontracted (= Attic ἐκυδοίμουν)
glossary.κυλίνδεται: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’rolls, comes rolling on’
glossary.κόων: Κόων — Coön, son of Antenor; masc. nom. sg., proper name
glossary.κόωνι: Κόων — Coön, son of Antenor; masc. dat. sg., proper name
glossary.λίς: λίς — lion; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic λέων)
glossary.λαίλαπι: λαῖλαψ — squall, whirlwind; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.λελάσμεθα: λανθάνω — mid. λανθάνομαι, λήθομαι, forget (+ gen.); perf. 1 pl. mid., epic λέλασμαι (= Attic λέλησμαι), present force: ’have forgotten, forget’
glossary.λυκίοισιν: Λύκιος — Lycian; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), as a noun: ’Lycians’
glossary.μέτρον: μέτρον — measure, due measure; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μεγάλοισί: μέγας — great, large; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.μενέω: μένω — stay, remain, wait; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic μενῶ)
glossary.μητροπάτωρ: μητροπάτωρ — mother’s father, maternal grandfather; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μνηστῆς: μνηστός — wooed, wedded (of a wife); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μογοστόκοι: μογοστόκος — bringing on the pangs of birth, travail-bringing; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μολίονα: Μολίων — Molion, attendant of Thymbraeus; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.μόλιβος: μόλιβος — lead; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic μόλυβδος)
glossary.νότοιο: Νότος — Notus, the south wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οἰκτρὸς: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οἴχετ: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. 3 sg., elided (οἴχετ’ = οἴχεται), perfect sense: ’is gone’
glossary.πέσητον: πίπτω — fall; aor. subj. 3 dual, in a simile after ὅτε: ’fall (among)’
glossary.παθόντε: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’having suffered’
glossary.πανημέριον: πανημέριος — lasting all day; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’all day long’
glossary.παύσατο: παύω — stop, make cease; mid. cease; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπαύσατο): ’ceased’
glossary.περκώτῃ: Περκώτη — Percote, a town of the Troad; fem. dat. sg., proper name
glossary.πικρὰς: πικρός — bitter, sharp, piercing; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πληθύν: πληθύς — crowd, throng, mass of men; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ποιμαίνοντο: ποιμαίνω — tend (a flock), shepherd; impf. 3 pl. mid.-pass., unaugmented (= ἐποιμαίνοντο): ’were being tended’
glossary.πολυπλάγκτοιο: πολύπλαγκτος — much-straying, far-roaming; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πρεσβυγενὴς: πρεσβυγενής — eldest-born, first-born; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προϊεῖσι: προΐημι — send forth, send out; pres. 3 pl. act., epic -εῖσι (= Attic προϊᾶσι)
glossary.πρῶθ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (πρῶθ’ = πρῶτα): ’first’
glossary.σεύῃ: σεύω — drive, chase, set on; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., in a simile: ’may set (on)’
glossary.σκίδναται: σκίδναμαι — spread out, scatter; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.σπάσσατο: σπάω — draw, pull out, wrench; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic doubled σ (= ἐσπάσατο), unaugmented
glossary.στήθεα: στῆθος — chest, breast; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic στήθη)
glossary.στυφελίξῃ: στυφελίζω — drive, strike hard, buffet; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a simile after ὁπότε: ’drives’
glossary.τλήσομαι: τλάω — endure, bear up under; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall endure’
glossary.τρόφι: τρόφις — swollen, thick, big (of a wave); adj. (or adv.), neut. nom. sg., with κῦμα; sense and form not certain
glossary.τύπτων: τύπτω — strike, beat; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’striking’
glossary.φρονέοντε: φρονέω — think, be minded, be proud; pres. part. masc. nom. dual, epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντε)
glossary.χερμαδίοισιν: χερμάδιον — stone (a hand-sized throwing stone); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀέλλῃ: ἄελλα — storm-wind, blast, squall; fem. dat. sg., with ἶσος
glossary.ἀΰτει: ἀΰτέω — call out, shout; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, contracted -εε → -ει (= Attic ἠΰτει): ’called to’
glossary.ἀγροτέρῳ: ἀγρότερος — wild, of the countryside; masc. dat. sg. (cf. ἄγριος)
glossary.ἀμύνετε: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. imper. 2 pl. act., + dat. of what is defended: ’ward off (from)’ · also pres. imper. 2 pl., + acc. of the evil and acc. of the person: ’ward off from’ (ἀμύνετε νηλεὲς ἦμαρ Αἴανθ’ ’ward the pitiless day from Ajax’)
glossary.ἀνέπνεον: ἀναπνέω — breathe again, recover breath; impf. 3 pl. act., uncontracted (= Attic ἀνέπνουν)
glossary.ἀνήνοθεν: ἀνήνοθα — well up, rise (perf. with pres. sense; root uncertain); perf. 3 sg. (ἀνήνοθε), ν-movable
glossary.ἀνεμοτρεφὲς: ἀνεμοτρεφής — wind-nurtured (of a spear); meaning not known, ’grown in the wind’ is a guess; adj. of two endings, neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπέκοψε: ἀποκόπτω — cut off, sever; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’cut off’
glossary.ἀπέπαυσαν: ἀποπαύω — make cease, stop (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’made cease (from)’
glossary.ἀργεστᾶο: ἀργεστής — bright, clearing (epithet of the south wind); meaning not known, ’bright’ the usual guess; masc. gen. sg., epic -ᾶο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἀργιόδοντας: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed, white-tusked (of dogs or swine); masc. acc. pl., stem ἀργιοδοντ-
glossary.ἀριδείκετος: ἀριδείκετος — very conspicuous, far-shown, eminent; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀσαῖον: Ἀσαῖος — Asaeus, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ἀστοῖσιν: ἀστός — townsman, citizen; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ἄορί: ἄορ — sword; neut. dat. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἄρησθε: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain for oneself; aor. subj. 2 pl. mid., after ἵνα: ’may win’
glossary.ἄσπετα: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, countless, boundless; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄφρεον: ἀφρέω — foam; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, uncontracted (= Attic ἤφρουν)
glossary.ἄχνη: ἄχνη — foam, spray; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλαύνετε: ἐλαύνω — drive, row, sail; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’drive!’
glossary.ἐνόησ: νοέω — perceive, notice, devise; aor. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἐνόησ’ = ἐνόησε): ’noticed’
glossary.ἐρικυδέος: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, much honoured; fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.ἐτέρσετο: τέρσομαι — become dry, dry up; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’dried’
glossary.ἔγχεΐ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., instrumental, epic ἔγχεϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
glossary.ἔθρεψε: τρέφω — rear, nurture, bring up; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔλεγχος: ἔλεγχος — disgrace, reproach, shame; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔνερθε: ἔνερθε — below, beneath; prep. + gen., also adv.: ’below’
glossary.ἔρεισε: ἐρείδω — press, lean, thrust; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἤρεισε): ’pressed’
glossary.ἔτορε: τορέω — pierce, bore through; 2nd aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’pierced’
glossary.ἔχῃ: ἔχω — have, hold, seize; pres. subj. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἕλκ: ἕλκω — drag, draw, pull; impf. 3 sg. act., elided (ἕλκ’ = ἕλκε), unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’drew’
glossary.ἕλκοντ: ἕλκω — drag, draw; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἕλκοντ’ = ἕλκοντα): ’dragging’
glossary.ἡγεμόνας: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἤχθετο: ἄχθομαι — be vexed, be distressed, be burdened (from ἄχθος ’load’); impf. 3 sg. mid.-pass., augmented: ’was distressed’
glossary.ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰοειδέα: ἰοειδής — violet-dark, deep-coloured (of the sea); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰοειδῆ)
glossary.ἰφθίμων: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout, sturdy; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἰφιδάμαντα: Ἰφιδάμας — Iphidamas, son of Antenor; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ἰφιδάμαντι: Ἰφιδάμας — Iphidamas, son of Antenor; masc. dat. sg., proper name
glossary.ἰφιδάμας: Ἰφιδάμας — Iphidamas, son of Antenor; masc. nom. sg., proper name
glossary.ἱππόνοον: Ἱππόνοος — Hipponous, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο)
glossary.ἵμασεν: ἱμάσσω — lash, whip (from ἱμάς ’strap’); aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.ἵσταο: ἵστημι — set; mid. stand; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -αο (= Attic ἵστασο): ’stand!’
glossary.ὀξεῖ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; fem. nom. pl., elided (ὀξεῖ’ = ὀξεῖαι)
glossary.ὀξεῖαι: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀπίτην: Ὀπίτης — Opites, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ὀρίνει: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse, agitate; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’stirs’
glossary.ὀρμένω: ὄρνυμι — set in motion; mid. rush, dart; mid. part. (syncopated 2nd aor.) masc. nom. dual: ’rushing’
glossary.ὄπατρον: ὄπατρος — of the same father, born of the same father; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄϊς: ὄϊς — sheep; common gender (masc. or fem.), acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς): ’sheep’
glossary.ὑπέρτερον: ὑπέρτερος — higher, greater, superior; comparative adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπεραέϊ: ὑπεραής — blowing from above (sense of ὑπερ- not certain); adj. of two endings, fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὑπεραεῖ)
glossary.ὠδίνουσαν: ὠδίνω — have the pangs of childbirth, be in labour; pres. part. act. fem. acc. sg.: ’in labour’
glossary.ὠδῖνας: ὠδίς — pang of childbirth, birth-pang; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὤριστος: ἄριστος — best, noblest (superlative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. sg., crasis ὁ ἄριστος (ὤριστος): ’the best’
glossary.ὦρόν: Ὦρος — Orus, a Danaan leader killed by Hector; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ῥαίνοντο: ῥαίνω — sprinkle, bespatter; impf. 3 pl. mid.-pass., unaugmented (= ἐρραίνοντο): ’were sprinkled’
glossary.αἰζηοὶ: αἰζηός — vigorous young man; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.αἴνυτ: αἴνυμαι — take, take off; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (αἴνυτ’ = αἴνυτο), unaugmented: ’was taking’
glossary.αὐλῶπις: αὐλῶπις — with a tube or socket (epithet of a helmet; sense not certain); fem. nom. sg., agreeing with τρυφάλεια
glossary.αὐτοκασίγνητον: αὐτοκασίγνητος — own brother, full brother; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βάλοι: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’were to hit’, in a supposition after ὡς εἴ
glossary.βιὸς: βιός — bow; masc. nom. sg. (oxytone, distinct from βίος ’life’)
glossary.βριαρήν: βριαρός — strong, heavy, weighty; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κόρυθα
glossary.γένυσσιν: γένυς — jaw; fem. dat. pl., epic -σσιν (= Attic γένυσι)
glossary.γελάσσας: γελάω — laugh; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic double σ (= Attic γελάσας): ’having laughed’
glossary.γναμπτῇσι: γναμπτός — curved, bent; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.δεξιτεροῖο: δεξιτερός — right (poetic for Attic δεξιός); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.δημογέροντος: δημογέρων — elder of the people; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δηϊοπίτην: Δηϊοπίτης — Deiopites, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.διελέξατο: διαλέγομαι — reason with, debate; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (Attic uses διελέχθη): ’debated’
glossary.δούρατος: δόρυ — spear; neut. gen. sg., epic stem δουρατ- (= Attic δόρατος)
glossary.εὐηφενέος: εὐηφενής — rich, abounding in wealth; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
glossary.θήγων: θήγω — whet, sharpen; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sharpening’
glossary.θόωνα: Θόων — Thoon, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.κάπριον: κάπριος — of a boar; as a noun, wild boar (σῦς understood); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κέρᾳ: κέρας — horn (also a bow of horn, or a lock of hair; sense disputed); neut. dat. sg., contracted (Attic κέρατι), of respect
glossary.καθεζόμενος: καθέζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting down’
glossary.καθορῶν: καθοράω — look down on, watch; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’looking down’
glossary.κακοὶ: κακός — bad, cowardly, base; masc. nom. pl.: ’cowards’
glossary.κατέπηκτο: καταπήγνυμι — fix in, stick fast; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’had stuck fast’
glossary.καταείσατο: ἵημι (mid. ἵεμαι), with κατά — speed, dart; aor. 3 sg. mid. (κατα- + ἐείσατο, unaugmented): ’sped down, came down’
glossary.κατακτείνας: κατακτείνω — kill, slay (poetic for Attic ἀποκτείνω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having killed’
glossary.κεκαδὼν: χάζω — give way; also deprive (+ gen.); aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic reduplicated κεκαδών: ’having deprived of’
glossary.κλυτός: κλυτός — famed, renowned, glorious; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κωφὸν: κωφός — blunt, dull, ineffective; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.κόμπος: κόμπος — clash, clatter, din; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λέονθ: λέων — lion; masc. acc. sg., elided and aspirated (λέονθ’ = λέοντα)
glossary.λωβητὴρ: λωβητήρ — outrager, one who abuses or mocks; masc. nom. sg., used as a vocative
glossary.λόχου: λόχος — ambush, hiding-place; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μέλλεις: μέλλω — be about to, be bound to, be sure to; pres. 2 sg. (+ inf.)
glossary.μένουσιν: μένω — stay, stand firm, wait for; pres. 3 pl.: ’wait for, stand against’
glossary.μίκτο: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. 3 sg. mid., syncopated, unaugmented (= ἐμίκτο): ’mingled’
glossary.μηκάδες: μηκάς — bleating; adj., fem. nom. pl. (of goats)
glossary.ξυλόχοιο: ξύλοχος — thicket, lair; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οἰωνοὶ: οἰωνός — bird of prey, bird of omen; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.οὐτιδανοῖο: οὐτιδανός — worthless, good-for-nothing; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.πάθω: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’what am I to suffer?’
glossary.παιονίδην: Παιονίδης — son of Paeon (Agastrophus); masc. acc. sg., patronymic
glossary.παρέμεινεν: παραμένω — stay beside, stand by; aor. 3 sg. (ν-movable): ’stayed by’
glossary.παρθενοπῖπα: παρθενοπίπης — gazer at girls, ogler; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.πειρηθείης: πειράω — try, make trial of; aor. pass. (deponent) opt. 2 sg., epic -ηθ- (= Attic πειραθείης): ’you were to make trial’
glossary.πεφρίκασι: φρίσσω — bristle, shudder; pf. 3 pl. with present sense: ’shudder at’, + acc.
glossary.πλάγχθη: πλάζω — drive off course, make wander; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπλάγχθη): ’was turned aside, glanced off’
glossary.πλέες: πλέων (πλείων) — more, many; masc. nom. pl., epic -ες (= Attic πλείονες)
glossary.ποδός: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg.: ’of the foot’
glossary.πολύαινε: πολύαινος — much-praised, greatly renowned; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.προφυγεῖν: προφεύγω — flee forth, escape; aor. inf.: ’to escape’
glossary.πρότμησιν: πρότμησις — the lower belly, the groin region (rare; sense traditional); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πῆχυν: πῆχυς — forearm; also an arm of a bow (sense disputed); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.στέωμεν: ἵστημι — set; stand; aor. subj. 1 pl. intrans., epic short-vowel στέωμεν (= Attic στῶμεν): ’let us make a stand’
glossary.στήθεσφι: στῆθος — chest, breast; neut. pl. in epic -σφι (= Attic gen. στηθῶν): ’from the chest’ (ἀπὸ στήθεσφι)
glossary.στήλῃ: στήλη — upright slab, pillar, gravestone; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.σφίσι: σφεῖς — they; dat. pl., epic σφίσι, often reflexive: ’to/for themselves’
glossary.σώκοιο: Σῶκος — Socus, a Trojan; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), proper name
glossary.σῶκος: Σῶκος — Socus, a Trojan, son of Hippasus; masc. nom. sg., proper name
glossary.ταρσὸν: ταρσός — flat surface, sole (of the foot); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ταρφέες: ταρφύς — thick, close-set, frequent; masc. nom. pl., epic -έες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.τιταίνετο: τιταίνω — stretch, draw (a bow); impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐτιταίνετο): ’was drawing’
glossary.τιτυσκόμενος: τιτύσκομαι — aim at, take aim; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’aiming’
glossary.τοιώδ: τοιόσδε — such as this, such; masc. acc. dual, elided (τοιώδ’ = τοιώδε)
glossary.τρίπτυχος: τρίπτυχος — three-folded, of three layers; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φέβωμαι: φέβομαι — flee, be put to flight; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid., after αἴ κε: ’if I flee’
glossary.χάροπ: Χάροψ — Charops, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., elided (Χάροπ’ = Χάροπα), proper name
glossary.χαλκόφι: χαλκός — bronze; masc. sg. in epic -φι (= Attic gen. χαλκοῦ): ’from the bronze’ (ἀπὸ χαλκόφι)
glossary.χερσιδάμαντα: Χερσιδάμας — Chersidamas, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.χραίσμῃσι: χραισμέω — ward off, avail; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῃ), with ἄν where Attic has the optative: ’would avail’
glossary.ἀΐξαντα: ἀΐσσω — dart, spring (Attic ᾄττω); aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’darting, leaping’
glossary.ἀγάστροφον: Ἀγάστροφος — Agastrophus, a Trojan, son of Paeon; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ἀγαστρόφου: Ἀγάστροφος — Agastrophus, a Trojan, son of Paeon; masc. gen. sg., proper name
glossary.ἀγλαὲ: ἀγλαός — splendid, proud; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀγοστῷ: ἀγοστός — crook of the arm, hollow of the hand; masc. dat. sg., instrumental
glossary.ἀλεξώμεσθα: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic ἀλεξώμεθα): ’let us defend ourselves’
glossary.ἀμπήδησε: ἀναπηδάω — leap up, spring out; aor. 3 sg., ἀμπ- for ἀναπ-: ’sprang out’
glossary.ἀμπερὲς: ἀμπερές — right through, straight through; adv.
glossary.ἀμφίδρυφοί: ἀμφίδρυφος (cf. ἀμφιδρυφής) — torn all round, i.e. cheeks scratched in mourning (traditional sense); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀνάλκιδος: ἄναλκις — without strength, cowardly, feeble; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνέδραμε: ἀνατρέχω — run back, run up; aor. 3 sg. (stem δραμ-): ’ran back’
glossary.ἀνέπνευσαν: ἀναπνέω — breathe again, get relief; aor. 3 pl.: ’drew breath again’ (with κεν, a past potential: ’would have’)
glossary.ἀνέρε: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. dual, epic ἀνέρε (= Attic ἄνδρε): ’two men’
glossary.ἀνδροκμήτῳ: ἀνδρόκμητος — made by men, man-wrought; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀποίχονται: ἀποίχομαι — be gone, keep away from; pres. 3 pl. mid., + gen.: ’keep away from’
glossary.ἀρίστω: ἄριστος — best; masc. acc. dual, in agreement with ἀνέρε: ’two best’
glossary.ἀριστεύῃσι: ἀριστεύω — be best, excel, play the hero; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῃ), after ὃς … κε: ’whoever excels’
glossary.ἀφάμαρτε: ἀφαμαρτάνω — miss; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἀφήμαρτε): ’missed’
glossary.ἁλώω: ἁλίσκομαι — be taken, be captured; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic lengthened vowel (= Attic ἁλῶ): ’I am taken’
glossary.ἄνελκε: ἀνέλκω — draw back, drag up; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἀνεῖλκε): ’drew back’
glossary.ἄφρων: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἆτ: ἄατος (ἆτος) — insatiable, never satisfied; masc. voc. sg., elided (ἆτ’ = ἆτα, an unusual -α vocative), with the gen. δόλων ’insatiate of tricks’
glossary.ἐξέλασ: ἐξελαύνω — drive out, ride out; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐξέλασ’ = ἐξέλασε): ’drove off’
glossary.ἐξανύω: ἐξανύω — accomplish, make an end of; pres. 1 sg. with future sense: ’I shall finish’
glossary.ἐπαλεξήσων: ἐπαλέξω — ward off, come to help; fut. part. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to defend’
glossary.ἐπαύρῃ: ἐπαυρίσκω — get a share of, touch; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after εἴ κε: ’if it touches’
glossary.ἐπεύξεαι: ἐπεύχομαι — cry out in triumph, boast over; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ἐπεύξῃ)
glossary.ἐπιείσομαι: ἐπέρχομαι (ἔπειμι) — go at, attack; fut. 1 sg. mid., from the εἶμι stem (ἐπι- + εἴσομαι)
glossary.ἐρεύθων: ἐρεύθω — redden, make red; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’reddening’
glossary.ἐρωὴν: ἐρωή — rush, swing, flight (of a missile); fem. acc. sg., after μετά: ’after the rush’
glossary.ἐρύκακε: ἐρύκω — hold back, ward off; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist: ’held off’
glossary.ἐτάνυσσε: τανύω — stretch, draw out; aor. 3 sg., double σ metrical (= Attic ἐτάνυσε): ’stretched’
glossary.ἔβλητ: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. 3 sg. mid.-pass., elided (ἔβλητ’ = ἔβλητο): ’was hit’
glossary.ἔλσαν: εἴλω (ἔλσαν) — press, hem in, drive together; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἷλσαν): ’drove, hemmed in’
glossary.ἔμπνυτο: ἐμπνύω (ἀμπνύω) — recover breath, revive; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’drew breath again’
glossary.ἔννομον: Ἔννομος — Ennomus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
glossary.ἔφυγες: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 2 sg.: ’you have escaped’
glossary.ἰφθίμοιο: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἰὸς: ἰός — arrow; masc. nom. sg. (not ἰός ’poison’)
glossary.ἱππασίδην: Ἱππασίδης — son of Hippasus (Charops); masc. acc. sg., patronymic
glossary.ἱππασίδῃσι: Ἱππασίδης — son of Hippasus; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), patronymic
glossary.ὀδυσσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg., double-σ form (metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆα)
glossary.ὀρούσας: ὀρούω — rush, spring; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’springing’
glossary.ὀρφανικοί: ὀρφανικός — orphaned, of an orphan; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄφελόν: ὀφείλω — owe, ought; aor. 1 sg. ὄφελον, unaugmented (= Attic ὤφελον), with ὡς + inf. in a wish: ’would that I had’
glossary.ὤλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed, lost’
glossary.ὦκ: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (ὦκ’ = ὦκα)
glossary.αὖε: ἀΰω (αὔω) — shout, call out; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’called’
glossary.βαινέτω: βαίνω — go, walk, step; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him go’
glossary.βαλόντες: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having cast’; with περί in tmesis, ’having cast around’ · also ’having put’ (ἐν … βαλόντες ’having put aboard’)
glossary.βαῖν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαινε), elided (βαῖν’ = βαῖνε): ’was going, went’
glossary.βεβλημένον: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; perf. part. pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’(having been) hit’
glossary.βιῴατο: βιάομαι — use force against, overpower; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -ῴατο (= Attic βιῷντο)
glossary.δάπτει: δάπτω — devour, tear; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’devours’
glossary.δαμάσσεται: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. subj. 3 sg., short-vowel, middle ending but active sense (= Attic δαμάσῃ), in a temporal clause with ἐπεί: ’subdues’
glossary.δαρδάπτουσιν: δαρδάπτω — devour, tear up; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable
glossary.δαφοινοὶ: δαφοινός — deep-red, tawny (δα- intensive + φοινός ’red’; exact sense not certain); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δείλ: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. voc. sg., elided (δείλ’ = δείλε), in the exclamation ἆ δείλε
glossary.διέτρεσαν: διατρέω — flee in terror, scatter in fear; aor. 3 pl. act. (διά + ἔτρεσαν): ’scattered in fright’
glossary.δουρός: δόρυ — spear; neut. gen. sg., epic δουρός (= Attic δορός)
glossary.δρῦς: δρῦς — oak; fem. acc. pl. (acc. pl. with long ῡ)
glossary.δόρυκλον: Δόρυκλος — Doryclus, a Trojan, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θάνω: θνῄσκω — die; aor. subj. 1 sg. act., after εἴ κε: ’if I die’
glossary.θανόντι: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’(for one) dead’
glossary.θοὸν: θοός — swift; neut. acc. sg. (masc. acc. sg. also): ’swift’
glossary.κάτεισι: κάτειμι (κατά + εἶμι) — go down; pres. 3 sg.: ’goes down’
glossary.καθαιρήσουσι: καθαιρέω — take down; close (the eyes of the dead); fut. 3 pl. act.: ’will close’
glossary.κατακαίριον: κατακαίριος — deadly, fatal (built on καίριος ’in the vital spot’; sense taken from context); neut. nom. sg.
glossary.κεβριόνης: Κεβριόνης — Cebriones, Hector’s charioteer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κιχάνεται: κιχάνω — reach, overtake; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’reaches, overtakes’
glossary.κλονέει: κλονέω — throw into confusion, drive in rout; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic κλονεῖ)
glossary.κλονέων: κλονέω — throw into confusion, drive in rout; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted: ’throwing into confusion’
glossary.κτεριοῦσί: κτερίζω — give funeral rites to, bury with honour; fut. 3 pl. act., contracted (κτεριοῦσι), accented before the enclitic γε
glossary.λιαρὸν: λιαρός — warm, lukewarm; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with αἷμα
glossary.λιγυρῇ: λιγυρός — clear-toned, shrill; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾷ)
glossary.λύσανδρον: Λύσανδρος — Lysander, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λῖν: λῖς — lion; masc. acc. sg. (nom. λῖς)
glossary.μάρνατο: μάρναμαι — fight; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμάρνατο): ’was fighting’
glossary.μετακλινθέντος: μετακλίνω — turn about, shift; aor. part. pass. gen. sg. (masc./neut.), in a genitive absolute: ’having turned’
glossary.μιχθήμεναι: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. inf. pass., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic μιχθῆναι): ’to be mingled’
glossary.μονωθεὶς: μονόω — leave alone, isolate; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’left alone’
glossary.νέμεϊ: νέμος — wooded pasture, glade; neut. dat. sg., epic νέμεϊ (= Attic νέμει)
glossary.νέρθεν: νέρθεν — from beneath, below, underneath; adv., epic (= ἔνερθεν)
glossary.νέστορά: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. acc. sg., accent shifted before the enclitic τε
glossary.νέων: νέος — young, youthful; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the young men’
glossary.νευρῆς: νευρή — bowstring, string; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic νευρᾶς)
glossary.οὔρεσι: ὄρος (epic οὖρος) — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic οὔρεσι (= Attic ὄρεσι)
glossary.πάθῃσιν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 3 sg. in -ῃσι, epic (= Attic πάθῃ)
glossary.πάνδοκον: Πάνδοκος — Pandocus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πάσσειν: πάσσω — sprinkle, strew; pres. inf. act.; with ἐπί in tmesis, ’sprinkle on’
glossary.παρέξ: παρέξ — aside, alongside, out beside; adv. (παρά + ἐκ)
glossary.παρβεβαώς: παραβαίνω — stand beside; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with apocope (παρβεβαώς = παραβεβαώς), + dat.: ’standing beside’
glossary.παῦσεν: παύω — stop, check; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔπαυσε), transitive
glossary.περίδεισαν: περιδείδω — fear greatly (for); aor. 3 pl. (περί + δεῖσαν), unaugmented, + dat.: ’they feared for’
glossary.πεύθετ: πεύθομαι — learn, hear of; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πεύθετ’ = πεύθετο, Attic ἐπύθετο): ’learned of’
glossary.πεύκας: πεύκη — pine, pine tree; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πλήθων: πλήθω — be full, swell; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’swollen, in spate’
glossary.πληγῆς: πληγή — blow, stroke (of a whip); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ποικιλομήτην: ποικιλομήτης — of shifting, many-colored cunning (ποικίλος + μῆτις); masc. acc. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.πριαμίδην: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
glossary.προβαλόντες: προβάλλω — throw forward, put forth; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having cast forward’
glossary.πτερὰ: πτερόν — feather, wing; neut. acc. pl. (nom. pl. also)
glossary.πυλάρτην: Πυλάρτης — Pylartes, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πόδεσσι: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.σίντην: σίντης — ravaging, destructive; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λῖν: ’ravager’
glossary.σπασθέντος: σπάω — draw, pull out; aor. part. pass. gen. sg. (masc./neut.), in a genitive absolute: ’having been drawn out’
glossary.στείβοντες: στείβω — tread, trample; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’treading on’
glossary.σῶκον: Σῶκος — Socus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σῶχ: Σῶκος — Socus, a Trojan; masc. voc. sg., elided (Σῶχ’ = Σῶκε), aspirated before Ἱππάσου
glossary.τάχιστ: ταχύς — swift; superl. neut. pl. τάχιστα used as adverb, elided (τάχιστ’): ’most quickly’
glossary.ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; masc. gen. sg. (from τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.φθῆ: φθάνω — be first, forestall; aor. 3 sg., epic root aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἔφθη): ’was first’
glossary.χάδε: χανδάνω — hold, contain; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαδε): ’held’
glossary.χάζετο: χάζομαι — give ground, draw back, yield (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐχάζετο)
glossary.χάζοντο: χάζομαι — give ground, draw back, yield (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐχάζοντο)
glossary.χειμάρρους: χειμάρροος — winter-flowing, torrential; masc. nom. sg., contracted (χειμάρρους = χειμάρροος): ’winter torrent’
glossary.ἀΐοντες: ἀΐω — hear, perceive (+ gen.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’hearing’
glossary.ἀζαλέας: ἀζαλέος — dry, parched; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλάπαζε: ἀλαπάζω — lay waste, empty, sack; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠλάπαζε)
glossary.ἀμύνετο: ἀμύνομαι — ward off from oneself, defend oneself against; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἠμύνετο)
glossary.ἀνέσσυτο: σεύομαι — rush, dart; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ-, with ἀνά (ἀνέσσυτο): ’rushed up’
glossary.ἀνδρόμεον: ἀνδρόμεος — of a man, human; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀντάξιος: ἀντάξιος — worth as much as, equal in worth to (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀποτμήξαντες: ἀποτμήγω — cut off, sever; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having cut off’
glossary.ἀφυσγετὸν: ἀφυσγετός — silt, mud and debris swept along by a stream; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλκιμοι: ἄλκιμος — valiant, stout; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in another direction, elsewhere; adv.; ἄλλυδις ἄλλος ’one this way, one that’
glossary.ἄντυγες: ἄντυξ — rim, rail (of a chariot-body); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄϊεν: ἀΐω — hear, perceive; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’heard’
glossary.ἆ: ἆ — ah!, oh!; interjection of dismay or reproach
glossary.ἐκτάμνειν: ἐκτάμνω (= ἐκτέμνω) — cut out; pres. inf. act., epic τάμνω (= Attic τέμνω): ’to cut out’
glossary.ἐξοπίσω: ἐξοπίσω — backward, behind, to the rear; adv. (of time, ’hereafter’)
glossary.ἐπεύξατο: ἐπεύχομαι — pray to, vow; vaunt over, boast; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’vaunted’
glossary.ἐπιμὶξ: ἐπιμίξ — in confusion, mixed together; adv. (cf. μίγνυμι)
glossary.ἐπισσώτρων: ἐπίσσωτρον — tire, rim of a chariot wheel; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐρύουσι: ἐρύω — drag, tug, draw; pres. 3 pl. act.; future in sense, ’will drag at’
glossary.ἐσφέρεται: εἰσφέρω — carry in; pres. 3 sg. mid., ἐς- for εἰς-: ’carries in (with it)’
glossary.ἐσχατιῇ: ἐσχατιή — the furthest point, edge, border; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾷ)
glossary.ἔγκασι: ἔγκατα — entrails, innards; neut. dat. pl., epic ἔγκασι (= Attic ἐγκάτοις)
glossary.ἔγνων: γιγνώσκω — recognise, know; aor. 1 sg.: ’I recognised’
glossary.ἔπαυσας: παύω — make cease, stop; aor. 2 sg. act., augmented: ’you made cease’
glossary.ἔργαθεν: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut out, keep off; aor. 3 sg., epic ἔργαθεν, ν-movable (= Attic εἶρξε): ’kept off’
glossary.ἔφερον: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they carried’ (1 sg. identical)
glossary.ἕλοιεν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. opt. 3 pl. act.: ’might take’, in a fear clause after μή
glossary.ἕπονθ: ἕπομαι (cf. ἕπω ’be busy about’) — follow; with ἀμφί, throng round; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided and aspirated (ἕπονθ’ = ἕποντο, θ for τ before the rough breathing)
glossary.ἤλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive; also strike, deal a blow; aor. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented ἔλασεν): ’drove, struck’ · also ’beat out, hammer (metal)’: aor. 3 sg., ’hammered’
glossary.ἤλυξε: ἀλύσκω — escape, avoid; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’escaped’
glossary.ἰάχοντος: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; pres. part. act. masc. gen. sg.: ’(as he) cried out’
glossary.ἰητρὸς: ἰατρός — physician, healer; masc. nom. sg., Ionic ἰητρός (= Attic ἰατρός)
glossary.ἰούς: ἰός — arrow; masc. acc. pl. (not ἰός ’poison’)
glossary.ἱππάσου: Ἵππασος — Hippasus, a Trojan; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱππείων: ἵππειος — of a horse; fem. gen. pl., agreeing with ὁπλέων
glossary.ὀλέκουσι: ὀλέκω — destroy, kill; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ὀπαζόμενος: ὀπάζω — make follow, drive on; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’driven on’
glossary.ὀρίνονται: ὀρίνω — stir up, throw into turmoil; pres. 3 pl. pass.: ’are thrown into turmoil’
glossary.ὁμίλει: ὁμιλέω — keep company with, mingle with; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὡμίλει), + dat.
glossary.ὁμιλέομεν: ὁμιλέω — keep company, be together, throng; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted -έομεν (= Attic ὁμιλοῦμεν)
glossary.ὁπλέων: ὁπλή — hoof; fem. gen. pl., Ionic -έων (= Attic ὁπλῶν)
glossary.ὄμβρῳ: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὄρεσφιν: ὄρος — mountain; neut. pl. in -φιν serving as gen. or dat. (= Attic ὀρῶν, ὄρεσι): ’from, in the mountains’
glossary.ὑπάλυξας: ὑπαλύσκω — escape, slip away from; aor. 2 sg. act.: ’you escaped’
glossary.ὑποστρέψας: ὑποστρέφω — turn back, return; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having turned back’
glossary.ὠμησταὶ: ὠμηστής — eating raw flesh; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ῥίμφ: ῥίμφα — lightly, swiftly; adv., elided (ῥίμφ’ = ῥίμφα)
glossary.ῥαθάμιγγες: ῥάθαμιγξ — drop, splash; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ῥῆξαί: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; aor. inf. act., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.αἰδοῖος: αἰδοῖος — revered, awesome, held in respect; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰτιόῳτο: αἰτιάομαι — accuse, blame; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., epic -όῳτο (= Attic αἰτιῷτο), potential with κε: ’would blame’
glossary.αἴγειον: αἴγειος — of a goat; adj. (two endings), masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τυρόν: ’goat’s (cheese)’
glossary.αἴθωνα: αἴθων — blazing, fiery, tawny; adj., masc. acc. sg., of a lion: ’tawny, fierce’
glossary.βεβλημένος: βάλλω — throw, hit with a missile; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’(having been) hit, wounded’
glossary.βιάζεται: βιάζομαι — use force on, press hard, overpower; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg., + dat. of means: ’is hard pressed’
glossary.βιαζόμενον: βιάζομαι — use force on, press hard; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. sg., + dat. of means: ’being hard pressed’
glossary.γουνὸς: γόνυ — knee; neut. gen. sg., epic γουνός (= Attic γόνατος): ’of the knee’ (γόνυ γουνὸς ἀμείβων ’changing knee after knee’)
glossary.δίψαν: δίψα — thirst; fem. acc. sg., object of ἀφέτην: ’put away thirst’
glossary.δεταί: δετή — brand, torch, a bound bundle of kindling (from δέω ’bind’; exact sense uncertain); fem. nom. pl.: ’torches’
glossary.δόναξ: δόναξ — reed; masc. nom. sg., also the reed shaft of an arrow: ’the shaft’
glossary.εἰσελθὼν: εἰσέρχομαι — go into, enter; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone in, entering’
glossary.εἰῶσι: ἐάω — allow, let; pres. 3 pl., epic εἰῶσι (= Attic ἐῶσι), + inf.: ’they allow’
glossary.εὐρυπύλῳ: Εὐρύπυλος — Eurypylus, son of Euaemon; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.θεῇσιν: θεά — goddess; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic θεαῖς), after ἐϊκυῖα: ’like goddesses’
glossary.θρασειάων: θρασύς — bold, daring; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θρασειῶν), agreeing with χειρῶν: ’of the bold (hands)’
glossary.θυγατέρ: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. acc. sg., elided (θυγατέρ’ = θυγατέρα)
glossary.θύρῃσιν: θύρα — door; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic θύραις): ’at the doors’
glossary.κάνεον: κάνεον — basket, wicker bread-basket; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (Attic κανοῦν)
glossary.καιόμεναί: καίω — burn, set alight; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. pl.: ’burning, blazing’
glossary.καλὴν: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κείρει: κείρω — cut down, crop, shear; pres. 3 sg.: ’crops, mows down’
glossary.κικλήσκεις: καλέω (κικλήσκω) — call, summon; pres. 2 sg.: ’you call’
glossary.κλίναντες: κλίνω — lean, rest; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having leaned, having rested’
glossary.κνήστι: κνῆστις — grater; fem. dat. sg., epic κνήστι (= Attic κνήστει), instrumental: ’with a grater’
glossary.κνῆ: κνάω — scrape, grate; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, Ionic contraction -η (= Attic ἔκνη): ’grated’
glossary.κρειῶν: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. gen. pl., epic κρειῶν (= Attic κρεῶν), gen. of the thing desired: ’for meat’
glossary.κρόμυον: κρόμυον — onion; neut. acc. sg. (Attic κρόμμυον)
glossary.κυανόπεζαν: κυανόπεζος — with dark-blue feet (κύανος ’dark enamel’ + πέζα ’foot’; exact sense uncertain); adj., fem. acc. sg., of a table
glossary.κυκειῶ: κυκεών — mixed drink, potion of wine, barley and cheese; masc. acc. sg., contracted, epic κυκειῶ (= κυκεῶνα)
glossary.κύκησε: κυκάω — stir, mix together; aor. 3 sg.: ’mixed’
glossary.λιλαιόμενα: λιλαίομαι — long for, be eager; pres. part. mid. neut. nom. pl., + inf.: ’eager to’
glossary.λισσομένους: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’begging, supplicating’
glossary.μάρναντο: μάρναμαι — fight; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐμάρναντο): ’fought’
glossary.μαχάονι: Μαχάων — Machaon, the healer, son of Asclepius; masc. dat. sg., after ἔοικε: ’to Machaon’
glossary.μενοιτιάδη: Μενοιτιάδης — son of Menoetius, i.e. Patroclus; masc. voc. sg., patronymic
glossary.μεσσαύλοιο: μέσσαυλος — farmyard, steading; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), of separation after ἀπό: ’from the farmyard’
glossary.μεσσηγύ: μεσσηγύ — in between, midway; adv., epic spelling (= μεσηγύ; Attic μεταξύ)
glossary.μεταστρεφθείς: μεταστρέφω — turn around, turn about; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., middle sense: ’having turned round’
glossary.μνησάσκετο: μιμνήσκω (μνάομαι) — remind; mid. remember, be mindful of; iterative aor. 3 sg. mid. in -σκε-, epic, + gen.: ’would call to mind’
glossary.μογέων: μογέω — toil, labour, struggle; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic μογῶν): ’toiling, with effort’
glossary.νεμέθοντο: νεμέθομαι — graze, feed; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic: ’were feeding’
glossary.νεμεσητὸς: νεμεσητός — to be resented, apt to take offence (sense stretched; αἰδοῖος νεμεσητός ’awesome and quick to anger’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νηλήϊαι: Νηλήϊος — of Neleus, Neleian; adj., fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic Νηλεῖαι), agreeing with ἵπποι (mares)
glossary.νηληϊάδεω: Νηληϊάδης — son of Neleus, i.e. Nestor; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.νηπίη: νήπιος — childish, feeble, foolish; adj., fem. nom. sg. (βίη νηπίη ’feeble strength’)
glossary.νωθής: νωθής — sluggish, slow, dull; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νύσσοντες: νύσσω — prick, jab, stab; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic νύττω): ’jabbing’
glossary.ξυστοῖσι: ξυστόν — spear, polished shaft (from ξύω ’scrape’); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς), instrumental: ’with spears’
glossary.οἴνῳ: οἶνος — wine; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with wine’
glossary.πάγεν: πήγνυμι — fix, make fast; aor. 3 pl. pass. (2nd aor.), epic, unaugmented (= ἐπάγησαν): ’stuck fast’
glossary.πάλυνε: παλύνω — sprinkle, strew; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’sprinkled’
glossary.πάννυχοι: πάννυχος — all night long; adj., masc. nom. pl.: ’through the night’
glossary.πάτροκλε: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.πίνοντ: πίνω — drink; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual, elided (πίνοντ’ = πίνοντε): ’the two drinking’
glossary.παρήϊξαν: παραΐσσω — dart past, rush past; aor. 3 pl., epic παρήϊξαν (= Attic παρῇξαν), + acc.: ’darted past’
glossary.πατροκλῆα: Πατροκλῆς — Patroclus (by-form of Πάτροκλος); masc. acc. sg. Πατροκλῆα (= Πάτροκλον)
glossary.πελειάδες: πελειάς — dove, rock-pigeon; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.περικαλλές: περικαλλής — very beautiful, exceedingly fair; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with δέπας
glossary.πλησίοι: πλησίος — near, close by; adj., masc. nom. pl., predicative: ’close beside’
glossary.πνοιὴν: πνοιή — breath, blast, breeze; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic πνοή), after ποτί: ’toward the breeze’
glossary.πολυηγερέες: πολυηγερής — thronging, gathered in great numbers (πολύς + ἀγείρω); adj. (two endings), masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.πολυκαγκέα: πολυκαγκής — very dry, parching (πολύς + καγκανός ’dry’; traditional gloss); adj., fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with δίψαν
glossary.ποτῷ: ποτόν — drink; neut. dat. sg., of purpose: ’for the drink’
glossary.πρήσσει: πρήσσω — do, accomplish, get done; pres. 3 sg., Ionic -ήσσ- (= Attic πράττει): οὔ τι πρήσσει ’accomplishes nothing’
glossary.πραμνείῳ: Πράμνειος — Pramnian, a kind of wine (origin and sense uncertain); adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πραπίδων: πραπίδες — midriff, the parts about the liver; fem. gen. pl. (plural only), after ὑπό: ’beneath the midriff’
glossary.προέεργε: προέργω — drive forward, push on; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic προεῖργε): ’kept driving on’
glossary.πυθμένες: πυθμήν — base, bottom, foot; masc. nom. pl.: ’bases’
glossary.πυκινοῖσι: πυκινός — thick, close-set, dense; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.πῖαρ: πῖαρ — fat, richness; neut. acc. sg. as a noun, object of ἑλέσθαι: ’fat flesh’
glossary.σάκε: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. pl., elided (σάκε’ = σάκεα, Attic σάκη)
glossary.στάντε: ἵστημι — set; aor. intrans. stand; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual, root aorist: ’the two having taken their stand’
glossary.στήσεσθαι: ἵστημι — set, stand; fut. inf. mid., in indirect statement after ὀΐω: ’to take a stand’
glossary.τάς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl., used as relative with τε: ’which’
glossary.τέσσαρ: τέσσαρες — four; numeral, neut. nom. pl., elided (τέσσαρ’ = τέσσαρα)
glossary.τίπτέ: τίπτε — why?; interrogative adv. (= τί ποτε), printed τίπτέ before με
glossary.ταφών: τέθηπα (aor. ἔταφον) — be amazed, stunned; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’dazed, stunned’
glossary.τελαμώνιον: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon, Telamonian; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν
glossary.τενέδοιο: Τένεδος — Tenedos, island off Troy; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after ἐκ: ’from Tenedos’
glossary.τετιημένος: τετίημαι — be grieved, be downcast (defective, perf. with pres. force); perf. part. masc. nom. sg., + acc. of respect: ’grieved (in heart)’
glossary.τετιηότι: τετίημαι — be grieved, be downcast (perf. with pres. force); perf. part. act. masc. dat. sg., epic -ηότι: ’grieved’
glossary.τρέσσε: τρέω — flee in fear, shrink back; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔτρεσε), unaugmented: ’shrank back’
glossary.τραπέζης: τράπεζα — table; fem. gen. sg., of separation: ’from the table’
glossary.τρεῖ: τρέω — tremble, shrink from, fear; pres. 3 sg., + acc.: ’shrinks from’
glossary.τρωπάσκετο: τρωπάω (τρέπω) — turn; iterative impf. 3 sg. mid. in -σκε-, epic, + inf.: ’would turn to (flee)’
glossary.τύπτουσιν: τύπτω — strike, beat; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’beat’
glossary.φαυσιάδην: Φαυσιάδης — son of Phausias; masc. acc. sg., patronymic, with Ἀπισάονα
glossary.χάλκειον: χάλκειος (Attic χάλκεος) — of bronze; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic χαλκοῦν)
glossary.χαλκείῃ: χάλκειος — of bronze; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic χαλκῇ), agreeing with κνήστι
glossary.χιτώνων: χιτών — tunic; masc. gen. pl., of separation: ’from the tunics’
glossary.χλωρόν: χλωρός — pale green, greenish-yellow, fresh; neut. acc. sg., of honey: ’yellow’
glossary.χρύσειαι: χρύσεος — golden; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic χρυσαῖ)
glossary.ἀΐσσουσι: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, spring; pres. 3 pl. (Attic ᾄττω): ’dart, fly’
glossary.ἀέκων: ἀέκων — unwilling, against one’s will; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄκων): ’unwillingly’
glossary.ἀκτήν: ἀκτή — coarsely ground grain, meal; fem. acc. sg. (a different word from ἀκτή ’shore’)
glossary.ἀλφίτου: ἄλφιτον — barley-groats, barley-meal; neut. gen. sg. (usu. pl.): ’of barley-meal’
glossary.ἀμείβων: ἀμείβω — exchange, change; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’changing, shifting’
glossary.ἀμογητὶ: ἀμογητί — without toil, easily; adv. (ἀ- privative + μογέω ’toil’)
glossary.ἀναίτιον: ἀναίτιος — guiltless, blameless; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνασχόμενοι: ἀνέχομαι — hold up (one’s own); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having raised, holding up’
glossary.ἀπέβησαν: ἀποβαίνω — step off, dismount; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’stepped down, dismounted’
glossary.ἀπαινύμενον: ἀπαίνυμαι — take away from, strip; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., + gen. of the person: ’stripping (of)’
glossary.ἀπεψύχοντο: ἀποψύχω — cool off, dry off; impf. 3 pl. mid., + acc.: ’cooled off, dried’
glossary.ἀπισάονα: Ἀπισάων — Apisaon, son of Phausias (a different Apisaon, son of Hippasus, is a Paeonian); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπισάονος: Ἀπισάων — Apisaon, son of Phausias; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀποκινήσασκε: ἀποκινέω — move away, shift from; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε, epic, + gen. of separation: ’would move from’
glossary.ἀριστεύεσκεν: ἀριστεύω — be best, excel; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -εσκε(ν), epic: ’used to excel’, + gen. of comparison
glossary.ἀρσινόου: Ἀρσίνοος — Arsinous, father of Hecamede; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀρχή: ἀρχή — beginning, origin, first cause; fem. nom. sg., as a predicate noun: ’the beginning’
glossary.ἀσκληπιάδῃ: Ἀσκληπιάδης — son of Asclepius; masc. dat. sg., patronymic, in apposition to Μαχάονι
glossary.ἀφέτην: ἀφίημι — send away, put off; aor. 3 dual, root aorist: ’the two put away’
glossary.ἀφίκοντο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἄειρεν: ἀείρω (Attic αἴρω) — lift, raise; impf. 3 sg., epic: ’lifted’
glossary.ἄκοντες: ἄκων — javelin, dart; masc. nom. pl. (a different word from ἄκων ’unwilling’)
glossary.ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλφιτα: ἄλφιτον — barley-groats, barley-meal (usu. pl.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄνωγε: ἄνωγα — command, bid, order; perf. with pres./past force, 3 sg.: ’bids, bade’
glossary.ἐάγῃ: ἄγνυμι — break, shatter; aor. 3 sg. pass. subj., epic ἐάγῃ (= Attic ἀγῇ), in a general relative clause: ’is broken’
glossary.ἐβάρυνε: βαρύνω — weigh down; aor. 3 sg.: ’weighed down’
glossary.ἐβιήσατο: βιάομαι — use force against, overpower; aor. 3 sg. mid., Ionic (= Attic ἐβιάσατο): ’overpowered’
glossary.ἐγρήσσοντες: ἐγρήσσω — be awake, keep watch; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic -ήσσ-: ’keeping awake’
glossary.ἐκλάσθη: κλάω — break, snap; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was broken, snapped’
glossary.ἐλελιχθέντες: ἐλελίζω — wheel round, rally; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. pl., middle sense: ’having rallied, wheeled round’
glossary.ἐνέποντες: ἐνέπω — tell, speak, converse; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’telling, speaking’
glossary.ἐντροπαλιζόμενος: ἐντροπαλίζομαι — keep turning round (to look back); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’turning about again and again’
glossary.ἐξήλασσαν: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. 3 pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐξήλασαν): ’drove out’
glossary.ἐπαυρεῖν: ἐπαυρίσκω — touch, graze, get a taste of; aor. inf. act. (2nd aor.), epic: ’to touch, graze’
glossary.ἐπιπροΐηλε: ἐπιπροϊάλλω — send forward to, push up to; aor. 3 sg., epic, + dat. of the person: ’pushed up to (them)’
glossary.ἐρατίζων: ἐρατίζω — long for, yearn for; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’yearning for’
glossary.ἐσσεύαντο: σεύω — drive, chase; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐσεύαντο): ’drove off, chased away’
glossary.ἐσσύμενός: σεύω — drive, hasten, urge on; perf. mid./pass. part. with pres. force, masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic περ: ’eager, hastening’
glossary.ἐφίστατο: ἐφίστημι — set upon; mid. stand at, take one’s stand by; impf. 3 sg. mid., + dat.: ’stood at’
glossary.ἐϋπλόκαμος: ἐϋπλόκαμος — with fine-plaited hair; adj., fem. nom. sg. (2-termination), epithet of goddesses and fair women
glossary.ἑδριάασθαι: ἑδριάομαι — seat oneself, sit down; pres. inf. mid., diectasis (= Attic ἑδριᾶσθαι)
glossary.ἑκαμήδη: Ἑκαμήδη — Hecamede, Nestor’s serving-woman; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔκμολεν: βλώσκω — go, come; aor. 3 sg., ἐκ + unaugmented μόλε(ν) (= ἐξέμολεν): ’came out’
glossary.ἔξελον: ἐξαιρέω — take out, pick out; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔξελον (= Attic ἐξεῖλον): ’picked out, chose’
glossary.ἔρειο: ἔρομαι — ask, inquire; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic ἔρειο (= Attic ἐροῦ): ’ask!’
glossary.ἕλκετ: ἕλκω — drag, draw; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (ἕλκετ’ = ἕλκετο; Attic εἵλκετο): ’drew (for himself)’
glossary.ἰθύει: ἰθύω — rush straight on, press on; pres. 3 sg.: ’rushes straight on’
glossary.ἰῶκά: ἰωκή — onrush, battle-din, rout (exact sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg., accented ἰῶκά before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἱδρῶσαι: ἱδρόω — sweat, be in a sweat; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl., contracted (ἱδρῶσαι = ἱδρόουσαι): ’sweating’
glossary.ἱεροῦ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., neut. gen. sg.
glossary.ἵστασθ: ἵστημι — set; mid. take one’s stand; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (ἵστασθ’ = ἵστασθε): ’take your stand!’
glossary.ὁδεύειν: ὁδεύω — travel, go on a way; pres. inf.: ’to go, to make one’s way’
glossary.ὄνος: ὄνος — ass, donkey; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄρμενα: ὄρνυμι — stir; mid. dart, rush; aor. part. mid. neut. nom. pl., syncopated (ὄρμενα = ὀρόμενα): ’darting’
glossary.ὄψον: ὄψον — relish, cooked food eaten with bread; neut. acc. sg., in apposition
glossary.ὑποστρεφθείς: ὑποστρέφω — turn back, turn round; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., middle sense: ’having turned back’
glossary.ὥπλισσε: ὁπλίζω — prepare, make ready; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὥπλισε): ’prepared’
glossary.ῥοπάλοισι: ῥόπαλον — club, cudgel; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), instrumental: ’with clubs’
glossary.ῥόπαλ: ῥόπαλον — club, cudgel; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ῥόπαλ’ = ῥόπαλα)
glossary.αἰθομένοις: αἴθω — burn, kindle; pres. part. mid./pass. neut. dat. pl.: ’burning’, of sacrificial offerings
glossary.αὐγείαο: Αὐγείας — Augeias, king of the Epeans in Elis; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αὐγείας: Αὐγείας — Augeias, king of the Epeans in Elis; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βάλλων: βάλλω — throw, hit; intrans. of a river, empty, fall into; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’falling (into the sea)’
glossary.βέλεσιν: βέλος — missile, dart; neut. dat. pl.: ’by missiles’
glossary.βήσαμεν: βαίνω — go; causative, make go, mount; aor. 1 pl. act. (= Attic ἐβήσαμεν), unaugmented: ’we made go’
glossary.βεβλήαται: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; perf. pass. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic βέβληνται): ’have been struck’
glossary.βεβλημένοι: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’(having been) struck’
glossary.βοηλασίῃ: βοηλασία — cattle-driving, a cattle-raid; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ), with ἀμφί: ’about a cattle-raid’
glossary.βουπρασίοιο: Βουπράσιον — Buprasium, a town of Elis; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.βουπρασίου: Βουπράσιον — Buprasium, a town of Elis; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.γαμβρὸς: γαμβρός — son-in-law, relative by marriage; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γεγήθει: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. γέγηθα) with past sense (= Attic ἐγεγήθει): ’was glad’
glossary.γναμπτοῖσι: γναμπτός — bent, flexible, pliant; adj., neut. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.δίφρους: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. acc. pl.: ’chariots’
glossary.δίῃ: δῖος — heavenly, divine, bright; fem. dat. sg., epithet of Elis: ’heavenly’
glossary.δαίτρευον: δαιτρεύω — divide, carve up, distribute; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἐδαίτρευον): ’they divided’
glossary.δαιτρεύειν: δαιτρεύω — divide, carve up, distribute; pres. inf. act.: ’to divide’
glossary.διείπομεν: διέπω — manage, order, arrange; 1 pl. past, either impf. διείπομεν (augment inside the compound) or aor. of διεῖπον ’tell through’: ’we arranged’
glossary.εἴποις: εἶπον — say, speak (aor. of ἐρῶ/λέγω); aor. opt. 2 sg. act., in a polite exhortation: ’you might say’
glossary.εἴσκοντες: ἴσκω — liken, take for, suppose; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’taking (you) for (him)’
glossary.εὕρομεν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 1 pl. act., 2nd aor.: ’we found’
glossary.θέουσ: θέω — run; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (θέουσ’ = θέουσα): ’running’
glossary.θέρωνται: θέρομαι — warm oneself, be heated; pres. subj. mid. 3 pl., long-vowel subj. in a clause after εἰς ὅ κε
glossary.θεοπροπίην: θεοπροπίη — prophecy, oracle; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic θεοπροπία): ’a prophecy’
glossary.θεύσεσθαι: θέω — run; fut. inf. mid., after ἔμελλον: ’to run’
glossary.θρυόεσσα: Θρυόεσσα — Thryoessa, a town on the Alpheus (θρύον ’rush’, i.e. reedy); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θωρήσσεσθαι: θωρήσσω — arm with a breastplate; mid. arm oneself; pres. inf. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic θωρήττεσθαι): ’to arm’
glossary.θύγατρ: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. acc. sg., elided (θύγατρ’ = θύγατρα)
glossary.κάσχεθε: κατέχω — hold back, restrain; aor. 3 sg. act. κάσχεθε (= κατέσχεθε; Attic κατέσχε), κατ- shortened by syncope: ’held back’
glossary.κέαται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 pl. mid./dep., epic κέαται (= Attic κεῖνται): ’lie’
glossary.κίοι: κίω — go, move; pres. opt. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἴοι): ’should go’
glossary.κατεκοιμήθημεν: κατακοιμάομαι — lie down to sleep; aor. 1 pl. pass./dep.: ’we lay down to sleep’
glossary.κεκακωμένοι: κακόω — ill-treat, distress; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’(having been) ill-treated’
glossary.κεκμηότας: κάμνω — grow weary, toil; perf. part. act. masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic κεκμηκότας): ’weary’
glossary.κελαινῇ: κελαινός — dark, black; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with λαίλαπι: ’dark’
glossary.κιόντι: κίω — go; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg. (= Attic ἰόντι), agreeing with μοι: ’(to me) going’
glossary.κτείνοντές: κτείνω — kill; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’killing’
glossary.κτεινώμεθ: κτείνω — kill; pres. subj. pass. 1 pl., elided (κτεινώμεθ’ = κτεινώμεθα): ’we are killed’
glossary.κόμισσα: κομίζω — take care of, carry off; aor. 1 sg. act., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκόμισα): ’I took charge of’
glossary.λέγοντες: λέγω — gather, pick up (Attic: say); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’gathering’
glossary.ληΐδα: ληΐς — booty, plunder, spoil; fem. acc. sg. (= Attic λεία): ’spoil’
glossary.λιπόμην: λείπω — leave; mid./pass. be left behind; aor. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλιπόμην): ’I was left behind’
glossary.μέλεσσιν: μέλος — limb; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic μέλεσιν): ’in the limbs’
glossary.μείναμεν: μένω — stay, wait, await; aor. 1 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμείναμεν): ’we waited’
glossary.μενοίτιον: Μενοίτιος — Menoetius, son of Actor, father of Patroclus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μενοίτιος: Μενοίτιος — Menoetius, son of Actor, father of Patroclus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετέπρεπον: μεταπρέπω — be conspicuous among, stand out among; impf. 1 sg. act., + dat.: ’I stood out among’
glossary.μετακλαύσεσθαι: μετακλαίω — weep afterwards, lament later; fut. inf. mid., after a verb of thinking: ’will weep afterwards’
glossary.μηρία: μηρίον — thigh-piece (of a sacrificial victim, burnt for the gods); neut. acc. pl.: ’thigh-pieces’
glossary.μινυήϊος: Μινυήϊος — the Minyeïus, a river of Elis (the Minyans’ river); adj. used as a name, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μολίονε: Μολίων — Molion, a son of Actor, one of the Molionidai; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the two Molions’
glossary.μούλιον: Μούλιος — Mulius, an Epean warrior (son-in-law of Augeias); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νέστορί: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. dat. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.νέῳ: νέος — young; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(to me,) young’
glossary.ναιετάασκε: ναιετάω — dwell, live; iterative impf. 3 sg. act., epic -ασκε and uncontracted (= Attic ᾤκει): ’used to dwell’
glossary.νεάτη: νέατος — furthest, last, lowest; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἔσχατος)
glossary.νηλεύς: Νηλεύς — Neleus, king of Pylos, father of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νηλεὺς: Νηλεύς — Neleus, king of Pylos, father of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νηλῆος: Νηλεύς — Neleus, king of Pylos, father of Nestor; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.νομῆας: νομεύς — herdsman, shepherd; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -έας)
glossary.ξανθὰς: ξανθός — yellow, chestnut, fair-haired; adj., fem. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους (mares): ’chestnut’
glossary.ξανθὴν: ξανθός — yellow, fair-haired; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀγαμήδην: ’fair-haired’
glossary.ξείνιά: ξείνιον — guest-gift, entertainment of a guest; neut. acc. pl., Ionic ξείν- (= Attic ξένια), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ξείνοις: ξεῖνος — guest, stranger, host; masc. dat. pl., Ionic ξείν- (= Attic ξένοις): ’for guests’
glossary.οἷσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -σι (= Attic οἷς): ’to whom’
glossary.οὐτάμενοί: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl., athematic: ’wounded’; accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.οὔτασται: οὐτάω — wound, stab; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been wounded’
glossary.οὕνεκά: οὕνεκα — because, since; conj., epic (= οὗ ἕνεκα; Attic ὅτι), accented before the enclitic μοι
glossary.οὖδας: οὖδας — ground, earth, floor; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πένθεος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πένθους)
