glossary.παρέθηκεν: παρατίθημι — set beside, set before; aor. 3 sg. act., κ-aorist: ’set out’
glossary.παραίφασίς: παραίφασις — persuasion, encouragement, comforting talk; fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.παῦροι: παῦρος — few, small; adj., masc. nom. pl.: ’few’
glossary.πείσεται: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, trust; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will obey’
glossary.περίτρεσαν: περιτρέω — tremble all round, shrink in fear; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= περιέτρεσαν): ’trembled’
glossary.πολεῖς: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολεῖς (= Attic πολλοί): ’many’
glossary.πολυπύρου: πολύπυρος — rich in wheat (πολύς + πυρός); adj., neut. gen. sg., agreeing with Βουπρασίου
glossary.ποτῆτος: ποτής — drink, drinking (= Attic πόσις); fem. gen. sg., after τάρπημεν: ’of drink’
glossary.πρεσβύτερος: πρέσβυς — old; comparative πρεσβύτερος ’older, elder’; masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.προέτω: προΐημι — send forth, let go; aor. imper. 3 sg. act.: ’let him send forth’
glossary.προθύροισι: πρόθυρον — forecourt, porch, gateway; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’in the forecourt’
glossary.πυλίοισι: Πύλιος — Pylian, of Pylos; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), as a noun: ’to the Pylians’
glossary.πύλονδ: Πύλος — Pylos; acc. sg. + -δε ’to’, elided (Πύλονδ’ = Πύλονδε): ’to Pylos’
glossary.πύματον: πύματος — last, final; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα
glossary.πώεα: πῶϋ — flock (of sheep) (= Attic πρόβατα); neut. pl. πώεα, nom./acc.: ’flocks’
glossary.πῶλοι: πῶλος — foal, young horse; masc. nom. pl.: ’foals’
glossary.σπένδων: σπένδω — pour a libation; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’pouring a libation of’
glossary.σπιδέος: σπιδής — wide, spread out; adj., masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -έος, agreeing with πεδίοιο
glossary.στῆμεν: ἵστημι — set; intrans. stand; aor. 1 pl. act., 2nd aor. (= Attic ἔστημεν): ’we stood’
glossary.στῆν: ἵστημι — set; intrans. stand; aor. 1 sg. act., 2nd aor., unaugmented (= Attic ἔστην): ’I stood’
glossary.συβόσια: συβόσιον — herd of swine; neut. acc. pl.: ’droves of swine’
glossary.συμφερόμεσθα: συμφέρομαι — clash with, come together in fight; impf. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic συνεφερόμεθα)
glossary.συναγρόμενοι: συναγείρω — gather together; 2nd aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., syncopated ἀγρόμενος: ’gathering together’
glossary.συνελάσσαμεν: συνελαύνω — drive together, round up; aor. 1 pl. act., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic συνηλάσαμεν): ’we drove together’
glossary.συῶν: σῦς — swine, pig; masc./fem. gen. pl.: ’of swine’
glossary.τάρπημεν: τέρπω — delight; pass. take one’s fill of, + gen.; aor. 1 pl. 2nd pass., unaugmented (= ἐτάρπημεν): ’we had our fill’
glossary.ταῦρον: ταῦρος — bull; masc. acc. sg.: ’a bull’
glossary.τειρόμενοι: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’being worn down’
glossary.τελέεσσι: τέλος — company, band of soldiers; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic τέλεσι): ’in companies’
glossary.τρίποδος: τρίπους — tripod (three-footed cauldron, a prize); masc. gen. sg., after περί: ’for a tripod’
glossary.τρίτῳ: τρίτος — third; ordinal, masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’on the third (day)’
glossary.τριηκόσι: τριηκόσιοι, -αι, -α — three hundred; numeral, neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic τριακόσια), elided (τριηκόσι’ = τριηκόσια)
glossary.τόσ: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (τόσ’ = τόσα): ’as many’
glossary.φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry, bear; mid. carry for oneself, take along; pres. inf. mid.: ’to carry (with oneself)’
glossary.φαέθων: φαέθων — shining, radiant; part. adj. (φαίνω), masc. nom. sg., epithet of the sun
glossary.φῶτες: φώς — man, hero; masc. nom. pl. (φώς, φωτός): ’men’
glossary.χαλκοχίτωνες: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze corselet; adj., masc. nom. pl., epithet of warriors
glossary.χρεῖος: χρεῖος — debt, what is owed; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic (= Attic χρέος)
glossary.χόρτῳ: χόρτος — enclosure, farmyard (for animals); masc. dat. sg., with ἐν: ’in the yard’
glossary.ἀέκητι: ἀέκητι — against the will of, in spite of; epic adv. used as a prep. + gen. (cf. ἀέκων ’unwilling’)
glossary.ἀγέλας: ἀγέλη — herd (of cattle); fem. acc. pl.: ’herds’
glossary.ἀγέλην: ἀγέλη — herd (of cattle); fem. acc. sg.: ’a herd’
glossary.ἀγαθὴ: ἀγαθός — good; adj., fem. nom. sg., predicate, agreeing with παραίφασις
glossary.ἀγαμήδην: Ἀγαμήδη — Agamede, daughter of Augeias, skilled in healing drugs; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγείροντες: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’gathering’
glossary.ἀγελαίην: ἀγελαῖος — of the herd, from the herd; adj., fem. acc. sg., Ionic -αίην (= Attic ἀγελαίαν), agreeing with βοῦν
glossary.ἀθλοφόροι: ἀθλοφόρος — prize-bearing, prize-winning; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
glossary.ἀκαχήμενον: ἀκαχίζω — distress; mid./perf. be grieved; perf. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic reduplicated: ’grieved’
glossary.ἀκμῆτες: ἀκμής — unwearied, fresh (the opposite of κεκμηώς); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀλάπαξα: ἀλαπάζω — sack, lay waste, destroy; aor. 1 sg. act., with κεν in a past potential: ’I would have laid waste’
glossary.ἀλεείνει: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun; pres. 3 sg. act., epic (= ἀλέομαι, Attic ἀλεύομαι): ’shuns’
glossary.ἀλησίου: Ἀλήσιον — Alesium, a place in Elis; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλφειῷ: Ἀλφειός — the Alpheus, river of Elis and Arcadia; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀμφέσταν: ἀμφίστημι — set around; intrans. stand around; aor. 3 pl. act., epic (= Attic ἀμφέστησαν): ’took their stand around’
glossary.ἀμφεστρατόωντο: ἀμφιστρατάομαι — encamp around, besiege; impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀμφεστρατῶντο)
glossary.ἀνάπνευσις: ἀνάπνευσις — breathing-space, relief, respite; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναπνεύσωσι: ἀναπνέω — get breath again, recover; aor. subj. 3 pl. act.: ’may get breath’
glossary.ἀπέκρυψεν: ἀποκρύπτω — hide away, conceal from; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’hid’, + dat. of the person
glossary.ἀπέτραπε: ἀποτρέπω — turn away, turn back; aor. 3 sg. act., 2nd aor.: ’turned back’
glossary.ἀπονήσεται: ἀπονίνημι — have benefit from, enjoy; fut. 3 sg. mid., + gen. of what is enjoyed: ’will have the benefit of’
glossary.ἀπόσχωνται: ἀπέχω — keep off; mid. hold oneself off, refrain from; aor. subj. mid. 3 pl., + gen. of separation: ’may hold off from’
glossary.ἀρήνης: Ἀρήνη — Arene, a town of Elis; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀρετῆς: ἀρετή — excellence, valour; fem. gen. sg., gen. of what is enjoyed after ἀπονήσεται
glossary.ἀτάσθαλα: ἀτάσθαλος — reckless, wanton, arrogant; adj., neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’wanton things’
glossary.ἀτεμβόμενος: ἀτέμβω — cheat, deprive; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’(being) cheated’
glossary.ἀϋτῇ: ἀϋτή — battle-cry, shout; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with a battle-cry’
glossary.ἄγειρεν: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἤγειρε): ’gathered’
glossary.ἄεθλα: ἄεθλον — prize, contest; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἆθλα): ’prizes’
glossary.ἄκοντι: ἄκων — javelin, dart; masc. dat. sg., of means: ’with a javelin’
glossary.ἄλεισον: ἄλεισον — cup, goblet; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐκάκωσε: κακόω — ill-treat, afflict; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’ill-treated’
glossary.ἐλίγαινον: λιγαίνω — cry out shrill, call loudly; impf. 3 pl. act.: ’cried out clearly’
glossary.ἐλατῆρ: ἐλατήρ — driver (of a chariot); masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐλατῆρ’ = ἐλατῆρα): ’driver’
glossary.ἐλαυνόμενος: ἐλαύνω — drive; mid. drive off for oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’driving off (as spoil)’
glossary.ἐμὴ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἲς: ’my’
glossary.ἐννύχιοι: ἐννύχιος — by night, nocturnal; adj., masc. nom. pl., used adverbially: ’by night’
glossary.ἐπέρρεον: ἐπιρρέω — flow on, stream upon; impf. 3 pl. act. (augment inside the compound, ρρ doubled): ’flowed up’
glossary.ἐπέτελλον: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give orders to (+ dat.); impf. 3 pl. act., augment inside the compound: ’gave charges’
glossary.ἐπέφραδε: φράζω — point out, tell, show; reduplicated 2nd aor. 3 sg. act. (ἔπεφραδον): ’pointed out’
glossary.ἐπέων: ἔπος — word; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπῶν): ’of words’
glossary.ἐπειοὶ: Ἐπειοί — the Epeans, the people of Elis; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπισχερώ: ἐπισχερώ — in a row, one after another, in succession; adv. (from σχερός ’continuous line’)
glossary.ἐπόρουσα: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring at; aor. 1 sg. act., augment inside the compound: ’I rushed upon’
glossary.ἐσσυμένους: σεύω — drive, set in motion; mid. rush, be eager; perf. part. pass./mid. masc. acc. pl., epic ἐσσυμένος: ’eager’
glossary.ἐτέων: ἔτος — year; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐτῶν): ’of years’
glossary.ἐόντ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. acc. dual, elided (ἐόντ’ = ἐόντε), epic (= Attic ὄντε): ’being’
glossary.ἑλόμεσθα: αἱρέω — take; mid. take for oneself; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic εἱλόμεθα), unaugmented: ’we took’
glossary.ἑπέσθω: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aor.: ’let him follow’
glossary.ἑπόμεσθα: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic εἱπόμεθα): ’we followed’
glossary.ἔκταθεν: κτείνω — kill; aor. 3 pl., epic strong form ἔκταθεν with passive sense (= Attic ἐκτάνθησαν): ’were killed’
glossary.ἔνδιοι: ἔνδιος — at midday, in the noon heat; adj., masc. nom. pl., used adverbially: ’at midday’
glossary.ἔννυχος: ἔννυχος — by night, in the night; adj. of two endings, masc./fem. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’by night’
glossary.ἔντεσιν: ἔντεα — gear, armour; neut. pl.; dat. pl. ἔντεσιν: ’in (their) gear’
glossary.ἔον: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔον (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’
glossary.ἔπεσεν: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg. act., 2nd aor. ἔπεσον with the 1st-aor. ending: ’fell’
glossary.ἔσθ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔσθ’ = ἔστι before a rough breathing)
glossary.ἔτρεσαν: τρέω — tremble, flee in fear; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’trembled’
glossary.ἕπετον: ἕπω — be busy about, tend (ἀμφὶ … ἕπω); impf. 2 dual act., unaugmented (= εἵπετον): ’you two were busy about’
glossary.ἠθέλετον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 2 dual act., augmented: ’you two were willing’
glossary.ἠκούομεν: ἀκούω — hear, listen; impf. 1 pl. act.: ’we heard’
glossary.ἠλασάμεσθα: ἐλαύνω — drive; mid. drive off for oneself; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα and σ (= Attic ἠλασάμεθα): ’we drove off’
glossary.ἠλείοισι: Ἠλεῖος — Elean, of Elis; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), as a noun: ’the Eleans’
glossary.ἡγεμόν: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἡγεμόν’ = ἡγεμόνα): ’leader’
glossary.ἡμετέροισι: ἡμέτερος — our; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with ἱππεῦσι
glossary.ἡρακληείη: Ἡρακληείη — of Heracles (the might of Heracles, i.e. Heracles); adj., fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic Ἡρακλεία)
glossary.ἤγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 1 sg. act., 2nd aor. with reduplicated stem: ’I brought’
glossary.ἤλιδι: Ἦλις — Elis, region of the Epeans; fem. dat. sg.: ’in Elis’
glossary.ἤλιθα: ἤλιθα — exceedingly, greatly; adv., epic (of uncertain origin), with πολλήν: ’exceeding(ly)’
glossary.ἰτυμονῆα: Ἰτυμονεύς — Itymoneus, son of Hypeirochus, an Epean; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἱεροῖσι: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. dat. pl., epic -οῖσι (= Attic -οῖς), as a noun: ’offerings’
glossary.ἱκόμεσθ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἱκόμεσθ’ = ἱκόμεσθα, epic for Attic ἱκόμεθα): ’we came to’
glossary.ἲς: ἴς — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴσης: ἴσος — equal, fair; adj., fem. gen. sg., gen. of what is lacking after ἀτεμβόμενος (μοίρης understood): ’(cheated of) an equal share’
glossary.ὀρίναις: ὀρίνω — stir, rouse, move; aor. opt. 2 sg. act., with κεν in a potential: ’you might stir’
glossary.ὀφείλετ: ὀφείλω — owe, be due; impf. 3 sg. pass., elided (ὀφείλετ’ = ὀφείλετο): ’was owed’
glossary.ὄληται: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid.: ’perish’
glossary.ὄφειλον: ὀφείλω — owe; impf. 3 pl. act. (= Attic ὤφειλον), unaugmented: ’they owed’
glossary.ὑβρίζοντες: ὑβρίζω — treat insolently, behave outrageously; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., + acc.: ’insulting’
glossary.ὑπέρτερός: ὑπέρτερος — higher, superior; comparative adj., masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.ὑπειροχίδην: Ὑπειροχίδης — son of Hypeirochus; patronymic, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπερέσχεθε: ὑπερέχω — hold over; aor. 3 sg. act. ὑπερέσχεθε, epic 2nd aor. (= Attic ὑπέρσχε), + gen.: ’held itself above’
glossary.ὑπερηφανέοντες: ὑπερηφανέω — behave overbearingly, be arrogant; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὑπερηφανοῦντες)
glossary.ὑπερμενεῖ: ὑπερμενής — exceedingly strong, mighty; adj., masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ὑποθέσθαι: ὑποτίθεμαι — suggest, advise; aor. inf. mid., 2nd aor.: ’to advise’
glossary.ὑπῆσαν: ὕπειμι — be under, be beneath; impf. 3 pl.: ’were under’
glossary.ὠλενίης: Ὠλένιος — Olenian, of Olenus; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας), agreeing with πέτρης
glossary.ὤσαισθε: ὠθέω — push; mid. push back; aor. opt. mid. 2 pl., with κε in a potential: ’you could push back’
glossary.ῥόον: ῥόος — stream, flow; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥοῦς): ’stream’
glossary.ῥύσι: ῥύσιον — pledge, reprisal; neut. acc. pl., elided (ῥύσι’ = ῥύσια): ’goods taken in reprisal’
glossary.αἰέν: αἰέν — always, ever; adv., epic by-form of αἰεί (= Attic ἀεί)
glossary.δεδιδάχθαι: διδάσκω — teach; perf. pass. inf., after φασιν: ’(they say) you have been taught’, the teacher given by προτί + gen.
glossary.δειλοὶ: δειλός — wretched, pitiable; masc. voc. pl., in address
glossary.διατρίψας: διατρίβω — rub through, crush by rubbing; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having rubbed (it) fine’
glossary.δικαιότατος: δίκαιος — just, righteous; superl. masc. nom. sg., with partitive gen.: ’most just (of the Centaurs)’
glossary.εὐρύπυλ: Εὐρύπυλος — Eurypylus; masc. voc. sg., elided Εὐρύπυλ’ (= Εὐρύπυλε), in address
glossary.κελάρυζε: κελαρύζω — gurgle, plash; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκελάρυζε): ’gurgled, welled’
glossary.κενταύρων: Κένταυροι — the Centaurs; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.λιαρῷ: λιαρός — warm, tepid; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ὕδατι
glossary.μαχαίρῃ: μάχαιρα — knife; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic μαχαίρᾳ), instrumental: ’with a knife’
glossary.μεθήσω: μεθίημι — let go, give up (+ gen.); fut. 1 sg.: ’I will let go of, abandon’
glossary.νίζ: νίζω — wash; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided νίζ’ (= νίζε): ’wash’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (= ἔνιζε): ’was washing’
glossary.νότιος: νότιος — moist, dripping (from νοτίς ’moisture’; not νότιος ’southern’); masc. nom. sg., of sweat
glossary.περιπευκές: περιπευκής — very sharp, keen (περι- intensive; root of ἐχεπευκής); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with βέλος
glossary.πεσέονται: πίπτω — fall; fut. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic πεσοῦνται): ’will fall’
glossary.πικρὴν: πικρός — bitter, sharp-tasting; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ῥίζαν
glossary.προτί: πρός (epic προτί) — toward, at, from; prep. + gen. of the source after a verb of learning: ’from (Achilles)’
glossary.σάωσον: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save, keep safe; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’save’
glossary.σκάζων: σκάζω — limp; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’limping’
glossary.σχήσουσι: ἔχω — have, hold, hold back; fut. 3 pl. (stem σχ-, fut. σχήσω): ’will hold back, check’
glossary.ταχέας: ταχύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic -έας (= Attic ταχεῖς), agreeing with κύνας: ’swift’
glossary.τειρομένοιο: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with σεῖο: ’distressed’
glossary.φασιν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl., enclitic: ’they say’ (+ acc. and inf.)
glossary.φθίσονται: φθίνω — perish, waste away; fut. 3 pl. mid. (φθίσομαι): ’will perish’
glossary.χρηΐζοντα: χρηΐζω — need, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic -ΐζω (= Attic χρῄζω): ’needing’
glossary.ἀντεβόλησε: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’met’
glossary.ἀργέτι: ἀργής — bright, white, gleaming; masc. dat. sg., epic ἀργέτι (= ἀργῆτι), agreeing with δημῷ: ’white (fat)’
glossary.ἄσειν: ἄω — sate, glut (+ dat. of what with); fut. inf. (the aor. inf. is ἆσαι), after ἐμέλλετε: ’to glut’; Attic uses κορέννυμι
glossary.ἐδίδαξε: διδάσκω — teach; aor. 3 sg., augmented, + acc. of the pupil: ’taught (him)’
glossary.ἐκτανύσας: ἐκτανύω — stretch out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stretched (him) out’
glossary.ἐμέλλετε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined; impf. 2 pl., augmented, + fut. inf.: ’you were destined to’
glossary.ἐνίσπω: ἐνέπω — tell, relate; aor. subj. 1 sg. (ἐνίσπον), in a purpose clause after ὄφρ’: ’that I may tell’
glossary.ἐτετεύχατο: τεύχω — make, build; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic ἐτετεύχηντο): ’had been built’
glossary.ἔκταμ: ἐκτάμνω (= ἐκτέμνω) — cut out; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided ἔκταμ’ (= ἔκταμε; Attic ἔκτεμε): ’cut out’
glossary.ἔρχομαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 1 sg.: ’I am going’
glossary.ἕλκεος: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. gen. sg., epic ἕλκεος (= Attic ἕλκους)
glossary.ἤην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἰητροὶ: ἰητρός — healer, physician; masc. nom. pl., Ionic (= Attic ἰατροί)
glossary.ὀδυνήφατον: ὀδυνήφατος — pain-killing (lit. ’pain-slaying’); fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ῥίζαν
glossary.ὀδύνας: ὀδύνη — pain, grief, anguish; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑπέχευε: ὑποχέω — pour or spread beneath; epic aor. 3 sg., augmented (= Attic ὑπέχεε): ’spread under’
glossary.ᾤκτειρε: οἰκτείρω — pity; aor. 3 sg., augmented (οι- → ῳ-): ’pitied’
glossary.αἴσηπος: Αἴσηπος — the Aesepus, a river of the Troad rising on Ida; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βαλλόμεν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; pres. part. mid./pass., neut. nom. pl., elided βαλλόμεν’ (= βαλλόμενα): ’being struck’
glossary.βοάγρια: βοάγριον — a thing of ox-hide, taken as ox-hide shields (exact sense unknown; rare word); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.γρήνικός: Γρήνικος — the Granicus, a river of the Troad; masc. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.δειδίσσετο: δειδίσσομαι — frighten, scare (causative of δείδω); impf. 3 sg. mid., active in sense, unaugmented (= ἐδειδίσσετο): ’scared off’
glossary.διαβαινέμεν: διαβαίνω — step across, cross; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic διαβαίνειν)
glossary.διαστάντες: διΐστημι — set apart; intrans. aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., root aorist (ἔστην): ’having stood apart’
glossary.δῖός: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.εἰσαγαγόντες: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., 2nd aor. stem ἀγαγ-: ’bringing in’
glossary.εἴκουσι: εἴκω — yield, give way; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.εὐρεῖ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. nom. sg., elided εὐρεῖ’ (= εὐρεῖα)
glossary.εὐρύ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρύπυλον: Εὐρύπυλος — Eurypylus, an Achaean leader, not the son of Telephus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θάνον: θνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθανον): ’they died’
glossary.θαμειὰς: θαμέες, θαμειαί — thick, close-set, frequent (plural adj.); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with αἰχμάς
glossary.θεμείλια: θεμείλια — foundations (pl. only; = Attic θεμέλια); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.θησέμεναι: τίθημι — put, set, make; fut. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic θήσειν): ’to make, bring about’
glossary.κάπριος: κάπριος (= κάπρος) — wild boar; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάρησός: Κάρησος — the Caresus, a river of the Troad; masc. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.κανάχιζε: κανάχιζω — ring, clang, rattle (sound-word); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκανάχιζε): ’rang’
glossary.καταβήμεναι: καταβαίνω — go down; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic καταβῆναι)
glossary.κλισίῃσι: κλισίη — hut, tent, shelter; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κλισίαις)
glossary.κρημνοὶ: κρημνός — overhanging bank, steep edge; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κύνεσσι: κύων — dog; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κυσί)
glossary.κὰρ: κατά — down; prep. + acc., apocope before ῥ (κὰρ ῥόον = κατὰ ῥόον): ’down the stream’
glossary.λάων: λᾶας — stone; masc. gen. pl. λάων (Attic λίθων)
glossary.λίποντο: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐλίποντο), passive in sense: ’were left, survived’
glossary.λεῖα: λεῖος — smooth, level; neut. acc. pl., predicate: ’smooth’
glossary.μεγάλους: μέγας — great, big, large; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μενέουσ: μένω — stay, stand firm; fut. 3 pl., elided, uncontracted μενέουσ’ (= μενέουσι, Attic μενοῦσι)
glossary.μενοίνεον: μενοινάω — be eager, desire, have in mind; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted, unaugmented (Attic ἐμενοίνων)
glossary.μητιόωντο: μητιάομαι — devise, plan; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted -όωντο (= Attic ἐμητιῶντο), unaugmented
glossary.μογέοντες: μογέω — toil, labour; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic μογοῦντες)
glossary.νωνύμνους: νώνυμνος — nameless, without fame (νη- privative + ὄνυμα); masc. acc. pl. (= Attic νώνυμος)
glossary.πένταχα: πένταχα — in five parts, fivefold; adv. (= Attic πενταχῇ)
glossary.πέρθετο: πέρθω — sack, destroy; 3 sg. mid. of the present stem, unaugmented (= ἐπέρθετο), passive in sense: ’was sacked’
glossary.παλίωξις: παλίωξις — a chase back, pursuit turned round (rare; sense inferred from πάλιν ’back’, not certain); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πειρητίζων: πειρητίζω (= πειράω) — try, test; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic, + acc. or gen.: ’testing’
glossary.περῆσαι: περάω — cross, pass over; aor. inf. act., epic (= Attic περᾶσαι): ’to cross’
glossary.ποιήσαντο: ποιέω — make, build; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐποιήσαντο): ’they made (for themselves)’
glossary.πουλυδάμας: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, Trojan counsellor; masc. nom. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Attic Πολυδάμας)
glossary.προρέουσι: προρρέω — flow forth, run on; pres. 3 pl. (Homeric spelling προρέουσι, Attic προρρέουσι)
glossary.πυκνοὺς: πυκνός — thick, close, dense; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πυργηδὸν: πυργηδόν — tower-wise, in the manner of a tower; adv. in -ηδόν (πύργος)
glossary.σκολόπεσσιν: σκόλοψ — stake, pointed pole; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic σκόλοψι), instrumental
glossary.σκόλοπες: σκόλοψ — stake, pointed pole; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.στεῖνος: στεῖνος — narrow place, narrowness (= Attic στένος); neut. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.στρέφεται: στρέφω — turn, wheel round; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’wheels about, turns’
glossary.συνεχές: συνεχής — continuous, unbroken; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’without a break’
glossary.σχήσειν: ἔχω — have, hold, hold out; fut. inf. act. from the stem σχη- (Attic σχήσειν, ἕξειν): ’to hold out’ · also fut. inf. act., transitive: ’to hold off, check’ (σχήσειν … μένος ’would hold off the might’)
glossary.ταρβεῖ: ταρβέω — be afraid, be dismayed; pres. 3 sg. act., contracted (ταρβέει)
glossary.τρίαιναν: τρίαινα — trident, Poseidon’s weapon; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τρυφάλειαι: τρυφάλεια — helmet (exact form of the helmet uncertain); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.τρώσεσθαι: τιτρώσκω — wound; fut. inf. mid. τρώσεσθαι, passive in sense: ’to be wounded’
glossary.τόλμων: τολμάω — dare, endure, bring oneself to; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἐτόλμων): ’dared’
glossary.φιτρῶν: φιτρός — log, piece of timber (usually plural); gen. pl.
glossary.χείλει: χεῖλος — lip, edge; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.χρεμέτιζον: χρεμετίζω — neigh, whinny; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἐχρεμέτιζον): ’whinnied’
glossary.ἀγάρροον: ἀγάρροος — strong-flowing (ἄγαν + ῥόος); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγάρρους)
glossary.ἀγηνορίη: ἀγηνορία — manliness, pride of courage, overbearing spirit; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
glossary.ἀκοντίζουσι: ἀκοντίζω — hurl a spear, throw a javelin (ἄκων); pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἀλαπάζει: ἀλαπάζω — sack, lay waste; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἀλεωρήν: ἀλεωρή — protection, defence; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to the stakes: ’a defence’
glossary.ἀμαλδύνας: ἀμαλδύνω — wipe out, destroy utterly; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having wiped out’
glossary.ἀμαλδῦναι: ἀμαλδύνω — wipe out, destroy utterly; aor. inf. act.: ’to wipe out’
glossary.ἀπόρθητος: ἀπόρθητος — unsacked, not plundered (ἀ- privative + πέρθω); fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), predicate
glossary.ἀργαλέη: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, grievous; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α), predicate
glossary.ἀρτύναντες: ἀρτύνω — arrange, prepare, set in order; aor. part. act., masc. nom. pl.: ’having arrayed (themselves)’
glossary.ἁλίπλοα: ἁλίπλοος — sense unknown; perhaps ’sea-sailed’ (ἅλς + πλέω), i.e. washed by the sea; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic -πλους)
glossary.ἅδε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; aor. 3 sg. act. (stem ἁδ-), unaugmented, + dat.
glossary.ἐελμένοι: εἴλω — shut in, hem in, press together; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic εἱλμένοι): ’hemmed in’
glossary.ἐλαύνομεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive on; pres. 1 pl. act.: ’we drive, are driving’ (horses)
glossary.ἐλλίσσεθ: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided ἐλλίσσεθ’ (= ἐλλίσσετο), augment doubling the λ: ’begged’
glossary.ἐμάρνατο: μάρναμαι — fight; impf. 3 sg. mid., athematic (= Attic ἐμάχετο): ’fought’
glossary.ἐνιαυτῷ: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. dat. sg., dat. of time when
glossary.ἐνιπλήξωμεν: ἐνιπλήσσω — dash into, strike against (+ dat.); aor. subj. 1 pl. act. (= Attic ἐμπλήξωμεν): ’we dash into’
glossary.ἐνοπή: ἐνοπή — shout, battle-cry, din; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπηρεφέες: ἐπηρεφής — overhanging, beetling; adj., masc./fem. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἐρυκόντων: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep off; pres. imper. 3 pl. act. (Attic ἐρυκόντων or ἐρυκέτωσαν): ’let them hold back’
glossary.ἐσβαίη: εἰσβαίνω — step in, get in; aor. opt. 3 sg. act. (ἐς + βαίνω), with κεν, potential: ’would get in’
glossary.ἐφεσταότες: ἐφίστημι — stand upon; perf. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic -αότες (= Attic ἐφεστηκότες): ’standing upon’
glossary.ἑλιχθέντων: ἑλίσσω — turn, wheel round; aor. pass. part. masc. gen. pl. (gen. absolute, with ’of us’ understood): ’(we) turned about’
glossary.ἑπτάπορός: Ἑπτάπορος — the Heptaporus (’seven fords’), a river of the Troad; masc. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.ἑπώμεθ: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. subj. mid. 1 pl., elided ἑπώμεθ’ (= ἑπώμεθα), hortatory: ’let us follow’
glossary.ἑστᾶσιν: ἵστημι — stand; perf. 3 pl. act., intransitive, contracted (= ἑστήκασι): ’stand, are standing’
glossary.ἔπλεν: πέλομαι — be, become; 3 sg. aor. ἔπλεν (by-form of ἔπλετο): ’was’
glossary.ἔτραπε: τρέπω — turn; 2nd aor. 3 sg. act. (cf. ἔτρεψε): ’turned’
glossary.ἠρήρει: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, fasten, make firm; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. ἄρηρα, intrans.): ’was fitted’
glossary.ἡγεῖτ: ἡγέομαι — lead, lead the way; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided ἡγεῖτ’ (= ἡγεῖτο): ’led the way’
glossary.ἡμιθέων: ἡμίθεος — half-god, demigod; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἰθύσῃ: ἰθύω — rush straight on, charge; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause: ’wherever it charges’
glossary.ἰσχανόωντο: ἰσχανάομαι (ἰσχανάω) — hold back, hold oneself back; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted -όωντο, unaugmented
glossary.ἰᾶτ: ἰάομαι — heal, cure; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided ἰᾶτ’ (= ἰᾶτο): ’was healing’
glossary.ἵεν: ἵημι — send, let flow; impf. 3 pl. act., ἵεν (= Attic ἵεσαν): ’sent’
glossary.ἵετ: ἵεμαι (mid. of ἵημι) — hasten, be eager, long (+ inf.); elided ἵετ’, pres. 3 sg. mid. (= ἵεται; or impf. ἵετο): ’is eager’
glossary.ἵστανται: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. ’take a stand’; pres. 3 pl. mid., intransitive: ’take their stand, stand’
glossary.ὀξέσιν: ὀξύς — sharp; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable (= Attic ὀξέσι)
glossary.ὀρυκτῇ: ὀρυκτός — dug, excavated (from ὀρύσσω); fem. dat. sg., agreeing with τάφρῳ
glossary.ὁμιλαδόν: ὁμιλαδόν — in a throng, in a crowd; adv. in -δόν (ὅμιλος)
glossary.ὁμόσε: ὁμόσε — to the same place, together; adv.
glossary.ὄρουσαν: ὀρούω — rush, leap, spring up; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ὤρουσαν): ’they rushed, leapt’
glossary.ὅππῃ: ὅππῃ — in whatever way, wherever; epic relative adv. (= Attic ὅπῃ)
glossary.ὑπερθορέειν: ὑπερθρῴσκω — leap over; 2nd aor. inf. act., epic -έειν (= Attic ὑπερθορεῖν): ’to leap over’
glossary.ὑποστρέψωσι: ὑποστρέφω — turn about, turn back; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., after εἰ δέ χ’: ’if they turn back’
glossary.ῥηϊδίη: ῥηΐδιος — easy; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ῥᾴδιος, ῥᾳδία), predicate
glossary.ῥοδίος: Ῥοδίος — the Rhodius, a river of the Troad; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ῥύοιτο: ῥύομαι — protect, shield, rescue; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a purpose clause: ’might protect’
glossary.ῥῆσός: Ῥῆσος — the Rhesus, a river of the Troad (same name as the Thracian king); masc. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.αἰόλοι: αἰόλος — quick-darting, nimble, gleaming; masc. nom. pl., epithet of wasps: ’nimble’
glossary.αὔας: αὖος — dry, withered; fem. acc. pl., of hides: ’dry’
glossary.αὖον: αὖος — dry; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’with a dry (hollow) ring’
glossary.βίηφι: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental in -φι (= dat. βίῃ): ’in might, by force’
glossary.δέχαται: δέχομαι — receive, await; 3 pl. mid., epic -αται (= Attic δέχονται), present force: ’await’
glossary.δευκαλίδαο: Δευκαλίδης — son of Deucalion (Idomeneus); masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δηΐφοβος: Δηΐφοβος — Deiphobus, a son of Priam, a leading Trojan warrior; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.διήλασεν: διελαύνω — drive through; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’drove through’
glossary.διηνεκέεσσ: διηνεκής — unbroken, continuous; fem. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic -έσι), elided διηνεκέεσσ’, agreeing with ῥίζῃσιν
glossary.δονήσας: δονέω — shake, toss; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having shaken’
glossary.δοχμώ: δοχμός — slanting, sideways; masc. nom. dual, of two creatures: ’slantwise’
glossary.δυσώνυμος: δυσώνυμος — of evil name, ill-omened; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.εἴσαντο: εἴδομαι — seem, appear (to be); aor. 3 pl. mid., epic, with dat. and inf.: ’seemed’
glossary.ζαὴς: ζαής — hard-blowing (ζα- intensive + ἄημι); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεσπιδαὲς: θεσπιδαής — wondrously blazing (θέσπις + δαίω ’burn’); adj., neut. nom./acc. sg., epithet of fire
glossary.κάλλιπεν: καταλείπω — leave behind; aor. 3 sg., κάλλιπεν = κατέλιπεν (κατά shortened before λ)
glossary.καθύπερθε: καθύπερθε(ν) — from above, above, overhead; adv. (κατά + ὕπερθε)
glossary.κακὰς: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with κῆρας
glossary.κατακτάμεν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. inf., epic (= Attic κατακτεῖναι)
glossary.κεβριόναο: Κεβριόνης — Cebriones, Hector’s charioteer; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), gen. of comparison: ’than Cebriones’
glossary.κεκλήγοντες: κλάζω — cry out, clamour; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., present force, epic -οντες (= κεκληγότες)
glossary.κολοσυρτὸν: κολοσυρτός — tumult, uproar of a noisy crowd; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κοῖλον: κοῖλος — hollow; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δόμος: ’hollow’
glossary.κόμπει: κομπέω — clash, ring, clatter; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκόμπει): ’clanged’
glossary.λαπίθαι: Λαπίθαι — the Lapiths, a people of Thessaly; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λαπιθάων: Λαπίθαι — the Lapiths, a people of Thessaly; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.λελιημένοι: λελίημαι — be eager, strain (to); perf. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., present force: ’eager’
glossary.λεοντῆα: Λεοντεύς — Leonteus, a Lapith leader; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.λιπεῖν: λείπω — leave, abandon; 2nd aor. inf. act.: ’to leave’
glossary.μίμνουσι: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, wait for, withstand; pres. 3 pl.: ’await’
glossary.μεγάλῃσι: μέγας — great; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic μεγάλαις), agreeing with ῥίζῃσιν
glossary.μηρὼ: μηρός — thigh; masc. acc. dual: ’both thighs’
glossary.μυλάκεσσι: μύλαξ — millstone, a heavy rounded stone; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -ξι), instrumental: ’with millstones’
glossary.νίσοντο: νίσομαι — go, go back, return; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were returning’
glossary.παιπαλοέσσῃ: παιπαλόεις — rugged, rocky; fem. dat. sg., epic -όεσσα (= Attic -όεισα), agreeing with ὁδῷ
glossary.πειριθόου: Πειρίθοος — Peirithous, king of the Lapiths; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πεπλήγετο: πλήσσω — strike; mid. strike one’s own (body); epic reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’struck (his thighs)’
glossary.πεποιθότες: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα, trust (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’trusting in’
glossary.πεῖθε: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπειθε), + acc.: ’did persuade, move’
glossary.ποιήσωνται: ποιέω — make; mid. make for oneself; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., indefinite in a simile: ’they make’
glossary.πολυποίτην: Πολυποίτης — Polypoetes, a Lapith leader, son of Peirithous; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πουλυδάμαντι: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, a Trojan, Hector’s counsellor; masc. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Πολυδάμαντι)
glossary.πουλυδάμαντος: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, a Trojan, Hector’s counsellor; masc. gen. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Πολυδάμαντος)
glossary.πῖπτον: πίπτω — fall; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπιπτον): ’were falling’
glossary.σαώσειαν: σαόω — save, rescue (= Attic σῴζω); aor. opt. 3 pl. act., in a clause of purpose after εἰ: ’might save’
glossary.σφῶν: σφεῖς — they, themselves; gen. pl. σφῶν: ’of themselves’ (with αὐτῶν)
glossary.σύεσσιν: σῦς (ὗς) — swine; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic συσί)
glossary.ταρφειὰς: ταρφύς — thick, close-packed; fem. acc. pl. ταρφειάς, with the understood νιφάδας: ’thick (flakes)’
glossary.τρίτων: τρίτος — third; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the third’
glossary.τυκτῇσι: τυκτός — well-made, fashioned; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with βόεσσι
glossary.υἷα: υἱός — son; acc. sg., epic υἷα (= Attic υἱόν)
glossary.φαεινὸς: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φιλοψευδὴς: φιλοψευδής — lie-loving, fond of falsehood; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χάσσασθαι: χάζομαι — give way, draw back; aor. inf. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic χάσασθαι): ’to give way’
glossary.ἀΐσσοντε: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two darting’
glossary.ἀΰτευν: ἀϋτέω — cry out, ring; impf. 3 pl., epic -ευν (= -εον), unaugmented: ’rang’
glossary.ἀγακλειτῶν: ἀγακλειτός — renowned, glorious; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀγαλλόμενος: ἀγάλλομαι — exult, glory (in, + dat.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγορεῦσαι: ἀγορεύω — speak, say, proclaim; aor. inf.: ’to speak, to tell’
glossary.ἀγροτέροισι: ἀγρότερος — wild, of the field; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀδάμαντα: Ἀδάμας — Adamas, a Trojan, son of Asius; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκαχήατο: ἀκαχίζω — grieve, distress; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ήατο: ’were grieved’, with acc. of respect
glossary.ἀλαστήσας: ἀλαστέω — be furious, rage, be beside oneself; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’in bitter indignation’
glossary.ἀλκάθοος: Ἀλκάθοος — Alcathous, a Trojan leader, son of Aesyetes; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλύξας: ἀλύσκω — escape, avoid; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμωμήτοιο: ἀμώμητος — blameless, faultless; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀμύνεσθαι: ἀμύνω — ward off; mid. defend oneself; pres. inf. mid.: ’to defend oneself’
glossary.ἀμύνονται: ἀμύνω — ward off; mid. fend off from oneself; pres. 3 pl. mid., + acc.: ’fend off’
glossary.ἀναπεπταμένας: ἀναπετάννυμι — spread out, throw open; perf. part. pass. fem. acc. pl.: ’thrown open’
glossary.ἀπολείπουσιν: ἀπολείπω — leave behind, abandon; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.ἀραρυῖαι: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; perf. part. fem. nom. pl., intransitive: ’closely fitted’
glossary.ἀριστερά: ἀριστερός — left; neut. pl. as a noun: ’the left (side)’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερά ’to the left’)
glossary.ἀσιάδην: Ἀσιάδης — son of Asius; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
glossary.ἀστεροπαῖον: Ἀστεροπαῖος — Asteropaeus, a Paeonian ally of the Trojans; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἁλῶναι: ἁλίσκομαι — be caught, be taken; aor. inf. ἁλῶναι
glossary.ἄγνυτον: ἄγνυμι — break; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐάγνυτον): ’the two broke’
glossary.ἄλλῃσι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἄλλαις), agreeing with πύλῃσιν
glossary.ἄραρον: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; 2nd aor. 3 pl. act., reduplicated, transitive: ’fitted’
glossary.ἄσιον: Ἄσιος — Asius, son of Hyrtacus; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐκτάμνοντες: ἐκτάμνω (= ἐκτέμνω) — cut out, cut off; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic: ’cutting off’
glossary.ἐνόησαν: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἐοικότε: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; perf. part. masc. nom. dual, + dat.: ’like’
glossary.ἐπεσσυμένους: ἐπισεύω — drive on; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. pl., ἐπέσσυμαι intrans.: ’rushing on’
glossary.ἐπικεκλιμένας: ἐπικλίνω — lean on, shut to; perf. part. pass. fem. acc. pl.: ’shut to’
glossary.ἐπιτάρροθοι: ἐπιτάρροθος — helper, ally in battle; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐτέτυξο: τεύχω — make; pass. be made, prove to be; plpf. 2 sg., epic ἐτέτυξο: ’you proved (to be)’
glossary.ἐϋδμήτων: ἐΰδμητος — well-built (ἐΰ + δέμω); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἑτέρων: ἕτερος — other, one of two; gen. pl.: ’of others’
glossary.ἔκιον: κίω — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ᾔεσαν): ’went’
glossary.ἔπρεπε: πρέπω — stand out, be conspicuous; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔραζε: ἔραζε — to the ground, earthward; adv., ἔρα + directional -ζε
glossary.ἕληται: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after εἰς ὅ κε ’until’ (= Attic ἕως ἂν …); with ἐκ in tmesis, ’take out’
glossary.ἠμύνοντο: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; mid. impf. 3 pl., augmented, + gen.: ’were defending’
glossary.ἥρωας: ἥρως — hero, man of rank or noble birth; acc. pl.
glossary.ἰαμενὸν: Ἰάμενος — Iamenus, a Trojan warrior; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀχῆα: ὀχεύς — bar, bolt (of a gate); masc. acc. sg., epic ὀχῆα (= Attic ὀχέα)
glossary.ὄρνυον: ὄρνυμι — rouse, urge on; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ὤρνυον): ’were urging on’
glossary.ὑπερθύμους: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, proud; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑψηλάων: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ὑψικάρηνοι: ὑψικάρηνος — high-headed, with lofty crown; adj. (2-ending), fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. dual, taken so with μηρώ: ’his own (two thighs)’ (dual form, not the relative)
glossary.ῥέον: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔρρεον): ’were flowing’
glossary.ῥίζῃσιν: ῥίζα — root; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ῥίζαις)
glossary.ῥηξάμενοι: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having broken’
glossary.αἰετὸς: ἀετός — eagle; masc. nom. sg., epic αἰετός (= Attic ἀετός)
glossary.αὐέρυον: αὐερύω — draw back, pull back (αὖ + ἐρύω); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.αὐτοσχεδίην: αὐτοσχέδιος — at close quarters, hand to hand; fem. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’in close combat’
glossary.αὐτὰ: αὐτός — self, same; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with κέλευθα: ’the very same’
glossary.γιγνώσκετε: γιγνώσκω — know, recognise, perceive; pres. 2 pl. indic.: ’you know’
glossary.δίεσθαι: δίεμαι — drive away, chase; pres. inf. mid., epic (cf. Attic διώκειν) · also pres. inf. mid. or pass., ’to be driven off’ (σταθμοῖο δίεσθαι ’to be driven from the steading’; sense not certain)
glossary.δείδοικας: δείδω — fear, dread; perf. 2 sg. with present force, epic (= Attic δέδοικας): ’you fear’
glossary.δεξί: δεξιός — on the right; neut. acc. pl., elided (δεξί’ = δεξιά), used adverbially: ’to the right’
glossary.εἰδείη: οἶδα — know; perf. opt. 3 sg. (εἰδείη), in a relative clause of characteristic: ’might know’
glossary.εἴξωσι: εἴκω — yield, give way; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., in a future condition: ’give way’
glossary.ζόφον: ζόφος — gloom, darkness (esp. of the west, where the sun sets); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θέλγε: θέλγω — charm, enchant, beguile; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθελγε): ’was enchanting’
glossary.θεοπρόπος: θεοπρόπος — seer, prophet (one who declares the god’s will); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θύελλαν: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κάββαλ: καταβάλλω — throw down, let fall; aor. 3 sg. in tmesis: κάββαλ’ = κατὰ βάλε run together (κατά assimilated before β), unaugmented, elided
glossary.καταλείψομεν: καταλείπω — leave behind; fut. 1 pl. act.: ’we shall leave behind’
glossary.κελευτιόωντ: κελευτιάω — give orders, urge on (from κελεύω); pres. part. masc. nom. dual, elided, epic -ιόωντε (= Attic κελευτιῶντε)
glossary.κλάγξας: κλάζω — screech, shriek, cry out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having screamed’
glossary.κονίην: κονία — dust; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η for Attic α (= Attic κονίαν)
glossary.κρόσσας: κρόσσαι — stepped ledges or battlements of a wall-tower (exact sense uncertain); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κτεινώμεθα: κτείνω — kill; pass. be killed; pres. subj. 1 pl. pass./mid., in a concession: ’(even if) we are killed’
glossary.κόσμῳ: κόσμος — order, good order; masc. dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’in order’
glossary.λήθετο: λανθάνω (mid. λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλήθετο): ’was forgetting, forgot’
glossary.λαθέσθαι: λανθάνω (mid. λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to forget’
glossary.μένωνα: Μένων — Menon, a warrior slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μαχήμων: μαχήμων — warlike, eager for battle; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with κραδίη
glossary.μεμαῶσιν: μέμονα — be eager, be set on; perf. part. (present sense) masc. dat. pl. μεμαῶσι(ν): ’eager’
glossary.μενεδήϊος: μενεδήϊος — standing firm against the enemy (μένω + δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with κραδίη
glossary.μερμήριζον: μερμηρίζω — ponder, be in doubt, debate with oneself; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.μεσήεις: μεσήεις — middling, of middle rank; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετατρέπομ: μετατρέπομαι — turn oneself to, pay heed to (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg. mid., elided μετατρέπομ’ = μετατρέπομαι, usually with a negative
glossary.νείκεον: νεικέω — rebuke, revile, quarrel with; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.), epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐνείκουν)
glossary.οἰωνοῖσι: οἰωνός — bird (esp. a bird of omen); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.οἰωνὸς: οἰωνός — bird of omen, omen; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πέλωρον: πέλωρ — monster, portent; neut. acc. sg., a noun in apposition to a masc. noun (the adjective πέλωρος ’monstrous’ would be masc. here)
glossary.πέτετο: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’was flying, flew’
glossary.παρφάμενος: πάρφημι (παράφημι) — talk over, win over with words; aor. part. mid., syncopated (= παραφάμενος), masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πειθοίατο: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο): ’might obey’
glossary.πειρήτιζον: πειρητίζω — try, make trial of, attempt; impf. 3 pl., epic by-form of πειράω; + inf.: ’were trying to’
glossary.περησέμεναι: περάω — pass over, cross, pass through; fut. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic περάσειν): ’to cross’
glossary.πνοιῇς: πνοιή — breath, blast; fem. dat. pl., Ionic η for Attic α (= Attic πνοαῖς)
glossary.πουλυδάμα: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, Hector’s Trojan counsellor; masc. voc. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Attic Πολυδάμα)
glossary.προβλῆτας: προβλής — jutting out, projecting; fem. acc. pl. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with στήλας
glossary.πρώτας: πρῶτος — first, foremost; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with στήλας: ’the first (laid)’
glossary.πύλωνα: Πύλων — Pylon, a warrior slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.στήλας: στήλη — upright block, pillar, post; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.στερεοῖς: στερεός — firm, hard, stiff; neut. dat. pl., agreeing with ἐπέεσσι: ’hard’
glossary.τανυπτερύγεσσι: τανυπτέρυξ — long-winged, with outspread wings; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -ξι), agreeing with οἰωνοῖσι
glossary.τεράων: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic τεράτων)
glossary.τετράφθω: τρέπω — turn; perf. imper. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’let him be turned’, i.e. ’let him turn back’
glossary.τεῖχός: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.φέρεν: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε): ’was bringing’
glossary.φοινήεντα: φοινήεις — blood-red, bloody; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δράκοντα
glossary.φοιτήτην: φοιτάω — go to and fro, range about; impf. 3 dual, epic -ήτην (= Attic ἐφοιτάτην): ’the two went to and fro’
glossary.φράξαντες: φράσσω — fence in, cover over, protect; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having covered’
glossary.φραζομένῳ: φράζομαι — consider, plan, ponder; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(me) planning’
glossary.χαλκοπαρῄου: χαλκοπάρῃος — bronze-cheeked; fem. gen. sg. (two-ending adj.), agreeing with κυνέης
glossary.χερειότερος: χερείων — worse, inferior; masc. nom. sg., comparative with extended ending -ότερος (= Attic χείρων)
glossary.ἀέξειν: ἀέξω — increase, make grow, strengthen; pres. inf. act.: ’to increase’
glossary.ἀγορῇσιν: ἀγορή — assembly, public meeting; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἀγοραῖς)
glossary.ἀεὶ: ἀεί — always, ever; adv. (epic also αἰεί)
glossary.ἀντιφάτην: Ἀντιφάτης — Antiphates, a warrior slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀποτρέψεις: ἀποτρέπω — turn away, turn back (+ gen. ’from’); fut. 2 sg. act.: ’you will turn away’
glossary.ἀπωσαμένους: ἀπωθέω — push away, thrust back; aor. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’having thrust back’
glossary.ἀσπαίροντα: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀφέηκε: ἀφίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., epic ἀφέηκε (= Attic ἀφῆκε): ’let go’
glossary.ἀφέξεαι: ἀπέχω (mid. ἀπέχομαι) — hold off from, abstain from (+ gen.); fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀφέξῃ)
glossary.ἅπασι: ἅπας — all, every one, the whole; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἐέργων: εἴργω — shut in, hem in, keep back; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐέργω (= Attic εἴργω)
glossary.ἐλευσόμεθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. 1 pl. mid. (ἐλεύσομαι), elided: ’we shall go’
glossary.ἐμόχλεον: μοχλέω — pry up, lever up; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμόχλουν)
glossary.ἐνιπρήσειν: ἐμπίμπρημι (ἐνιπίμπρημι) — set on fire, burn; fut. inf. act. (ἐνιπρήσω): ’to burn’
glossary.ἐπάλξεις: ἔπαλξις — battlement, parapet; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐπιπλήσσεις: ἐπιπλήσσω — rebuke, chide, reproach; pres. 2 sg. (+ dat. of person)
glossary.ἐρρίγησαν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver with fear; aor. 3 pl., epic (augment with doubled ρ)
glossary.ἐτέλεσσε: τελέω — complete, accomplish, bring to pass; aor. 3 sg., epic -εσσε (= Attic ἐτέλεσε)
glossary.ἑοῖσιν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. dat. pl., agreeing with τεκέεσσιν: ’his own’
glossary.ἔλποντο: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; impf. 3 pl. mid. (deponent)
glossary.ἔρειπον: ἐρείπω — throw down, tear down, demolish; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἔρυον: ἐρύω — drag, pull, haul; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were dragging’
glossary.ἔσχεθεν: ἔχω — have, hold, hold back; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form ending -θε(ν) (= ἔσχε): ’held back, withstood’
glossary.ἔχματα: ἔχμα — support, prop, foundation (ἔχω ’hold’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἰδνωθεὶς: ἰδνόω — bend, bow; pass. bend oneself; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having bent (back)’
glossary.ἰόντας: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’going’
glossary.ἱππόμαχον: Ἱππόμαχος — Hippomachus, son of Antimachus, slain at the wall; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴδοιεν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 pl. act., in a past general clause after a relative: ’whomever they saw’
glossary.ἴωσι: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 3 pl., in an indirect alternative question after εἴτε: ’whether they go’
glossary.ἵεσθε: ἵημι (mid. ἵεμαι) — send; mid. hurry, rush, press on; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’press on!’
glossary.ὀλέσσεις: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; fut. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλεῖς): ’you will lose’
glossary.ὀτρύνοντες: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁμοκλητῆρος: ὁμοκλητήρ — one who calls out sharply, a rebuker or urger (ὁμοκλέω); masc. gen. sg., object of ἀκούσας
glossary.ὄπαζε: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give as a companion; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπόπαζε): ’kept granting’
glossary.ὄφιν: ὄφις — snake, serpent; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑποκρίναιτο: ὑποκρίνομαι — answer, interpret (of a sign); aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would interpret’
glossary.ῥήγνυσθαι: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; pres. inf. mid./pass.: ’to break through’
glossary.ῥηξόμεθα: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; fut. 1 pl. mid., ’we shall break through’ (the wall, for ourselves)
glossary.ῥινοῖσι: ῥινός — hide, skin; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ῥῆξ: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst through; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided ῥῆξ’ = ῥῆξε (= Attic ἔρρηξε)
glossary.αὐτόφι: αὐτόφι — at the very spot, close by (αὐτός + epic suffix -φι; = Attic αὐτοῦ); adv., after παρά: ’right beside (them)’
glossary.βώσαντι: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg., epic βώσαντι (= Attic βοήσαντι): ’(for him) having shouted’
glossary.βώτορας: βώτωρ — herdsman, shepherd; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.γεγωνεῖν: γεγωνέω — call out, make oneself heard (beside perf. γέγωνα); pres. inf. act., after ἔην: ’to make oneself heard’
glossary.γλαῦκε: Γλαῦκος — Glaucus, Lycian ally of Sarpedon, son of Hippolochus; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.διηνεκέσιν: διηνεκής — unbroken, continuous; masc./fem. dat. pl., with ν-movable (= διηνεκέσι)
glossary.δούρεσσι: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δόρασι): ’with spears’
glossary.εἰσορόωσι: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. indic. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶσι): ’they look on’ · also pres. part. dat. pl. (= Attic εἰσορῶσι): ’(to them) looking at’
glossary.εἴλυται: εἰλύω — wrap, cover over; perf. mid.-pass. 3 sg.: ’is wrapped, is covered’
glossary.εὕρῃσι: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic εὕρῃ), in a condition with εἰ … κε: ’he finds’
glossary.ζαχρηεῖς: ζαχρηής — very violent, impetuous (traditional sense; ζα- intensive, the rest of the word obscure); masc. nom. pl., uncontracted ζαχρηέες
glossary.θαμειαὶ: θαμέες (fem. θαμειαί) — close-set, crowded, thick; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.θοώτην: Θοώτης — Thoötes, a herald; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θοῆς: θοός — swift, quick; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.θοῶτα: Θοώτης — Thoötes, a herald; masc. voc. sg., in address
glossary.θωρηκτάων: θωρηκτής — wearing a corselet, corseleted; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.κέχυται: χέω — pour; perf. mid.-pass. 3 sg.: ’has been poured, lies spread out’
glossary.καθύπερθ: καθύπερθε(ν) — above, on top, from above; adv., elided (καθύπερθ’ = καθύπερθε)
glossary.καλύψῃ: καλύπτω — cover, veil; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after ὄφρα, of the result aimed at: ’it may cover’
glossary.κοιμήσας: κοιμάω — lull to sleep, put to rest; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lulled to sleep’
glossary.κορυφὰς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κύκλον: κύκλος — circle, ring; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λίθοι: λίθος — stone; masc. nom. pl., also construed as fem. (λίθοι … αἱ μέν ’some of the stones’)
glossary.λιμέσιν: λιμήν — harbour, anchorage; masc. dat. pl., with ν-movable (= λιμέσι)
glossary.λυκίοισι: Λύκιοι — the Lycians; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λυκομήδης: Λυκομήδης — Lycomedes, a Greek leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λωτοῦντα: λωτόεις — abounding in lotus, lotus-grown; neut. acc. pl., contracted (λωτοῦντα = λωτόεντα)
glossary.μέλλοιμεν: μέλλω — be about to, be going to (+ inf.); pres. opt. 1 pl., in a condition with εἰ: ’we were going to’
glossary.μέμονε: μέμονα — be eager, be minded (+ inf.); perf. 3 sg. with present force: ’he is minded, is bent on’
glossary.μέτα: μετά — among, amid; prep. + dat., accent thrown back when it stands after its noun (anastrophe): ’among’
glossary.μενεσθῆος: Μενεσθεύς — Menestheus, the Athenian leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.νεμόμεσθα: νέμω — mid. hold, possess, enjoy (land); pres. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic νεμόμεθα): ’we hold’
glossary.νιφέμεν: νίφω — snow; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic νίφειν): ’to snow’
glossary.πάπτηνεν: παπταίνω — look about, glance around; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἐπάπτηνε): ’looked around’
glossary.πανδίων: Πανδίων — Pandion, a companion of Teucer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεδία: πεδίον — plain, flat land; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πειρήσοντα: πειράω — try, make trial of (+ gen.); fut. part. act. masc. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to make trial of’
glossary.πειρῶντο: πειράομαι — try, attempt (+ inf.); impf. 3 pl. mid., contracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐπειρῶντο): ’were trying’
glossary.πιφαυσκόμενος: πιφαύσκω — declare, make known, show; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’showing, making plain’
glossary.προβοῶντε: προβοάω — cry out loudly, shout forth; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual, contracted (προβοῶντε = προβοάοντε)
glossary.προσπλάζον: προσπλάζω — wash up against, beat upon (πρός + πλάζω ’drive, buffet’); pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg.: ’washing up against’
glossary.πρώονας: πρών — spur, jutting ridge, foothill; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πυροφόροιο: πυροφόρος — wheat-bearing; masc./fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πωτῶντο: πωτάομαι (ποτάομαι) — fly, flit about; impf. 3 pl. mid., contracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐποτῶντο): ’flew’
glossary.σακέων: σάκος — shield; neut. gen. pl., uncontracted (= Attic σακῶν)
glossary.σπέσθω: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid. (σπέσθω = Attic ἑπέσθω, zero-grade stem σπ-): ’let him follow’
glossary.στέλλοιμι: στέλλω — send, dispatch; pres. opt. 1 sg. act., potential with κε: ’I would send’
glossary.σταθμοῖο: σταθμός — stall, fold, steading (also door-post, jamb); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), of separation
glossary.σχόμενος: ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold; mid. hold before oneself; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., stem σχ-: ’having held (before him)’
glossary.τετεύξεται: τεύχω — make ready, prepare, bring about; fut. perf. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’will have been prepared’
glossary.τετιμήμεσθα: τιμάω — honour; perf. 1 pl. mid.-pass., epic -μεσθα (= Attic τετιμήμεθα): ’we have been honoured’
glossary.τεῦκρόν: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, Greek archer, half-brother of Ajax; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τινάσσων: τινάσσω — shake, brandish; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’brandishing’
glossary.τρυφαλειῶν: τρυφάλεια — helmet (of uncertain derivation); fem. gen. pl.
glossary.τῇδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in this place, at this spot’
glossary.φυγόντε: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two of us having escaped’
glossary.φυλάσσοντας: φυλάσσω — guard, watch over; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl.: ’guarding’
glossary.χαλκεὺς: χαλκεύς — smith, bronze-worker; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χειμερίῳ: χειμέριος — wintry, of winter; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.χρυσείῃς: χρύσειος — golden, of gold; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic χρυσαῖς)
glossary.ἀγήρω: ἀγήρως — ageless, never growing old; masc. nom. dual
glossary.ἀγοί: ἀγός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀθανάτω: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. dual
glossary.ἀκλεέες: ἀκλεής — without glory, inglorious; masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀκλεεῖς)
glossary.ἀκορήτω: ἀκόρητος — insatiable, never having enough (+ gen.); masc. nom./acc. dual
glossary.ἀκταῖς: ἀκτή — headland, foreland, shore; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀμύναι: ἀμύνω — ward off (harm from), defend; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., epic -αι (= Attic ἀμύνειε), in a relative clause of characteristic: ’might ward off’
glossary.ἀντιάσητον: ἀντιάω — meet, encounter, take part in (+ gen.); aor. subj. 2 dual act., after ὄφρα: ’you two may meet’
glossary.ἀντιόω: ἀντιάω (ἀντιόω) — meet, face (+ gen.); pres. subj. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἀντιῶ), with future force: ’I shall meet’
glossary.ἀπείρητος: ἀπείρητος — untried, without trial or experience; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’without making trial’
glossary.ἀρὴν: ἀρή — bane, ruin, harm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄγοντε: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two leading’
glossary.ἄκρους: ἄκρος — topmost, high, outermost; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐβάλοντο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put together, join; aor. 3 pl. mid., augmented, with σύν in tmesis (σὺν … ἐβάλοντο = συνεβάλοντο): ’they joined, set to’
glossary.ἐξήλατον: ἐξήλατος — beaten out, wrought (of metal); masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπειγομένοισι: ἐπείγω — press hard, urge; pass. be hard pressed; pres. part. mid.-pass. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐπιδευὴς: ἐπιδευής — in want, lacking (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπώχατο: ἐπέχω (?) — shut, bar (of gates; stem ὀχ- ’hold fast’, derivation uncertain); plpf. mid.-pass. 3 pl., epic -ατο for -ντο: ’had been shut’
glossary.ἐρεμνῇ: ἐρεμνός — dark, black, dusky; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐρρήξαντο: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; aor. 3 pl. mid., augmented with doubled ρ: ’broke (for themselves)’
glossary.ἐρύκεται: ἐρύκω — hold back, check; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’holds back, is held back’
glossary.ἐσελθεῖν: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. inf. act., epic ἐσ- (= Attic εἰσελθεῖν): ’to get in’
glossary.ἐφεστᾶσιν: ἐφίστημι — set upon; intrans. perf. stand over, hang over; perf. 3 pl. act. (ἐφεστᾶσιν = ἐφεστήκασι): ’stand over’
glossary.ἑσταότας: ἵστημι — set up; perf. stand; perf. part. masc. acc. pl., epic ἑσταότας (= Attic ἑστῶτας): ’standing’
glossary.ἔβρισαν: βρίθω — be heavy, press heavily; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’weighed down, pressed hard’
glossary.ἔδουσί: ἔδω — eat; pres. 3 pl. act. (= Attic ἐσθίουσι), accented before an enclitic: ’they eat’
glossary.ἔξαιτον: ἔξαιτος — specially chosen, choice, picked out; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔσσεσθ: εἰμί — be; fut. inf., epic ἔσσεσθαι (= Attic ἔσεσθαι), elided: ’to be’
glossary.ἔσχετο: ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold; mid. hold before oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’held (before him)’
glossary.ἕλιξιν: ἕλιξ — twisting, curved, rolling (of cattle, perhaps ’curved-horned’ or ’rolling-gaited’; sense disputed); masc./fem. dat. pl.
glossary.ἡμέτεροι: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἥρπαξε: ἁρπάζω — snatch, seize, carry off; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’snatched’
glossary.ἱπποκόμων: ἱπποκόμος — with horsehair (plume), horsehair-crested; masc./fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἱστάμενοι: ἵστημι — mid. stand, take one’s stand; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’standing’
glossary.ἶσοι: ἶσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
glossary.ὀρέξομεν: ὀρέγω — stretch out, hold out, grant; fut. 1 pl. act.: ’we shall reach out, we shall grant’
glossary.ὀρεσίτροφος: ὀρεσίτροφος — mountain-nurtured, mountain-bred; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀτρύνετον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. imper. 2 dual act.: ’you two urge on’
glossary.ὀϊλιάδην: Ὀϊλιάδης — son of Oileus (the lesser Ajax); masc. acc. sg., patronymic
glossary.ὄπατρος: ὄπατρος — of the same father, born of the same father; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπαλύξαι: ὑπαλύσκω — escape from under, slip away from; aor. inf. act.: ’to escape’
glossary.ὑψηλῶν: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ὤρετο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented, + inf.: ’bestirred himself, set himself (to)’
glossary.ᾖε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
glossary.ῥάβδοισι: ῥάβδος — rod, stick; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ῥάψε: ῥάπτω — stitch, sew together; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔρραψε): ’stitched’
glossary.ῥήξαντες: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having broken through’
glossary.ῥήξασθαι: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; aor. inf. mid., with διά in tmesis (διὰ … ῥήξασθαι = διαρρήξασθαι): ’to break through’
glossary.ῥίγησ: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver (with fear); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (ῥίγησ’ = ῥίγησε): ’shuddered’
